import uuid

from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q


class Tenant(models.Model):
    class Kind(models.TextChoices):
        PERSONAL = "personal", "Personal"
        BUSINESS = "business", "Business"

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = "active", "Active"
        SUSPENDED = "suspended", "Suspended"
        DELETION_PENDING = "deletion_pending", "Deletion pending"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Kind.choices)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=100, null=True, blank=True, unique=True)
    personal_owner = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="personal_tenant",
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=16,
        choices=Status.choices,
        default=Status.ACTIVE,
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=(
                    Q(kind="personal", personal_owner__isnull=False)
                    | Q(kind="business", personal_owner__isnull=True)
                ),
                name="tenant_kind_personal_owner_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    status__in=["active", "suspended", "deletion_pending"]
                ),
                name="tenant_status_valid_check",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["kind", "status"], name="tenant_kind_status_idx"),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Membership(models.Model):
    class Role(models.TextChoices):
        OWNER = "owner", "Owner"
        ADMIN = "admin", "Admin"
        MEMBER = "member", "Member"

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = "active", "Active"
        INVITED = "invited", "Invited"
        SUSPENDED = "suspended", "Suspended"
        REVOKED = "revoked", "Revoked"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        Tenant,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="memberships",
    )
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="tenant_memberships",
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Role.choices)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=16,
        choices=Status.choices,
        default=Status.ACTIVE,
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "user"],
                name="membership_tenant_user_uniq",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(role__in=["owner", "admin", "member"]),
                name="membership_role_valid_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    status__in=["active", "invited", "suspended", "revoked"]
                ),
                name="membership_status_valid_check",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["user", "status"], name="membership_user_status_idx"),
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "status", "role"],
                name="membership_tenant_role_idx",
            ),
        ]


class QuotaAccount(models.Model):
    class Scope(models.TextChoices):
        TENANT = "tenant", "Tenant"
        MEMBER = "member", "Member"
        WORKSPACE = "workspace", "Workspace"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        Tenant,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="quota_accounts",
    )
    scope = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Scope.choices)
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="member_quota_accounts",
    )
    limit_bytes = models.BigIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    workspace = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Workspace", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="quota_accounts",
    )
    plan = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.StoragePlan", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        related_name="assignments",
    )
    used_bytes = models.BigIntegerField(default=0)
    reserved_bytes = models.BigIntegerField(default=0)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=(
                    Q(scope="tenant", user__isnull=True, workspace__isnull=True)
                    | Q(scope="member", user__isnull=False, workspace__isnull=True)
                    | Q(scope="workspace", user__isnull=True, workspace__isnull=False)
                ),
                name="quota_scope_user_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(limit_bytes__isnull=True) | Q(limit_bytes__gte=0),
                name="quota_limit_nonnegative_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(used_bytes__gte=0),
                name="quota_used_nonnegative_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(reserved_bytes__gte=0),
                name="quota_reserved_nonnegative_check",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant"],
                condition=Q(scope="tenant"),
                name="quota_tenant_scope_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["workspace"],
                condition=Q(scope="workspace"),
                name="quota_workspace_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "id"],
                name="quota_tenant_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "user"],
                condition=Q(scope="member"),
                name="quota_member_scope_uniq",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["tenant", "user"], name="quota_tenant_user_idx"),
        ]


class Workspace(models.Model):
    """A collaboration area contained within one tenant."""

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = "active", "Active"
        ARCHIVED = "archived", "Archived"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        Tenant,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="workspaces",
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=100)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    default_member_role = models.CharField(
        max_length=16,
        choices=(("viewer", "Viewer"), ("editor", "Editor")),
        default="viewer",
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=16,
        choices=Status.choices,
        default=Status.ACTIVE,
    )
    is_default = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        related_name="created_workspaces",
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "slug"],
                name="workspace_tenant_slug_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "id"],
                name="workspace_tenant_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant"],
                condition=Q(is_default=True),
                name="workspace_one_default_per_tenant",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(status__in=["active", "archived"]),
                name="workspace_status_valid_check",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["tenant", "status"], name="workspace_tenant_status_idx"),
        ]
        ordering = ["name", "id"]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.tenant.name} / {self.name}"


class WorkspaceMembership(models.Model):
    class Role(models.TextChoices):
        ADMIN = "admin", "Workspace admin"
        EDITOR = "editor", "Editor"
        VIEWER = "viewer", "Viewer"

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = "active", "Active"
        REVOKED = "revoked", "Revoked"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    workspace = models.ForeignKey(
        Workspace,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="member_assignments",
    )
    membership = models.ForeignKey(
        Membership,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="workspace_assignments",
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Role.choices, default=Role.VIEWER)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.ACTIVE)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        related_name="created_workspace_memberships",
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["workspace", "membership"],
                name="workspace_member_pair_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["workspace", "id"],
                name="workspace_member_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(role__in=["admin", "editor", "viewer"]),
                name="workspace_member_role_valid",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(status__in=["active", "revoked"]),
                name="workspace_member_status_valid",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["workspace", "status", "role"], name="workspace_member_role_idx"),
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.workspace_id and self.membership_id:
            workspace_tenant_id = Workspace.objects.filter(pk=self.workspace_id).values_list("tenant_id", flat=True).first()
            membership_tenant_id = Membership.objects.filter(pk=self.membership_id).values_list("tenant_id", flat=True).first()
            if workspace_tenant_id is not None and membership_tenant_id is not None and workspace_tenant_id != membership_tenant_id:
                from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
                raise ValidationError("Workspace and member must belong to the same tenant.")
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

"""Tenant-scoped organization quota allocations. No cross-tenant administration."""
from django.db import transaction
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from rest_framework.authentication import SessionAuthentication
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, authentication_classes, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response

from accounts.api_views import require_csrf
from accounts.models import Membership, QuotaAccount, QuotaAuditEvent, Tenant, Workspace
from accounts.quota_admin_api import MAX_BYTES, _summary


def _administrator(user, tenant_id):
    tenant = Tenant.objects.filter(
        pk=tenant_id, kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, status=Tenant.Status.ACTIVE,
    ).first()
    if tenant is None or not getattr(user, "is_active", False):
        return None
    member = Membership.objects.filter(
        tenant=tenant, user=user, status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        role__in=[Membership.Role.OWNER, Membership.Role.ADMIN],
    ).first()
    return tenant if member is not None else None


@require_csrf
@api_view(["GET", "PATCH"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def organization_quota_view(request, tenant_id):
    tenant = _administrator(request.user, tenant_id)
    if tenant is None:
        return Response({"detail": "Organization quota is unavailable."}, status=404)
    if request.method == "GET":
        rows = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(tenant=tenant).select_related("user", "workspace").order_by("scope", "id")
        return Response({"quotas": [
            {"scope": q.scope,
             "target_id": str(q.workspace_id or q.user_id or tenant.pk),
             "target": q.workspace.name if q.workspace_id else q.user.get_username() if q.user_id else tenant.name,
             "quota": _summary(q)}
            for q in rows
        ]})
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"scope", "target_id", "limit_bytes", "reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide scope, target_id, limit_bytes and reason."}, status=400)
    scope = data["scope"]
    if scope not in ("tenant", "member", "workspace"):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid quota scope."}, status=400)
    limit = data["limit_bytes"]
    if type(limit) is not int or not 0 <= limit <= MAX_BYTES:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid quota limit."}, status=400)
    reason = data["reason"]
    if not isinstance(reason, str) or not 8 <= len(reason.strip()) <= 500:
        return Response({"detail": "Reason must contain 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    reason = reason.strip()
    target = str(data["target_id"])
    with transaction.atomic():
        if scope == "tenant":
            if target != str(tenant.pk):
                return Response({"detail": "Quota target unavailable."}, status=404)
            q, _ = QuotaAccount.objects.get_or_create(
                tenant=tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
                defaults={"limit_bytes": 0},
            )
        elif scope == "member":
            try:
                member_id = int(target)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                return Response({"detail": "Invalid member ID."}, status=400)
            membership = Membership.objects.filter(tenant=tenant, user_id=member_id, status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE).first()
            if membership is None:
                return Response({"detail": "Organization member unavailable."}, status=404)
            q, _ = QuotaAccount.objects.get_or_create(
                tenant=tenant, user=membership.user, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER,
                defaults={"limit_bytes": 0},
            )
        else:
            try:
                workspace = Workspace.objects.filter(pk=target, tenant=tenant, is_default=False).first()
            except (ValueError, ValidationError):
                return Response({"detail": "Invalid workspace ID."}, status=400)
            if workspace is None:
                return Response({"detail": "Workspace unavailable."}, status=404)
            q = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE).first()
            if q is None:
                return Response({"detail": "Reconcile legacy workspace quota before editing."}, status=409)
        q = QuotaAccount.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=q.pk)
        old, old_plan = q.limit_bytes, q.plan_id or ""
        if old == limit:
            return Response({"quota": _summary(q), "unchanged": True})
        q.limit_bytes = limit
        q.plan = None
        q.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes", "plan", "updated_at"])
        QuotaAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=request.user, quota_account=q, old_limit_bytes=old,
            new_limit_bytes=limit, old_plan_code=old_plan,
            new_plan_code="", reason=reason,
        )
        return Response({"quota": _summary(q)})

"""Centralized authorization for dedicated BlueDrive platform administrators.

A Django staff Superuser is the bootstrap SUPER ADMIN, not a regular admin.
A non-superuser requires an explicit ACTIVE PlatformAdminIdentity.
"""
from django.core.exceptions import ObjectDoesNotExist


def platform_role(user):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active or not user.is_staff:
        return None
    if user.is_superuser:
        return "super_admin"
    try:
        identity = user.platform_admin_identity
    except ObjectDoesNotExist:
        return None
    return "platform_admin" if identity.status == "active" else None


def is_platform_admin(user):
    return platform_role(user) is not None


def is_platform_super_admin(user):
    return platform_role(user) == "super_admin"


================================================================================
FILE: backend\accounts\platform_admin_middleware.py

from django.http import JsonResponse
from .platform_admin import is_platform_admin, is_platform_super_admin
from .session_tracking import record_authenticated_session


class DedicatedPlatformAdminMiddleware:
    """Block dedicated admins from non-admin product APIs (not just the UI).

    This runs after AuthenticationMiddleware and intentionally does not alter
    normal user permissions or Django's own /admin/ routes.
    """
    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        path = request.path_info
        if is_platform_admin(request.user):
            # Only the bootstrap Super Admin may enter Django's /admin/ site;
            # ordinary Platform Admins use the Next.js admin console instead.
            if path.startswith('/admin/') and not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
                return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Django admin access is restricted.'}, status=403)
            # Dedicated admins may only call their admin APIs, inspect their
            # session, or log out. CSRF remains available for sign-in flows.
            allowed = (
                path.startswith('/accounts/api/admin/')
                or path in ('/accounts/api/me/', '/accounts/api/logout/',
                            '/accounts/api/csrf/', '/accounts/api/login/')
                or path.startswith('/admin/')
            )
            if not allowed:
                return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Platform administrators cannot use user/Drive APIs.'}, status=403)
        response = self.get_response(request)
        record_authenticated_session(request)
        return response

"""Provision dedicated platform administrators without promoting Drive users.

Only existing Django staff superusers (Super Admins) can provision or disable.
Invitations are emailed, never returned as a token in API responses or logs.
"""
import logging
from smtplib import SMTPException
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.contrib.auth.password_validation import validate_password
from django.contrib.auth.tokens import default_token_generator
from django.contrib.auth.validators import UnicodeUsernameValidator
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.core.mail import send_mail
from django.db import IntegrityError, transaction
from django.forms import EmailField
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.encoding import force_str
from django.utils.http import urlsafe_base64_decode, urlsafe_base64_encode
from rest_framework.authentication import SessionAuthentication
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, authentication_classes, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import AllowAny, BasePermission
from rest_framework.response import Response

from .api_views import require_csrf
from .models import PlatformAdminAuditEvent, PlatformAdminIdentity
from .platform_admin import is_platform_super_admin
from .session_tracking import revoke_all_database_sessions

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SuperAdminOnly(BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return is_platform_super_admin(request.user)


def _reason_from(body):
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return None
    reason = body.get("reason")
    if not isinstance(reason, str):
        return None
    reason = reason.strip()
    return reason if 8 <= len(reason) <= 500 else None


def _email_administrator_invitation(user):
    """Send only by an explicitly configured email backend; never return tokens."""
    token = default_token_generator.make_token(user)
    uid = urlsafe_base64_encode(force_str(user.pk).encode())
    link = f"{settings.NEXTJS_FRONTEND_URL}/admin-invite?{urlencode({'uid': uid, 'token': token})}"
    send_mail(
        subject="Activate your BlueDrive Platform Administrator account",
        message=(
            f"You have been invited to BlueDrive as a Platform Administrator.\n\n"
            f"Account: {user.get_username()}\n"
            f"Set your password using this one-time link:\n{link}\n\n"
            f"If you did not expect this invitation, ignore the message. "
            f"The link expires automatically."
        ),
        from_email=settings.DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL,
        recipient_list=[user.email], fail_silently=False,
    )


def _email_configuration_error():
    if not getattr(settings, "ADMIN_INVITES_ENABLED", False):
        return Response({"detail": "Administrator invitations are not configured."}, status=503)
    if not getattr(settings, "NEXTJS_FRONTEND_URL", "") or not getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL", ""):
        return Response({"detail": "Administrator invitation email settings are incomplete."}, status=503)
    if not settings.DEBUG and settings.EMAIL_BACKEND in {
        "django.core.mail.backends.console.EmailBackend",
        "django.core.mail.backends.filebased.EmailBackend",
        "django.core.mail.backends.locmem.EmailBackend",
        "django.core.mail.backends.dummy.EmailBackend",
    }:
        return Response({"detail": "A secure email transport is required in production."}, status=503)
    return None


@require_csrf
@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([SuperAdminOnly])
def invite_platform_administrator_view(request):
    config_error = _email_configuration_error()
    if config_error is not None:
        return config_error
    body = request.data
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or set(body) != {"username", "email", "reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide only username, email and reason."}, status=400)
    reason = _reason_from(body)
    if reason is None:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide a reason of 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    username = body.get("username")
    email = body.get("email")
    if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(email, str):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid username or email."}, status=400)
    username, email = username.strip(), email.strip().lower()
    User = get_user_model()
    if not 3 <= len(username) <= User._meta.get_field(User.USERNAME_FIELD).max_length:
        return Response({"detail": "Username must have at least 3 characters."}, status=400)
    try:
        UnicodeUsernameValidator()(username)
        email = EmailField(max_length=254).clean(email)
    except ValidationError:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid username or email."}, status=400)
    if User.objects.filter(username__iexact=username).exists() or User.objects.filter(email__iexact=email).exists():
        return Response({"detail": "The username or email is already registered. Create a separate administrator identity."}, status=409)

    # No plaintext password, no promotion of an existing Drive account.
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            new_user = User.objects.create_user(
                username=username, email=email, password=None,
                is_active=False, is_staff=True, is_superuser=False,
            )
            identity = PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.create(
                user=new_user, invited_by=request.user, status=PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.INVITED,
            )
            _email_administrator_invitation(new_user)
            PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.create(
                actor=request.user, target_user=new_user,
                action=PlatformAdminAuditEvent.Action.INVITE_ADMIN,
                reason=reason,
                metadata={"delivery": "email", "role": "platform_admin"},
            )
    except IntegrityError:
        return Response({"detail": "Account already exists."}, status=409)
    except (SMTPException, OSError, ConnectionError):
        logger.warning("Administrator invitation mail delivery failed (no token logged).")
        return Response({"detail": "Could not deliver the invitation. Check the email configuration and retry."}, status=503)
    return Response({
        "id": new_user.pk, "username": new_user.get_username(),
        "email": email, "role": "platform_admin", "status": identity.status,
        "delivery": "email",
    }, status=201)


@require_csrf
@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([SuperAdminOnly])
def reinvite_platform_administrator_view(request, user_id):
    config_error = _email_configuration_error()
    if config_error is not None:
        return config_error
    if not isinstance(request.data, dict) or set(request.data) != {"reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide a reason."}, status=400)
    reason = _reason_from(request.data)
    if reason is None:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide a reason of 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            user = get_user_model().objects.select_for_update().filter(pk=user_id).first()
            if user is None:
                return Response({"detail": "Account not found."}, status=404)
            if user.is_superuser or not user.is_staff or user.pk == request.user.pk:
                return Response({"detail": "Protected administrator account."}, status=403)
            identity = PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.select_for_update().filter(user=user).first()
            if identity is None or identity.status == PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.ACTIVE:
                return Response({"detail": "Only invited or disabled administrators can be reinvited."}, status=409)
            # Changing the password marker revokes all previously issued links.
            user.is_active = False
            user.set_unusable_password()
            user.save(update_fields=["is_active", "password"])
            identity.status = PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.INVITED
            identity.activated_at = None
            identity.save(update_fields=["status", "activated_at"])
            _email_administrator_invitation(user)
            PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.create(
                actor=request.user, target_user=user,
                action=PlatformAdminAuditEvent.Action.INVITE_ADMIN,
                reason=reason, metadata={"delivery": "email", "resend": True},
            )
    except (SMTPException, OSError, ConnectionError):
        logger.warning("Administrator reinvitation delivery failed (no token logged).")
        return Response({"detail": "Could not deliver the invitation. Retry after checking email settings."}, status=503)
    return Response({"id": user_id, "status": "invited", "delivery": "email"})


@require_csrf
@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([])
@permission_classes([AllowAny])
def accept_platform_administrator_invitation_view(request):
    body = request.data
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or set(body) != {"uid", "token", "password1", "password2"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid invitation request."}, status=400)
    uid, token, password1, password2 = (body.get(key) for key in ("uid", "token", "password1", "password2"))
    if any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in (uid, token, password1, password2)):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid invitation request."}, status=400)
    if not uid or len(uid) > 128 or not token or len(token) > 256:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid invitation link."}, status=400)
    if password1 != password2:
        return Response({"detail": "Passwords do not match."}, status=400)
    try:
        pk = force_str(urlsafe_base64_decode(uid))
        if not pk.isdecimal():
            raise ValueError("Invalid user ID")
    except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OverflowError):
        return Response({"detail": "Invitation is invalid or expired."}, status=400)
    User = get_user_model()
    with transaction.atomic():
        user = User.objects.select_for_update().filter(pk=pk).first()
        if user is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Invitation is invalid or expired."}, status=400)
        identity = PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.select_for_update().filter(user=user).first()
        if (identity is None or identity.status != PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.INVITED
                or user.is_active or not user.is_staff or user.is_superuser
                or user.has_usable_password()
                or not default_token_generator.check_token(user, token)):
            return Response({"detail": "Invitation is invalid or expired."}, status=400)
        try:
            validate_password(password1, user=user)
        except ValidationError as error:
            return Response({"detail": "Choose a stronger password.", "fieldErrors": {"password1": error.messages}}, status=400)
        user.set_password(password1)
        user.is_active = True
        user.save(update_fields=["password", "is_active"])
        identity.status = PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.ACTIVE
        identity.activated_at = timezone.now()
        identity.save(update_fields=["status", "activated_at"])
        PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=user, target_user=user,
            action=PlatformAdminAuditEvent.Action.ACCEPT_ADMIN,
            reason="Administrator accepted a one-time invitation.",
        )
    return Response({"activated": True})


@require_csrf
@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([SuperAdminOnly])
def disable_platform_administrator_view(request, user_id):
    if not isinstance(request.data, dict) or set(request.data) != {"reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide a reason."}, status=400)
    reason = _reason_from(request.data)
    if reason is None:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide a reason of 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    if getattr(settings, "SESSION_ENGINE", "django.contrib.sessions.backends.db") != "django.contrib.sessions.backends.db":
        return Response({"detail": "Administrator session revocation requires Django database sessions."}, status=503)
    with transaction.atomic():
        user = get_user_model().objects.select_for_update().filter(pk=user_id).first()
        if user is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Account not found."}, status=404)
        if user.pk == request.user.pk or user.is_superuser or not user.is_staff:
            return Response({"detail": "Protected administrator account."}, status=403)
        identity = PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.select_for_update().filter(user=user).first()
        if identity is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Not a dedicated administrator."}, status=403)
        if identity.status == PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.DISABLED:
            return Response({"detail": "Account is already disabled."}, status=409)
        identity.status = PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.DISABLED
        identity.save(update_fields=["status"])
        user.is_active = False
        user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save(update_fields=["is_active", "password"])
        revoke_all_database_sessions(user)
        PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=request.user, target_user=user,
            action=PlatformAdminAuditEvent.Action.DISABLE_ADMIN,
            reason=reason,
        )
    return Response({"id": user.pk, "status": "disabled"})

"""Platform quota inventory and controlled allocations; never exposes file content."""
import re
from django.utils.text import slugify

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q, Count
from rest_framework.authentication import SessionAuthentication
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, authentication_classes, permission_classes
from rest_framework.response import Response

from accounts.models import (QuotaAccount, QuotaAuditEvent, StoragePlan, StoragePlanAuditEvent,
    StoragePolicy, StoragePolicyAuditEvent, Tenant, Workspace)
from accounts.admin_api import IsPlatformAdmin, active_collaboration_workspaces
from accounts.platform_admin import is_platform_super_admin
from accounts.api_views import require_csrf

PAGE_SIZE = 20
MAX_BYTES = 10 ** 17


def _page(request):
    try:
        page = int(request.query_params.get("page", "1"))
        return page if 1 <= page <= 100000 else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _summary(row, warning_percent=80, critical_percent=95):
    if row is None:
        return None
    total = row.used_bytes + row.reserved_bytes
    return {
        "id": str(row.pk), "limit_bytes": row.limit_bytes,
        "used_bytes": row.used_bytes, "reserved_bytes": row.reserved_bytes,
        "remaining_bytes": None if row.limit_bytes is None else max(0, row.limit_bytes - total),
        "percentage": None if not row.limit_bytes else round(100 * total / row.limit_bytes, 1),
        "plan_code": row.plan_id,
        "status": "over_quota" if row.limit_bytes is not None and total > row.limit_bytes else
                  "full" if row.limit_bytes is not None and total == row.limit_bytes else
                  "critical" if row.limit_bytes and total * 100 >= critical_percent * row.limit_bytes else
                  "warning" if row.limit_bytes and total * 100 >= warning_percent * row.limit_bytes else "normal",
    }


@api_view(["GET"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_directory_view(request):
    scope = request.query_params.get("scope", "personal")
    if scope not in ("personal", "workspace"):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid storage scope."}, status=400)
    page = _page(request)
    if page is None:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid page."}, status=400)
    query = str(request.query_params.get("q", "")).strip()[:100]
    sort = request.query_params.get("sort", "name_asc")
    sorts = {"name_asc", "name_desc", "newest", "oldest"}
    if sort not in sorts:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid sort."}, status=400)
    policy = StoragePolicy.objects.filter(pk=1).first()
    warning = policy.warning_percent if policy else 80
    critical = policy.critical_percent if policy else 95
    if scope == "personal":
        tenants = Tenant.objects.filter(kind=Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL).select_related("personal_owner")
        if query:
            tenants = tenants.filter(
                Q(personal_owner__username__icontains=query) |
                Q(personal_owner__email__icontains=query)
            )
        ordering = {"name_asc": ("personal_owner__username", "pk"),
                    "name_desc": ("-personal_owner__username", "pk"),
                    "newest": ("-created_at", "pk"), "oldest": ("created_at", "pk")}[sort]
        count = tenants.count()
        rows = list(tenants.order_by(*ordering)[(page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE:page * PAGE_SIZE])
        quotas = {q.tenant_id: q for q in QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant__in=rows, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )}
        results = [{
            "scope": "personal", "id": str(tenant.pk),
            "name": tenant.personal_owner.get_username() if tenant.personal_owner else tenant.name,
            "detail": tenant.personal_owner.email if tenant.personal_owner else "",
            "tenant_status": tenant.status,
            "quota": _summary(quotas.get(tenant.pk), warning, critical),
            "editable": True,
        } for tenant in rows]
    else:
        ws = active_collaboration_workspaces().select_related("tenant")
        if query:
            ws = ws.filter(Q(name__icontains=query) | Q(tenant__name__icontains=query))
        ordering = {"name_asc": ("name", "pk"), "name_desc": ("-name", "pk"),
                    "newest": ("-created_at", "pk"), "oldest": ("created_at", "pk")}[sort]
        count = ws.count()
        rows = list(ws.order_by(*ordering)[(page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE:page * PAGE_SIZE])
        quotas = {q.workspace_id: q for q in QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            workspace__in=rows, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
        )}
        results = [{
            "scope": "workspace", "id": str(workspace.pk), "name": workspace.name,
            "detail": workspace.tenant.name, "tenant_status": workspace.tenant.status,
            "tenant_kind": workspace.tenant.kind,
            "quota": _summary(quotas.get(workspace.pk), warning, critical),
            # Business-owned storage is view-only on the platform. Enterprise
            # allocation must use separate tenant-scoped authorization.
            "editable": workspace.tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL,
        } for workspace in rows]
    return Response({"count": count, "page": page, "page_size": PAGE_SIZE, "results": results})


@api_view(["GET"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_plans_view(request):
    include_inactive = request.query_params.get("include_inactive") == "1"
    plans = StoragePlan.objects.all()
    if not include_inactive:
        plans = plans.filter(is_active=True)
    return Response({"plans": [
        {**_plan_dict(p), "assignments": p.assignment_count}
        for p in plans.annotate(assignment_count=Count("assignments")).order_by("scope", "limit_bytes", "code")
    ]})


def _valid_limit(value):
    return type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= MAX_BYTES


@require_csrf
@api_view(["PATCH"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_update_view(request, quota_id):
    """Super-admin-only write; never silently deletes or reduces stored data."""
    if not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
        return Response({"detail": "Super Admin permission is required."}, status=403)
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"reason", "plan_code", "limit_bytes"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Provide reason, plan_code and limit_bytes."}, status=400)
    reason = data.get("reason")
    if not isinstance(reason, str) or not 8 <= len(reason.strip()) <= 500:
        return Response({"detail": "Reason must contain 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    reason = reason.strip()
    plan_code = data.get("plan_code")
    limit = data.get("limit_bytes")
    if plan_code is not None and (not isinstance(plan_code, str) or not plan_code.strip()):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid plan code."}, status=400)
    if plan_code is None and not _valid_limit(limit):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid quota limit."}, status=400)
    with transaction.atomic():
        row = (
            QuotaAccount.objects
            .select_for_update()
            .filter(pk=quota_id)
            .first()
        )
        if row is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Quota account unavailable."}, status=404)
        if row.tenant.kind != Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL or row.scope not in (QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT, QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE):
            return Response({"detail": "Organization allocations must be managed by the organization administrator."}, status=403)
        if row.scope == QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE and (row.workspace is None or row.workspace.is_default):
            return Response({"detail": "Invalid quota scope."}, status=400)
        plan = None
        if plan_code is not None:
            plan = StoragePlan.objects.filter(code=plan_code, is_active=True).first()
            if plan is None:
                return Response({"detail": "Plan unavailable."}, status=400)
            required = StoragePlan.Scope.PERSONAL if row.scope == QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT else StoragePlan.Scope.WORKSPACE
            if plan.scope != required:
                return Response({"detail": "Plan scope mismatch."}, status=400)
            limit = plan.limit_bytes
        policy = StoragePolicy.objects.filter(pk=1).first()
        warning = policy.warning_percent if policy else 80
        critical = policy.critical_percent if policy else 95
        if row.limit_bytes == limit and row.plan_id == (plan.code if plan else None):
            return Response({"quota": _summary(row, warning, critical), "unchanged": True})
        old_limit, old_plan = row.limit_bytes, row.plan_id or ""
        row.limit_bytes = limit
        row.plan = plan
        row.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes", "plan", "updated_at"])
        QuotaAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=request.user, quota_account=row,
            old_limit_bytes=old_limit, new_limit_bytes=limit,
            old_plan_code=old_plan, new_plan_code=plan.code if plan else "",
            reason=reason,
        )
        return Response({"quota": _summary(row, warning, critical)})

         "new_limit_bytes": e.new_limit_bytes, "old_plan_code": e.old_plan_code,
         "new_plan_code": e.new_plan_code, "reason": e.reason}
        for e in rows
    ]})


def _reason(data):
    value = data.get("reason")
    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) and 8 <= len(value.strip()) <= 500 else None


def _plan_dict(plan):
    return {"code": plan.code, "name": plan.name, "scope": plan.scope,
            "limit_bytes": plan.limit_bytes, "is_active": plan.is_active}


@require_csrf
@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_plan_create_view(request):
    """Create a new non-billing quota preset; immutable code and scope."""
    if not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
        return Response({"detail": "Super Admin permission is required."}, status=403)
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"code", "name", "scope", "limit_bytes", "reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid plan fields."}, status=400)
    code, name, scope, limit = data["code"], data["name"], data["scope"], data["limit_bytes"]
    if (not isinstance(code, str) or not 2 <= len(code) <= 48 or slugify(code) != code or
            not isinstance(name, str) or not 2 <= len(name.strip()) <= 80 or
            scope not in (StoragePlan.Scope.PERSONAL, StoragePlan.Scope.WORKSPACE) or
            not _valid_limit(limit) or not _reason(data)):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid code, name, scope, limit or reason."}, status=400)
    with transaction.atomic():
        if StoragePlan.objects.filter(pk=code).exists():
            return Response({"detail": "Plan code already exists."}, status=409)
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.create(code=code, name=name.strip(), scope=scope, limit_bytes=limit)
        StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.create(actor=request.user, plan_code=code,
            action="created", before={}, after=_plan_dict(plan), reason=_reason(data))
    return Response({"plan": _plan_dict(plan)}, status=201)


@require_csrf
@api_view(["PATCH"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_plan_update_view(request, code):
    if not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
        return Response({"detail": "Super Admin permission is required."}, status=403)
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"name", "limit_bytes", "is_active", "reason"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid plan fields."}, status=400)
    if (not isinstance(data["name"], str) or not 2 <= len(data["name"].strip()) <= 80 or
            not _valid_limit(data["limit_bytes"]) or type(data["is_active"]) is not bool or not _reason(data)):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid plan values or reason."}, status=400)
    with transaction.atomic():
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.select_for_update().filter(pk=code).first()
        if plan is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Plan unavailable."}, status=404)
        if code in {"free", "workspace-starter"} and data["is_active"] is False:
            return Response({"detail": "Baseline plans must remain active."}, status=409)
        before = _plan_dict(plan)
        plan.name = data["name"].strip()
        plan.limit_bytes = data["limit_bytes"]
        plan.is_active = data["is_active"]
        after = _plan_dict(plan)
        if before != after:
            plan.save(update_fields=["name", "limit_bytes", "is_active", "updated_at"])
            StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.create(actor=request.user, plan_code=code,
                action="updated", before=before, after=after, reason=_reason(data))
    # Existing allocations preserve their limit_bytes. Future plan assignments use the new preset.
    return Response({"plan": after, "existing_allocations_unchanged": True})



# The two baseline presets always stay available. Additional presets are
# removable when unused; assignments to legacy presets are never erased.
BASELINE_PLANS = frozenset({"free", "workspace-starter"})


@require_csrf
@api_view(["DELETE"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_plan_delete_view(request, code):
    if not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
        return Response({"detail": "Super Admin permission is required."}, status=403)
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"reason"} or not _reason(data):
        return Response({"detail": "Reason must contain 8–500 characters."}, status=400)
    if code in BASELINE_PLANS:
        return Response({"detail": "Free and Workspace Starter are protected baseline plans."}, status=409)
    with transaction.atomic():
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.select_for_update().filter(pk=code).first()
        if plan is None:
            return Response({"detail": "Plan unavailable."}, status=404)
        if QuotaAccount.objects.filter(plan_id=code).exists():
            return Response({"detail": "Plan is assigned to quota accounts. Disable it first; existing allocations must be preserved."}, status=409)
        before = _plan_dict(plan)
        # Audit must not FK to the deleted plan; only the code and snapshot remain.
        plan.delete()
        StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=request.user, plan_code=code, action="deleted",
            before=before, after={}, reason=_reason(data),
        )
    return Response(status=204)

@require_csrf
@api_view(["PATCH"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsPlatformAdmin])
def quota_policy_update_view(request):
    if not is_platform_super_admin(request.user):
        return Response({"detail": "Super Admin permission is required."}, status=403)
    data = request.data
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"warning_percent", "critical_percent", "reason"} or not _reason(data):
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid quota policy fields or reason."}, status=400)
    warning, critical = data["warning_percent"], data["critical_percent"]
    if type(warning) is not int or type(critical) is not int or not 1 <= warning < critical <= 100:
        return Response({"detail": "Require 1 <= warning < critical <= 100."}, status=400)
    with transaction.atomic():
        StoragePolicy.objects.get_or_create(pk=1)
        policy = StoragePolicy.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=1)
        before = {"warning_percent": policy.warning_percent, "critical_percent": policy.critical_percent}
        after = {"warning_percent": warning, "critical_percent": critical}
        if before != after:
            policy.warning_percent = warning
            policy.critical_percent = critical
            policy.save(update_fields=["warning_percent", "critical_percent", "updated_at"])
            StoragePolicyAuditEvent.objects.create(
                actor=request.user, old_limit=None, new_limit=None,
                before=before, after=after, reason=_reason(data),
            )
    return Response(after)

from django.db import transaction

from accounts.models import Membership, QuotaAccount, StoragePlan, Tenant, WorkspaceMembership
from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
from accounts.platform_admin import is_platform_admin


def starting_storage_plan(scope):
    """Read the currently configured baseline preset for new allocations.

    This is deliberately strict: a missing/inactive baseline must not silently
    allocate unlimited storage or a second hard-coded quota value.
    """
    plan_code = {
        StoragePlan.Scope.PERSONAL: "free",
        StoragePlan.Scope.WORKSPACE: "workspace-starter",
    }.get(scope)
    if plan_code is None:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported starting storage scope.")
    try:
        return StoragePlan.objects.get(code=plan_code, scope=scope, is_active=True)
    except StoragePlan.DoesNotExist as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Required baseline storage plan '{plan_code}' is missing or inactive. "
            "Check Storage Plans before provisioning new storage."
        ) from exc


@transaction.atomic
def get_personal_tenant(user):
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False) or user.pk is None:
        raise ValueError("A saved authenticated user is required.")

    if user.is_staff or user.is_superuser or is_platform_admin(user):
        raise PermissionError("Platform administrators cannot provision personal drives.")

    tenant, _ = Tenant.objects.get_or_create(
        personal_owner=user,
        defaults={
            "kind": Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL,
            "name": f"{user.get_username()}'s Drive"[:255],
            "status": Tenant.Status.ACTIVE,
        },
    )
    Membership.objects.get_or_create(
        tenant=tenant,
        user=user,
        defaults={
            "role": Membership.Role.OWNER,
            "status": Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        },
    )
    
    workspace = get_default_workspace(tenant)
    WorkspaceMembership.objects.get_or_create(
        workspace=workspace,
        membership=Membership.objects.get(tenant=tenant, user=user),
        defaults={
            "role": WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN,
            "status": WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
        },
    )

    # Resolve the plan only when an allocation is missing; returning users
    # keep their previously assigned plan and storage limit unchanged.
    if not QuotaAccount.objects.filter(tenant=tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT).exists():
        plan = starting_storage_plan(StoragePlan.Scope.PERSONAL)
        QuotaAccount.objects.get_or_create(
            tenant=tenant,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
            defaults={
                "plan": plan,
                "limit_bytes": plan.limit_bytes,
                "used_bytes": 0,
                "reserved_bytes": 0,
            },
        )

    return tenant

FILE: backend\accounts\session_tracking.py

"""Best-effort inventory of authenticated DB-backed sessions.

The inventory begins after this feature is installed. An unexpired Django
session is NOT proof that a user is currently online; `last_seen_at` represents
the last authenticated HTTP request observed by this middleware.
"""
import logging
from datetime import timedelta

from django.contrib.sessions.models import Session
from django.db import DatabaseError
from django.utils import timezone

from .models import TrackedAccountSession

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
ONLINE_WINDOW = timedelta(minutes=5)
TRACKING_INTERVAL = timedelta(seconds=60)


def record_authenticated_session(request):
    user = getattr(request, "user", None)
    session_key = getattr(getattr(request, "session", None), "session_key", None)
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active or not session_key:
        return
    now = timezone.now()
    try:
        session = Session.objects.filter(pk=session_key, expire_date__gt=now).first()
        if session is None:
            # First login response: SessionMiddleware has not saved its row yet.
            return
        observed, created = TrackedAccountSession.objects.get_or_create(
            session=session,
            defaults={
                "user": user,
                "user_agent": request.META.get("HTTP_USER_AGENT", "")[:255],
            },
        )
        if not created and observed.user_id == user.pk and observed.last_seen_at <= now - TRACKING_INTERVAL:
            TrackedAccountSession.objects.filter(pk=observed.pk).update(last_seen_at=now)
    except DatabaseError:
        # Do not bring down every user request if migration has not run yet or
        # the optional activity inventory is temporarily unavailable.
        logger.warning("Account session tracking unavailable", exc_info=True)


def revoke_all_database_sessions(user):
    """Revoke tracked AND legacy Django database sessions for a user.

    Scan is needed because Django's default Session model lacks a user index.
    For large deployments replace this with an indexed session registry and a
    complete migration/backfill plan. Do not silently skip older sessions.
    """
    keys = []
    for session in Session.objects.iterator(chunk_size=500):
        decoded = session.get_decoded()
        if str(decoded.get("_auth_user_id", "")) == str(user.pk):
            keys.append(session.pk)
    # Avoid mutating a QuerySet while its server-side cursor is still open.
    for start in range(0, len(keys), 500):
        Session.objects.filter(pk__in=keys[start:start + 500]).delete()

"""Self-service APIs for personal activity, quota, privacy, and data deletion."""
from django.contrib.auth.hashers import check_password
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.authentication import SessionAuthentication
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, authentication_classes, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response

from accounts.access import get_default_tenant, get_default_workspace, resolve_request_workspace
from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, Tenant
from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant
from files.models import File
from files.permanent_delete import PermanentDeleteError, permanently_delete_files
from folders.models import Folder
from logs.models import ActivityLog, SearchHistory


def _selected_workspace(request):
    try:
        tenant = get_default_tenant(request.user)
        workspace = resolve_request_workspace(request, tenant)
    except Exception:
        return None, None
    if workspace is None:
        return None, None
    return workspace.tenant, workspace


@api_view(["GET"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def my_quota_view(request):
    tenant, workspace = _selected_workspace(request)
    if tenant is None or workspace is None:
        return Response({"detail": "An accessible workspace is required."}, status=404)

    # Shared workspaces have a separate quota, visible to authorized members;
    # do not reveal personal My Drive usage to collaborators.
    if not workspace.is_default:
        from accounts.access import can_access_workspace
        if not can_access_workspace(request.user, workspace):
            return Response({"detail": "Workspace unavailable."}, status=404)
        ws_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
        ).first()
        if ws_quota is None:
            return Response({
                "workspaceId": str(workspace.pk), "tenantName": tenant.name,
                "configured": False, "limitBytes": None, "usedBytes": None,
                "reservedBytes": None, "remainingBytes": None, "percentUsed": None,
                "message": "Workspace quota is not initialized. Ask a platform administrator to reconcile quota data.",
            })
        total = ws_quota.used_bytes + ws_quota.reserved_bytes
        limit = ws_quota.limit_bytes
        return Response({
            "workspaceId": str(workspace.pk), "tenantName": tenant.name,
            "configured": True, "scope": "workspace",
            "limitBytes": limit, "usedBytes": ws_quota.used_bytes,
            "reservedBytes": ws_quota.reserved_bytes,
            "remainingBytes": None if limit is None else max(0, limit - total),
            "percentUsed": None if not limit else min(100, round(100 * total / limit)),
            "updatedAt": ws_quota.updated_at,
        })

    # Personal-tenant owners see their own tenant quota. Guests do not see the
    # owner's aggregate usage because that includes private My Drive data. For
    # business tenants, upload enforcement requires both tenant and member caps.
    member_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
        tenant=tenant,
        scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER,
        user=request.user,
    ).first()
    is_personal_owner = (
        tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL
        and tenant.personal_owner_id == request.user.pk
    )
    tenant_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
        tenant=tenant,
        scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
    ).first()

    context = {
        "workspaceId": str(workspace.pk),
        "tenantName": tenant.name,
    }

    if tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL and not is_personal_owner:
        # Uploads in a shared personal workspace consume the owner's tenant
        # quota. That aggregate includes the owner's private My Drive, so it is
        # intentionally not exposed to collaborators; individual usage is not
        # yet tracked for personal-tenant guests.
        message = (
            "Shared workspace storage is charged to the owner's plan. "
            "Individual usage is not currently tracked or displayed."
        )
        if tenant_quota is None:
            message = (
                "The workspace owner has not configured shared storage quota. "
                "Uploads may be unavailable until the owner configures storage."
            )
        return Response({
            **context,
            "configured": False,
            "limitBytes": None,
            "usedBytes": None,
            "reservedBytes": None,
            "remainingBytes": None,
            "percentUsed": None,
            "message": message,
        })

    if tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS:
        if tenant_quota is None:
            return Response({
                **context,
                "configured": False,
                "limitBytes": None,
                "usedBytes": None,
                "reservedBytes": None,
                "remainingBytes": None,
                "percentUsed": None,
                "message": "Organization storage quota is not configured; uploads are unavailable until an administrator configures it.",
            })
        if member_quota is None:
            return Response({
                **context,
                "configured": False,
                "limitBytes": None,
                "usedBytes": None,
                "reservedBytes": None,
                "remainingBytes": None,
                "percentUsed": None,
                "message": "An administrator must allocate a member quota before you can upload to this organization workspace.",
            })
        quota = member_quota
    else:
        quota = tenant_quota

    if quota is None:
        return Response({
            **context,
            "configured": False,
            "limitBytes": None,
            "usedBytes": 0,
            "reservedBytes": 0,
            "remainingBytes": None,
            "percentUsed": None,
            "message": "Storage quota is not configured.",
        })

    def summary(account):
        limit_bytes = account.limit_bytes
        used_bytes = max(0, int(account.used_bytes))
        reserved_bytes = max(0, int(account.reserved_bytes))
        remaining = None if limit_bytes is None else max(0, int(limit_bytes) - used_bytes - reserved_bytes)
        percent = None if not limit_bytes else min(100, round((used_bytes + reserved_bytes) * 100 / limit_bytes))
        return {
            "limitBytes": limit_bytes,
            "usedBytes": used_bytes,
            "reservedBytes": reserved_bytes,
            "remainingBytes": remaining,
            "percentUsed": percent,
        }

    result = {
        **context,
        "configured": True,
        "scope": quota.scope,
        **summary(quota),
        "updatedAt": quota.updated_at,
    }
    # Business uploads reserve against both the member allocation and the
    # organization cap. Surface both so the sidebar does not imply that a
    # member can use more than the organization's remaining capacity.
    if tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS and tenant_quota is not None:
        result["organizationCap"] = summary(tenant_quota)
    return Response(result)


def _history_window(request, default=50):
    """Bounds-check untrusted pagination params for history endpoints."""
    try:
        limit = int(request.query_params.get("limit", str(default)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        limit = default
    try:
        offset = int(request.query_params.get("offset", "0"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        offset = 0
    return max(1, min(limit, 100)), max(0, min(offset, 100000))


@api_view(["GET"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def my_activity_view(request):
    limit, offset = _history_window(request)
    action_filter = str(request.query_params.get("action", "all")).strip().upper()
    if action_filter not in {"ALL", ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD, ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD}:
        return Response({"detail": "Invalid activity action filter."}, status=400)
    rows = ActivityLog.objects.filter(user=request.user).exclude(
        action=ActivityLog.Action.SEARCH,
    )
    if action_filter != "ALL":
        rows = rows.filter(action=action_filter)
    rows = list(rows.select_related("tenant", "workspace").order_by(
        "-created_at", "-pk",
    )[offset:offset + limit + 1])
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    return Response({"hasMore": has_more, "events": [
        {
            "id": row.pk,
            "action": row.action,
            "actionLabel": row.get_action_display(),
            "description": row.description,
            "tenantName": row.tenant.name if row.tenant_id else None,
            "workspaceId": str(row.workspace_id) if row.workspace_id else None,
            "workspaceName": row.workspace.name if row.workspace_id else None,
            "createdAt": row.created_at,
            "metadata": row.metadata if isinstance(row.metadata, dict) else {},
        }
        for row in rows[:limit]
    ]})


@api_view(["GET", "DELETE"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def my_search_history_view(request):
    history = SearchHistory.objects.filter(user=request.user)
    if request.method == "DELETE":
        deleted_count, _ = history.delete()
        return Response({"deletedCount": deleted_count})

    limit, offset = _history_window(request)
    rows = list(history.select_related("workspace").order_by(
        "-created_at", "-pk",
    )[offset:offset + limit + 1])
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    return Response({"hasMore": has_more, "items": [
        {
            "id": row.pk,
            "query": row.query,
            "resultCount": row.result_count,
            "workspaceName": row.workspace.name if row.workspace_id else None,
            "createdAt": row.created_at,
        }
        for row in rows[:limit]
    ]})


@api_view(["POST"])
@authentication_classes([SessionAuthentication])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def delete_my_drive_data_view(request):
    if not isinstance(request.data, dict) or set(request.data) != {"confirmation", "password"}:
        return Response({"detail": "Confirmation and current password are required."}, status=400)
    if request.data.get("confirmation") != "DELETE MY DRIVE":
        return Response({"detail": "Type DELETE MY DRIVE exactly to confirm."}, status=400)
    password = request.data.get("password")
    if not isinstance(password, str) or not password or not check_password(password, request.user.password):
        return Response({"detail": "The current password is incorrect."}, status=403)

    # This action is intentionally restricted to the user's private default
    # workspace. It does not delete shared workspace content, the account, or
    # the retained security audit log.
    personal_tenant = get_personal_tenant(request.user)
    workspace = get_default_workspace(personal_tenant)
    drive_files = list(File.objects.filter(
        tenant=personal_tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        owner=request.user,
    ))
    folder_count = Folder.objects.filter(
        tenant=personal_tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        owner=request.user,
    ).count()

    try:
        deleted_files = permanently_delete_files(drive_files)
    except PermanentDeleteError:
        # Keep adapter/object references and lower-level storage details in the
        # server logs, not in a self-service response returned to the client.
        return Response({
            "detail": "Some storage objects could not be deleted. The request was stopped so it can be retried safely.",
        }, status=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)

    Folder.objects.filter(
        tenant=personal_tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        owner=request.user,
    ).delete()

    ActivityLog.objects.create(
        user=request.user,
        tenant=personal_tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        action=ActivityLog.Action.DELETE_MY_DRIVE_DATA,
        description="Permanently deleted all files and folders in My Drive.",
        metadata={"filesDeleted": deleted_files, "foldersDeleted": folder_count},
    )
    return Response({
        "detail": "My Drive data was permanently deleted.",
        "filesDeleted": deleted_files,
        "foldersDeleted": folder_count,
        "auditLogRetained": True,
    })

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db.models.signals import post_save
from django.dispatch import receiver

from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant, starting_storage_plan
from accounts.platform_admin import is_platform_admin


@receiver(post_save, sender=get_user_model())
def create_personal_tenant_for_new_user(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    # Provisioned admins are created inactive with an unusable password.
    # They are staff before the first post_save, so they must never receive
    # the ordinary user's Personal Tenant during invitation.
    if created and not instance.is_staff and not instance.is_superuser:
        get_personal_tenant(instance)


from accounts.models import Membership, Tenant, WorkspaceMembership
from accounts.access import get_default_workspace


@receiver(post_save, sender=Membership)
def ensure_default_workspace_for_new_membership(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    if not created:
        return
    # A membership added to another user's personal tenant (for example when
    # accepting a Workspace invitation) must not grant access to its private
    # default/My Drive workspace. Business members also receive no implicit
    # access to a workspace; grants must be explicit and least-privilege.
    tenant = instance.tenant
    if tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.PERSONAL and tenant.personal_owner_id != instance.user_id:
        return
    if instance.role == Membership.Role.MEMBER:
        return
    if instance.status == Membership.Status.REVOKED:
        assignment_status = WorkspaceMembership.Status.REVOKED
    else:
        assignment_status = WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE
    workspace = get_default_workspace(instance.tenant)
    role = (
        WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN
        if instance.role in (Membership.Role.OWNER, Membership.Role.ADMIN)
        else WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR
    )
    WorkspaceMembership.objects.get_or_create(
        workspace=workspace,
        membership=instance,
        defaults={"role": role, "status": assignment_status},
    )


@receiver(post_save, sender="accounts.Workspace")
def provision_new_workspace_quota(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    """Assign Workspace Starter to newly created non-default workspaces."""
    if created and not instance.is_default:
        from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, StoragePlan
        plan = starting_storage_plan(StoragePlan.Scope.WORKSPACE)
        QuotaAccount.objects.get_or_create(
            tenant=instance.tenant, workspace=instance,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
            defaults={"plan": plan, "limit_bytes": plan.limit_bytes},
        )

"""Ensure private history is ordered and paginated without hiding older actions."""

from datetime import timedelta

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone

from logs.models import ActivityLog, SearchHistory


class ActivityHistoryPaginationTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(username="history-paging-user", password="test-123!")
        self.other = User.objects.create_user(username="history-paging-other", password="test-123!")
        self.client.force_login(self.user)

    def test_activity_is_newest_first_across_pages_and_excludes_search_audit(self):
        older = ActivityLog.objects.create(user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD, description="older upload")
        newer = ActivityLog.objects.create(user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD, description="newer download")
        ActivityLog.objects.filter(pk=older.pk).update(created_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(days=2))
        ActivityLog.objects.create(user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.SEARCH, description="legacy search")
        ActivityLog.objects.create(user=self.other, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD, description="private other user")
        first = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"limit": "1"}).json()
        second = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"limit": "1", "offset": "1"}).json()
        self.assertEqual([e["id"] for e in first["events"]], [newer.pk])
        self.assertTrue(first["hasMore"])
        self.assertEqual([e["id"] for e in second["events"]], [older.pk])
        self.assertFalse(second["hasMore"])

    def test_search_history_is_private_newest_first_and_paginated(self):
        older = SearchHistory.objects.create(user=self.user, query="old keyword")
        newer = SearchHistory.objects.create(user=self.user, query="new keyword")
        SearchHistory.objects.filter(pk=older.pk).update(created_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(days=2))
        SearchHistory.objects.create(user=self.other, query="other user search")
        first = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-search-history"), {"limit": "1"}).json()
        second = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-search-history"), {"limit": "1", "offset": "1"}).json()
        self.assertEqual([e["query"] for e in first["items"]], ["new keyword"])
        self.assertTrue(first["hasMore"])
        self.assertEqual([e["query"] for e in second["items"]], ["old keyword"])
        self.assertFalse(second["hasMore"])

"""Read-only file metadata authorization / filtering regression tests.

Run: python manage.py test accounts.test_admin_files_api
"""
from datetime import timedelta

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.models import Membership, Tenant, Workspace
from files.models import File, FileVersion, StorageConfig, StorageLocation


class AdminFilesAPITests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.admin = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="platform-file-admin", email="platform@example.test", password="strong-password-123!"
        )
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(
            username="file-owner", email="owner@example.test", password="strong-password-123!"
        )
        # A post_save signal provisions a Personal Tenant and default Workspace
        # for every regular user. Reuse them instead of violating the unique
        # personal_owner and one-default-workspace-per-tenant constraints.
        self.personal = Tenant.objects.get(personal_owner=self.owner)
        self.business = Tenant.objects.create(kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Example Org")
        self.personal_ws = Workspace.objects.get(tenant=self.personal, is_default=True)
        self.independent_ws = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, name="Shared Project", slug="shared-project", is_default=False,
        )
        self.org_ws = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.business, name="Team Assets", slug="team-assets", is_default=True,
        )
        # Files must be owned by a member of the same tenant. The test's
        # organization owner must belong to Example Org before creating files.
        # Creating this membership after org_ws also lets its signal attach the
        # owner to the existing default workspace without creating another one.
        self.business_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.business,
            user=self.owner,
            role=Membership.Role.OWNER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.personal_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, workspace=self.personal_ws, owner=self.owner,
            file_name="report.pdf", file_path="uploads/private-object.pdf",
            file_size=2048, mime_type="application/pdf", hash_sha256="secretchecksum",
        )
        self.workspace_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, workspace=self.independent_ws, owner=self.owner,
            file_name="collaboration-notes.txt", file_size=256, mime_type="text/plain",
        )
        self.org_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.business, workspace=self.org_ws, owner=self.owner,
            file_name="team-photo.png", file_path="uploads/tenant-object.png",
            file_size=8192, mime_type="image/png",
        )
        self.trashed_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, workspace=self.personal_ws, owner=self.owner,
            file_name="old-report.txt", file_size=500, mime_type="text/plain",
            deleted_at=timezone.now(), purge_after=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=30),
        )
        version = FileVersion.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, file=self.personal_file, version_number=1,
            state=FileVersion.State.AVAILABLE, size_bytes=2048,
            is_current=True, sha256="secret-version-checksum",
        )
        storage = StorageConfig.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, provider=StorageConfig.Provider.MINIO,
            endpoint="https://private-minio.example.test", credential_ref="secret-admin-credential",
        )
        StorageLocation.objects.create(
            tenant=self.personal, file_version=version, storage_config=storage,
            object_ref="private/bucket/object-key", state=StorageLocation.State.AVAILABLE,
        )
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_login(self.admin)

    def test_file_inventory_search_scope_and_status(self):
        endpoint = reverse("api-admin-files")
        response = self.client.get(endpoint)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["summary"], {
            "active": 3, "trash": 1, "active_metadata_bytes": 10496,
        })
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"scope": "organization"}).data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"scope": "my_drive"}).data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"scope": "workspace"}).data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"q": "team-photo"}).data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"q": "Example Org"}).data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, {"type": "image"}).data["count"], 1)
        trashed = self.client.get(endpoint, {"status": "trash"}).data
        self.assertEqual(trashed["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(trashed["results"][0]["lifecycle"], "trash")

    def test_file_details_expose_no_contents_or_storage_secrets(self):
        detail = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-file-detail", args=[self.personal_file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(detail.status_code, 200, detail.content)
        self.assertEqual(detail.data["name"], "report.pdf")
        self.assertEqual(detail.data["versions"][0]["storage"][0]["provider"], "minio")
        raw = detail.content.decode("utf-8")
        for secret in (
            "private-object.pdf", "secretchecksum", "secret-version-checksum",
            "private-minio.example.test", "secret-admin-credential", "private/bucket/object-key",
            "wrapped_dek", "encryption_nonce", "download_url",
        ):
            self.assertNotIn(secret, raw)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-files"), {}).status_code, 405)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(reverse("api-admin-file-detail", args=[self.personal_file.pk])).status_code, 405)

    def test_normal_users_cannot_view_other_files_or_admin_inventory(self):
        outsider = APIClient()
        outsider.force_login(self.owner)
        self.assertEqual(outsider.get(reverse("api-admin-files")).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(outsider.get(reverse("api-admin-file-detail", args=[self.org_file.pk])).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(APIClient().get(reverse("api-admin-files")).status_code, 403)

    def test_invalid_filters_and_missing_files(self):
        endpoint = reverse("api-admin-files")
        for filter_args in ({"scope": "unknown"}, {"status": "bad"}, {"page": "zero"},
                            {"sort": "unknown"}, {"workspace_id": "invalid-uuid"},
                            {"owner_id": "admin"}):
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(endpoint, filter_args).status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-file-detail", args=[99999999])).status_code, 404)
