"""Tests for editable quota presets, deletion, quota thresholds and safe activity projection."""
import json
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.core.management import call_command
from io import StringIO
from django.urls import reverse

from accounts.models import (
    StoragePlan, StoragePlanAuditEvent, StoragePolicy, StoragePolicyAuditEvent,
    QuotaAccount, Tenant,
)
from files.models import File
from logs.models import ActivityLog
from logs.services import log_action
from folders.models import Folder


class AdminPlanPolicyTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.admin = User.objects.create_superuser(username="plan-admin", email="padmin@example.test", password="testPass123!")
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(username="plan-owner", email="powner@example.test", password="testPass123!")
        self.tenant = self.owner.personal_tenant
        self.client.force_login(self.admin)

    def test_create_plan_and_audit(self):
        response = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-create"),
            data=json.dumps({"code": "test-quota-plan", "name": "Test Plan", "scope": "personal",
                             "limit_bytes": 123456, "reason": "Create a test preset"}),
            content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.get(pk="test-quota-plan")
        self.assertEqual(plan.limit_bytes, 123456)
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.filter(plan_code=plan.code, action="created").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-create"),
            data=json.dumps({"code": "test-quota-plan", "name": "Test Plan", "scope": "personal",
                             "limit_bytes": 123456, "reason": "Duplicate plan attempt"}),
            content_type="application/json").status_code, 409)

    def test_update_plan_preserves_existing_assignments(self):
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.get(code="development")
        quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT)
        quota.plan = plan
        quota.limit_bytes = 1234
        quota.save(update_fields=["plan", "limit_bytes"])
        response = self.client.patch(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-update", kwargs={"code": plan.code}),
            data=json.dumps({"name": "Dev plan renamed", "limit_bytes": 9999,
                             "is_active": False, "reason": "Change future quota presets"}),
            content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(quota.limit_bytes, 1234)
        self.assertEqual(quota.plan_id, plan.code)
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.filter(plan_code=plan.code, action="updated").exists())

    def test_policy_thresholds_only_and_share_size_payload_rejected(self):
        url = reverse("api-admin-quota-policy-update")
        bad = self.client.patch(url, data=json.dumps({"warning_percent": 95, "critical_percent": 80,
            "reason": "Invalid thresholds attempt"}), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(bad.status_code, 400)
        removed_option = self.client.patch(url, data=json.dumps({"max_personal_file_bytes": 20,
            "warning_percent": 70, "critical_percent": 90,
            "reason": "Removed share-size option"}), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(removed_option.status_code, 400)
        result = self.client.patch(url, data=json.dumps({"warning_percent": 70,
            "critical_percent": 90, "reason": "Update quota warning levels"}), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200)
        policy = StoragePolicy.objects.get(pk=1)
        self.assertEqual(policy.warning_percent, 70)
        self.assertEqual(policy.critical_percent, 90)
        self.assertEqual(StoragePolicyAuditEvent.objects.count(), 1)

    def test_regular_user_cannot_edit_presets_or_policy(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.owner)
        payload = {"code": "bad-plan", "name": "Bad plan", "scope": "personal", "limit_bytes": 100,
                   "reason": "User must not be admin"}
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-create"),
            data=json.dumps(payload), content_type="application/json").status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse("api-admin-quota-policy-update"),
            data=json.dumps({"warning_percent": 80, "critical_percent": 95,
                "reason": "Unauthorized user update"}),
            content_type="application/json").status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-delete", kwargs={"code": "pro"}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Unauthorized delete attempt"}),
            content_type="application/json").status_code, 403)

    def test_delete_unassigned_plan_is_audited(self):
        code = "pro"
        self.assertFalse(QuotaAccount.objects.filter(plan_id=code).exists())
        result = self.client.delete(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-delete", kwargs={"code": code}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Remove unused preset safely"}), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 204)
        self.assertFalse(StoragePlan.objects.filter(pk=code).exists())
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.filter(plan_code=code, action="deleted").exists())

    def test_delete_assigned_plan_is_blocked_without_quota_changes(self):
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.get(pk="development")
        quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT)
        quota.plan = plan
        quota.limit_bytes = 56789
        quota.save(update_fields=["plan", "limit_bytes"])
        result = self.client.delete(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-delete", kwargs={"code": plan.code}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Remove obsolete but assigned plan"}), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 409)
        quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(quota.plan_id, plan.code)
        self.assertEqual(quota.limit_bytes, 56789)
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlan.objects.filter(pk=plan.code).exists())

    def test_baseline_plans_cannot_be_deleted(self):
        for code in ("free", "workspace-starter"):
            response = self.client.delete(reverse("api-admin-quota-plan-delete", kwargs={"code": code}),
                data=json.dumps({"reason": "Preserve baseline allocation plans"}), content_type="application/json")
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 409)

    def test_prune_plans_preserves_assigned_quota_and_baselines(self):
        plan = StoragePlan.objects.get(pk="development")
        quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT)
        quota.plan = plan
        quota.limit_bytes = 123456
        quota.save(update_fields=["plan", "limit_bytes"])
        out = StringIO()
        call_command("prune_storage_plans", stdout=out)
        self.assertIn("DRY RUN", out.getvalue())
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlan.objects.get(pk="pro").is_active)

        call_command("prune_storage_plans", apply=True, actor=self.admin.username, stdout=StringIO())
        self.assertEqual(set(StoragePlan.objects.filter(is_active=True).values_list("code", flat=True)),
                         {"free", "workspace-starter"})
        self.assertFalse(StoragePlan.objects.get(pk="development").is_active)
        self.assertFalse(StoragePlan.objects.filter(pk="pro").exists())
        quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(quota.plan_id, "development")
        self.assertEqual(quota.limit_bytes, 123456)
        self.assertTrue(StoragePlanAuditEvent.objects.filter(plan_code="pro", action="deleted").exists())

    def test_share_size_setting_is_no_longer_enforced(self):
        from sharing.policy import file_share_allowed, folder_share_allowed
        default_space = self.tenant.workspaces.get(is_default=True)
        file = File.objects.create(tenant=self.tenant, owner=self.owner,
            workspace=default_space, file_name="large.bin", file_size=300)
        folder = Folder.objects.create(tenant=self.tenant, owner=self.owner,
            workspace=default_space, folder_name="Uploads")
        policy, _ = StoragePolicy.objects.get_or_create(pk=1)
        policy.max_personal_file_bytes = 1  # Legacy value is ignored.
        policy.save(update_fields=["max_personal_file_bytes"])
        self.assertTrue(file_share_allowed(file))
        self.assertTrue(folder_share_allowed(folder))
        payload = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-quota-policy")).json()
        self.assertNotIn("max_personal_file_bytes", payload)

    def test_activity_share_metadata_is_projected_safely(self):
        log_action(self.owner, ActivityLog.Action.SHARE, "Shared report", metadata={
            "recipient_email": "recipient@example.test", "recipient_username": "recipient",
            "permission": "viewer", "shared_count": 1, "resource_names": ["report.pdf"],
            "private_token": "DO_NOT_EXPOSE"})
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-activity"), {"action": "SHARE"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        event = response.json()["results"][0]
        self.assertEqual(event["share"]["recipient"], "recipient@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(event["share"]["permission"], "viewer")
        self.assertNotIn("private_token", str(event))
        self.assertNotIn("description", event)

"""API regression coverage for read-only User Activity and Admin Audit pages.

Run with: python manage.py test accounts.test_platform_admin_logs -v 2
"""

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase

from logs.models import ActivityLog
from .models import PlatformAdminAuditEvent, PlatformAdminIdentity


class PlatformLogDirectoryTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.super_admin = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="logs-super-admin", email="logs-admin@example.test", password="Admin-Test-Password-2026!"
        )
        self.member = User.objects.create_user(
            username="logs-member", email="logs-member@example.test", password="User-Test-Password-2026!"
        )
        self.admin_user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="logs-regular-admin", email="regular-admin@example.test",
            password="Admin-Test-Password-2026!", is_staff=True, is_active=True,
        )
        PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.create(
            user=self.admin_user, invited_by=self.super_admin,
            status=PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.activity = ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.member,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD,
            description="Private search phrase or file details should not be exposed",
            metadata={"private_token": "DO_NOT_DISCLOSE"},
        )
        self.admin_audit = PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.create(
            actor=self.super_admin, target_user=self.member,
            action=PlatformAdminAuditEvent.Action.SUSPEND,
            reason="Test administrator policy review",
            metadata={"session_key": "DO_NOT_DISCLOSE"},
        )

    def test_previous_search_events_are_not_shown_or_offered_as_filters(self):
        legacy_search = ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.member, action=ActivityLog.Action.SEARCH,
            description="Searched workspace files.",
        )
        self.client.force_login(self.super_admin)
        response = self.client.get("/accounts/api/admin/activity/")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["count"], 1)
        self.assertNotIn(str(legacy_search.pk), {row["id"] for row in response.json()["results"]})
        self.assertNotIn(ActivityLog.Action.SEARCH, {a["value"] for a in response.json()["actions"]})
        self.assertTrue(ActivityLog.objects.filter(pk=legacy_search.pk).exists())

    def test_regular_user_cannot_read_platform_logs(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.member)
        for path in ("/accounts/api/admin/activity/", "/accounts/api/admin/audit/"):
            response = self.client.get(path)
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

    def test_unauthed_users_cannot_read_platform_logs(self):
        for path in ("/accounts/api/admin/activity/", "/accounts/api/admin/audit/"):
            response = self.client.get(path)
            self.assertIn(response.status_code, (401, 403))

    def test_user_activity_search_filter_and_privacy(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.super_admin)
        response = self.client.get("/accounts/api/admin/activity/", {
            "q": "logs-member", "scope": "unassigned", "action": "UPLOAD",
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        body = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(body["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(body["results"][0]["user"], "logs-member")
        self.assertEqual(body["results"][0]["action"], "UPLOAD")
        self.assertNotIn("metadata", body["results"][0])
        self.assertNotIn("description", body["results"][0])
        self.assertNotIn("DO_NOT_DISCLOSE", response.content.decode())
        self.assertNotIn("Private search phrase", response.content.decode())
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/accounts/api/admin/activity/", {"scope": "organization"}).json()["count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post("/accounts/api/admin/activity/").status_code, 405)

    def test_share_details_are_whitelisted_and_old_events_are_unknown(self):
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.member, action=ActivityLog.Action.SHARE,
            metadata={
                "operation": "permission_changed", "recipient_email": "recipient@example.test",
                "recipient_username": "recipient", "permission": "editor",
                "previous_permission": "viewer", "resource_names": ["report.pdf"],
                "resource_kinds": ["file"], "shared_count": 1,
                "internal_secret": "NEVER_EXPOSE_THIS",
            },
        )
        ActivityLog.objects.create(user=self.member, action=ActivityLog.Action.SHARE, description="Old legacy share")
        self.client.force_login(self.super_admin)
        response = self.client.get("/accounts/api/admin/activity/", {"action": "SHARE"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["count"], 2)
        entries = response.json()["results"]
        detailed = next(row for row in entries if row["share"]["operation"] == "permission_changed")
        self.assertEqual(detailed["share"]["recipient"], "recipient@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(detailed["share"]["previous_permission"], "viewer")
        self.assertEqual(detailed["share"]["resources"], ["report.pdf"])
        self.assertNotIn("NEVER_EXPOSE_THIS", response.content.decode())
        legacy = next(row for row in entries if row["share"]["operation"] == "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(legacy["share"]["recipient"], "")

    def test_admin_audit_actions_and_privacy(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.admin_user)
        response = self.client.get("/accounts/api/admin/audit/", {
            "action": "user.suspend", "q": "logs-super-admin",
        })
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        body = response.json()
        self.assertEqual(body["count"], 1)
        event = body["results"][0]
        self.assertEqual(event["actor"], "logs-super-admin")
        self.assertEqual(event["target"], "logs-member")
        self.assertEqual(event["reason"], "Test administrator policy review")
        self.assertNotIn("metadata", event)
        self.assertNotIn("DO_NOT_DISCLOSE", response.content.decode())
        self.assertTrue(any(action["value"] == "admin.invite" for action in body["actions"]))
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post("/accounts/api/admin/audit/").status_code, 405)

    def test_bad_filters_rejected_and_date_filter_works(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.super_admin)
        for endpoint in ("activity", "audit"):
            url = f"/accounts/api/admin/{endpoint}/"
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {"action": "nonexistent"}).status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {"from": "2026-02-31"}).status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {"from": "2026-10-25", "to": "2026-10-24"}).status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {"page": "not-a-number"}).status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {"from": "2099-01-01"}).json()["count"], 0)

"""Phase 02 platform admin behavior; run with Django's database test runner.

    python manage.py test accounts.test_platform_admin_phase2
"""
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.contrib.sessions.models import Session
from django.test import Client, TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.models import PlatformAdminAuditEvent, TrackedAccountSession


class PlatformAdminPhase02Tests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.admin = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="platform-operator", email="operator@example.test", password="Strong-test-password-123!"
        )
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="regular-person", email="regular@example.test", password="Another-test-password-123!"
        )
        self.other = User.objects.create_user(
            username="regular-other", email="other@example.test", password="Another-test-password-456!"
        )
        self.client = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        self.client.force_login(self.admin)
        csrf_response = self.client.get(reverse("api-csrf"))
        self.csrf_header = {"HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN": csrf_response.data["csrfToken"]}

    def post(self, route, payload=None, **kwargs):
        return self.client.post(route, payload or {"reason": "Requested by security review"},
                                format="json", **(kwargs or self.csrf_header))

    def test_suspend_disables_user_and_revokes_old_db_session(self):
        old_client = Client()
        old_client.force_login(self.user)
        old_key = old_client.session.session_key
        self.assertTrue(Session.objects.filter(session_key=old_key).exists())
        response = self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertFalse(self.user.is_active)
        self.assertFalse(Session.objects.filter(session_key=old_key).exists())
        event = PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.get(action="user.suspend")
        self.assertEqual(event.actor_id, self.admin.pk)
        self.assertEqual(event.target_user_id, self.user.pk)

    def test_reactivate_restores_login_not_old_sessions(self):
        old_client = Client()
        old_client.force_login(self.user)
        old_key = old_client.session.session_key
        self.assertEqual(self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk])).status_code, 200)
        response = self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-reactivate", args=[self.user.pk]),
                             {"reason": "Identity reverified by support"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(self.user.is_active)
        self.assertFalse(Session.objects.filter(session_key=old_key).exists())
        self.assertEqual(PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.count(), 2)

    def test_admin_and_staff_accounts_are_protected(self):
        result = self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.admin.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 403)
        self.other.is_staff = True
        self.other.save(update_fields=["is_staff"])
        result = self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.other.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 403)
        self.assertFalse(PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.exists())

    def test_reason_and_csrf_are_required(self):
        missing_csrf = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk]),
                                        {"reason": "Legitimate reason"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(missing_csrf.status_code, 403)
        short_reason = self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk]),
                                 {"reason": "bad"})
        self.assertEqual(short_reason.status_code, 400)
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(self.user.is_active)
        self.assertFalse(PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.exists())

    def test_normal_user_cannot_read_or_mutate_platform_admin_api(self):
        outsider = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        outsider.force_login(self.other)
        self.assertEqual(outsider.get(reverse("api-admin-users")).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(outsider.get(reverse("api-admin-audit")).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(outsider.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk]),
                                      {"reason": "Not authorized"}, format="json").status_code, 403)
        self.user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(self.user.is_active)

    def test_observed_session_can_be_listed_and_revoked(self):
        other_client = Client()
        other_client.force_login(self.user)
        key = other_client.session.session_key
        self.assertEqual(other_client.get(reverse("api-current-account")).status_code, 200)
        session = TrackedAccountSession.objects.get(user=self.user)
        self.assertEqual(session.session_id, key)
        listed = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-sessions"))
        self.assertEqual(listed.status_code, 200, listed.content)
        self.assertIn(str(session.pk), [row["id"] for row in listed.data["results"]])
        revoked = self.post(reverse("api-admin-session-revoke", args=[session.pk]),
                            {"reason": "User requested logout"})
        self.assertEqual(revoked.status_code, 200, revoked.content)
        self.assertFalse(Session.objects.filter(session_key=key).exists())
        self.assertFalse(TrackedAccountSession.objects.filter(pk=session.pk).exists())
        self.assertEqual(PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.filter(action="session.revoke").count(), 1)

    def test_audit_history_tracks_the_actor_and_reason(self):
        self.post(reverse("api-admin-user-suspend", args=[self.user.pk]),
                  {"reason": "Excessive suspicious uploads"})
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-audit"))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        row = response.data["results"][0]
        self.assertEqual(row["actor"], "platform-operator")
        self.assertEqual(row["target"], "regular-person")
        self.assertEqual(row["reason"], "Excessive suspicious uploads")

"""Phase 04: independent administrator provisioning and security boundary.

Run: python manage.py test accounts.test_platform_admin_phase4 -v 2
"""
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.contrib.sessions.models import Session
from django.core import mail
from django.test import Client, TestCase, override_settings
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from .models import PlatformAdminAuditEvent, PlatformAdminIdentity, Tenant
from .platform_admin import is_platform_admin, is_platform_super_admin


@override_settings(
    DEBUG=True,
    ADMIN_INVITES_ENABLED=True,
    NEXTJS_FRONTEND_URL="http://localhost:3000",
    DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL="security@example.test",
    EMAIL_BACKEND="django.core.mail.backends.locmem.EmailBackend",
)
class PlatformAdminPhase04Tests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.root = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="root-operator", email="root@example.test", password="Root-Admin-Test-Password-123!"
        )
        self.normal = User.objects.create_user(
            username="normal-person", email="normal@example.test", password="Regular-Password-Test-123!"
        )
        self.client = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        self.client.force_login(self.root)
        self.csrf_header = {"HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN": self.client.get(reverse("api-csrf")).data["csrfToken"]}

    def invite(self, username="new-platform-admin", email="new.admin@example.test"):
        return self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite"), {
            "username": username, "email": email,
            "reason": "Provision a dedicated security operator account",
        }, format="json", **self.csrf_header)

    def test_super_admin_provisions_separate_inactive_account_without_drive(self):
        response = self.invite()
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
        user = get_user_model().objects.get(username="new-platform-admin")
        self.assertTrue(user.is_staff)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_superuser)
        self.assertFalse(user.is_active)
        self.assertFalse(user.has_usable_password())
        self.assertFalse(Tenant.objects.filter(personal_owner=user).exists())
        self.assertEqual(user.platform_admin_identity.status, PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.INVITED)
        self.assertEqual(len(mail.outbox), 1)
        self.assertNotIn("token", response.data)
        event = PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.get(action="admin.invite")
        self.assertEqual(event.actor_id, self.root.id)
        self.assertEqual(event.target_user_id, user.id)
        self.assertFalse(is_platform_admin(user))

    def test_invitation_activation_is_one_time_and_stays_non_superuser(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.invite().status_code, 201)
        url = next(line for line in mail.outbox[0].body.splitlines() if "/admin-invite?" in line)
        params = parse_qs(urlsplit(url).query)
        new_client = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        csrf = new_client.get(reverse("api-csrf")).data["csrfToken"]
        payload = {
            "uid": params["uid"][0], "token": params["token"][0],
            "password1": "Accepted-Admin-Password-2026!",
            "password2": "Accepted-Admin-Password-2026!",
        }
        accepted = new_client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite-accept"), payload, format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf)
        self.assertEqual(accepted.status_code, 200, accepted.data)
        admin = get_user_model().objects.get(username="new-platform-admin")
        self.assertTrue(admin.is_active)
        self.assertTrue(admin.check_password(payload["password1"]))
        self.assertFalse(admin.is_superuser)
        self.assertTrue(is_platform_admin(admin))
        self.assertFalse(is_platform_super_admin(admin))
        self.assertFalse(Tenant.objects.filter(personal_owner=admin).exists())
        replay = new_client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite-accept"), payload, format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf)
        self.assertEqual(replay.status_code, 400)

        standard_admin = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        standard_admin.force_login(admin)
        other_csrf = standard_admin.get(reverse("api-csrf")).data["csrfToken"]
        self.assertEqual(standard_admin.get(reverse("api-admin-access")).status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(standard_admin.get(reverse("api-admin-files")).status_code, 200)
        cannot_invite = standard_admin.post(reverse("api-admin-invite"), {
            "username": "another", "email": "another@example.test", "reason": "No permission to provision",
        }, format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=other_csrf)
        self.assertEqual(cannot_invite.status_code, 403)

    def test_normal_user_cannot_invite_and_existing_user_cannot_be_promoted(self):
        conflict = self.invite(username=self.normal.username, email="other@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(conflict.status_code, 409)
        conflict_email = self.invite(username="other-account", email=self.normal.email)
        self.assertEqual(conflict_email.status_code, 409)
        regular = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        regular.force_login(self.normal)
        csrf = regular.get(reverse("api-csrf")).data["csrfToken"]
        denied = regular.post(reverse("api-admin-invite"), {
            "username": "illegal", "email": "illegal@example.test", "reason": "Attempt to gain elevated access",
        }, format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf)
        self.assertEqual(denied.status_code, 403)

    def test_disable_standard_admin_revokes_sessions_but_not_bootstrap_admin(self):
        self.invite()
        user = get_user_model().objects.get(username="new-platform-admin")
        user.platform_admin_identity.status = PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.ACTIVE
        user.platform_admin_identity.save(update_fields=["status"])
        user.is_active = True
        user.set_password("Temporary-Admin-Password-2026!")
        user.save(update_fields=["is_active", "password"])
        logged_in = Client()
        logged_in.force_login(user)
        session_key = logged_in.session.session_key
        self.assertTrue(Session.objects.filter(session_key=session_key).exists())
        response = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-disable", args=[user.pk]), {
            "reason": "Administrator no longer needs platform access",
        }, format="json", **self.csrf_header)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
        user.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertFalse(user.is_active)
        self.assertFalse(user.has_usable_password())
        self.assertEqual(user.platform_admin_identity.status, PlatformAdminIdentity.Status.DISABLED)
        self.assertFalse(Session.objects.filter(session_key=session_key).exists())
        self.assertEqual(PlatformAdminAuditEvent.objects.filter(action="admin.disable").count(), 1)
        protected = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-disable", args=[self.root.pk]), {
            "reason": "Should never disable a Super Admin",
        }, format="json", **self.csrf_header)
        self.assertEqual(protected.status_code, 403)

    def test_reinvite_invalidates_old_link_and_preserves_identity(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.invite().status_code, 201)
        user = get_user_model().objects.get(username="new-platform-admin")
        first_link = next(line for line in mail.outbox[-1].body.splitlines() if "/admin-invite?" in line)
        first = parse_qs(urlsplit(first_link).query)
        response = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-reinvite", args=[user.pk]), {
            "reason": "The original invitation expired or was not delivered"
        }, format="json", **self.csrf_header)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
        second_link = next(line for line in mail.outbox[-1].body.splitlines() if "/admin-invite?" in line)
        second = parse_qs(urlsplit(second_link).query)
        self.assertNotEqual(first["token"][0], second["token"][0])
        self.assertEqual(PlatformAdminIdentity.objects.filter(user=user).count(), 1)
        new_client = APIClient(enforce_csrf_checks=True)
        csrf = new_client.get(reverse("api-csrf")).data["csrfToken"]
        payload = {"uid": first["uid"][0], "token": first["token"][0],
                   "password1": "Accepted-Admin-Password-2026!", "password2": "Accepted-Admin-Password-2026!"}
        old_result = new_client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite-accept"), payload,
                                     format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf)
        self.assertEqual(old_result.status_code, 400)
        payload["token"] = second["token"][0]
        new_result = new_client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite-accept"), payload,
                                     format="json", HTTP_X_CSRFTOKEN=csrf)
        self.assertEqual(new_result.status_code, 200, new_result.data)

    @override_settings(ADMIN_INVITES_ENABLED=False)
    def test_invitation_is_disabled_by_default_without_transport(self):
        response = self.invite()
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 503)
        self.assertFalse(get_user_model().objects.filter(username="new-platform-admin").exists())

    def test_mutations_require_csrf(self):
        response = self.client.post(reverse("api-admin-invite"), {
            "username": "missing-csrf", "email": "missing@example.test", "reason": "Provision for legitimate security use",
        }, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)
        self.assertFalse(get_user_model().objects.filter(username="missing-csrf").exists())

"""Regression tests: platform workspace counts exclude internal/default areas."""

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse

from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
from accounts.models import Tenant, Workspace
from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant


class PlatformWorkspaceDirectoryTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.operator = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="directory-operator", email="operator@example.test", password="test-secret-123!"
        )
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(
            username="directory-user", email="user@example.test", password="test-secret-123!"
        )
        personal = get_personal_tenant(self.owner)
        self.default_personal = get_default_workspace(personal)
        self.personal_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=personal, name="test_workspace", slug="test-workspace", created_by=self.owner
        )
        self.archived = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=personal, name="Old Project", slug="old-project", status=Workspace.Status.ARCHIVED
        )
        self.business = Tenant.objects.create(kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Example Corporation")
        self.default_business = get_default_workspace(self.business)
        self.business_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.business, name="Engineering", slug="engineering"
        )
        self.suspended = Tenant.objects.create(
            kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Suspended Corp", status=Tenant.Status.SUSPENDED
        )
        self.suspended_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.suspended, name="Hidden Project", slug="hidden-project"
        )
        self.client.force_login(self.operator)

    def test_directory_returns_only_active_non_default_workspaces(self):
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-workspaces"))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["count"], 2)
        rows = response.json()["results"]
        self.assertEqual(
            {row["id"] for row in rows},
            {str(self.personal_workspace.pk), str(self.business_workspace.pk)},
        )
        self.assertNotIn("is_default", rows[0])
        self.assertTrue(all(row["status"] == "active" for row in rows))

    def test_search_filters_after_excluding_defaults(self):
        result = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-workspaces"), {"q": "General"}).json()
        self.assertEqual(result["count"], 0)
        result = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-workspaces"), {"q": "test_workspace"}).json()
        self.assertEqual(result["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["results"][0]["id"], str(self.personal_workspace.pk))

    def test_overview_and_organization_counts_match_workspace_directory(self):
        summary = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-overview"))
        self.assertEqual(summary.status_code, 200)
        workspaces = summary.json()["workspaces"]
        self.assertEqual(workspaces["total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(workspaces["active"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(workspaces["personal"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(workspaces["organization"], 1)

        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-organizations"))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        counts = {row["name"]: row["workspaces"] for row in response.json()["results"]}
        self.assertEqual(counts["Example Corporation"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(counts["Suspended Corp"], 0)

FILE: backend\accounts\test_quota_management.py

"""Quota scope isolation and least-privilege administrative assignment tests."""
import json
from datetime import timedelta

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, QuotaAuditEvent, StoragePlan, Workspace
from files.models import File, UploadSession
from files.quota import QuotaExceeded, QuotaStateError, reserve_upload_quota, finalize_upload_quota
from files.permanent_delete import permanently_delete_files


class QuotaManagementTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        self.superadmin = User.objects.create_superuser(username="quota-superadmin", email="sup@example.test", password="pass123456")
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(username="quota-owner", email="owner@example.test", password="pass123456")
        self.tenant = self.owner.personal_tenant
        self.my_drive = Workspace.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, is_default=True)
        self.space = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=self.tenant, slug="project", name="Project", created_by=self.owner)
        self.personal_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, scope="tenant")
        self.workspace_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(workspace=self.space, scope="workspace")
        self.personal_quota.limit_bytes = 100
        self.personal_quota.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes"])
        self.workspace_quota.limit_bytes = 60
        self.workspace_quota.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes"])

    def make_upload(self, workspace, size):
        return UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant, workspace=workspace, initiated_by=self.owner,
            client_name="sample.bin", expected_size_bytes=size,
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=1),
        )

    def test_independent_workspace_quota_and_private_drive(self):
        default_upload = self.make_upload(self.my_drive, 70)
        reserve_upload_quota(default_upload.pk, self.owner)
        workspace_upload = self.make_upload(self.space, 50)
        reserve_upload_quota(workspace_upload.pk, self.owner)
        self.personal_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.workspace_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.personal_quota.reserved_bytes, 70)
        self.assertEqual(self.workspace_quota.reserved_bytes, 50)
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceeded):
            reserve_upload_quota(self.make_upload(self.space, 11).pk, self.owner)
        finalize_upload_quota(workspace_upload.pk, completed=True, actual_size_bytes=40, actor=self.owner)
        self.personal_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.workspace_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.personal_quota.used_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.workspace_quota.used_bytes, 40)
        self.assertEqual(self.workspace_quota.reserved_bytes, 0)

    def test_missing_workspace_quota_fails_closed(self):
        self.workspace_quota.delete()
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaStateError):
            reserve_upload_quota(self.make_upload(self.space, 20).pk, self.owner)

    def test_quota_directory_and_plans(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.superadmin)
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-quotas"), {"scope": "workspace"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn(str(self.space.pk), [r["id"] for r in response.json()["results"]])
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-quotas"), {"scope": "personal"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(any(r["quota"] and r["quota"]["id"] == str(self.personal_quota.pk) for r in response.json()["results"]))
        plans = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-quota-plans"))
        self.assertEqual(plans.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(any(p["code"] == "development" for p in plans.json()["plans"]))

    def test_superadmin_can_assign_plan_and_creates_audit_event(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.superadmin)
        result = self.client.patch(
            reverse("api-admin-quota-update", kwargs={"quota_id": self.personal_quota.pk}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Upgrade allocated by administrator", "plan_code": "free", "limit_bytes": None}),
            content_type="application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200)
        self.personal_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.personal_quota.plan_id, "free")
        self.assertEqual(self.personal_quota.limit_bytes, StoragePlan.objects.get(code="free").limit_bytes)
        event = QuotaAuditEvent.objects.get(quota_account=self.personal_quota)
        self.assertEqual(event.actor, self.superadmin)

    def test_regular_user_cannot_read_or_update_platform_quota(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.owner)
        result = self.client.get(reverse("api-admin-quotas"))
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 403)
        result = self.client.patch(
            reverse("api-admin-quota-update", kwargs={"quota_id": self.personal_quota.pk}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Attempt to change another user", "plan_code": None, "limit_bytes": 500}),
            content_type="application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 403)

    def test_invalid_plan_scope_does_not_change_limit(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.superadmin)
        result = self.client.patch(
            reverse("api-admin-quota-update", kwargs={"quota_id": self.workspace_quota.pk}),
            data=json.dumps({"reason": "Trying incorrect package category", "plan_code": "free", "limit_bytes": None}),
            content_type="application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 400)
        self.workspace_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.workspace_quota.limit_bytes, 60)

    def test_legacy_file_without_reservation_releases_scope_usage_on_delete(self):
        file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant, workspace=self.space, owner=self.owner,
            file_name="legacy.txt", file_size=7,
        )
        self.workspace_quota.used_bytes = 7
        self.workspace_quota.save(update_fields=["used_bytes"])
        permanently_delete_files([file])
        self.workspace_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.workspace_quota.used_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.personal_quota.used_bytes, 0)


class OrganizationQuotaAuthorizationTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        from accounts.models import Tenant, Membership
        User = get_user_model()
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(username="org-owner", password="pass123456")
        self.stranger = User.objects.create_user(username="org-outsider", password="pass123456")
        self.employee = User.objects.create_user(username="org-employee", password="pass123456")
        self.organization = Tenant.objects.create(name="Quota Enterprise", kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS)
        Membership.objects.create(tenant=self.organization, user=self.owner, role=Membership.Role.OWNER)
        Membership.objects.create(tenant=self.organization, user=self.employee, role=Membership.Role.MEMBER)
        self.workspace = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=self.organization, name="Engineering", slug="engineering")
        self.quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(workspace=self.workspace, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE)
        self.url = reverse("api-organization-quota", kwargs={"tenant_id": self.organization.pk})

    def test_organization_owner_may_allocate_own_workspace(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.owner)
        response = self.client.patch(self.url, data=json.dumps({
            "scope": "workspace", "target_id": str(self.workspace.pk),
            "limit_bytes": 200 * 1024 * 1024,
            "reason": "Allocating engineering storage",
        }), content_type="application/json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.quota.limit_bytes, 200 * 1024 * 1024)
        self.assertTrue(QuotaAuditEvent.objects.filter(actor=self.owner, quota_account=self.quota).exists())

    def test_non_admin_and_outsider_cannot_edit_quota(self):
        for user in [self.employee, self.stranger]:
            self.client.force_login(user)
            response = self.client.patch(self.url, data=json.dumps({
                "scope": "workspace", "target_id": str(self.workspace.pk),
                "limit_bytes": 900 * 1024 * 1024,
                "reason": "Attempting quota escalation",
            }), content_type="application/json")
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
        self.quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.quota.limit_bytes, 100 * 1024 * 1024)

FILE: backend\accounts\test_saas_workspace_api.py

"""Regression tests for personal SaaS workspaces and email-bound invitations."""

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
from accounts.models import Membership, Workspace, WorkspaceMembership
from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant
from logs.models import ActivityLog


User = get_user_model()


class PersonalSaaSWorkspaceApiTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(
            username="saas-owner",
            email="saas-owner@example.test",
            password="test-password",
        )
        self.member = User.objects.create_user(
            username="saas-invitee",
            email="saas-invitee@example.test",
            password="test-password",
        )
        self.owner_tenant = get_personal_tenant(self.owner)
        self.default_workspace = get_default_workspace(self.owner_tenant)
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)

    def test_create_workspace_keeps_my_drive_separate_and_appears_in_listing(self):
        initial = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-workspaces"))
        self.assertEqual(initial.status_code, 200)
        self.assertNotIn(str(self.default_workspace.pk), {row["id"] for row in initial.data["workspaces"]})

        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-my-workspaces"),
            {
                "name": "Design Studio",
                "description": "Product design collaboration",
                "default_member_role": WorkspaceMembership.Role.VIEWER,
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
        workspace = Workspace.objects.get(pk=response.data["workspace"]["id"])
        self.assertEqual(workspace.tenant_id, self.owner_tenant.pk)
        self.assertFalse(workspace.is_default)
        self.assertTrue(WorkspaceMembership.objects.filter(
            workspace=workspace,
            membership__user=self.owner,
            role=WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN,
            status=WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
        ).exists())
        listed = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-workspaces"))
        self.assertIn(str(workspace.pk), {row["id"] for row in listed.data["workspaces"]})

    def test_invite_is_email_bound_single_use_and_grants_only_selected_workspace(self):
        workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.owner_tenant,
            name="Invite Only",
            slug="invite-only",
            created_by=self.owner,
        )
        owner_membership = Membership.objects.get(tenant=self.owner_tenant, user=self.owner)
        WorkspaceMembership.objects.update_or_create(
            workspace=workspace,
            membership=owner_membership,
            defaults={
                "role": WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN,
                "status": WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
                "created_by": self.owner,
            },
        )
        invite_response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-create-workspace-invite", args=[workspace.pk]),
            {"email": self.member.email, "role": WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(invite_response.status_code, 201, invite_response.data)
        token = invite_response.data["inviteToken"]

        member_client = APIClient()
        member_client.force_authenticate(self.member)
        preview = member_client.get(reverse("api-preview-workspace-invite"), {"token": token})
        self.assertEqual(preview.status_code, 200, preview.data)

        accept = member_client.post(
            reverse("api-accept-workspace-invite"),
            {"token": token},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(accept.status_code, 200, accept.data)
        assignment = WorkspaceMembership.objects.get(
            workspace=workspace,
            membership__user=self.member,
        )
        self.assertEqual(assignment.role, WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR)

        default_workspace = get_default_workspace(self.owner_tenant)
        self.assertFalse(WorkspaceMembership.objects.filter(
            workspace=default_workspace,
            membership__user=self.member,
            status=WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
        ).exists())
        replay = member_client.post(
            reverse("api-accept-workspace-invite"),
            {"token": token},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(replay.status_code, 410)
        self.assertTrue(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            workspace=workspace,
            user=self.member,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.JOIN_WORKSPACE,
        ).exists())

        # Workspace timeline is manager-only: the owner can see the join event,
        # but an Editor cannot inspect the activity of every other member.
        owner_timeline = self.client.get(reverse("api-workspace-activity", args=[workspace.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(owner_timeline.status_code, 200, owner_timeline.data)
        self.assertIn(ActivityLog.Action.JOIN_WORKSPACE, {row["action"] for row in owner_timeline.data["events"]})
        member_timeline = member_client.get(reverse("api-workspace-activity", args=[workspace.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(member_timeline.status_code, 403)

    def test_invitation_cannot_be_accepted_by_a_different_email(self):
        workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.owner_tenant,
            name="Email Restricted",
            slug="email-restricted",
            created_by=self.owner,
        )
        invite = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-create-workspace-invite", args=[workspace.pk]),
            {"email": self.member.email, "role": WorkspaceMembership.Role.VIEWER},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(invite.status_code, 201, invite.data)

        other_user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="wrong-email",
            email="wrong-email@example.test",
            password="test-password",
        )
        other_client = APIClient()
        other_client.force_authenticate(other_user)
        response = other_client.post(
            reverse("api-accept-workspace-invite"),
            {"token": invite.data["inviteToken"]},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)
        self.assertFalse(WorkspaceMembership.objects.filter(
            workspace=workspace,
            membership__user=other_user,
        ).exists())

FILE: backend\accounts\test_self_service_api.py

"""Tests for private account activity, search history and My Drive deletion."""

from unittest.mock import patch

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
from accounts.models import Membership, QuotaAccount, Tenant, Workspace, WorkspaceMembership
from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant
from files.models import File
from folders.models import Folder
from logs.models import ActivityLog, SearchHistory


User = get_user_model()


class SelfServiceApiTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="privacy-user",
            email="privacy-user@example.test",
            password="Correct-password-123!",
        )
        self.other = User.objects.create_user(
            username="other-privacy-user",
            email="other-privacy-user@example.test",
            password="Correct-password-456!",
        )
        self.tenant = get_personal_tenant(self.user)
        self.workspace = get_default_workspace(self.tenant)
        self.other_tenant = get_personal_tenant(self.other)
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.user)

    def test_activity_and_search_history_are_scoped_to_the_authenticated_user(self):
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.user,
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=self.workspace,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.VIEW,
            description="My activity",
        )
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.other,
            tenant=self.other_tenant,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.VIEW,
            description="Other user's activity",
        )
        SearchHistory.objects.create(user=self.user, tenant=self.tenant, workspace=self.workspace, query="private query")
        other_history = SearchHistory.objects.create(user=self.other, tenant=self.other_tenant, query="other query")

        activity = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"))
        self.assertEqual(activity.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("My activity", {row["description"] for row in activity.data["events"]})
        self.assertNotIn("Other user's activity", {row["description"] for row in activity.data["events"]})

        history = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-search-history"))
        self.assertEqual(history.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([row["query"] for row in history.data["items"]], ["private query"])

        cleared = self.client.delete(reverse("api-my-search-history"))
        self.assertEqual(cleared.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(SearchHistory.objects.filter(user=self.user).exists())
        self.assertTrue(SearchHistory.objects.filter(pk=other_history.pk).exists())

    def test_personal_activity_filters_uploads_and_downloads_before_limit(self):
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.user, tenant=self.tenant, workspace=self.workspace,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD, description="Uploaded sample.txt",
        )
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.user, tenant=self.tenant, workspace=self.workspace,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD, description="Downloaded sample.txt",
        )
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.other, tenant=self.other_tenant,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD, description="Other user download",
        )
        ActivityLog.objects.create(
            user=self.user, tenant=self.tenant,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.LOGIN, description="Latest activity",
        )
        uploads = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"action": "UPLOAD", "limit": 1})
        self.assertEqual(uploads.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([event["action"] for event in uploads.data["events"]], ["UPLOAD"])

        downloads = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"action": "DOWNLOAD"})
        self.assertEqual(downloads.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([event["description"] for event in downloads.data["events"]], ["Downloaded sample.txt"])

        invalid = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"action": "DELETE;DROP"})
        self.assertEqual(invalid.status_code, 400)

    def test_shared_personal_workspace_does_not_disclose_owner_tenant_usage(self):
        shared_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            name="Guest collaboration",
            slug="guest-collaboration",
            created_by=self.user,
        )
        guest_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            user=self.other,
            role=Membership.Role.MEMBER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        WorkspaceMembership.objects.create(
            workspace=shared_workspace,
            membership=guest_membership,
            role=WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR,
        )
        # My Drive and collaboration workspaces have independent quotas.
        # New non-default workspaces are provisioned with their own quota.
        QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        ).update(used_bytes=9000, limit_bytes=10000)
        updated = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=shared_workspace,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
        ).update(used_bytes=1300, reserved_bytes=100, limit_bytes=7000)
        self.assertEqual(updated, 1, "Expected automatic workspace quota provisioning")

        self.client.force_authenticate(self.other)
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("api-my-quota"),
            HTTP_X_WORKSPACE_ID=str(shared_workspace.pk),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(response.data["configured"])
        self.assertEqual(response.data["scope"], QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["workspaceId"], str(shared_workspace.pk))
        self.assertEqual(response.data["limitBytes"], 7000)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["usedBytes"], 1300)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["reservedBytes"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["remainingBytes"], 5600)
        self.assertNotIn("organizationCap", response.data)
        self.assertNotIn("tenantQuota", response.data)
        # A guest cannot select the owner's default My Drive workspace.
        private_response = self.client.get(
            reverse("api-my-quota"),
            HTTP_X_WORKSPACE_ID=str(self.workspace.pk),
        )
        self.assertEqual(private_response.status_code, 404)

    def test_business_quota_requires_member_allocation_before_uploads_allowed(self):
        business = Tenant.objects.create(
            kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS,
            name="Quota Organization",
            status=Tenant.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=business,
            user=self.user,
            role=Membership.Role.OWNER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        workspace = get_default_workspace(business)
        QuotaAccount.objects.create(
            tenant=business,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
            limit_bytes=10000,
            used_bytes=100,
            reserved_bytes=0,
        )

        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("api-my-quota"),
            HTTP_X_WORKSPACE_ID=str(workspace.pk),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(response.data["configured"])
        self.assertIn("allocate a member quota", response.data["message"])

    def test_business_quota_reports_member_and_organization_caps(self):
        business = Tenant.objects.create(
            kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS,
            name="Quota Organization With Allocation",
            status=Tenant.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=business,
            user=self.user,
            role=Membership.Role.OWNER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        workspace = get_default_workspace(business)
        QuotaAccount.objects.create(
            tenant=business,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
            limit_bytes=10000,
            used_bytes=7000,
            reserved_bytes=500,
        )
        QuotaAccount.objects.create(
            tenant=business,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER,
            user=self.user,
            limit_bytes=3000,
            used_bytes=400,
            reserved_bytes=100,
        )

        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("api-my-quota"),
            HTTP_X_WORKSPACE_ID=str(workspace.pk),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(response.data["configured"])
        self.assertEqual(response.data["scope"], QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["usedBytes"], 400)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["organizationCap"]["usedBytes"], 7000)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["organizationCap"]["reservedBytes"], 500)

    def test_delete_my_drive_requires_exact_phrase_and_current_password(self):
        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-delete-my-drive-data"),
            {"confirmation": "DELETE MY DRIVE", "password": "wrong-password"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-delete-my-drive-data"),
            {"confirmation": "delete my drive", "password": "Correct-password-123!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_successful_delete_targets_only_private_my_drive_and_keeps_audit(self):
        folder = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=self.workspace,
            owner=self.user,
            folder_name="Delete me",
        )
        drive_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=self.workspace,
            owner=self.user,
            folder=folder,
            file_name="private.txt",
            file_path="uploads/private.txt.enc",
            file_size=12,
            mime_type="text/plain",
        )
        other_folder = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.other_tenant,
            workspace=get_default_workspace(self.other_tenant),
            owner=self.other,
            folder_name="Keep me",
        )
        shared_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            name="Shared project",
            slug="shared-project",
            created_by=self.user,
        )
        shared_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=shared_workspace,
            owner=self.user,
            file_name="shared-project.txt",
            file_path="uploads/shared-project.txt.enc",
            file_size=13,
            mime_type="text/plain",
        )

        def fake_permanent_delete(files):
            files = list(files)
            ids = [item.pk for item in files]
            File.objects.filter(pk__in=ids).delete()
            return len(ids)

        with patch("accounts.settings_api.permanently_delete_files", side_effect=fake_permanent_delete) as delete_mock:
            response = self.client.post(
                reverse("api-delete-my-drive-data"),
                {"confirmation": "DELETE MY DRIVE", "password": "Correct-password-123!"},
                format="json",
            )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["filesDeleted"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(response.data["auditLogRetained"])
        passed_files = list(delete_mock.call_args.args[0])
        self.assertEqual([item.pk for item in passed_files], [drive_file.pk])
        self.assertFalse(File.objects.filter(pk=drive_file.pk).exists())
        self.assertFalse(Folder.objects.filter(pk=folder.pk).exists())
        self.assertTrue(Folder.objects.filter(pk=other_folder.pk).exists())
        self.assertTrue(File.objects.filter(pk=shared_file.pk).exists())
        self.assertTrue(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user,
            workspace=self.workspace,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.DELETE_MY_DRIVE_DATA,
        ).exists())

FILE: backend\accounts\test_starting_storage_plans.py

"""Baseline plan allocation tests for new ordinary users and workspaces."""

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, StoragePlan, Tenant, Workspace
from accounts.services import get_personal_tenant


class StartingStoragePlansTests(TestCase):
    def test_new_regular_user_starts_on_free(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username="free-starter-owner", password="pass123456")
        tenant = get_personal_tenant(owner)
        quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT)
        self.assertEqual(quota.plan_id, "free")
        self.assertEqual(quota.limit_bytes, 10 * 1024 * 1024)
        self.assertEqual(quota.used_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(quota.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertFalse(QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            workspace__tenant=tenant, workspace__is_default=True,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
        ).exists())

    def test_new_workspace_starts_on_starter_for_personal_and_business(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username="workspace-starter-owner", password="pass123456")
        personal = get_personal_tenant(owner)
        business = Tenant.objects.create(kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Starter Organization")
        starter = StoragePlan.objects.get(code="workspace-starter")
        for tenant, slug in ((personal, "personal-project"), (business, "business-project")):
            ws = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=tenant, name=slug, slug=slug, created_by=owner)
            quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(workspace=ws, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE)
            self.assertEqual(quota.plan_id, starter.code)
            self.assertEqual(quota.limit_bytes, starter.limit_bytes)
            self.assertEqual(quota.used_bytes, 0)

    def test_changes_to_plan_size_only_affect_future_allocations(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        first = User.objects.create_user(username="free-existing", password="pass123456")
        old_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(
            tenant=get_personal_tenant(first), scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )
        old_limit = old_quota.limit_bytes
        free = StoragePlan.objects.get(code="free")
        free.limit_bytes = 25 * 1024 * 1024
        free.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes"])
        second = User.objects.create_user(username="free-next", password="pass123456")
        second_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(
            tenant=get_personal_tenant(second), scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )
        old_quota.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(old_quota.limit_bytes, old_limit)
        self.assertEqual(old_quota.plan_id, "free")
        self.assertEqual(second_quota.plan_id, "free")
        self.assertEqual(second_quota.limit_bytes, 25 * 1024 * 1024)

    def test_workspace_plan_change_does_not_retroactively_reassign(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username="starter-existing", password="pass123456")
        tenant = get_personal_tenant(owner)
        first = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=tenant, name="Original", slug="original", created_by=owner)
        first_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(workspace=first)
        original_limit = first_quota.limit_bytes
        starter = StoragePlan.objects.get(code="workspace-starter")
        starter.limit_bytes = 80 * 1024 * 1024
        starter.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes"])
        second = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=tenant, name="New", slug="new", created_by=owner)
        first_quota.refresh_from_db()
        second_quota = QuotaAccount.objects.get(workspace=second)
        self.assertEqual(first_quota.limit_bytes, original_limit)
        self.assertEqual(second_quota.limit_bytes, starter.limit_bytes)
        self.assertEqual(second_quota.plan_id, "workspace-starter")

    def test_platform_admin_does_not_receive_free_drive(self):
        User = get_user_model()
        admin = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username="no-free-for-admin", email="admin@example.test", password="pass123456"
        )
        self.assertFalse(Tenant.objects.filter(personal_owner=admin).exists())

FILE: backend\accounts\test_workspace_api.py

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.access import workspace_role_for_user
from accounts.models import Membership, Tenant, Workspace, WorkspaceMembership
from logs.models import ActivityLog

User = get_user_model()


class WorkspaceApiTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.admin = User.objects.create_user(username="org-admin", password="test-password")
        self.member = User.objects.create_user(username="org-member", password="test-password")
        self.tenant = Tenant.objects.create(kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Example Corporation")
        self.admin_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant, user=self.admin,
            role=Membership.Role.ADMIN, status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.member_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant, user=self.member,
            role=Membership.Role.MEMBER, status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.admin)

    def test_admin_can_create_workspace_and_creator_is_admin(self):
        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-organization-workspaces", args=[self.tenant.pk]),
            {"name": "Engineering", "description": "Engineering documents"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
        workspace = Workspace.objects.get(pk=response.data["workspace"]["id"])
        assignment = WorkspaceMembership.objects.get(
            workspace=workspace, membership=self.admin_membership,
        )
        self.assertEqual(assignment.role, WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN)
        self.assertTrue(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            tenant=self.tenant, user=self.admin,
            action=ActivityLog.Action.CREATE_WORKSPACE,
        ).exists())

    def test_regular_member_cannot_create_workspace(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.member)
        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("api-organization-workspaces", args=[self.tenant.pk]),
            {"name": "Unauthorized"}, format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

    def test_access_requires_direct_workspace_membership(self):
        workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant, name="Engineering", slug="engineering",
        )
        self.assertIsNone(workspace_role_for_user(self.member, workspace))
        assignment = WorkspaceMembership.objects.create(
            workspace=workspace,
            membership=self.member_membership,
            role=WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR,
            status=WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.assertEqual(workspace_role_for_user(self.member, workspace), WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR)
        assignment.status = WorkspaceMembership.Status.REVOKED
        assignment.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        self.assertIsNone(workspace_role_for_user(self.member, workspace))

    def test_workspace_access_does_not_cross_tenants(self):
        other_tenant = Tenant.objects.create(kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS, name="Other Corporation")
        workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=other_tenant, name="Finance", slug="finance",
        )
        self.assertIsNone(workspace_role_for_user(self.member, workspace))
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("api-workspace-members", args=[other_tenant.pk, workspace.pk])
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)

    def test_owner_or_tenant_admin_has_workspace_admin_role(self):
        workspace = Workspace.objects.create(tenant=self.tenant, name="Finance", slug="finance")
        self.assertEqual(workspace_role_for_user(self.admin, workspace), WorkspaceMembership.Role.ADMIN)
        workspace.status = Workspace.Status.ARCHIVED
        workspace.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        self.assertIsNone(workspace_role_for_user(self.admin, workspace))

FILE: backend\accounts\tests.py
