def _shared_drive_items_response(request, query_text=""):
    """Return directly shared roots across all tenants, after per-item authorization.

    A recipient must not need a WorkspaceMembership in the sender's tenant to
    access an item that was explicitly shared with them. Permission helpers
    still verify that the source tenant/workspace and the share chain are live.
    """
    shares = Share.objects.filter(receiver=request.user).select_related(
        "owner", "tenant", "file", "file__owner", "file__folder",
        "folder", "folder__owner",
    ).order_by("-created_at", "pk")

    visible_files = []
    visible_folders = []
    seen_file_ids = set()
    seen_folder_ids = set()

    for share in shares:
        if share.file_id:
            drive_file = share.file
            if drive_file.pk in seen_file_ids or not can_view_file(drive_file, request.user):
                continue
            if query_text and query_text.casefold() not in drive_file.file_name.casefold():
                continue
            seen_file_ids.add(drive_file.pk)
            visible_files.append((share, drive_file))
        elif share.folder_id:
            folder = share.folder
            if folder.pk in seen_folder_ids or not can_view_folder(folder, request.user):
                continue
            if query_text and query_text.casefold() not in folder.folder_name.casefold():
                continue
            seen_folder_ids.add(folder.pk)
            visible_folders.append((share, folder))

    starred_file_ids = set(StarredItem.objects.filter(
        user=request.user, file_id__in=seen_file_ids,
    ).values_list("file_id", flat=True))
    starred_folder_ids = set(StarredItem.objects.filter(
        user=request.user, folder_id__in=seen_folder_ids,
    ).values_list("folder_id", flat=True))

    items = [
        _folder_item(
            folder,
            owner=share.owner.get_username(),
            starred=folder.pk in starred_folder_ids,
            can_manage=False,
        )
        for share, folder in visible_folders
    ]
    items.extend(
        _file_item(
            drive_file,
            owner=share.owner.get_username(),
            starred=drive_file.pk in starred_file_ids,
            can_manage=False,
        )
        for share, drive_file in visible_files
    )
    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item["type"] != "folder", item["name"].casefold(), item["id"]))

    if query_text:
        SearchHistory.objects.create(
            user=request.user,
            query=query_text,
            result_count=len(items),
        )

    return JsonResponse({"items": items, "query": query_text or None})


@login_required
@require_GET
def drive_items_api(request):
    """Return Drive items scoped to an authorized workspace or direct share."""
    view = request.GET.get("view", "drive")
    if view not in {"drive", "recent", "trash", "shared", "starred"}:
        raise Http404
    query_text = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()[:255]

    # Shared with me is intentionally cross-tenant: direct shares are a
    # separate authorization path from workspace membership. Each item is
    # checked by can_view_file/can_view_folder before any metadata is returned.
    if view == "shared":
        return _shared_drive_items_response(request, query_text)

    folder_id = request.GET.get("folder")
    folder = None
    tenant = None
    workspace = None
    if folder_id and view == "drive":
        try:
            folder_id = int(folder_id)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise Http404
        folder = Folder.objects.select_related(
            "tenant", "workspace", "owner", "parent",
        ).filter(pk=folder_id, deleted_at__isnull=True).first()
        # This also allows a recipient to browse a shared folder owned by a
        # different tenant while keeping an unshared folder indistinguishable
        # from a nonexistent one.
        if folder is None or not can_view_folder(folder, request.user):
            raise Http404
        tenant = folder.tenant
        workspace = folder.workspace
    else:
        tenant = get_default_tenant(request.user)
        if tenant is None:
            raise Http404
        workspace = resolve_request_workspace(request, tenant)
        if workspace is None:
            raise Http404
        tenant = workspace.tenant

    starred_entries = StarredItem.objects.filter(
        user=request.user,
        tenant=tenant,
    ).filter(Q(file__workspace=workspace) | Q(folder__workspace=workspace))
    starred_file_ids = set(starred_entries.filter(file__isnull=False).values_list("file_id", flat=True))
    starred_folder_ids = set(starred_entries.filter(folder__isnull=False).values_list("folder_id", flat=True))

    if query_text:
        # Search is scoped to exactly the active workspace; it never queries
        # other tenants/workspaces and permissions are rechecked per result.
        file_rows = list(File.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
            file_name__icontains=query_text,
        ).filter(Q(folder__isnull=True) | Q(folder__deleted_at__isnull=True)).select_related(
            "owner", "folder"
        ).order_by("file_name", "pk")[:200])
        folder_rows = list(Folder.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
            folder_name__icontains=query_text,
        ).filter(Q(parent__isnull=True) | Q(parent__deleted_at__isnull=True)).select_related(
            "owner", "parent"
        ).order_by("folder_name", "pk")[:200])
        items = []
        for row in folder_rows:
            if can_view_folder(row, request.user):
                owner_label = "Me" if row.owner_id == request.user.id else row.owner.get_username()
                items.append(_folder_item(
                    row,
                    owner=owner_label,
                    can_manage=can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, row.workspace),
                    starred=row.pk in starred_folder_ids,
                ))
        for row in file_rows:
            if can_view_file(row, request.user):
                owner_label = "Me" if row.owner_id == request.user.id else row.owner.get_username()
                items.append(_file_item(
                    row,
                    owner=owner_label,
                    can_manage=can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, row.workspace),
                    starred=row.pk in starred_file_ids,
                ))
        items.sort(key=lambda item: (item["type"] != "folder", item["name"].casefold()))
        SearchHistory.objects.create(
            user=request.user,
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            query=query_text,
            result_count=len(items),
        )
    elif view == "starred":
        entries = list(
            starred_entries.select_related(
                "file", "file__folder", "folder", "folder__parent"
            ).order_by("-created_at")
        )
        items = []
        stale_entry_ids = []
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.file_id:
                drive_file = entry.file
                is_live = drive_file.deleted_at is None and (
                    drive_file.folder_id is None or drive_file.folder.deleted_at is None
                )
                is_accessible = (
                    drive_file.tenant_id == tenant.id
                    and drive_file.workspace_id == workspace.pk
                    and can_view_file(drive_file, request.user)
                )
                if is_live and is_accessible:
                    items.append(_file_item(drive_file, starred=True))
                elif drive_file.deleted_at is None and not is_accessible:
                    stale_entry_ids.append(entry.pk)
            elif entry.folder_id:
                folder_item = entry.folder
                is_live = folder_item.deleted_at is None and (
                    folder_item.parent_id is None or folder_item.parent.deleted_at is None
                )
                is_accessible = (
                    folder_item.tenant_id == tenant.id
                    and folder_item.workspace_id == workspace.pk
                    and can_view_folder(folder_item, request.user)
                )
                if is_live and is_accessible:
                    items.append(_folder_item(folder_item, starred=True))
                elif folder_item.deleted_at is None and not is_accessible:
                    stale_entry_ids.append(entry.pk)
        if stale_entry_ids:
            StarredItem.objects.filter(user=request.user, tenant=tenant, pk__in=stale_entry_ids).delete()
    elif view == "trash":
        # Show only top-level trashed entries. Items inside a trashed folder are
        # represented by that folder instead of appearing as duplicate Trash rows.
        folders = Folder.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            deleted_at__isnull=False,
        ).filter(Q(parent__isnull=True) | Q(parent__deleted_at__isnull=True)).select_related(
            "owner"
        ).order_by("-deleted_at", "folder_name")
        files = File.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            deleted_at__isnull=False,
        ).filter(Q(folder__isnull=True) | Q(folder__deleted_at__isnull=True)).select_related(
            "owner"
        ).order_by("-deleted_at", "file_name")
        items = [
            _folder_item(
                item,
                starred=item.pk in starred_folder_ids,
                can_manage=can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, item.workspace),
            )
            for item in folders
            if can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, item.workspace)
        ]
        items.extend(
            _file_item(
                item,
                starred=item.pk in starred_file_ids,
                can_manage=can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, item.workspace),
            )
            for item in files
            if can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, item.workspace)
        )
    elif view == "recent":
        # Recent includes owned items and items accessible through a direct or
        # inherited share. Sort by the newest of access and content modification.
        share_rows = list(
            Share.objects.filter(receiver=request.user, tenant=tenant)
            .filter(Q(file__workspace=workspace) | Q(folder__workspace=workspace))
            .select_related("owner", "folder", "file")
        )
        direct_shared_file_ids = {row.file_id for row in share_rows if row.file_id}
        shared_folder_ids = set()
        for share in share_rows:
            if share.folder_id and share.folder.deleted_at is None:
                shared_folder_ids.update(
                    item.pk for item in _owned_subtree(share.folder, share.owner, tenant)
                    if item.deleted_at is None
                )

        file_queryset = File.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).filter(
            Q(folder__isnull=True) | Q(folder__deleted_at__isnull=True)
        ).select_related("owner", "folder").annotate(
            recent_activity_at=Greatest(
                Coalesce("last_accessed_at", "updated_at"), "updated_at"
            )
        ).order_by("-recent_activity_at")[:200]
        file_rows = [
            row for row in file_queryset
            if can_view_file(row, request.user)
        ]

        folder_queryset = Folder.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).filter(
            Q(parent__isnull=True) | Q(parent__deleted_at__isnull=True)
        ).select_related("owner", "parent").annotate(
            recent_activity_at=Greatest(
                Coalesce("last_accessed_at", "updated_at"), "updated_at"
            )
        ).order_by("-recent_activity_at")[:200]
        folder_rows = [
            row for row in folder_queryset
            if can_view_folder(row, request.user)
        ]
        recent_rows = [(row.recent_activity_at, "file", row) for row in file_rows]
        recent_rows.extend((row.recent_activity_at, "folder", row) for row in folder_rows)
        recent_rows.sort(key=lambda row: row[0], reverse=True)
        items = []
        for activity_at, item_type, row in recent_rows[:100]:
            is_shared = row.owner_id != request.user.id
            owner = row.owner.username if is_shared else "Me"
            can_manage = (
                not is_shared
                and can_edit_workspace_content(request.user, row.workspace)
            )
            if item_type == "file":
                items.append(_file_item(
                    row, owner=owner, modified=activity_at, can_manage=can_manage,
                    starred=row.pk in starred_file_ids,
                ))
            else:
                items.append(_folder_item(
                    row, owner=owner, modified=activity_at, can_manage=can_manage,
                    starred=row.pk in starred_folder_ids,
                ))
    elif view == "shared":
        shares = Share.objects.filter(
            receiver=request.user,
            tenant=tenant,
        ).filter(Q(file__workspace=workspace) | Q(folder__workspace=workspace)).select_related(
            "owner", "file", "file__owner", "file__folder", "folder", "folder__owner"
        )
        items = []
        for share in shares:
            if share.file_id:
                if (
                    share.file.workspace_id == workspace.pk
                    and share.file.deleted_at is None
                    and (share.file.folder_id is None or share.file.folder.deleted_at is None)
                    and can_view_file(share.file, request.user)
                ):
                    items.append(_file_item(share.file, owner=share.owner.username, can_manage=False, starred=share.file_id in starred_file_ids))
            elif (
                share.folder.workspace_id == workspace.pk
                and share.folder.deleted_at is None
                and can_view_folder(share.folder, request.user)
            ):
                items.append(_folder_item(share.folder, owner=share.owner.username, can_manage=False, starred=share.folder_id in starred_folder_ids))
    else:
        # A workspace is a collaborative area: members see the items owned by
        # all members who have stored content there. can_view_* is the actual
        # authorization check, so this does not expose My Drive to other users.
        folders = list(Folder.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            parent=folder,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).select_related("owner").order_by("folder_name"))
        files = list(File.objects.filter(
            tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            folder=folder,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).select_related("owner", "folder").order_by("file_name"))
        items = [
            _folder_item(
                item,
                owner="Me" if item.owner_id == request.user.id else item.owner.get_username(),
                starred=item.pk in starred_folder_ids,
                can_manage=can_edit_folder_tree(item, request.user),
            )
            for item in folders
            if can_view_folder(item, request.user)
        ]
        items.extend(
            _file_item(
                item,
                owner="Me" if item.owner_id == request.user.id else item.owner.get_username(),
                starred=item.pk in starred_file_ids,
                can_manage=can_edit_file(item, request.user),
            )
            for item in files
            if can_view_file(item, request.user)
        )
    return JsonResponse({"items": items, "query": query_text or None})


def _owner_initials(owner):
    parts = owner.split()
    return "".join(part[0].upper() for part in parts[:2]) or "?"


def _file_item(item, *, owner="Me", modified=None, starred=False, can_manage=None):
    return {
        "id": item.id,
        "workspaceId": str(item.workspace_id),
        "name": item.file_name,
        "owner": owner,
        "ownerInitials": "Me" if owner == "Me" else _owner_initials(owner),
        "modified": (modified or item.updated_at).isoformat(),
        "size": item.file_size,
        "type": "image" if item.mime_type.startswith("image/") else "document",
        "starred": bool(starred),
        "canManage": owner == "Me" if can_manage is None else bool(can_manage),
    }


def _folder_item(item, *, owner="Me", modified=None, starred=False, can_manage=None):
    return {
        "id": -item.id,
        "folderId": item.id,
        "workspaceId": str(item.workspace_id),
        "name": item.folder_name,
        "owner": owner,
        "ownerInitials": "Me" if owner == "Me" else _owner_initials(owner),
        "modified": (modified or item.updated_at).isoformat(),
        "size": None,
        "type": "folder",
        "starred": bool(starred),
        "canManage": owner == "Me" if can_manage is None else bool(can_manage),
    }


@login_required
def dashboard(request):
    return redirect_to_frontend("/drive")


@login_required
def recent(request):
    return redirect_to_frontend("/drive/recent")


@login_required
def search(request):
    query = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()[:100]
    return redirect_to_frontend("/drive", {"q": query} if query else None)

def _redirect_drive(request, folder_id=None):
    return redirect("folder_open", folder_id=folder_id) if folder_id else redirect("dashboard")


def _redirect_bulk_result(request, folder_id=None):
    source = request.POST.get("source", "drive")
    if source == "search":
        query = request.POST.get("q", "")
        return redirect(f"{reverse('search')}?{urlencode({'q': query})}") if query else redirect("dashboard")
    if source == "recent":
        return redirect("recent")
    return _redirect_drive(request, folder_id)


def _parse_ids(request, key):
    values = request.POST.getlist(key)
    ids = []
    for value in values:
        try:
            value = int(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if value > 0 and value not in ids:
            ids.append(value)
    return ids


def _top_level_folders(folders):
    selected = {folder.id: folder for folder in folders}
    result = []
    for folder in folders:
        parent = folder.parent
        nested = False
        while parent is not None:
            if parent.id in selected:
                nested = True
                break
            parent = parent.parent
        if not nested:
            result.append(folder)
    return result


def _folder_contains_ids(source, candidate_id):
    current = candidate_id
    while current:
        if current == source.id:
            return True
        current = Folder.objects.filter(
            pk=current,
            tenant_id=source.tenant_id,
            workspace_id=source.workspace_id,
        ).values_list("parent_id", flat=True).first()
    return False


@login_required
@require_POST
def bulk_action(request):
    """Secure multi-select operations for files and folders owned by the current user."""
    action = request.POST.get("action", "").strip().lower()
    file_ids = _parse_ids(request, "file_ids")
    folder_ids = _parse_ids(request, "folder_ids")
    current_folder_id = request.POST.get("current_folder_id") or None
    tenant = get_default_tenant(request.user)
    if tenant is None:
        raise Http404
    workspace = resolve_request_workspace(request, tenant)
    if workspace is None:
        raise Http404("Workspace is unavailable or not accessible.")
    tenant = workspace.tenant

    if not file_ids and not folder_ids:
        messages.warning(request, "No items selected.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)

    files = list(File.objects.filter(
        id__in=file_ids,
        owner=request.user,
        tenant=tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        deleted_at__isnull=True,
    ).select_related("folder"))
    folders = list(Folder.objects.filter(
        id__in=folder_ids,
        owner=request.user,
        tenant=tenant,
        workspace=workspace,
        deleted_at__isnull=True,
    ).select_related("parent"))

    # Never silently operate on IDs that are not owned by the current user.
    if len(files) != len(file_ids) or len(folders) != len(folder_ids):
        messages.error(request, "One or more selected items are not accessible in this workspace.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)
    if any(not can_edit_file(item, request.user) for item in files) or any(
        not can_edit_folder_tree(item, request.user) for item in folders
    ):
        messages.error(request, "Editor access to every selected item is required.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)

    top_folders = _top_level_folders(folders)
    top_folder_ids = {folder.id for folder in top_folders}

    # A file inside a selected folder is already covered by that folder operation.
    covered_file_ids = set()
    if top_folder_ids:
        for file in files:
            if file.folder_id and any(_folder_contains_ids(folder, file.folder_id) for folder in top_folders):
                covered_file_ids.add(file.id)
    direct_files = [file for file in files if file.id not in covered_file_ids]

    if action in {"copy", "cut"}:
        request.session["clipboard"] = {
            "type": "multi_cut" if action == "cut" else "multi",
            "files": [file.id for file in direct_files],
            "folders": [folder.id for folder in top_folders],
        }
        request.session.modified = True
        log_action(request.user, ActivityLog.Action.CUT if action == "cut" else ActivityLog.Action.COPY,
                   f"{action.title()} {len(direct_files)} file(s) and {len(top_folders)} folder(s) to clipboard",
                   workspace=workspace)
        messages.success(request, f"Selected items added to clipboard.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)

    if action == "trash":
        deleted_time = timezone.now()
        with transaction.atomic():
            for folder in top_folders:
                subtree = []
                stack = [folder]
                while stack:
                    current = stack.pop()
                    subtree.append(current)
                    stack.extend(Folder.objects.filter(
                        owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
                        parent=current, deleted_at__isnull=True,
                    ))
                ids = [item.id for item in subtree]
                Folder.objects.filter(
                    owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, id__in=ids
                ).update(deleted_at=deleted_time)
                File.objects.filter(
                    owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
                    folder_id__in=ids, deleted_at__isnull=True,
                ).update(deleted_at=deleted_time)
            File.objects.filter(
                owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
                id__in=[file.id for file in direct_files],
            ).update(deleted_at=deleted_time)
        log_action(request.user, ActivityLog.Action.DELETE,
                   f"Moved {len(direct_files)} file(s) and {len(top_folders)} folder(s) to Trash",
                   workspace=workspace)
        messages.success(request, "Selected items moved to Trash.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)

    if action == "move":
        destination_id = request.POST.get("destination_id") or None
        destination = None
        if destination_id:
            destination = get_object_or_404(
                Folder, id=destination_id, owner=request.user, tenant=tenant,
                workspace=workspace, deleted_at__isnull=True,
            )

        for folder in top_folders:
            if destination and _folder_contains_ids(folder, destination.id):
                messages.error(request, "A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.")
                return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)
            if Folder.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
                                     parent=destination, folder_name__iexact=folder.folder_name,
                                     deleted_at__isnull=True).exclude(id=folder.id).exists():
                messages.error(request, f'A folder named "{folder.folder_name}" already exists at the destination.')
                return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)
        for file in direct_files:
            if File.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
                                   folder=destination, file_name__iexact=file.file_name,
                                   deleted_at__isnull=True).exclude(id=file.id).exists():
                messages.error(request, f'A file named "{file.file_name}" already exists at the destination.')
                return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)

        with transaction.atomic():
            for folder in top_folders:
                folder.parent = destination
                folder.save(update_fields=["parent", "updated_at"])
            for file in direct_files:
                file.folder = destination
                file.save(update_fields=["folder", "updated_at"])
        log_action(request.user, ActivityLog.Action.MOVE,
                   f"Moved {len(direct_files)} file(s) and {len(top_folders)} folder(s)",
                   workspace=workspace)
        messages.success(request, "Selected items moved successfully.")
        return _redirect_bulk_result(request, destination.id if destination else None)

    messages.error(request, "Unknown bulk action.")
    return _redirect_bulk_result(request, current_folder_id)


@login_required
@require_POST
def bulk_paste(request):
    """Paste a multi-item clipboard created by bulk_action."""
    clipboard = request.session.get("clipboard")
    if not clipboard:
        messages.warning(request, "Clipboard is empty.")
        return _redirect_drive(request, request.POST.get("folder_id") or None)
    if clipboard.get("type") not in {"multi", "multi_cut"}:
        from files.views import file_paste
        return file_paste(request)

    destination_id = request.POST.get("folder_id") or None
    tenant = get_default_tenant(request.user)
    if tenant is None:
        raise Http404
    workspace = resolve_request_workspace(request, tenant)
    if workspace is None:
        raise Http404("Workspace is unavailable or not accessible.")
    tenant = workspace.tenant
    destination = None
    if destination_id:
        destination = get_object_or_404(
            Folder, id=destination_id, owner=request.user, tenant=tenant,
            workspace=workspace, deleted_at__isnull=True,
        )

    source_files = list(File.objects.filter(
        owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
        id__in=clipboard.get("files", []), deleted_at__isnull=True
    ).select_related("folder"))
    source_folders = list(Folder.objects.filter(
        owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace,
        id__in=clipboard.get("folders", []), deleted_at__isnull=True
    ).select_related("parent"))
    if len(source_files) != len(clipboard.get("files", [])) or len(source_folders) != len(clipboard.get("folders", [])):
        messages.error(request, "One or more clipboard items are no longer available.")
        request.session.pop("clipboard", None)
        return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)

    top_folders = _top_level_folders(source_folders)
    cut = clipboard.get("type") == "multi_cut"

    if cut:
        for folder in top_folders:
            if destination and _folder_contains_ids(folder, destination.id):
                messages.error(request, "A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.")
                return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id)
            if Folder.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, parent=destination, folder_name__iexact=folder.folder_name, deleted_at__isnull=True).exclude(id=folder.id).exists():
                messages.error(request, f'A folder named "{folder.folder_name}" already exists at the destination.')
                return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id)
        for file in source_files:
            if File.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, folder=destination, file_name__iexact=file.file_name, deleted_at__isnull=True).exclude(id=file.id).exists():
                messages.error(request, f'A file named "{file.file_name}" already exists at the destination.')
                return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id)
        with transaction.atomic():
            for folder in top_folders:
                folder.parent = destination
                folder.save(update_fields=["parent", "updated_at"])
            for file in source_files:
                file.folder = destination
                file.save(update_fields=["folder", "updated_at"])
        request.session.pop("clipboard", None)
        log_action(request.user, ActivityLog.Action.MOVE, "Pasted moved multi-selection", workspace=workspace)
        messages.success(request, "Selected items moved successfully.")
        return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)

    try:
        created_files = []
        with transaction.atomic():
            for source in top_folders:
                root_name = source.folder_name
                if Folder.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, parent=destination, folder_name__iexact=root_name, deleted_at__isnull=True).exists():
                    root_name = _unique_copy_folder_name(
                        request.user, tenant, destination, root_name, workspace=workspace
                    )
                folder_map = {source.id: Folder.objects.create(
                    tenant=tenant,
                    workspace=workspace,
                    owner=request.user,
                    folder_name=root_name,
                    parent=destination,
                )}
                tree = _owned_subtree(source, request.user, tenant)
                for original in tree[1:]:
                    folder_map[original.id] = Folder.objects.create(
                        tenant=tenant,
                        workspace=workspace,
                        owner=request.user,
                        folder_name=original.folder_name,
                        parent=folder_map[original.parent_id],
                    )
                for original in tree:
                    target = folder_map[original.id]
                    for source_file in File.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, folder=original, deleted_at__isnull=True):
                        name = source_file.file_name
                        if File.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, folder=target, file_name__iexact=name, deleted_at__isnull=True).exists():
                            name = unique_copy_name(File, "file_name", name, folder=target, owner=request.user, workspace=workspace)
                        created_files.append(clone_encrypted_file_with_quota(
                            source_file,
                            owner=request.user,
                            folder=target,
                            file_name=name,
                            tenant=tenant,
                        ))
            for source_file in source_files:
                name = source_file.file_name
                if File.objects.filter(owner=request.user, tenant=tenant, workspace=workspace, folder=destination, file_name__iexact=name, deleted_at__isnull=True).exists():
                    name = unique_copy_name(File, "file_name", name, folder=destination, owner=request.user, workspace=workspace)
                created_files.append(clone_encrypted_file_with_quota(
                    source_file,
                    owner=request.user,
                    folder=destination,
                    file_name=name,
                    tenant=tenant,
                ))
    except (QuotaExceeded, QuotaStateError):
        for created_file in created_files:
            if created_file.file_path:
                created_file.file_path.delete(save=False)
        messages.error(request, "The workspace or member quota does not allow this copy.")
        return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)
    except InvalidTag:
        for created_file in created_files:
            if created_file.file_path:
                created_file.file_path.delete(save=False)
        messages.error(request, "File integrity verification failed. Copy was cancelled.")
        return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)
    except Exception:
        for created_file in created_files:
            if created_file.file_path:
                created_file.file_path.delete(save=False)
        messages.error(request, "Could not paste the selected items.")
        return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)

    request.session.pop("clipboard", None)
    log_action(request.user, ActivityLog.Action.COPY, "Pasted copied multi-selection", workspace=workspace)
    messages.success(request, "Selected items pasted successfully.")
    return _redirect_drive(request, destination.id if destination else None)


def _owned_subtree(folder, owner, tenant):
    """Return only descendants that remain inside the root workspace."""
    result = [folder]
    index = 0
    while index < len(result):
        current = result[index]
        result.extend(
            Folder.objects.filter(
                owner=owner,
                tenant=tenant,
                workspace=folder.workspace,
                parent=current,
                deleted_at__isnull=True,
            )
        )
        index += 1
    return result


def _unique_copy_folder_name(owner, tenant, parent, original_name, *, workspace=None):
    if workspace is None and parent is not None:
        workspace = parent.workspace
    candidate = f"{original_name} (copy)"
    number = 2
    queryset = Folder.objects.filter(
        owner=owner,
        tenant=tenant,
        parent=parent,
        folder_name__iexact=candidate,
        deleted_at__isnull=True,
    )
    if workspace is not None:
        queryset = queryset.filter(workspace=workspace)
    while queryset.exists():
        candidate = f"{original_name} (copy {number})"
        number += 1
        queryset = Folder.objects.filter(
            owner=owner,
            tenant=tenant,
            parent=parent,
            folder_name__iexact=candidate,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
        )
        if workspace is not None:
            queryset = queryset.filter(workspace=workspace)
    return candidate

"""Verify an upload's content and publish it under the primary storage prefix.

The multipart worker provides a SHA-256-verified, seekable stream. It is
validated without materializing the entire file in RAM, then published with an
S3-side conditional copy. Legacy callers that supply raw bytes still use
PutObject, preserving their existing behavior.
"""
import hashlib
import hmac
import io

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.core.files import File as DjangoFile
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.module_loading import import_string

from files.models import File, FileVersion, StorageConfig, StorageLocation, UploadSession
from files.quota import finalize_upload_quota
from files.services import unique_upload_name
from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter
from files.validators import MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE, calculate_sha256, detect_mime_type, validate_filename
from logs.models import ActivityLog
from logs.services import log_action


def finalize_verified_upload(
    session, plaintext, actor, *, verified_sha256=None, verified_etag=""
):
    """Publish a verified upload. `verified_sha256` is trusted only from the worker.

    For direct byte callers (e.g. duplication) this function hashes the bytes
    itself. For the multipart worker, the content has already been hashed from
    the downloaded staging object, so the stream is not hashed a second time.
    """
    session.refresh_from_db()
    if session.state in (UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE, UploadSession.State.COMPLETED):
        return {"upload_id": str(session.pk), "state": session.state, "file_id": session.file_id}
    if session.state not in (UploadSession.State.VERIFYING, UploadSession.State.SCANNING):
        raise ValueError("Upload is not awaiting finalization.")

    content = io.BytesIO(plaintext) if isinstance(plaintext, bytes) else plaintext
    if not all(callable(getattr(content, name, None)) for name in ("read", "seek", "tell")):
        raise TypeError("Verified upload content must be bytes or a seekable binary stream.")
    content.seek(0, io.SEEK_END)
    actual_size = content.tell()
    content.seek(0)
    if actual_size != session.expected_size_bytes or actual_size > MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("Verified upload size does not match its reservation.")
    actual_sha256 = verified_sha256 or calculate_sha256(content)
    if not isinstance(actual_sha256, str) or len(actual_sha256) != 64 or any(
        char not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for char in actual_sha256
    ):
        raise ValueError("Verified upload SHA-256 is malformed.")
    actual_sha256 = actual_sha256.lower()
    if session.expected_sha256 and not hmac.compare_digest(
        actual_sha256, session.expected_sha256.lower()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Verified upload checksum does not match its reservation.")

    extension = validate_filename(session.client_name)
    mime_type = detect_mime_type(DjangoFile(content, name=session.client_name), extension)
    scanner_path = getattr(settings, "SECUREDRIVE_UPLOAD_SCANNER", "")
    if scanner_path:
        session.state = UploadSession.State.SCANNING
        session.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        # Existing scanner hook accepts bytes. Its 100-MiB buffer is retained
        # only when configured; replace with a stream-based scanner interface
        # when the malware scanning stage is implemented.
        content.seek(0)
        scanner_payload = content.read(MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE + 1)
        content.seek(0)
        if len(scanner_payload) != actual_size or import_string(scanner_path)(
            scanner_payload, session.client_name
        ) is not True:
            session.state = UploadSession.State.FAILED
            session.failure_code = "security_scan_rejected"
            session.save(update_fields=["state", "failure_code", "updated_at"])
            finalize_upload_quota(session.pk, completed=False, actor=actor)
            raise ValidationError("File did not pass the configured security scan.")

    storage = get_storage_adapter()
    # Persist the destination key *before* performing network I/O. If Django
    # terminates after CopyObject but before the DB commit, the retry will use
    # the same key. Never hold a DB transaction open during the S3 operation.
    with transaction.atomic():
        locked_session = UploadSession.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=session.pk)
        if locked_session.state in (UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE, UploadSession.State.COMPLETED):
            return {"upload_id": str(locked_session.pk), "state": locked_session.state, "file_id": locked_session.file_id}
        if locked_session.state not in (UploadSession.State.VERIFYING, UploadSession.State.SCANNING):
            raise ValueError("Upload state changed during finalization.")
        final_key = locked_session.final_object_key or storage.create_object_key("primary")
        if not locked_session.final_object_key:
            locked_session.final_object_key = final_key
            locked_session.save(update_fields=["final_object_key", "updated_at"])
        session = locked_session

    if verified_sha256 is not None and session.object_key and actual_size > 0:
        # The worker read and SHA-256-verified the staged bytes. Copy within
        # storage without downloading/uploading them a second time.
        storage.publish_verified_object(
            session.object_key, final_key,
            expected_size=actual_size, expected_sha256=actual_sha256,
            upload_session_id=str(session.pk), content_type=mime_type,
            expected_source_etag=verified_etag,
        )
    else:
        # Legacy duplication has no staged object. Keep its verified PutObject
        # path but perform the network write outside this function's DB atomic.
        content.seek(0)
        storage.put_object(
            final_key, content, size_bytes=actual_size,
            sha256_hex=actual_sha256,
            content_type=mime_type or "application/octet-stream",
        )

    tenant = session.tenant
    folder = session.target_folder
    owner = folder.owner if folder else actor
    with transaction.atomic():
        locked = (
            UploadSession.objects
            .select_related("tenant", "target_folder")
            .select_for_update(of=("self",))
            .get(pk=session.pk)
        )
        if locked.state in (UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE, UploadSession.State.COMPLETED):
            return {"upload_id": str(locked.pk), "state": locked.state, "file_id": locked.file_id}
        if locked.state not in (UploadSession.State.VERIFYING, UploadSession.State.SCANNING):
            raise ValueError("Upload state changed during finalization.")
        visible_name = unique_upload_name(
            File, "file_name", locked.client_name,
            folder=folder, owner=owner, workspace=locked.workspace,
        )
        drive_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=tenant, workspace=locked.workspace, owner=owner, folder=folder,
            file_name=visible_name, file_size=actual_size, mime_type=mime_type,
            hash_sha256=actual_sha256, is_encrypted=False,
            encryption_version=1, file_path="",
        )
        cfg, _ = StorageConfig.objects.get_or_create(
            tenant=tenant, provider=StorageConfig.Provider.MINIO,
            defaults={
                "endpoint": settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL,
                "status": StorageConfig.Status.ACTIVE,
            },
        )
        version = FileVersion.objects.create(
            tenant=tenant, file=drive_file, version_number=1,
            state=FileVersion.State.AVAILABLE, size_bytes=actual_size,
            mime_type=mime_type, sha256=actual_sha256, is_current=True,
            is_encrypted=False, encryption_scheme="", encryption_version=1,
            verified_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        StorageLocation.objects.create(
            tenant=tenant, file_version=version, storage_config=cfg,
            object_ref=final_key, state=StorageLocation.State.AVAILABLE,
            size_bytes=actual_size, checksum=actual_sha256,
            verified_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        locked.file = drive_file
        locked.state = UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE
        locked.completed_at = timezone.now()
        locked.save(update_fields=["file", "state", "completed_at", "updated_at"])
        finalize_upload_quota(
            locked.pk, completed=True, actual_size_bytes=actual_size, actor=actor
        )
        log_action(
            locked.initiated_by,
            ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD,
            f"Uploaded {drive_file.file_name}",
            obj=drive_file,
            metadata={
                "size_bytes": actual_size,
                "upload_id": str(locked.pk),
                "source": "multipart",
            },
        )

    if session.object_key:
        try:
            storage.delete_object(session.object_key)
        except Exception:
            # Reconciliation can garbage-collect the source when it is safe.
            pass
    return {
        "upload_id": str(session.pk),
        "state": UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE,
        "file_id": drive_file.pk,
        "name": visible_name,
    }

from django import forms
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

from folders.models import Folder

from .models import File
from pathlib import PurePath

from .validators import (
    MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE,
    calculate_sha256,
    detect_mime_type,
    validate_client_mime_type,
    validate_filename,
)

class FileUploadForm(forms.ModelForm):

    class Meta:
        model = File
        fields = ["file_path", "folder"]

        widgets = {
            "file_path": forms.ClearableFileInput(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                }
            ),
            "folder": forms.Select(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-select",
                }
            ),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, user=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        if user is not None:
            self.fields["folder"].queryset = Folder.objects.filter(
                owner=user,
                deleted_at__isnull=True,
            ).order_by("folder_name")

        self.fields["folder"].required = False
        self.fields["folder"].empty_label = "My Drive"

    def clean_file_path(self):
        uploaded_file = self.cleaned_data["file_path"]

        if uploaded_file.size > MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
            raise ValidationError(
                "File size must not exceed 100 MB."
            )

        extension = validate_filename(uploaded_file.name)

        detected_mime_type = detect_mime_type(
            uploaded_file,
            extension,
        )

        validate_client_mime_type(
            uploaded_file.content_type,
            extension,
            detected_mime_type,
        )

        # Hash plaintext trước encryption ở bước sau.
        self.detected_mime_type = detected_mime_type
        self.sha256 = calculate_sha256(uploaded_file)

        return uploaded_file


class FileRenameForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """Chỉ đổi tên hiển thị; ciphertext trên storage không cần đổi tên."""

    class Meta:
        model = File
        fields = ["file_name"]

        widgets = {
            "file_name": forms.TextInput(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "autocomplete": "off",
                    "maxlength": 255,
                }
            ),
        }

    def clean_file_name(self):
        new_name = self.cleaned_data["file_name"]

        # Dùng cùng policy an toàn với lúc upload.
        new_extension = validate_filename(new_name)

        # Không đổi extension vì nội dung đã được validate/mã hóa từ lúc upload.
        old_extension = PurePath(
            self.instance.file_name
        ).suffix.lower()

        if new_extension != old_extension:
            raise ValidationError(
                "Changing the file extension is not allowed."
            )

        return new_name


class FileMoveForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """Di chuyển file sang folder thuộc chính user hoặc về My Drive."""

    class Meta:
        model = File
        fields = ["folder"]

        widgets = {
            "folder": forms.Select(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-select",
                }
            ),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, user=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        self.fields["folder"].queryset = Folder.objects.filter(
            owner=user,
            deleted_at__isnull=True,
        ).order_by("folder_name")

        self.fields["folder"].required = False
        self.fields["folder"].empty_label = "My Drive"

FILE: backend\files\management\commands\check_connections.py

"""Verify PostgreSQL and MinIO/S3 API connectivity without touching user objects."""
import hashlib
import io
import uuid

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import connection

from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Test the PostgreSQL connection and perform a temporary MinIO write/read/delete probe."

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            connection.ensure_connection()
            with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                cursor.execute("SELECT 1")
                if cursor.fetchone()[0] != 1:
                    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected SQL probe result")
        except Exception as error:
            raise CommandError(
                f"PostgreSQL connection failed ({type(error).__name__}). "
                "Check DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD and that PostgreSQL is running."
            ) from None
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS("PostgreSQL: connected and SELECT 1 succeeded."))

        adapter = None
        object_key = None
        probe = f"SecureDrive connectivity probe {uuid.uuid4()}".encode("utf-8")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(probe).hexdigest()
        try:
            adapter = get_storage_adapter()
            object_key = adapter.create_object_key("quarantine")
            stat = adapter.put_object(
                object_key,
                io.BytesIO(probe),
                size_bytes=len(probe),
                sha256_hex=digest,
            )
            if stat.size_bytes != len(probe):
                raise RuntimeError("Stored probe size did not match")
            body = adapter.open_object(object_key)
            try:
                round_trip = body.read(len(probe) + 1)
            finally:
                body.close()
            if round_trip != probe:
                raise RuntimeError("Stored probe bytes did not match")
        except Exception as error:
            if isinstance(error, CommandError):
                raise
            raise CommandError(
                f"MinIO/S3 API check failed ({type(error).__name__}). "
                "Check SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL, bucket, credentials, network access and bucket permissions."
            ) from None
        finally:
            if adapter is not None and object_key is not None:
                try:
                    adapter.delete_object(object_key)
                except Exception:
                    self.stderr.write(self.style.WARNING(
                        "Warning: the temporary MinIO probe object could not be deleted. "
                        "Check bucket permissions and remove the probe object if it remains."
                    ))

        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            "MinIO/S3: connected; temporary object write/read verified and cleanup attempted."
        ))
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS("All connection probes passed."))


================================================================================
FILE: backend\files\management\commands\cleanup_uploads.py
================================================================================
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone

from files.models import UploadSession
from files.quota import QuotaStateError, finalize_upload_quota
from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter
from files.storage_adapters.base import StorageError


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Abort expired multipart uploads and release their quota reservations."

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        now = timezone.now()
        sessions = UploadSession.objects.filter(
            (Q(expires_at__lte=now, state__in=[UploadSession.State.INITIATED, UploadSession.State.UPLOADING, UploadSession.State.EXPIRED, UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE])
             | Q(state=UploadSession.State.CANCELED)
             | Q(expires_at__lte=now, state=UploadSession.State.FAILED))
        ).order_by("expires_at")
        adapter = get_storage_adapter()
        cleaned = pending = 0
        for session in sessions.iterator():
            try:
                if session.provider_upload_id:
                    adapter.abort_multipart(session.object_key, session.provider_upload_id)
                if session.object_key:
                    adapter.delete_object(session.object_key)
                if session.final_object_key and session.state != UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE:
                    adapter.delete_object(session.final_object_key)
                with transaction.atomic():
                    locked = UploadSession.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=session.pk)
                    if locked.state not in (UploadSession.State.COMPLETED, UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE, UploadSession.State.CANCELED):
                        locked.state = UploadSession.State.EXPIRED
                        locked.failure_code = "expired"
                        locked.save(update_fields=["state", "failure_code", "updated_at"])
                        try:
                            finalize_upload_quota(locked.pk, completed=False)
                        except QuotaStateError:
                            pass
                cleaned += 1
            except StorageError:
                pending += 1
        self.stdout.write(f"Expired sessions cleaned: {cleaned}; cleanup pending: {pending}")


================================================================================
FILE: backend\files\management\commands\finalize_uploads.py
================================================================================
import hashlib
import tempfile

from files.validators import calculate_sha256
from datetime import timedelta

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.db import transaction
from django.db import IntegrityError
from django.utils import timezone

from files.finalization import finalize_verified_upload
from files.models import UploadFinalizationJob, UploadSession
from files.quota import finalize_upload_quota
from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter
from files.storage_adapters.base import (
    MultipartPart,
    StorageError,
    StorageIntegrityError,
    StorageNotFoundError,
    StorageRetryableError,
)
from files.validators import MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


PART_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024


def _quarantine_failed_upload(upload_id):
    """Move a completed but permanently failed staging object to quarantine.

    Uses a deterministic key so the operation can be retried after a process crash.
    It does not delete a staging object until the adapter has verified its copy.
    If multipart completion never produced an object, it aborts the multipart upload.
    """
    session = UploadSession.objects.filter(pk=upload_id).first()
    if session is None or session.state != UploadSession.State.FAILED or not session.object_key:
        return False

    # Already quarantined (including legacy sessions created by older code).
    if session.object_key.startswith("quarantine/"):
        return True

    storage = get_storage_adapter()
    quarantine_key = f"quarantine/{session.pk.hex}"

    # If finalization wrote PRIMARY but the database transaction did not commit,
    # that object is an orphan. Remove it best-effort; the staging source remains
    # the canonical input for quarantine.
    if session.final_object_key:
        try:
            storage.delete_object(session.final_object_key)
        except StorageNotFoundError:
            pass
        except StorageError:
            logger.warning(
                "Could not remove orphaned publication object for failed upload %s",
                session.pk,
                exc_info=True,
            )

    try:
        stat = storage.stat_object(session.object_key)
    except StorageNotFoundError:
        # Recovery case: a previous invocation may have copied to quarantine but
        # failed before updating PostgreSQL.
        try:
            storage.stat_object(quarantine_key)
        except StorageNotFoundError:
            if session.provider_upload_id:
                try:
                    storage.abort_multipart(session.object_key, session.provider_upload_id)
                except StorageError:
                    logger.warning(
                        "Could not abort incomplete multipart upload %s",
                        session.pk,
                        exc_info=True,
                    )
            return False
        else:
            UploadSession.objects.filter(
                pk=session.pk, state=UploadSession.State.FAILED
            ).update(object_key=quarantine_key)
            return True

    storage.quarantine_object(
        session.object_key,
        quarantine_key=quarantine_key,
        expected_size=stat.size_bytes,
    )
    updated = UploadSession.objects.filter(
        pk=session.pk, state=UploadSession.State.FAILED
    ).update(object_key=quarantine_key)
    if not updated:
        logger.warning(
            "Quarantined upload object but could not update its session reference: %s",
            session.pk,
        )
        return False
    return True


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Verify and optionally scan staged uploads, publish valid files to PRIMARY, and quarantine permanent failures."

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        # Recover the DB/storage split if multipart completion succeeded but the
        # web request died before committing its outbox row.
        for upload_id in UploadSession.objects.filter(
            state__in=[UploadSession.State.VERIFYING, UploadSession.State.SCANNING]
        ).values_list("pk", flat=True).iterator():
            UploadFinalizationJob.objects.get_or_create(upload_session_id=upload_id)
        stale_before = timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=10)
        UploadFinalizationJob.objects.filter(
            state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.PROCESSING, updated_at__lt=stale_before
        ).update(state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.PENDING)
        done = failed = retrying = 0
        for job_id in UploadFinalizationJob.objects.filter(
            state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.PENDING
        ).values_list("pk", flat=True)[:100]:
            with transaction.atomic():
                job = UploadFinalizationJob.objects.select_for_update().select_related(
                    "upload_session__initiated_by"
                ).get(pk=job_id)
                if job.state != UploadFinalizationJob.State.PENDING:
                    continue
                job.state = UploadFinalizationJob.State.PROCESSING
                job.attempts += 1
                job.save(update_fields=["state", "attempts", "updated_at"])
                upload = job.upload_session
            try:
                storage = get_storage_adapter()
                if upload.expected_size_bytes:
                    parts = [MultipartPart(part_number=int(part["part_number"]), etag=str(part["etag"])) for part in upload.part_manifest]
                    stat = storage.complete_multipart(
                        upload.object_key, upload.provider_upload_id, parts,
                        expected_size=upload.expected_size_bytes,
                        expected_part_size=PART_SIZE,
                        expected_part_count=(upload.expected_size_bytes + PART_SIZE - 1) // PART_SIZE,
                        expected_upload_session_id=str(upload.pk),
                    )
                    if stat.metadata.get("securedrive-upload-id") != str(upload.pk):
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Completed object metadata failed verification.")
                else:
                    stat = storage.verify_object(
                        upload.object_key, expected_size=0,
                        expected_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b"").hexdigest(),
                    )
                if stat.size_bytes != upload.expected_size_bytes or stat.size_bytes > MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
                    raise StorageIntegrityError("Completed object size failed verification.")
                # Download to an 8-MiB memory-bounded spool instead of holding
                # the entire 100-MiB object in RAM. The verified bytes are used
                # for MIME/ZIP checks and (optionally) a scanner. On success, S3
                # copies the original object internally, avoiding a second upload
                # from Django. The original staging key remains until DB commit.
                with tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=8 * 1024 * 1024, mode="w+b") as verified:
                    retrieved = storage.download_to(
                        upload.object_key, verified, max_bytes=MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE
                    )
                    if retrieved.size_bytes != stat.size_bytes:
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Staging object size changed during verification.")
                    if stat.etag and retrieved.etag != stat.etag:
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Staging object changed during verification.")
                    verified.seek(0, 2)
                    actual_size = verified.tell()
                    if actual_size != upload.expected_size_bytes:
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Verified object size changed during finalization.")
                    digest = calculate_sha256(verified)
                    if upload.expected_sha256 and digest != upload.expected_sha256:
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Verified object checksum changed during finalization.")
                    UploadSession.objects.filter(
                        pk=upload.pk, state=UploadSession.State.VERIFYING
                    ).update(received_bytes=actual_size, actual_size_bytes=actual_size)
                    if settings.SECUREDRIVE_UPLOAD_SCANNER:
                        UploadSession.objects.filter(
                            pk=upload.pk, state=UploadSession.State.VERIFYING
                        ).update(state=UploadSession.State.SCANNING)
                    finalize_verified_upload(
                        upload, verified, upload.initiated_by,
                        verified_sha256=digest, verified_etag=retrieved.etag,
                    )
                UploadFinalizationJob.objects.filter(pk=job.pk).update(state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.DONE)
                done += 1
            except Exception as error:
                logger.exception(
                    "Upload finalization failed: upload_id=%s, job_id=%s, "
                    "attempt=%s, error_type=%s, error=%s",
                    upload.pk,
                    job.pk,
                    job.attempts,
                    type(error).__name__,
                    error,
                )
                # A live-name uniqueness race is resolved on a bounded retry;
                # the next transaction observes the winner and picks (2), (3), … .
                transient = isinstance(error, (StorageRetryableError, IntegrityError))
                if transient and job.attempts < 3:
                    UploadFinalizationJob.objects.filter(pk=job.pk).update(state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.PENDING)
                    retrying += 1
                else:
                    UploadSession.objects.filter(pk=upload.pk, state__in=[UploadSession.State.VERIFYING, UploadSession.State.SCANNING]).update(state=UploadSession.State.FAILED, failure_code="finalization_failed")
                    try:
                        finalize_upload_quota(upload.pk, completed=False)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    try:
                        quarantined = _quarantine_failed_upload(upload.pk)
                        if not quarantined:
                            logger.warning(
                                "Failed upload was marked failed but its object could not be quarantined: upload_id=%s",
                                upload.pk,
                            )
                    except Exception:
                        # Do not hide the original finalization error. Keep the source
                        # object and metadata so cleanup/reconciliation can retry safely.
                        logger.exception(
                            "Could not quarantine failed upload object: upload_id=%s",
                            upload.pk,
                        )
                    UploadFinalizationJob.objects.filter(pk=job.pk).update(state=UploadFinalizationJob.State.FAILED)
                    failed += 1
        self.stdout.write(f"Finalized: {done}; retrying: {retrying}; failed: {failed}")

FILE: backend\files\management\commands\run_upload_finalizer.py
================================================================================
"""Continuously process completed multipart uploads for local development.

Run this in a separate terminal from `python manage.py runserver`:
    python manage.py run_upload_finalizer

Production should run the same worker as a supervised service/container.
"""
import time
from io import StringIO

from django.core.management import call_command
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Continuously run the SecureDrive upload finalization worker."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--interval",
            type=float,
            default=2.0,
            help="Seconds between finalization sweeps (minimum 0.5).",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        interval = options["interval"]
        if interval < 0.5:
            raise CommandError("--interval must be at least 0.5 seconds.")

        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS("SecureDrive upload finalizer is running; press Ctrl+C to stop."))
        try:
            while True:
                try:
                    output = StringIO()
                    call_command("finalize_uploads", stdout=output, stderr=self.stderr)
                    result = output.getvalue().strip()
                    if result and "Finalized: 0; retrying: 0; failed: 0" not in result:
                        self.stdout.write(result)
                except KeyboardInterrupt:
                    raise
                except Exception as error:
                    # Keep the supervised local worker alive across transient DB/storage outages.
                    self.stderr.write(
                        self.style.ERROR(
                            f"Upload finalization sweep failed ({type(error).__name__}); retrying."
                        )
                    )
                time.sleep(interval)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            self.stdout.write("SecureDrive upload finalizer stopped.")

FILE: backend\files\migrations\0008_backfill_legacy_storage_metadata.py

from itertools import islice

from django.db import migrations
from django.db.models import Count, F
from django.db.models.functions import Lower


def backfill_legacy_storage_metadata(apps, schema_editor):
    Tenant = apps.get_model("accounts", "Tenant")
    QuotaAccount = apps.get_model("accounts", "QuotaAccount")
    File = apps.get_model("files", "File")
    FileVersion = apps.get_model("files", "FileVersion")
    StorageConfig = apps.get_model("files", "StorageConfig")
    StorageLocation = apps.get_model("files", "StorageLocation")
    database = schema_editor.connection.alias

    tenants_by_owner = dict(
        Tenant.objects.using(database)
        .filter(kind="personal")
        .values_list("personal_owner_id", "pk")
    )
    files = File.objects.using(database)

    missing_owners = list(
        files.exclude(owner_id__in=tenants_by_owner).values_list("pk", flat=True)[:10]
    )
    if missing_owners:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot backfill file tenants: no personal tenant for file IDs "
            f"{missing_owners}."
        )

    files_in_other_owner_folders = list(
        files.filter(folder__isnull=False)
        .exclude(owner_id=F("folder__owner_id"))
        .values_list("pk", flat=True)[:10]
    )
    if files_in_other_owner_folders:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot backfill file tenants: file and folder have different owners "
            f"for file IDs {files_in_other_owner_folders}."
        )

    duplicate_names = list(
        files.filter(deleted_at__isnull=True)
        .annotate(normalized_name=Lower("file_name"))
        .values("owner_id", "folder_id", "normalized_name")
        .annotate(item_count=Count("pk"))
        .filter(item_count__gt=1)[:10]
    )
    if duplicate_names:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot enforce tenant-scoped case-insensitive file names until "
            "legacy live sibling duplicates are resolved."
        )

    negative_sizes = list(
        files.filter(file_size__lt=0).values_list("pk", flat=True)[:10]
    )
    if negative_sizes:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot create positive file-version sizes for file IDs "
            f"{negative_sizes}; correct the legacy metadata first."
        )

    path_collisions = list(
        files.exclude(file_path="")
        .values("owner_id", "file_path")
        .annotate(item_count=Count("pk"))
        .filter(item_count__gt=1)[:10]
    )
    if path_collisions:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Cannot create unique storage locations: legacy file paths are reused "
            "within a user account. Resolve the duplicate references first."
        )

    storage_configs = {}
    usage_by_tenant = {}
    file_iterator = files.only(
        "pk",
        "owner_id",
        "tenant_id",
        "file_name",
        "file_path",
        "file_size",
        "mime_type",
        "hash_sha256",
        "is_encrypted",
        "encryption_version",
        "encryption_nonce",
        "wrapped_dek",
        "dek_nonce",
    ).iterator(chunk_size=200)

    while batch := list(islice(file_iterator, 200)):
        versions = []
        locations = []
        for drive_file in batch:
            tenant_id = tenants_by_owner[drive_file.owner_id]
            drive_file.tenant_id = tenant_id
            usage_by_tenant[tenant_id] = (
                usage_by_tenant.get(tenant_id, 0) + drive_file.file_size
            )

            storage_config_id = storage_configs.get(tenant_id)
            if storage_config_id is None:
                storage_config_id = StorageConfig.objects.using(database).create(
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    provider="local",
                    status="active",
                ).pk
                storage_configs[tenant_id] = storage_config_id

            has_storage_path = bool(drive_file.file_path)
            version = FileVersion(
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                file_id=drive_file.pk,
                version_number=1,
                state="pending" if has_storage_path else "failed",
                size_bytes=drive_file.file_size,
                mime_type=drive_file.mime_type,
                sha256=drive_file.hash_sha256,
                is_current=True,
                is_encrypted=drive_file.is_encrypted,
                encryption_version=drive_file.encryption_version,
                encryption_nonce=drive_file.encryption_nonce,
                wrapped_dek=drive_file.wrapped_dek,
                dek_nonce=drive_file.dek_nonce,
            )
            versions.append(version)
            if has_storage_path:
                locations.append(
                    StorageLocation(
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        file_version_id=version.pk,
                        storage_config_id=storage_config_id,
                        object_ref=drive_file.file_path,
                        state="pending",
                        size_bytes=drive_file.file_size,
                        checksum=drive_file.hash_sha256,
                    )
                )

        files.bulk_update(batch, ["tenant"], batch_size=200)
        FileVersion.objects.using(database).bulk_create(
            versions,
            batch_size=100,
        )
        StorageLocation.objects.using(database).bulk_create(
            locations,
            batch_size=100,
        )

    for tenant_id, used_bytes in usage_by_tenant.items():
        QuotaAccount.objects.using(database).filter(
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            scope="tenant",
        ).update(used_bytes=used_bytes)


class Migration(migrations.Migration):
    dependencies = [
        ("accounts", "0002_create_personal_tenants"),
        ("files", "0007_fileversion_quotareservation_storageconfig_and_more"),
        ("folders", "0008_backfill_personal_tenant"),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(backfill_legacy_storage_metadata),
    ]

def _constraint_sql(apps, schema_editor, spec, add):
    app, model_name, name, columns, ref_app, ref_model_name, ref_columns, on_delete = spec
    model = apps.get_model(app, model_name)
    ref_model = apps.get_model(ref_app, ref_model_name)
    quote = schema_editor.quote_name
    table = quote(model._meta.db_table)
    constraint = quote(name)

    if add:
        ref_table = quote(ref_model._meta.db_table)
        local_columns = ", ".join(quote(column) for column in columns)
        referenced_columns = ", ".join(quote(column) for column in ref_columns)
        sql = (
            f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD CONSTRAINT {constraint} "
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({local_columns}) REFERENCES {ref_table} "
            f"({referenced_columns}) ON DELETE {on_delete} "
            "DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED"
        )
    else:
        sql = f"ALTER TABLE {table} DROP CONSTRAINT {constraint}"
    schema_editor.execute(sql)


def add_tenant_foreign_keys(apps, schema_editor):
    if schema_editor.connection.vendor != "postgresql":
        return
    for spec in FOREIGN_KEYS:
        _constraint_sql(apps, schema_editor, spec, add=True)


def remove_tenant_foreign_keys(apps, schema_editor):
    if schema_editor.connection.vendor != "postgresql":
        return
    for spec in reversed(FOREIGN_KEYS):
        _constraint_sql(apps, schema_editor, spec, add=False)

    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(
            add_tenant_foreign_keys,
            reverse_code=remove_tenant_foreign_keys,
        ),

import django.db.models.deletion
from django.db import migrations, models
from django.db.models.functions import Coalesce, Lower


def backfill_file_and_upload_workspace(apps, schema_editor):
    database = schema_editor.connection.alias
    Workspace = apps.get_model("accounts", "Workspace")
    Folder = apps.get_model("folders", "Folder")
    File = apps.get_model("files", "File")
    UploadSession = apps.get_model("files", "UploadSession")

    for workspace in Workspace.objects.using(database).filter(is_default=True).iterator(chunk_size=500):
        File.objects.using(database).filter(
            tenant_id=workspace.tenant_id,
            workspace__isnull=True,
        ).update(workspace_id=workspace.pk)
        UploadSession.objects.using(database).filter(
            tenant_id=workspace.tenant_id,
            target_folder__isnull=True,
            workspace__isnull=True,
        ).update(workspace_id=workspace.pk)

    UploadSession.objects.using(database).filter(
        workspace__isnull=True,
        target_folder__isnull=False,
    ).update(workspace_id=models.Subquery(
        Folder.objects.using(database).filter(pk=models.OuterRef("target_folder_id")).values("workspace_id")[:1]
    ))


def workspace_constraints(apps, schema_editor, *, add):
    if schema_editor.connection.vendor != "postgresql":
        return
    quote = schema_editor.quote_name
    file_table = quote(apps.get_model("files", "File")._meta.db_table)
    upload_table = quote(apps.get_model("files", "UploadSession")._meta.db_table)
    folder_table = quote(apps.get_model("folders", "Folder")._meta.db_table)
    workspace_table = quote(apps.get_model("accounts", "Workspace")._meta.db_table)
    statements = [
        (
            file_table,
            "file_workspace_tenant_fk",
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({quote('tenant_id')}, {quote('workspace_id')}) "
            f"REFERENCES {workspace_table} ({quote('tenant_id')}, {quote('id')}) "
            "ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED",
        ),
        (
            file_table,
            "file_folder_same_workspace_fk",
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('folder_id')}) "
            f"REFERENCES {folder_table} ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('id')}) "
            "ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED",
        ),
        (
            upload_table,
            "upload_workspace_tenant_fk",
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({quote('tenant_id')}, {quote('workspace_id')}) "
            f"REFERENCES {workspace_table} ({quote('tenant_id')}, {quote('id')}) "
            "ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED",
        ),
        (
            upload_table,
            "upload_folder_same_workspace_fk",
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('target_folder_id')}) "
            f"REFERENCES {folder_table} ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('id')}) "
            "ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED",
        ),
        (
            upload_table,
            "upload_file_same_workspace_fk",
            f"FOREIGN KEY ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('file_id')}) "
            f"REFERENCES {file_table} ({quote('workspace_id')}, {quote('id')}) "
            "ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED",
        ),
    ]
    for table, name, definition in statements:
        if add:
            schema_editor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD CONSTRAINT {quote(name)} {definition}")
        else:
            schema_editor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} DROP CONSTRAINT {quote(name)}")


def add_workspace_constraints(apps, schema_editor):
    workspace_constraints(apps, schema_editor, add=True)


def remove_workspace_constraints(apps, schema_editor):
    workspace_constraints(apps, schema_editor, add=False)
