import uuid

from django.db import models
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db.models.functions import Coalesce, Lower
from folders.models import Folder
from django.db.models import Q


class File(models.Model):

    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Tenant",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="files",
    )

    workspace = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Workspace",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="files",
    )

    owner = models.ForeignKey(
        User,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="files",
    )

    folder = models.ForeignKey(
        Folder,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="files",
    )

    # ==========================
    # File metadata
    # ==========================

    file_name = models.CharField(
        max_length=255,
    )

    file_path = models.FileField(
        upload_to="uploads/",
    )

    file_size = models.BigIntegerField(
        default=0,
    )

    mime_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
    )

    hash_sha256 = models.CharField(
        max_length=64,
        blank=True,
    )

    # ==========================
    # Encryption
    # ==========================

    is_encrypted = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
    )

    # Nonce của AES-GCM dùng để mã hóa file
    encryption_nonce = models.BinaryField(
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        editable=False,
    )

    # DEK được mã hóa bằng KEK
    wrapped_dek = models.BinaryField(
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        editable=False,
    )

    # Nonce dùng để wrap DEK
    dek_nonce = models.BinaryField(
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        editable=False,
    )

    # Version của encryption scheme
    encryption_version = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(
        default=1,
        editable=False,
    )

    # ==========================
    # Trash
    # ==========================

    deleted_at = models.DateTimeField(
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        editable=False,
    )
    purge_after = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    # ==========================
    # Timestamps
    # ==========================

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now_add=True,
    )

    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now=True,
    )

    last_accessed_at = models.DateTimeField(
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        editable=False,
    )

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                models.F("workspace"),
                Coalesce(
                    "folder",
                    models.Value(-1, output_field=models.BigIntegerField()),
                ),
                Lower("file_name"),
                condition=Q(deleted_at__isnull=True),
                name="file_live_sibling_name_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "id"],
                name="file_tenant_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["workspace", "id"],
                name="file_workspace_id_uniq",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "folder", "deleted_at"],
                name="file_tenant_folder_del_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["workspace", "folder", "deleted_at"],
                name="file_ws_folder_del_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "owner", "deleted_at"],
                name="file_tenant_owner_del_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["workspace", "owner", "deleted_at"],
                name="file_ws_owner_del_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "purge_after"],
                condition=Q(deleted_at__isnull=False),
                name="file_purge_after_idx",
            ),
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Existing callers may not provide a workspace. Infer it from the
        # destination folder, or fall back to the tenant's default workspace.
        if self.workspace_id is None and self.tenant_id:
            if self.folder_id:
                self.workspace_id = Folder.objects.filter(
                    pk=self.folder_id
                ).values_list("workspace_id", flat=True).first()
            if self.workspace_id is None:
                from accounts.models import Tenant
                from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
                tenant = Tenant.objects.get(pk=self.tenant_id)
                self.workspace_id = get_default_workspace(tenant).pk
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.file_name


class FileVersion(models.Model):
    class State(models.TextChoices):
        PENDING = "pending", "Pending"
        UPLOADING = "uploading", "Uploading"
        VERIFYING = "verifying", "Verifying"
        SCANNING = "scanning", "Scanning"
        AVAILABLE = "available", "Available"
        QUARANTINED = "quarantined", "Quarantined"
        FAILED = "failed", "Failed"
        DELETING = "deleting", "Deleting"
        DELETED = "deleted", "Deleted"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Tenant",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="file_versions",
    )
    file = models.ForeignKey(
        File,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="versions",
    )
    version_number = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    state = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=State.choices)
    size_bytes = models.PositiveBigIntegerField()
    mime_type = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    sha256 = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True)
    is_current = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    is_encrypted = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    encryption_scheme = models.CharField(max_length=32, blank=True)
    encryption_version = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=1)
    encryption_nonce = models.BinaryField(null=True, blank=True, editable=False)
    wrapped_dek = models.BinaryField(null=True, blank=True, editable=False)
    dek_nonce = models.BinaryField(null=True, blank=True, editable=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    verified_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    deleted_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    state__in=[
                        "pending",
                        "uploading",
                        "verifying",
                        "scanning",
                        "available",
                        "quarantined",
                        "failed",
                        "deleting",
                        "deleted",
                    ]
                ),
                name="file_version_state_valid_check",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "file", "version_number"],
                name="file_version_number_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["file"],
                condition=Q(state="available", is_current=True),
                name="file_one_current_version_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["tenant", "id"],
                name="version_tenant_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(size_bytes__gte=0),
                name="file_version_size_nonnegative_check",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(encryption_version__gte=1),
                name="file_version_enc_version_positive_check",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "file", "version_number"],
                name="version_tenant_file_num_idx",
            ),
        ]


class StorageConfig(models.Model):
    class Provider(models.TextChoices):
        LOCAL = "local", "Local filesystem"
        S3 = "s3", "S3"
        MINIO = "minio", "MinIO"

    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = "active", "Active"
        READ_ONLY = "read_only", "Read only"
        DISABLED = "disabled", "Disabled"

    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    tenant = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.Tenant",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="storage_configs",
    )
    provider = models.CharField(max_length=16, choices=Provider.choices)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=16,
        choices=Status.choices,
        default=Status.ACTIVE,
    )
    endpoint = models.URLField(max_length=512, blank=True)
    credential_ref = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

        max_length=20,
        choices=State.choices,
        default=State.INITIATED,
    )
    failure_code = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True)
    expires_at = models.DateTimeField()
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

                fields=["workspace", "id"],
                name="upload_workspace_id_uniq",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(

                condition=~Q(idempotency_key=""),
                name="upload_idempotency_key_uniq",
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(
                fields=["tenant", "state", "expires_at"],
                name="upload_tenant_state_exp_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["workspace", "state", "expires_at"],
                name="upload_ws_state_exp_idx",
            ),
            models.Index(
                fields=["initiated_by", "state", "created_at"],
                name="upload_user_state_created_idx",
            ),
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.workspace_id is None and self.tenant_id:
            if self.target_folder_id:
                self.workspace_id = Folder.objects.filter(
                    pk=self.target_folder_id
                ).values_list("workspace_id", flat=True).first()
            if self.workspace_id is None:
                from accounts.models import Tenant
                from accounts.access import get_default_workspace
                tenant = Tenant.objects.get(pk=self.tenant_id)
                self.workspace_id = get_default_workspace(tenant).pk
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

"""Safe physical cleanup for permanently deleted Drive files.

Object storage operations happen before deleting database metadata. If a storage
operation fails, metadata is retained and locations record the failure so the
operation can be retried without silently orphaning an object.
"""
from collections import defaultdict

from django.db import transaction

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount
from files.models import (
    File,
    FileVersion,
    QuotaReservation,
    StorageLocation,
    UploadSession,
)
from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter


class PermanentDeleteError(Exception):
    """Raised when not all underlying objects could be removed."""


def permanently_delete_files(files):
    files = list(files)
    if not files:
        return 0

    file_ids = [item.pk for item in files]
    versions = list(FileVersion.objects.filter(file_id__in=file_ids))
    version_ids = [item.pk for item in versions]
    locations = list(
        StorageLocation.objects.filter(file_version_id__in=version_ids)
        .select_related("storage_config")
        .order_by("created_at")
    )

    storage = None
    if any(location.state != StorageLocation.State.DELETED for location in locations):
        storage = get_storage_adapter()

    failures = []
    for location in locations:
        if location.state == StorageLocation.State.DELETED:
            continue
        location.state = StorageLocation.State.DELETE_PENDING
        location.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        try:
            # S3 DeleteObject is idempotent; repeated attempts are safe.
            storage.delete_object(location.object_ref)
        except Exception:
            location.state = StorageLocation.State.ERROR
            location.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
            failures.append(location.object_ref)
        else:
            location.state = StorageLocation.State.DELETED
            location.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])

    # If any MinIO operation failed, retain legacy media files as well. A retry
    # can safely skip object locations already marked DELETED and retry the rest.
    if failures:
        raise PermanentDeleteError(
            f"Could not permanently delete {len(failures)} storage object(s)."
        )

    # Support legacy objects stored by Django's configured MEDIA storage.
    for drive_file in files:
        if not drive_file.file_path:
            continue
        try:
            drive_file.file_path.delete(save=False)
        except Exception:
            failures.append(f"media:{drive_file.pk}")

    if failures:
        raise PermanentDeleteError(
            f"Could not permanently delete {len(failures)} legacy media object(s)."
        )

    with transaction.atomic():
        sessions = list(
            UploadSession.objects.select_for_update()
            .filter(file_id__in=file_ids)
            .order_by("pk")
        )
        session_ids = [session.pk for session in sessions]
        reservations = list(
            QuotaReservation.objects.select_for_update()
            .filter(
                upload_session_id__in=session_ids,
                state=QuotaReservation.State.CONSUMED,
            )
            .order_by("quota_account_id", "pk")
        )
        actual_sizes = {
            session.pk: (
                session.actual_size_bytes
                if session.actual_size_bytes is not None
                else next((f.file_size for f in files if f.pk == session.file_id), 0)
            )
            for session in sessions
        }
        decrement_by_account = defaultdict(int)
        for reservation in reservations:
            decrement_by_account[reservation.quota_account_id] += max(
                0, int(actual_sizes.get(reservation.upload_session_id, 0))
            )

        # Legacy files imported before UploadSession bookkeeping may have no
        # consumed reservation. The reconciliation command includes those
        # logical bytes, so release them on physical deletion as well.
        billed_files = {
            session.file_id for session in sessions
            if any(res.upload_session_id == session.pk for res in reservations)
        }
        for file in files:
            if file.pk in billed_files:
                continue
            if file.workspace and not file.workspace.is_default:
                quota = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
                    workspace_id=file.workspace_id, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
                ).first()
            else:
                quota = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
                    tenant_id=file.tenant_id, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
                ).first()
            if quota is not None:
                decrement_by_account[quota.pk] += max(0, int(file.file_size))

        accounts = {
            account.pk: account
            for account in QuotaAccount.objects.select_for_update()
            .filter(pk__in=decrement_by_account.keys())
            .order_by("pk")
        }
        for account_id, amount in decrement_by_account.items():
            account = accounts[account_id]
            account.used_bytes = max(0, account.used_bytes - amount)
            account.save(update_fields=["used_bytes", "updated_at"])

        # Keep upload/quota history, but detach the protected FK to the deleted file.
        UploadSession.objects.filter(pk__in=session_ids).update(file=None)
        StorageLocation.objects.filter(file_version_id__in=version_ids).delete()
        FileVersion.objects.filter(pk__in=version_ids).delete()
        File.objects.filter(pk__in=file_ids).delete()

    return len(file_ids)

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from accounts.models import Membership, QuotaAccount, Tenant
from files.models import QuotaReservation, UploadSession


class QuotaError(Exception):
    """Base exception for upload quota operations."""


class QuotaExceeded(QuotaError):
    pass


class QuotaStateError(QuotaError):
    pass


def _get_active_membership(upload, user):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active:
        raise QuotaStateError("An authenticated tenant member is required.")
    if upload.tenant.status != Tenant.Status.ACTIVE:
        raise QuotaStateError("The upload tenant is not active.")

    membership = Membership.objects.filter(
        tenant_id=upload.tenant_id,
        user_id=user.pk,
        status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
    ).first()
    if membership is None:
        raise QuotaStateError("The user is not an active member of this tenant.")
    return membership


@transaction.atomic
def reserve_upload_quota(upload_session_id, user):
    upload = (
        UploadSession.objects.select_for_update()
        .select_related("tenant", "workspace")
        .get(pk=upload_session_id)
    )
    if upload.initiated_by_id != getattr(user, "pk", None):
        raise QuotaStateError("Only the upload initiator can reserve its quota.")

    _get_active_membership(upload, user)
    reservations = list(
        QuotaReservation.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(upload_session=upload)
        .order_by("quota_account_id")
    )
    if reservations and all(
        reservation.state == QuotaReservation.State.RESERVED
        for reservation in reservations
    ):
        return reservations
    if reservations and all(
        reservation.state == QuotaReservation.State.CONSUMED
        for reservation in reservations
    ):
        return reservations
    if reservations and not all(
        reservation.state == QuotaReservation.State.RELEASED
        for reservation in reservations
    ):
        raise QuotaStateError("The upload has inconsistent quota reservation state.")
    if upload.state not in (
        UploadSession.State.INITIATED,
        UploadSession.State.UPLOADING,
    ):
        raise QuotaStateError("Quota can only be reserved for an active upload.")

    # My Drive uses the tenant allocation. Collaborative workspaces charge
    # their own quota exclusively; a member's private Drive remains untouched.
    # Missing accounts on old workspaces are an explicit migration blocker,
    # never an implicit unlimited allocation.
    if upload.workspace_id is None:
        raise QuotaStateError("Upload has no workspace scope.")
    if upload.workspace.status != "active":
        raise QuotaStateError("Workspace is not active.")
    if upload.workspace.is_default:
        requested_accounts = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant_id=upload.tenant_id, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )
        if upload.tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS:
            requested_accounts = requested_accounts | QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
                tenant_id=upload.tenant_id,
                user_id=user.pk,
                scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER,
            )
    else:
        requested_accounts = QuotaAccount.objects.filter(
            tenant_id=upload.tenant_id,
            workspace_id=upload.workspace_id,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE,
        )
    accounts_by_id = {
        account.pk: account
        for account in QuotaAccount.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(pk__in=requested_accounts.values("pk"))
        .order_by("pk")
    }
    if upload.workspace.is_default:
        if not any(account.scope == QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT for account in accounts_by_id.values()):
            raise QuotaStateError("The My Drive quota is not configured.")
        if upload.tenant.kind == Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS and not any(
            account.scope == QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER and account.user_id == user.pk
            for account in accounts_by_id.values()
        ):
            raise QuotaStateError("The organization member quota is not configured.")
    elif len(accounts_by_id) != 1 or not any(
        account.scope == QuotaAccount.Scope.WORKSPACE
        and account.workspace_id == upload.workspace_id
        for account in accounts_by_id.values()
    ):
        raise QuotaStateError("Workspace quota not initialized. Run quota reconciliation.")

    requested_bytes = upload.expected_size_bytes
    for account in accounts_by_id.values():
        if (
            account.limit_bytes is not None
            and account.used_bytes + account.reserved_bytes + requested_bytes
            > account.limit_bytes
        ):
            raise QuotaExceeded("The upload exceeds the available quota.")

    prior_by_account = {
        reservation.quota_account_id: reservation for reservation in reservations
    }
    result = []
    for account in accounts_by_id.values():
        account.reserved_bytes += requested_bytes
        account.save(update_fields=["reserved_bytes", "updated_at"])
        reservation = prior_by_account.get(account.pk)
        if reservation:
            reservation.reserved_bytes = requested_bytes
            reservation.state = QuotaReservation.State.RESERVED
            reservation.finalized_at = None
            reservation.save(
                update_fields=["reserved_bytes", "state", "finalized_at"]
            )
        else:
            reservation = QuotaReservation.objects.create(
                tenant_id=upload.tenant_id,
                upload_session=upload,
                quota_account=account,
                reserved_bytes=requested_bytes,
                state=QuotaReservation.State.RESERVED,
            )
        result.append(reservation)
    return result


@transaction.atomic
def finalize_upload_quota(
    upload_session_id,
    *,
    completed,
    actual_size_bytes=None,
    actor=None,
):
    upload = UploadSession.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=upload_session_id)
    if actor is not None:
        if upload.initiated_by_id != getattr(actor, "pk", None):
            raise QuotaStateError("Only the upload initiator can finalize its quota.")
        _get_active_membership(upload, actor)
    reservations = list(
        QuotaReservation.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(upload_session=upload)
        .order_by("quota_account_id")
    )
    if not reservations:
        raise QuotaStateError("The upload has no quota reservation.")

    target_state = (
        QuotaReservation.State.CONSUMED
        if completed
        else QuotaReservation.State.RELEASED
    )
    if all(reservation.state == target_state for reservation in reservations):
        if completed and upload.actual_size_bytes != actual_size_bytes:
            raise QuotaStateError(
                "The upload was already finalized with a different object size."
            )
        return reservations
    if not all(
        reservation.state == QuotaReservation.State.RESERVED
        for reservation in reservations
    ):
        raise QuotaStateError("The upload quota has already been finalized.")
    if completed and (
        actual_size_bytes is None
        or actual_size_bytes < 0
        or any(actual_size_bytes > row.reserved_bytes for row in reservations)
    ):
        raise QuotaStateError("The verified object size exceeds its reservation.")
    if completed:
        if (
            upload.actual_size_bytes is not None
            and upload.actual_size_bytes != actual_size_bytes
        ):
            raise QuotaStateError(
                "The verified object size conflicts with the upload session."
            )
        upload.actual_size_bytes = actual_size_bytes
        upload.save(update_fields=["actual_size_bytes", "updated_at"])

    accounts = {
        account.pk: account
        for account in QuotaAccount.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(pk__in=[row.quota_account_id for row in reservations])
        .order_by("pk")
    }
    for reservation in reservations:
        account = accounts[reservation.quota_account_id]
        if account.reserved_bytes < reservation.reserved_bytes:
            raise QuotaStateError("The quota reservation counters are inconsistent.")
        account.reserved_bytes -= reservation.reserved_bytes
        if completed:
            account.used_bytes += actual_size_bytes
        account.save(update_fields=["reserved_bytes", "used_bytes", "updated_at"])
        reservation.state = target_state
        reservation.finalized_at = timezone.now()
        reservation.save(update_fields=["state", "finalized_at"])
    return reservations

def unique_copy_name(model, field_name, original_name, *, folder=None, owner=None, exclude_id=None, workspace=None):
    """Return a collision-free copy name in the target folder."""
    if "." in original_name:
        stem, extension = original_name.rsplit(".", 1)
        suffix = f".{extension}"
    else:
        stem, suffix = original_name, ""

    candidate = f"{stem} (copy){suffix}"
    number = 2

    filters = {field_name: candidate}
    if owner is not None:
        filters["owner"] = owner
    if folder is not None:
        filters["folder"] = folder
    else:
        filters["folder__isnull"] = True
    if workspace is not None:
        filters["workspace"] = workspace

    if exclude_id is not None:
        queryset = model.objects.filter(**filters).exclude(id=exclude_id)
    else:
        queryset = model.objects.filter(**filters)

    while queryset.exists():
        candidate = f"{stem} (copy {number}){suffix}"
        filters[field_name] = candidate
        if exclude_id is not None:
            queryset = model.objects.filter(**filters).exclude(id=exclude_id)
        else:
            queryset = model.objects.filter(**filters)
        number += 1

    return candidate


def _clone_encrypted_file(source_file, *, owner, folder, file_name, tenant=None):
    """Clone a SecureDrive file with a fresh file ID, DEK and nonce."""
    if (
        not source_file.is_encrypted
        or not source_file.encryption_nonce
        or not source_file.wrapped_dek
        or not source_file.dek_nonce
        or not source_file.file_path
    ):
        raise ValueError("Source file encryption metadata is incomplete.")

    master_key = get_master_key()
    source_dek = unwrap_dek(
        bytes(source_file.wrapped_dek),
        bytes(source_file.dek_nonce),
        master_key,
    )
    source_aad = build_file_aad(
        owner_id=source_file.owner_id,
        file_id=source_file.id,
        version=source_file.encryption_version,
    )

    with source_file.file_path.open("rb") as stored_file:
        ciphertext = stored_file.read()

    plaintext = decrypt_bytes(
        ciphertext,
        bytes(source_file.encryption_nonce),
        source_dek,
        source_aad,
    )

    cloned = File(
        tenant=(
            folder.tenant
            if folder is not None
            else tenant or get_personal_tenant(owner)
        ),
        owner=owner,
        workspace=(folder.workspace if folder is not None else source_file.workspace),
        folder=folder,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_size=source_file.file_size,
        mime_type=source_file.mime_type,
        hash_sha256=source_file.hash_sha256,
        is_encrypted=True,
        encryption_version=source_file.encryption_version,
    )
    cloned.save()

    stored_name = None
    try:
        new_dek = generate_dek()
        new_aad = build_file_aad(
            owner_id=cloned.owner_id,
            file_id=cloned.id,
            version=cloned.encryption_version,
        )
        new_ciphertext, new_nonce = encrypt_bytes(
            plaintext,
            new_dek,
            new_aad,
        )
        wrapped_dek, dek_nonce = wrap_dek(new_dek, master_key)

        encrypted_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.enc"
        cloned.file_path.save(
            encrypted_name,
            ContentFile(new_ciphertext),
            save=False,
        )
        stored_name = cloned.file_path.name
        cloned.encryption_nonce = new_nonce
        cloned.wrapped_dek = wrapped_dek
        cloned.dek_nonce = dek_nonce
        cloned.save(update_fields=[
            "file_path",
            "encryption_nonce",
            "wrapped_dek",
            "dek_nonce",
            "updated_at",
        ])
        return cloned
    except Exception:
        if stored_name:
            try:
                cloned.file_path.storage.delete(stored_name)
            except Exception:
                pass
        cloned.delete()
        raise


def clone_encrypted_file_with_quota(
    source_file,
    *,
    owner,
    folder,
    file_name,
    tenant,
):
    """Copy a file while reserving and consuming the target tenant quota."""
    if owner.pk != source_file.owner_id:
        raise ValueError("A file copy must retain its current owner.")
    if tenant.pk != source_file.tenant_id:
        raise ValueError("A file copy cannot cross tenant boundaries.")
    if folder is not None and folder.tenant_id != tenant.pk:
        raise ValueError("The destination folder belongs to another tenant.")

    upload = UploadSession.objects.create(
        tenant=tenant,
        workspace=(folder.workspace if folder is not None else source_file.workspace),
        initiated_by=owner,
        target_folder=folder,
        client_name=file_name[:255],
        expected_size_bytes=source_file.file_size,
        expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=1),
    )
    reserved = False
    cloned = None
    try:
        reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, owner)
        reserved = True
        upload.state = UploadSession.State.UPLOADING
        upload.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        cloned = _clone_encrypted_file(
            source_file,
            owner=owner,
            folder=folder,
            file_name=file_name,
            tenant=tenant,
        )
        with transaction.atomic():
            finalize_upload_quota(
                upload.pk,
                completed=True,
                actual_size_bytes=cloned.file_size,
                actor=owner,
            )
            upload.file = cloned
            upload.state = UploadSession.State.COMPLETED
            upload.completed_at = timezone.now()
            upload.save(
                update_fields=["file", "state", "completed_at", "updated_at"]
            )
        return cloned
    except Exception:
        if cloned is not None:
            if cloned.file_path:
                cloned.file_path.delete(save=False)
            cloned.delete()
        if reserved:
            finalize_upload_quota(upload.pk, completed=False)
        upload.state = UploadSession.State.FAILED
        upload.failure_code = "copy_failed"
        upload.save(update_fields=["state", "failure_code", "updated_at"])
        raise


def unique_upload_name(model, field_name, original_name, *, folder=None, owner=None, workspace=None):
    """Return a collision-free upload name using (1), (2), ... suffixes."""
    from pathlib import PurePath

    path = PurePath(original_name)
    suffix = ''.join(path.suffixes)
    stem = original_name[:-len(suffix)] if suffix else original_name
    candidate = original_name
    number = 1

    while True:
        # Match File's case-insensitive live sibling-name constraint.
        filters = {f"{field_name}__iexact": candidate, "deleted_at__isnull": True}
        if owner is not None:
            filters["owner"] = owner
        if folder is not None:
            filters["folder"] = folder
        else:
            filters["folder__isnull"] = True
        if workspace is not None:
            filters["workspace"] = workspace
        if not model.objects.filter(**filters).exists():
            return candidate
        number += 1
        candidate = f"{stem} ({number}){suffix}"

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import BinaryIO, Protocol, Sequence


class StorageError(Exception):
    """Base class for sanitized storage operation failures."""


class StorageNotFoundError(StorageError):
    pass


class StorageRetryableError(StorageError):
    """A transient error; callers may retry within their own bounded policy."""


class StorageNonRetryableError(StorageError):
    pass


class StorageIntegrityError(StorageNonRetryableError):
    pass


class StorageConfigurationError(StorageNonRetryableError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True, repr=False)
class ObjectStat:
    size_bytes: int
    etag: str = ""
    checksum_sha256: str = ""
    checksum_type: str = ""
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, repr=False)
class MultipartUpload:
    upload_id: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, repr=False)
class PresignedRequest:
    url: str = field(repr=False)
    method: str
    required_headers: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MultipartPart:
    part_number: int
    etag: str
    size_bytes: int = 0
    checksum_sha256: str = ""


class StorageAdapter(Protocol):
    """Provider-neutral object and multipart operations used by file services."""

    def create_object_key(self, purpose: str) -> str: ...

    def stat_object(self, object_key: str) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def verify_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def initiate_multipart(
        self, object_key: str, *, upload_session_id: str, content_type: str = ""
    ) -> MultipartUpload: ...

    def create_part_upload_url(
        self, object_key: str, upload_id: str, part_number: int, *, expires_in: int
    ) -> PresignedRequest: ...

    def complete_multipart(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        upload_id: str,
        parts: Sequence[MultipartPart],
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_part_size: int | None = None,
        expected_part_count: int | None = None,
        expected_upload_session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def list_uploaded_parts(self, object_key: str, upload_id: str) -> list[MultipartPart]: ...

    def abort_multipart(self, object_key: str, upload_id: str) -> None: ...

    def create_download_url(
        self, object_key: str, *, expires_in: int, download_name: str | None = None
    ) -> PresignedRequest: ...

    def open_object(self, object_key: str) -> BinaryIO: ...

    def download_to(
        self, object_key: str, destination: BinaryIO, *, max_bytes: int | None = None
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def put_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        body: BinaryIO,
        *,
        size_bytes: int,
        sha256_hex: str,
        content_type: str = "application/octet-stream",
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def publish_verified_object(
        self,
        source_key: str,
        destination_key: str,
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str,
        upload_session_id: str,
        content_type: str = "application/octet-stream",
        expected_source_etag: str = "",
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def quarantine_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        *,
        quarantine_key: str,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat: ...

    def delete_object(self, object_key: str) -> None: ...

from django.conf import settings

from .base import StorageConfigurationError
from .s3_compatible import S3CompatibleStorageAdapter


def get_storage_adapter():
    """Build the configured provider adapter without exposing SDK details."""
    if not getattr(settings, "SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL", ""):
        raise StorageConfigurationError("Object storage is not configured.")

    return S3CompatibleStorageAdapter(
        endpoint_url=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL,
        bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
        region=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_REGION,
        addressing_style=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ADDRESSING_STYLE,
        access_key_id=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
        secret_access_key=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
        tls_verify=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_TLS_VERIFY,
        ca_bundle=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_CA_BUNDLE,
        connect_timeout=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT,
        read_timeout=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_READ_TIMEOUT,
        max_attempts=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
        retry_base_seconds=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS,
        retry_max_seconds=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS,
        max_presigned_url_seconds=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_PRESIGN_MAX_SECONDS,
        server_side_encryption=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_SSE,
        kms_key_id=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_KMS_KEY_ID,
    )

import base64
import logging
import random
import re
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import BinaryIO, Callable, Sequence
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit

import boto3
from botocore.config import Config
from botocore.exceptions import (
    BotoCoreError,
    ClientError,
    ConnectTimeoutError,
    ConnectionClosedError,
    EndpointConnectionError,
    ProxyConnectionError,
    ReadTimeoutError,
)

from .base import (
    MultipartPart,
    MultipartUpload,
    ObjectStat,
    PresignedRequest,
    StorageConfigurationError,
    StorageError,
    StorageIntegrityError,
    StorageNonRetryableError,
    StorageNotFoundError,
    StorageRetryableError,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_RETRYABLE_CODES = {
    "408",
    "429",
    "500",
    "502",
    "503",
    "504",
    "InternalError",
    "RequestTimeout",
    "RequestTimeoutException",
    "SlowDown",
    "ServiceUnavailable",
    "Throttling",
    "ThrottlingException",
}
_NOT_FOUND_CODES = {"NoSuchKey", "NotFound", "404"}
_MISSING_UPLOAD_CODES = {"NoSuchUpload"}
_ACCESS_CODES = {
    "AccessDenied",
    "InvalidAccessKeyId",
    "InvalidToken",
    "SignatureDoesNotMatch",
    "ExpiredToken",
    "InvalidRegion",
}
_SHA256_HEX = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")
# Keep legacy prefixes accepted so existing database references remain readable.
# New uploads use staging/, validated objects are published under primary/, and
# rejected/failed completed uploads are retained under quarantine/.
_SERVER_OBJECT_KEY = re.compile(r"^(staging|primary|quarantine|final|preview)/[0-9a-f]{32}$")
_ALLOWED_KEY_PURPOSES = {"staging", "primary", "quarantine", "final", "preview"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _RetrySettings:
    attempts: int
    base_seconds: float
    max_seconds: float


class S3CompatibleStorageAdapter:
    """S3 API adapter; SDK exceptions and credentials stay behind this boundary."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        endpoint_url: str,
        bucket: str,
        region: str = "us-east-1",
        addressing_style: str = "path",
        access_key_id: str = "",
        secret_access_key: str = "",
        tls_verify: bool | str = True,
        ca_bundle: str = "",
        connect_timeout: float = 2,
        read_timeout: float = 10,
        max_attempts: int = 3,
        retry_base_seconds: float = 0.1,
        retry_max_seconds: float = 1.0,
        max_presigned_url_seconds: int = 300,
        server_side_encryption: str = "",
        kms_key_id: str = "",
        client=None,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
        random_uniform: Callable[[float, float], float] = random.uniform,
    ):
        parsed = urlsplit(endpoint_url)
        if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.netloc:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("Object storage endpoint must be an HTTP(S) URL.")
        if not bucket:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("Object storage bucket is required.")
        if addressing_style not in {"path", "virtual", "auto"}:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("S3 addressing style must be path, virtual, or auto.")
        if (access_key_id and not secret_access_key) or (secret_access_key and not access_key_id):
            raise StorageConfigurationError(
                "Both object storage credentials must be configured together."
            )
        if not 1 <= max_attempts <= 5 or connect_timeout <= 0 or read_timeout <= 0:
            raise StorageConfigurationError(
                "Object storage retry and timeout settings are invalid."
            )
        if not 0 <= retry_base_seconds <= retry_max_seconds <= 5:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("Object storage retry backoff settings are invalid.")
        if not 1 <= max_presigned_url_seconds <= 900:
            raise StorageConfigurationError(
                "Presigned URL lifetime must be between 1 and 900 seconds."
            )
        if server_side_encryption not in {"", "AES256", "aws:kms"}:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("Unsupported server-side encryption setting.")
        if server_side_encryption == "aws:kms" and not kms_key_id:
            raise StorageConfigurationError("A KMS key reference is required for KMS encryption.")

        self._endpoint_url = endpoint_url.rstrip("/")
        self._bucket = bucket
        self._max_presigned_url_seconds = max_presigned_url_seconds
        self._sse = server_side_encryption
        self._kms_key_id = kms_key_id
        self._retry = _RetrySettings(max_attempts, retry_base_seconds, retry_max_seconds)
        self._sleep = sleep
        self._random_uniform = random_uniform

        if client is not None:
            self._client = client
            return

        verify = ca_bundle or tls_verify
        client_args = {
            "service_name": "s3",
            "endpoint_url": self._endpoint_url,
            "region_name": region,
            "use_ssl": parsed.scheme == "https",
            "verify": verify,
            "config": Config(
                signature_version="s3v4",
                s3={"addressing_style": addressing_style},
                connect_timeout=connect_timeout,
                read_timeout=read_timeout,
                # Retry policy is implemented below so each operation has one bounded policy.
                retries={"total_max_attempts": 1, "mode": "standard"},
            ),
        }
        if access_key_id:
            client_args["aws_access_key_id"] = access_key_id
            client_args["aws_secret_access_key"] = secret_access_key
        self._client = boto3.client(**client_args)

    def create_object_key(self, purpose: str) -> str:
        if not isinstance(purpose, str) or purpose not in _ALLOWED_KEY_PURPOSES:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Unsupported object key purpose.")
        return f"{purpose}/{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def stat_object(self, object_key: str) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        response = self._call(
            "head_object",
            lambda: self._client.head_object(
                Bucket=self._bucket,
                Key=object_key,
                ChecksumMode="ENABLED",
            ),
        )
        return self._to_stat(response)

    def verify_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        stat = self.stat_object(object_key)
        if stat.size_bytes != expected_size:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Stored object size does not match the expected size.")
        if expected_sha256:
            if not _SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(expected_sha256):
                raise StorageIntegrityError("Expected SHA-256 value is malformed.")
            if stat.checksum_type == "COMPOSITE":
                raise StorageIntegrityError(
                    "Composite multipart checksum cannot verify a full-object SHA-256."
                )
            if not stat.checksum_sha256:
                raise StorageIntegrityError("Storage did not return a SHA-256 checksum.")
            try:
                actual_hex = base64.b64decode(stat.checksum_sha256, validate=True).hex()
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                raise StorageIntegrityError(
                    "Storage returned a malformed SHA-256 checksum."
                ) from None
            if actual_hex.lower() != expected_sha256.lower():
                raise StorageIntegrityError(
                    "Stored object checksum does not match the expected checksum."
                )
        return stat

    def initiate_multipart(
        self, object_key: str, *, upload_session_id: str, content_type: str = ""
    ) -> MultipartUpload:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not upload_session_id:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("An upload session identifier is required.")
        params = {
            "Bucket": self._bucket,
            "Key": object_key,
            "Metadata": {"securedrive-upload-id": str(upload_session_id)},
        }
        if content_type:
            params["ContentType"] = content_type
        params.update(self._sse_parameters())
        # Do not retry: an ambiguous successful initiate could create an orphaned multipart upload.
        response = self._call(
            "create_multipart_upload",
            lambda: self._client.create_multipart_upload(**params),
            idempotent=False,
        )
        return MultipartUpload(upload_id=response["UploadId"])

    def create_part_upload_url(
        self, object_key: str, upload_id: str, part_number: int, *, expires_in: int
    ) -> PresignedRequest:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not upload_id:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Multipart upload identifier is required.")
        self._validate_expiry(expires_in)
        if not 1 <= part_number <= 10000:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Multipart part number is outside the allowed range.")
        try:
            url = self._client.generate_presigned_url(
                "upload_part",
                Params={
                    "Bucket": self._bucket,
                    "Key": object_key,
                    "UploadId": upload_id,
                    "PartNumber": part_number,
                },
                ExpiresIn=expires_in,
                HttpMethod="PUT",
            )
            return PresignedRequest(url=url, method="PUT")
        except BotoCoreError:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError(
                "Could not create a part upload authorization."
            ) from None

    def complete_multipart(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        upload_id: str,
        parts: Sequence[MultipartPart],
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_part_size: int | None = None,
        expected_part_count: int | None = None,
        expected_upload_session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not upload_id or expected_size < 0:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError(
                "Multipart upload identifier or expected size is invalid."
            )
        normalized = self._validate_manifest(parts)
        try:
            provider_parts = self._list_all_parts(object_key, upload_id)
        except StorageNotFoundError:
            return self._verify_completed_upload(
                object_key, expected_size, expected_upload_session_id
            )
        except StorageNonRetryableError as error:
            if getattr(error, "provider_code", "") not in _MISSING_UPLOAD_CODES:
                raise
            return self._verify_completed_upload(
                object_key, expected_size, expected_upload_session_id
            )
        if [(p.part_number, p.etag) for p in normalized] != [
            (p.part_number, p.etag) for p in provider_parts
        ]:
            raise StorageIntegrityError(
                "Multipart manifest does not match provider-confirmed parts."
            )
        if expected_part_count is not None and len(provider_parts) != expected_part_count:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Provider part count does not match the upload session.")
        if expected_part_size is not None:
            if expected_part_size <= 0 or any(
                part.size_bytes != expected_part_size
                for part in provider_parts[:-1]
            ) or (provider_parts and not 0 < provider_parts[-1].size_bytes <= expected_part_size):
                raise StorageIntegrityError("Provider part sizes do not match the upload session.")
        if sum(part.size_bytes for part in provider_parts) != expected_size:
            raise StorageIntegrityError(
                "Provider-confirmed part sizes do not match the expected object size."
            )

        try:
            self._call(
                "complete_multipart_upload",
                lambda: self._client.complete_multipart_upload(
                    Bucket=self._bucket,
                    Key=object_key,
                    UploadId=upload_id,
                    MultipartUpload={
                        "Parts": [
                            {"PartNumber": part.part_number, "ETag": part.etag}
                            for part in normalized
                        ]
                    },
                ),
                idempotent=False,
            )
        except (StorageRetryableError, StorageNotFoundError) as completion_error:
            # Complete may have succeeded while its response was lost. HEAD resolves that ambiguity.
            try:
                return self._verify_completed_upload(
                    object_key, expected_size, expected_upload_session_id
                )
            except StorageNotFoundError:
                raise completion_error
            except StorageError:
                raise
        except StorageNonRetryableError as error:
            if getattr(error, "provider_code", "") not in _MISSING_UPLOAD_CODES:
                raise
            return self._verify_completed_upload(
                object_key, expected_size, expected_upload_session_id
            )
        return self._verify_completed_upload(
            object_key, expected_size, expected_upload_session_id
        )

    def list_uploaded_parts(self, object_key: str, upload_id: str) -> list[MultipartPart]:
        """Read provider-confirmed part receipts for resume reconciliation.

        These are not used as the completion manifest: the browser must retain
        ETags returned by its own successful UploadPart calls.
        """
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not upload_id:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Multipart upload identifier is required.")
        return self._list_all_parts(object_key, upload_id)

    def abort_multipart(self, object_key: str, upload_id: str) -> None:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not upload_id:
            return
        try:
            self._call(
                "abort_multipart_upload",
                lambda: self._client.abort_multipart_upload(
                    Bucket=self._bucket, Key=object_key, UploadId=upload_id
                ),
            )
        except StorageNotFoundError:
            # Repeated abort is safe after the provider has removed the multipart session.
            return
        except StorageNonRetryableError as error:
            if getattr(error, "provider_code", "") in _MISSING_UPLOAD_CODES:
                return
            raise

    def create_download_url(
        self, object_key: str, *, expires_in: int, download_name: str | None = None
    ) -> PresignedRequest:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        self._validate_expiry(expires_in)
        params = {"Bucket": self._bucket, "Key": object_key}
        if download_name:
            safe_name = download_name.replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "")[:255]
            params["ResponseContentDisposition"] = (
                f"attachment; filename*=UTF-8''{quote(safe_name, safe='')}"
            )
        try:
            url = self._client.generate_presigned_url(
                "get_object", Params=params, ExpiresIn=expires_in, HttpMethod="GET"
            )
            return PresignedRequest(url=url, method="GET")
        except BotoCoreError:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Could not create a download authorization.") from None

    def open_object(self, object_key: str) -> BinaryIO:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        response = self._call(
            "get_object",
            lambda: self._client.get_object(Bucket=self._bucket, Key=object_key),
        )
        return response["Body"]

    def download_to(
        self, object_key: str, destination: BinaryIO, *, max_bytes: int | None = None
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if not destination.seekable():
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Download destination must support safe retry reset.")
        if max_bytes is not None and max_bytes < 0:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Download size limit is invalid.")
        for attempt in range(1, self._retry.attempts + 1):
            body = None
            try:
                destination.seek(0)
                destination.truncate(0)
                response = self._client.get_object(Bucket=self._bucket, Key=object_key)
                body = response["Body"]
                declared_size = int(response.get("ContentLength", -1))
                if max_bytes is not None and (declared_size < 0 or declared_size > max_bytes):
                    raise StorageIntegrityError("Downloaded object exceeds the allowed size.")
                downloaded = 0
                while True:
                    chunk = body.read(1024 * 1024)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    downloaded += len(chunk)
                    if max_bytes is not None and downloaded > max_bytes:
                        raise StorageIntegrityError("Downloaded object exceeds the allowed size.")
                    destination.write(chunk)
                destination.flush()
                if downloaded != declared_size:
                    raise StorageIntegrityError(
                        "Downloaded object length does not match storage metadata."
                    )
                return self._to_stat(response)
            except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as error:
                mapped = self._map_error(error)
                retryable = isinstance(mapped, StorageRetryableError)
                logger.warning(
                    "Object storage request failed",
                    extra={
                        "operation": "download_object",
                        "retryable": retryable,
                        "attempt": attempt,
                    },
                )
                if not retryable or attempt == self._retry.attempts:
                    raise mapped from None
                self._sleep(self._backoff(attempt))
            finally:
                if body is not None:
                    body.close()
        raise StorageRetryableError("Object storage download exhausted its retry policy.")

    def put_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        body: BinaryIO,
        *,
        size_bytes: int,
        sha256_hex: str,
        content_type: str = "application/octet-stream",
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        if size_bytes < 0 or not _SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(sha256_hex):
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Object size or checksum is invalid.")
        params = {
            "Bucket": self._bucket,
            "Key": object_key,
            "Body": body,
            "ContentLength": size_bytes,
            "ContentType": content_type or "application/octet-stream",
            "ChecksumSHA256": base64.b64encode(bytes.fromhex(sha256_hex)).decode("ascii"),
            "Metadata": {"securedrive-sha256": sha256_hex.lower()},
        }
        params.update(self._sse_parameters())
        # Do not replay an ambiguous body write; resolve its outcome with HeadObject below.
        try:
            self._call("put_object", lambda: self._client.put_object(**params), idempotent=False)
        except StorageRetryableError as write_error:
            # Resolve a lost response without replaying a possibly completed body write.
            try:
                return self.verify_object(
                    object_key, expected_size=size_bytes, expected_sha256=sha256_hex
                )
            except StorageNotFoundError:
                raise write_error
        return self.verify_object(
            object_key, expected_size=size_bytes, expected_sha256=sha256_hex
        )

    def publish_verified_object(
        self,
        source_key: str,
        destination_key: str,
        *,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str,
        upload_session_id: str,
        content_type: str = "application/octet-stream",
        expected_source_etag: str = "",
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        """Publish a SHA-256-verified staging object using an S3-side copy.

        SHA-256 is computed independently by the finalizer over GET data before
        this call. CopyObject is *not* a replacement for that verification.
        Source ETag is used only as an If-Match concurrency condition, not as a
        content digest. The source is retained until the DB publication commits.
        """
        self._validate_object_key(source_key)
        self._validate_object_key(destination_key)
        if (
            not source_key.startswith("staging/")
            or not destination_key.startswith("primary/")
            or source_key == destination_key
            or expected_size < 0
            or not _SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(expected_sha256)
            or not upload_session_id
        ):
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Invalid verified publication request.")

        source = self.stat_object(source_key)
        if (
            source.size_bytes != expected_size
            or source.metadata.get("securedrive-upload-id") != upload_session_id
        ):
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Staging object no longer matches its upload session.")
        if not source.etag:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Staging object has no conditional-copy ETag.")
        if expected_source_etag and source.etag != expected_source_etag:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Staging object changed after its checksum was verified.")

        def verified_destination():
            target = self.stat_object(destination_key)
            if (
                target.size_bytes != expected_size
                or target.metadata.get("securedrive-sha256") != expected_sha256.lower()
                or target.metadata.get("securedrive-upload-id") != upload_session_id
            ):
                raise StorageIntegrityError("Published object metadata/size verification failed.")
            return target

        try:
            self._call(
                "copy_object",
                lambda: self._client.copy_object(
                    Bucket=self._bucket,
                    Key=destination_key,
                    CopySource={"Bucket": self._bucket, "Key": source_key},
                    CopySourceIfMatch=f'"{source.etag}"',
                    MetadataDirective="REPLACE",
                    Metadata={
                        "securedrive-sha256": expected_sha256.lower(),
                        "securedrive-upload-id": upload_session_id,
                    },
                    ContentType=content_type or "application/octet-stream",
                    **self._sse_parameters(),
                ),
                idempotent=False,
            )
        except StorageRetryableError as copy_error:
            # A lost CopyObject response is ambiguous. HEAD can reconcile a
            # completed copy; otherwise retain staging for a bounded retry.
            try:
                return verified_destination()
            except StorageNotFoundError:
                raise copy_error
        return verified_destination()

    def quarantine_object(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        *,
        quarantine_key: str,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_sha256: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        self._validate_object_key(quarantine_key)
        if expected_size < 0 or (expected_sha256 and not _SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(expected_sha256)):
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Quarantine size or checksum is invalid.")
        if object_key == quarantine_key:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Quarantine source and destination must be different.")
        if not quarantine_key.startswith("quarantine/"):
            raise StorageNonRetryableError(
                "Quarantine destination must use a server-generated quarantine key."
            )
        try:
            self.verify_object(
                object_key, expected_size=expected_size, expected_sha256=expected_sha256
            )
        except StorageNotFoundError:
            # A stable server-persisted destination makes copy/delete retries idempotent.
            return self.verify_object(
                quarantine_key,
                expected_size=expected_size,
                expected_sha256=expected_sha256,
            )
        try:
            self._call(
                "copy_object",
                lambda: self._client.copy_object(
                    Bucket=self._bucket,
                    Key=quarantine_key,
                    CopySource={"Bucket": self._bucket, "Key": object_key},
                    MetadataDirective="COPY",
                    **self._sse_parameters(),
                ),
                idempotent=False,
            )
            quarantined = self.verify_object(
                quarantine_key,
                expected_size=expected_size,
                expected_sha256=expected_sha256,
            )
        except StorageError:
            # Source is retained on any uncertain copy outcome for reconciliation.
            raise
        self.delete_object(object_key)
        return quarantined

    def delete_object(self, object_key: str) -> None:
        self._validate_object_key(object_key)
        # S3 DeleteObject is idempotent, including when the object is already absent.
        self._call(
            "delete_object",
            lambda: self._client.delete_object(Bucket=self._bucket, Key=object_key),
        )

    def _list_all_parts(self, object_key: str, upload_id: str) -> list[MultipartPart]:
        parts = []
        marker = None
        while True:
            params = {"Bucket": self._bucket, "Key": object_key, "UploadId": upload_id}
            if marker is not None:
                params["PartNumberMarker"] = marker
            response = self._call("list_parts", lambda: self._client.list_parts(**params))
            parts.extend(
                MultipartPart(
                    part_number=item["PartNumber"],
                    etag=item["ETag"],
                    size_bytes=int(item.get("Size", 0)),
                    checksum_sha256=item.get("ChecksumSHA256", ""),
                )
                for item in response.get("Parts", [])
            )
            if not response.get("IsTruncated"):
                return parts
            next_marker = response.get("NextPartNumberMarker")
            if (
                not isinstance(next_marker, int)
                or next_marker <= (marker or 0)
            ):
                raise StorageIntegrityError("Storage returned an invalid multipart pagination marker.")
            marker = next_marker

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_manifest(parts: Sequence[MultipartPart]) -> list[MultipartPart]:
        normalized = list(parts)
        if not normalized:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Multipart completion requires at least one part.")
        numbers = [part.part_number for part in normalized]
        if numbers != sorted(set(numbers)) or numbers[0] < 1 or numbers[-1] > 10000:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Multipart part numbers must be unique and ordered.")
        if any(not part.etag or "\r" in part.etag or "\n" in part.etag for part in normalized):
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Multipart part token is invalid.")
        return normalized

    def _verify_completed_upload(
        self,
        object_key: str,
        expected_size: int,
        expected_upload_session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> ObjectStat:
        # Validate the SecureDrive session UUID stored in object metadata. This is
        # not the independent S3 Multipart UploadId used to complete the upload.
        stat = self.stat_object(object_key)
        if (
            expected_upload_session_id is not None
            and stat.metadata.get("securedrive-upload-id") != str(expected_upload_session_id)
        ):
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Completed object does not match the SecureDrive upload session.")
        if stat.size_bytes != expected_size:
            raise StorageIntegrityError("Completed object size does not match the expected size.")
        return stat

    def _to_stat(self, response: dict) -> ObjectStat:
        return ObjectStat(
            size_bytes=int(response.get("ContentLength", 0)),
            etag=str(response.get("ETag", "")).strip('"'),
            checksum_sha256=response.get("ChecksumSHA256", ""),
            checksum_type=response.get("ChecksumType", ""),
            metadata={
                str(key).lower(): str(value)
                for key, value in response.get("Metadata", {}).items()
            },
        )

    def _call(self, operation: str, call: Callable, *, idempotent: bool = True):
        attempts = self._retry.attempts if idempotent else 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            try:
                return call()
            except StorageError:
                raise
            except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as error:
                mapped = self._map_error(error)
                retryable = isinstance(mapped, StorageRetryableError)
                logger.warning(
                    "Object storage request failed",
                    extra={"operation": operation, "retryable": retryable, "attempt": attempt},
                )
                if not retryable or attempt == attempts:
                    raise mapped from None
                self._sleep(self._backoff(attempt))

    def _backoff(self, attempt: int) -> float:
        ceiling = min(
            self._retry.max_seconds,
            self._retry.base_seconds * (2 ** (attempt - 1)),
        )
        return self._random_uniform(0, ceiling)

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_object_key(object_key: str) -> None:
        if not isinstance(object_key, str) or not _SERVER_OBJECT_KEY.fullmatch(object_key):
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Object key must be generated by the server.")

    @staticmethod
    def _map_error(error: Exception) -> StorageError:
        if isinstance(error, StorageError):
            return error
        if isinstance(error, ClientError):
            response = error.response or {}
            error_info = response.get("Error", {})
            code = str(error_info.get("Code", "Unknown"))
            status = int(response.get("ResponseMetadata", {}).get("HTTPStatusCode", 0) or 0)
            if code in _NOT_FOUND_CODES:
                return StorageNotFoundError("Object storage resource was not found.")
            if code in _MISSING_UPLOAD_CODES:
                mapped = StorageNonRetryableError("Multipart upload no longer exists.")
                mapped.provider_code = code
                return mapped
            if code in _RETRYABLE_CODES or status in {408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}:
                return StorageRetryableError("Object storage is temporarily unavailable.")
            if code in _ACCESS_CODES:
                return StorageNonRetryableError("Object storage rejected the configured identity.")
            mapped = StorageNonRetryableError("Object storage rejected the operation.")
            mapped.provider_code = code
            return mapped
        if isinstance(
            error,
            (
                ConnectTimeoutError,
                ReadTimeoutError,
                EndpointConnectionError,
                ProxyConnectionError,
                ConnectionClosedError,
            ),
        ):
            return StorageRetryableError("Object storage timed out or could not be reached.")
        if isinstance(error, BotoCoreError):
            return StorageNonRetryableError("Object storage SDK could not perform the operation.")
        return StorageNonRetryableError("Object storage operation failed.")

    def _sse_parameters(self) -> dict:
        if not self._sse:
            return {}
        params = {"ServerSideEncryption": self._sse}
        if self._sse == "aws:kms":
            params["SSEKMSKeyId"] = self._kms_key_id
        return params

    def _validate_expiry(self, expires_in: int) -> None:
        if not 1 <= expires_in <= self._max_presigned_url_seconds:
            raise StorageNonRetryableError("Presigned URL lifetime exceeds policy.")

"""Transfer events are recorded exactly once for successful file publication."""

import hashlib
from datetime import timedelta
from unittest.mock import patch

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone

from files.finalization import finalize_verified_upload
from files.models import UploadSession
from logs.models import ActivityLog


class MultipartUploadActivityTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = get_user_model().objects.create_user(
            username="transfer-audit-owner", password="test-secret-123!"
        )
        self.content = b"verified multipart content"
        self.session = UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.user.personal_tenant,
            initiated_by=self.user,
            client_name="report.txt",
            expected_size_bytes=len(self.content),
            expected_sha256=hashlib.sha256(self.content).hexdigest(),
            object_key="staging/audit-test",
            state=UploadSession.State.VERIFYING,
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=1),
        )

    @patch("files.finalization.finalize_upload_quota")
    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_successful_upload_is_logged_once_and_visible_in_personal_history(self, adapter_factory, quota):
        storage = adapter_factory.return_value
        storage.create_object_key.return_value = "primary/audit-test"
        result = finalize_verified_upload(self.session, self.content, self.user)
        self.assertEqual(result["state"], UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE)
        self.assertEqual(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD,
        ).count(), 1)
        event = ActivityLog.objects.get(user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD)
        self.assertEqual(event.workspace_id, self.session.workspace_id)
        self.assertEqual(event.metadata["size_bytes"], len(self.content))
        self.assertEqual(event.metadata["resource_name"], "report.txt")
        self.assertEqual(event.object_id, result["file_id"])
        quota.assert_called_once()

        again = finalize_verified_upload(self.session, self.content, self.user)
        self.assertEqual(again["file_id"], result["file_id"])
        self.assertEqual(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD,
        ).count(), 1)
        storage.put_object.assert_called_once()

        self.client.force_login(self.user)
        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"action": "UPLOAD"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([row["action"] for row in response.json()["events"]], ["UPLOAD"])

    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_failed_upload_does_not_emit_success_event(self, adapter_factory):
        self.session.state = UploadSession.State.FAILED
        self.session.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            finalize_verified_upload(self.session, self.content, self.user)
        self.assertFalse(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.UPLOAD,
        ).exists())
        adapter_factory.assert_not_called()
