from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.http import Http404
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse

from accounts.models import Membership
from files.models import File, FileVersion, StorageConfig, StorageLocation
from files.views import _safe_download_filename
from logs.models import ActivityLog


User = get_user_model()


class DownloadSecurityTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(username="download-owner", password="secret")
        self.file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.user.personal_tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            file_name='report "final".pdf',
            file_path="uploads/report.enc",
            file_size=12,
            mime_type="application/pdf",
        )
        self.version = FileVersion.objects.create(
            tenant=self.file.tenant,
            file=self.file,
            version_number=1,
            state=FileVersion.State.AVAILABLE,
            size_bytes=12,
            mime_type="application/pdf",
            is_current=True,
        )
        # A current AVAILABLE version is downloadable only after its object is
        # published to an active PRIMARY storage location. Model that valid
        # state in download-success tests rather than bypassing the guard.
        self.storage_config = StorageConfig.objects.create(
            tenant=self.file.tenant,
            provider=StorageConfig.Provider.MINIO,
            status=StorageConfig.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.storage_location = StorageLocation.objects.create(
            tenant=self.file.tenant,
            file_version=self.version,
            storage_config=self.storage_config,
            object_ref=f"primary/tests/{self.version.pk}",
            state=StorageLocation.State.AVAILABLE,
            size_bytes=12,
        )
        self.client.force_login(self.user)

    def test_private_file_is_not_downloadable_by_another_user(self):
        other = User.objects.create_user(username="download-other", password="secret")
        self.client.force_login(other)
        response = self.client.get(reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)

    def test_removed_or_suspended_membership_cannot_download(self):
        for status in (Membership.Status.REVOKED, Membership.Status.SUSPENDED):
            with self.subTest(status=status):
                Membership.objects.filter(
                    user=self.user, tenant=self.file.tenant
                ).update(status=status)
                response = self.client.get(
                    reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]),
                    HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json",
                )
                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)
                Membership.objects.filter(
                    user=self.user, tenant=self.file.tenant
                ).update(status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE)

    def test_inactive_user_cannot_download(self):
        User.objects.filter(pk=self.user.pk).update(is_active=False)
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]),
            HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json",
        )
        self.assertIn(response.status_code, (302, 403))

    def test_non_available_states_are_not_released_and_explain_status_to_owner(self):
        for state in (
            FileVersion.State.SCANNING,
            FileVersion.State.QUARANTINED,
            FileVersion.State.FAILED,
        ):
            with self.subTest(state=state):
                FileVersion.objects.filter(pk=self.version.pk).update(state=state)
                response = self.client.get(
                    reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]),
                    HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json",
                )
                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 409)
                self.assertIn("detail", response.json())
        FileVersion.objects.filter(pk=self.version.pk).update(
            state=FileVersion.State.AVAILABLE
        )

    def test_download_is_attachment_private_and_has_safe_headers(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch

        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", return_value=b"verified bytes"):
            response = self.client.get(reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response["Content-Type"], "application/octet-stream")
        self.assertTrue(response["Content-Disposition"].startswith("attachment;"))
        self.assertIn('filename="report \\\"final\\\".pdf"', response["Content-Disposition"])
        self.assertEqual(response["X-Content-Type-Options"], "nosniff")
        self.assertEqual(response["Cache-Control"], "private, no-store")
        self.assertEqual(response["Referrer-Policy"], "no-referrer")

    def test_successful_download_is_visible_in_personal_activity(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch

        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", return_value=b"verified bytes"):
            result = self.client.get(reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200)
        events = ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD,
        )
        self.assertEqual(events.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(events.first().object_id, self.file.pk)
        self.assertEqual(events.first().metadata["size_bytes"], len(b"verified bytes"))

        response = self.client.get(reverse("api-my-activity"), {"action": "DOWNLOAD"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(response.json()["events"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["events"][0]["action"], "DOWNLOAD")

    def test_blocked_download_does_not_create_download_activity(self):
        self.storage_location.state = StorageLocation.State.ERROR
        self.storage_location.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        result = self.client.get(
            reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]),
            HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 409)
        self.assertIn("primary storage", result.json()["detail"].lower())
        self.assertFalse(ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            user=self.user, action=ActivityLog.Action.DOWNLOAD,
        ).exists())

    def test_download_without_available_primary_location_is_blocked(self):
        from django.urls import reverse

        self.storage_location.state = StorageLocation.State.ERROR
        self.storage_location.save(update_fields=["state", "updated_at"])
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]),
            HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 409)
        self.assertIn("primary storage", response.json()["detail"].lower())

    def test_download_filename_cannot_inject_headers_or_paths(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            _safe_download_filename("../unsafe\\name\r\nX-Evil: yes.pdf"),
            ".._unsafe_nameX-Evil: yes.pdf",
        )

    def test_repeated_download_requests_are_reauthorized(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch

        url = reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk])
        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", return_value=b"verified") as decrypt:
            first = self.client.get(url)
            second = self.client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(first.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(second.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(decrypt.call_count, 2)

    def test_integrity_failure_and_missing_object_return_errors_not_success_redirects(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch

        url = reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk])
        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", side_effect=InvalidTag):
            corrupt = self.client.get(url, HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json")
        self.assertEqual(corrupt.status_code, 422)
        self.assertIn("integrity", corrupt.json()["detail"].lower())

        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", side_effect=Http404):
            missing = self.client.get(url, HTTP_ACCEPT="application/octet-stream, application/json")
        self.assertEqual(missing.status_code, 404)

    def test_preview_only_serves_allowlisted_types_inline(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch

        self.file.mime_type = "application/pdf"
        self.file.save(update_fields=["mime_type"])
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("file_view", args=[self.file.pk]),
            HTTP_ACCEPT="application/json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 409)

        self.file.mime_type = "image/png"
        self.file.save(update_fields=["mime_type"])
        with patch("files.views._decrypt_file", return_value=b"png-bytes"):
            response = self.client.get(reverse("file_view", args=[self.file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response["Content-Type"], "image/png")
        self.assertTrue(response["Content-Disposition"].startswith("inline;"))
        self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], "sandbox")

    def test_trashed_file_is_unavailable(self):
        self.file.deleted_at = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
        self.file.save(update_fields=["deleted_at"])
        response = self.client.get(reverse("file_download", args=[self.file.pk]))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)

FILE: backend\files\tests\test_finalization_streaming.py

"""Regression tests for memory-bounded finalization and durable publication."""
import hashlib
import tempfile
from datetime import timedelta
from unittest.mock import patch

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase, override_settings
from django.utils import timezone

from files.finalization import finalize_verified_upload
from files.models import File, FileVersion, StorageLocation, UploadSession
from files.storage_adapters.base import StorageRetryableError


@override_settings(SECUREDRIVE_UPLOAD_SCANNER="")
class FinalizationStreamTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = get_user_model().objects.create_user(
            username="finalization-stream-owner", password="test-secret-123!"
        )
        self.data = b"safe streaming data\n"
        self.sha = hashlib.sha256(self.data).hexdigest()
        self.session = UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.user.personal_tenant,
            initiated_by=self.user,
            client_name="sample.txt",
            expected_size_bytes=len(self.data),
            expected_sha256=self.sha,
            object_key="staging/" + "a" * 32,
            state=UploadSession.State.VERIFYING,
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=1),
        )

    @patch("files.finalization.finalize_upload_quota")
    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_stream_publication_uses_s3_copy_and_records_integrity(self, get_adapter, quota):
        storage = get_adapter.return_value
        storage.create_object_key.return_value = "primary/" + "b" * 32
        with tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4, mode="w+b") as stream:
            stream.write(self.data)
            self.assertTrue(stream._rolled)
            result = finalize_verified_upload(
                self.session, stream, self.user,
                verified_sha256=self.sha, verified_etag="etag-2",
            )
        self.assertEqual(result["state"], UploadSession.State.AVAILABLE)
        args = storage.publish_verified_object.call_args
        self.assertEqual(args.args[:2], (
            "staging/" + "a" * 32, "primary/" + "b" * 32
        ))
        self.assertEqual(args.kwargs["expected_source_etag"], "etag-2")
        self.assertEqual(args.kwargs["expected_sha256"], self.sha)
        storage.put_object.assert_not_called()
        storage.delete_object.assert_called_once_with("staging/" + "a" * 32)
        file = File.objects.get(pk=result["file_id"])
        self.assertEqual(file.hash_sha256, self.sha)
        self.assertEqual(FileVersion.objects.get(file=file).sha256, self.sha)
        self.assertEqual(StorageLocation.objects.get(file_version__file=file).checksum, self.sha)
        quota.assert_called_once()

    @patch("files.finalization.finalize_upload_quota")
    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_copy_failure_preserves_pending_session_and_destination(self, get_adapter, quota):
        storage = get_adapter.return_value
        storage.create_object_key.return_value = "primary/" + "b" * 32
        storage.publish_verified_object.side_effect = StorageRetryableError("S3 unavailable")
        with tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4, mode="w+b") as stream:
            stream.write(self.data)
            with self.assertRaises(StorageRetryableError):
                finalize_verified_upload(
                    self.session, stream, self.user,
                    verified_sha256=self.sha,
                )
        self.session.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.session.state, UploadSession.State.VERIFYING)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.final_object_key, "primary/" + "b" * 32)
        self.assertFalse(File.objects.filter(tenant=self.session.tenant, file_name="sample.txt").exists())
        storage.delete_object.assert_not_called()
        quota.assert_not_called()

    @patch("files.finalization.finalize_upload_quota")
    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_stream_hash_mismatch_fails_before_copy(self, get_adapter, quota):
        with tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=4, mode="w+b") as stream:
            stream.write(self.data)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                finalize_verified_upload(
                    self.session, stream, self.user,
                    verified_sha256="0" * 64,
                )
        get_adapter.assert_not_called()
        quota.assert_not_called()

    @patch("files.finalization.finalize_upload_quota")
    @patch("files.finalization.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_legacy_bytes_do_not_require_staging_copy(self, get_adapter, quota):
        storage = get_adapter.return_value
        storage.create_object_key.return_value = "primary/" + "b" * 32
        finalize_verified_upload(self.session, self.data, self.user)
        storage.put_object.assert_called_once()
        storage.publish_verified_object.assert_not_called()

import json
import os
import unittest
from io import BytesIO
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from unittest.mock import patch

from django.conf import settings

from files.storage_adapters import get_storage_adapter
from files.storage_adapters.base import (
    MultipartPart,
    StorageNonRetryableError,
    StorageNotFoundError,
    StorageRetryableError,
)
from files.storage_adapters.s3_compatible import S3CompatibleStorageAdapter


MINIO_ENABLED = os.getenv("SECUREDRIVE_MINIO_INTEGRATION", "").lower() in {
    "1",
    "true",
    "yes",
}


@unittest.skipUnless(
    MINIO_ENABLED,
    "Set SECUREDRIVE_MINIO_INTEGRATION=true to run against a disposable MinIO bucket.",
)
class MinIOStorageIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.adapter = get_storage_adapter()

    def test_missing_object_is_a_typed_not_found(self):
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("final")
        with self.assertRaises(StorageNotFoundError):
            self.adapter.stat_object(key)

    def test_repeated_abort_and_delete_are_safe(self):
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("quarantine")
        upload = self.adapter.initiate_multipart(
            key, upload_session_id="integration-test-session"
        )
        self.adapter.abort_multipart(key, upload.upload_id)
        self.adapter.abort_multipart(key, upload.upload_id)
        self.adapter.delete_object(key)
        self.adapter.delete_object(key)

    def test_list_uploaded_parts_for_browser_resume(self):
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("staging")
        upload = self.adapter.initiate_multipart(
            key, upload_session_id="integration-resume-parts"
        )
        try:
            payload = b"resume-receipt"
            response = self.adapter._client.upload_part(
                Bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
                Key=key,
                UploadId=upload.upload_id,
                PartNumber=1,
                Body=payload,
            )
            parts = self.adapter.list_uploaded_parts(key, upload.upload_id)
            self.assertEqual(len(parts), 1)
            self.assertEqual(parts[0].part_number, 1)
            self.assertEqual(parts[0].etag, response["ETag"])
            self.assertEqual(parts[0].size_bytes, len(payload))
        finally:
            self.adapter.abort_multipart(key, upload.upload_id)

    def test_repeated_multipart_complete_returns_the_same_verified_object(self):
        payload = b"repeatable-complete"
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("quarantine")
        upload = self.adapter.initiate_multipart(
            key, upload_session_id="integration-repeat-complete"
        )
        try:
            uploaded = self.adapter._client.upload_part(
                Bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
                Key=key,
                UploadId=upload.upload_id,
                PartNumber=1,
                Body=payload,
            )
            parts = [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag=uploaded["ETag"])]
            first = self.adapter.complete_multipart(
                key, upload.upload_id, parts, expected_size=len(payload),
                expected_upload_session_id="integration-repeat-complete",
            )
            repeated = self.adapter.complete_multipart(
                key, upload.upload_id, parts, expected_size=len(payload),
                expected_upload_session_id="integration-repeat-complete",
            )
            self.assertEqual(first.size_bytes, len(payload))
            self.assertEqual(repeated.size_bytes, first.size_bytes)
            self.assertEqual(
                repeated.metadata.get("securedrive-upload-id"), "integration-repeat-complete"
            )
        finally:
            self.adapter.abort_multipart(key, upload.upload_id)
            self.adapter.delete_object(key)

    def test_publish_verified_staging_uses_server_side_copy(self):
        """Run only against a disposable bucket with real S3 CopyObject support."""
        import hashlib

        payload = b"verified-by-the-worker" * 1024
        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        session_id = "integration-publish-staging"
        staging = self.adapter.create_object_key("staging")
        primary = self.adapter.create_object_key("primary")
        upload = self.adapter.initiate_multipart(
            staging, upload_session_id=session_id,
        )
        try:
            part = self.adapter._client.upload_part(
                Bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
                Key=staging,
                UploadId=upload.upload_id,
                PartNumber=1,
                Body=payload,
            )
            complete_stat = self.adapter.complete_multipart(
                staging, upload.upload_id,
                [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag=part["ETag"])],
                expected_size=len(payload),
                expected_upload_session_id=session_id,
            )
            # Emulate the finalizer's independent verification, not the
            # checksum calculated by the storage provider.
            retrieved = BytesIO()
            downloaded_stat = self.adapter.download_to(
                staging, retrieved, max_bytes=len(payload)
            )
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(retrieved.getvalue()).hexdigest(), digest)
            self.assertEqual(downloaded_stat.etag, complete_stat.etag)
            published = self.adapter.publish_verified_object(
                staging, primary, expected_size=len(payload),
                expected_sha256=digest, upload_session_id=session_id,
                expected_source_etag=downloaded_stat.etag,
            )
            self.assertEqual(published.size_bytes, len(payload))
            self.assertEqual(published.metadata.get("securedrive-sha256"), digest)
            copied = BytesIO()
            self.adapter.download_to(primary, copied, max_bytes=len(payload))
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(copied.getvalue()).hexdigest(), digest)
        finally:
            self.adapter.abort_multipart(staging, upload.upload_id)
            self.adapter.delete_object(staging)
            self.adapter.delete_object(primary)

    def test_wrong_credentials_are_non_retryable_and_redacted(self):
        adapter = S3CompatibleStorageAdapter(
            endpoint_url=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL,
            bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
            region=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_REGION,
            addressing_style=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ADDRESSING_STYLE,
            access_key_id="invalid-integration-access-key",
            secret_access_key="invalid-integration-secret-key",
            tls_verify=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_TLS_VERIFY,
            ca_bundle=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_CA_BUNDLE,
            max_attempts=3,
        )
        with self.assertRaises(StorageNonRetryableError) as raised:
            adapter.stat_object(self.adapter.create_object_key("final"))
        self.assertNotIn("invalid-integration", str(raised.exception))

    def test_failed_provider_complete_is_non_retryable(self):
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("quarantine")
        upload = self.adapter.initiate_multipart(
            key, upload_session_id="integration-failed-complete"
        )
        try:
            # The provider has one valid part; a tampered ETag must fail at multipart completion.
            self.adapter._client.upload_part(
                Bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
                Key=key,
                UploadId=upload.upload_id,
                PartNumber=1,
                Body=b"small-final-part",
            )
            altered_etag = '"deliberately-wrong-etag"'
            with patch.object(
                self.adapter._client,
                "list_parts",
                return_value={
                    "Parts": [
                        {
                            "PartNumber": 1,
                            "ETag": altered_etag,
                            "Size": len(b"small-final-part"),
                        }
                    ],
                    "IsTruncated": False,
                },
            ):
                with self.assertRaises(StorageNonRetryableError):
                    self.adapter.complete_multipart(
                        key,
                        upload.upload_id,
                        [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag=altered_etag)],
                        expected_size=len(b"small-final-part"),
                    )
        finally:
            self.adapter.abort_multipart(key, upload.upload_id)
            self.adapter.delete_object(key)

    def test_timeout_against_configured_fault_injection_endpoint_is_bounded(self):
        endpoint = os.getenv("SECUREDRIVE_MINIO_TIMEOUT_TEST_ENDPOINT", "").strip()
        if not endpoint:
            self.skipTest(
                "Configure a local delay/fault proxy endpoint for timeout integration coverage."
            )
        control_endpoint = os.getenv(
            "SECUREDRIVE_MINIO_TIMEOUT_CONTROL_ENDPOINT", "http://127.0.0.1:8474"
        ).rstrip("/")
        proxy_name = "securedrive-timeout-test"

        def toxiproxy(method, path, payload=None):
            request = Request(
                f"{control_endpoint}{path}",
                data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                method=method,
            )
            try:
                with urlopen(request, timeout=2):
                    return
            except HTTPError as error:
                if method == "DELETE" and error.code == 404:
                    return
                raise

        toxiproxy("DELETE", f"/proxies/{proxy_name}")
        toxiproxy(
            "POST",
            "/proxies",
            {
                "name": proxy_name,
                "listen": "0.0.0.0:8666",
                "upstream": os.getenv("SECUREDRIVE_MINIO_TIMEOUT_UPSTREAM", "minio:9000"),
                "enabled": True,
            },
        )
        toxiproxy(
            "POST",
            f"/proxies/{proxy_name}/toxics",
            {
                "name": "downstream-delay",
                "type": "latency",
                "stream": "downstream",
                "toxicity": 1.0,
                "attributes": {"latency": 250, "jitter": 0},
            },
        )
        adapter = S3CompatibleStorageAdapter(
            endpoint_url=endpoint,
            bucket=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
            region=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_REGION,
            addressing_style=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ADDRESSING_STYLE,
            access_key_id=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
            secret_access_key=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
            tls_verify=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_TLS_VERIFY,
            ca_bundle=settings.SECUREDRIVE_STORAGE_CA_BUNDLE,
            connect_timeout=0.1,
            read_timeout=0.1,
            max_attempts=2,
        )
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(StorageRetryableError):
                adapter.stat_object(self.adapter.create_object_key("final"))
        finally:
            toxiproxy("DELETE", f"/proxies/{proxy_name}/toxics/downstream-delay")
            toxiproxy("DELETE", f"/proxies/{proxy_name}")

    def test_checksum_and_size_verification(self):
        import hashlib

        content = b"minio adapter integration content"
        checksum = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        key = self.adapter.create_object_key("final")
        try:
            stat = self.adapter.put_object(
                key,
                BytesIO(content),
                size_bytes=len(content),
                sha256_hex=checksum,
            )
            self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, len(content))
            self.assertEqual(
                self.adapter.verify_object(
                    key, expected_size=len(content), expected_sha256=checksum
                ).size_bytes,
                len(content),
            )
        finally:
            self.adapter.delete_object(key)

FILE: backend\files\tests\test_quota.py

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from threading import Barrier
from unittest.mock import patch
from unittest import skipUnless

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import IntegrityError, connection
from django.test import TestCase, TransactionTestCase

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, Tenant
from files.models import File, QuotaReservation, UploadSession
from files.quota import (
    QuotaExceeded,
    QuotaStateError,
    finalize_upload_quota,
    reserve_upload_quota,
)
from files.services import clone_encrypted_file_with_quota


User = get_user_model()


class QuotaReservationTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(username="quota-user")
        self.tenant = self.user.personal_tenant
        self.account = QuotaAccount.objects.get(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )
        self.account.limit_bytes = 100
        self.account.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes", "updated_at"])

    def create_upload(self, *, size=70, state=UploadSession.State.INITIATED):
        return UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            initiated_by=self.user,
            client_name="sample.bin",
            expected_size_bytes=size,
            state=state,
            expires_at="2035-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        )

    def test_reservation_is_idempotent_and_completion_consumes_actual_size(self):
        upload = self.create_upload()

        first = reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)
        second = reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)

        self.assertEqual(len(first), 1)
        self.assertEqual(first[0].pk, second[0].pk)
        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 70)
        self.assertEqual(QuotaReservation.objects.count(), 1)

        finalize_upload_quota(
            upload.pk,
            completed=True,
            actual_size_bytes=64,
        )
        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.used_bytes, 64)
        self.assertEqual(
            QuotaReservation.objects.get().state,
            QuotaReservation.State.CONSUMED,
        )
        finalize_upload_quota(
            upload.pk,
            completed=True,
            actual_size_bytes=64,
        )
        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.account.used_bytes, 64)

    def test_failed_or_canceled_upload_releases_reservation(self):
        upload = self.create_upload()
        reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)

        finalize_upload_quota(upload.pk, completed=False)
        self.account.refresh_from_db()

        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.used_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(
            QuotaReservation.objects.get().state,
            QuotaReservation.State.RELEASED,
        )

    def test_quota_limit_rejects_reservation_without_changing_counters(self):
        upload = self.create_upload(size=101)

        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceeded):
            reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)

        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertFalse(QuotaReservation.objects.exists())

    def test_business_upload_requires_member_allocation_and_checks_both_limits(self):
        self.tenant.kind = Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS
        self.tenant.personal_owner = None
        self.tenant.save(update_fields=["kind", "personal_owner"])
        member_account = QuotaAccount.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.MEMBER,
            user=self.user,
            limit_bytes=50,
        )
        upload = self.create_upload(size=60)

        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceeded):
            reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)

        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        member_account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(member_account.reserved_bytes, 0)

    def test_only_initiator_can_reserve_and_completed_upload_cannot_start_reservation(self):
        other_user = User.objects.create_user(username="other-quota-user")
        upload = self.create_upload()
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaStateError):
            reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, other_user)

        upload.state = UploadSession.State.COMPLETED
        upload.save(update_fields=["state"])
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaStateError):
            reserve_upload_quota(upload.pk, self.user)

    def test_database_rejects_negative_quota_counters(self):
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with self.atomic():
                QuotaAccount.objects.filter(pk=self.account.pk).update(
                    reserved_bytes=-1
                )

    @patch("files.services._clone_encrypted_file")
    def test_copy_reserves_and_consumes_target_tenant_quota(self, clone_file):
        source = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            file_name="source.bin",
            file_size=40,
            file_path="uploads/source.enc",
        )
        clone_file.side_effect = lambda source_file, *, owner, folder, file_name, tenant: File.objects.create(
            tenant=tenant,
            owner=owner,
            folder=folder,
            file_name=file_name,
            file_size=source_file.file_size,
            file_path="uploads/copy.enc",
        )

        copied = clone_encrypted_file_with_quota(
            source,
            owner=self.user,
            folder=None,
            file_name="source (copy).bin",
            tenant=self.tenant,
        )

        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        upload = UploadSession.objects.get(file=copied)
        self.assertEqual(copied.tenant_id, self.tenant.pk)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.used_bytes, 40)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.COMPLETED)
        self.assertEqual(
            QuotaReservation.objects.get(upload_session=upload).state,
            QuotaReservation.State.CONSUMED,
        )

    @patch(
        "files.services._clone_encrypted_file",
        side_effect=ValueError("copy failed"),
    )
    def test_failed_copy_releases_reserved_quota(self, _clone_file):
        source = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            file_name="source.bin",
            file_size=40,
            file_path="uploads/source.enc",
        )

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "copy failed"):
            clone_encrypted_file_with_quota(
                source,
                owner=self.user,
                folder=None,
                file_name="source (copy).bin",
                tenant=self.tenant,
            )

        self.account.refresh_from_db()
        upload = UploadSession.objects.get(client_name="source (copy).bin")
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.FAILED)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.used_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.account.reserved_bytes, 0)
        self.assertEqual(
            QuotaReservation.objects.get(upload_session=upload).state,
            QuotaReservation.State.RELEASED,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def atomic():
        from django.db import transaction

        return transaction.atomic()


@skipUnless(connection.vendor == "postgresql", "Requires PostgreSQL row locks.")
class QuotaReservationConcurrencyTests(TransactionTestCase):
    reset_sequences = True

    def test_concurrent_reservations_cannot_overrun_quota(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username="concurrent-quota-user")
        tenant = user.personal_tenant
        account = QuotaAccount.objects.get(
            tenant=tenant,
            scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT,
        )
        account.limit_bytes = 100
        account.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes", "updated_at"])
        uploads = [
            UploadSession.objects.create(
                tenant=tenant,
                initiated_by=user,
                client_name=f"item-{index}.bin",
                expected_size_bytes=60,
                expires_at="2035-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            )
            for index in range(2)
        ]
        barrier = Barrier(2)

        def attempt(upload_id):
            from django.db import close_old_connections

            close_old_connections()
            try:
                barrier.wait()
                reserve_upload_quota(upload_id, User.objects.get(pk=user.pk))
                return "reserved"
            except QuotaExceeded:
                return "rejected"
            finally:
                close_old_connections()

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
            results = list(executor.map(attempt, [row.pk for row in uploads]))

        self.assertCountEqual(results, ["reserved", "rejected"])
        account.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(account.reserved_bytes, 60)

import base64
import hashlib
import unittest
from io import BytesIO
from unittest.mock import Mock

from botocore.exceptions import ReadTimeoutError

from files.storage_adapters.base import (
    MultipartPart,
    StorageIntegrityError,
    StorageNonRetryableError,
    StorageRetryableError,
)
from files.storage_adapters.s3_compatible import S3CompatibleStorageAdapter


class StorageAdapterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def build_adapter(self, client, **kwargs):
        return S3CompatibleStorageAdapter(
            endpoint_url="http://localhost:9000",
            bucket="securedrive-test",
            client=client,
            sleep=Mock(),
            random_uniform=lambda low, high: high,
            **kwargs,
        )

    def test_server_object_keys_never_use_user_filename(self):
        adapter = self.build_adapter(Mock())
        key = adapter.create_object_key("quarantine")
        self.assertRegex(key, r"^quarantine/[0-9a-f]{32}$")
        with self.assertRaises(StorageNonRetryableError):
            adapter.create_object_key("../../customer-name.txt")

    def test_object_checksum_and_size_are_verified(self):
        payload = b"verified bytes"
        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.return_value = {
            "ContentLength": len(payload),
            "ChecksumSHA256": base64.b64encode(bytes.fromhex(digest)).decode(),
            "ChecksumType": "FULL_OBJECT",
        }
        stat = self.build_adapter(client).verify_object(
            "final/" + "a" * 32, expected_size=len(payload), expected_sha256=digest
        )
        self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, len(payload))
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).verify_object("final/" + "a" * 32, expected_size=999)

    def test_missing_native_checksum_does_not_fall_back_to_etag(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.return_value = {"ContentLength": 3, "ETag": '"abc"'}
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).verify_object(
                "final/" + "a" * 32, expected_size=3, expected_sha256="a" * 64
            )

    def test_transient_timeout_retries_are_bounded(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.side_effect = [
            ReadTimeoutError(endpoint_url="http://storage", error="timeout"),
            {"ContentLength": 1},
        ]
        sleep = Mock()
        adapter = S3CompatibleStorageAdapter(
            endpoint_url="http://localhost:9000",
            bucket="securedrive-test",
            client=client,
            max_attempts=2,
            sleep=sleep,
            random_uniform=lambda low, high: high,
        )
        self.assertEqual(adapter.stat_object("final/" + "a" * 32).size_bytes, 1)
        self.assertEqual(client.head_object.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(sleep.call_count, 1)

    def test_transient_timeout_stops_at_retry_limit(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.side_effect = ReadTimeoutError(
            endpoint_url="http://storage", error="timeout"
        )
        with self.assertRaises(StorageRetryableError):
            self.build_adapter(client, max_attempts=2).stat_object("final/" + "a" * 32)
        self.assertEqual(client.head_object.call_count, 2)

    def test_stream_download_restarts_from_zero_after_read_timeout(self):
        payload = b"complete response"

        class PartialThenTimeout:
            def __init__(self):
                self.read_count = 0

            def read(self, _size):
                self.read_count += 1
                if self.read_count == 1:
                    return b"partial"
                raise ReadTimeoutError(endpoint_url="http://storage", error="timeout")

            def close(self):
                pass

        client = Mock()
        client.get_object.side_effect = [
            {"Body": PartialThenTimeout(), "ContentLength": len(payload)},
            {"Body": BytesIO(payload), "ContentLength": len(payload)},
        ]
        destination = BytesIO(b"old data")
        adapter = self.build_adapter(client, max_attempts=2)
        stat = adapter.download_to("final/" + "a" * 32, destination)
        self.assertEqual(destination.getvalue(), payload)
        self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, len(payload))
        self.assertEqual(client.get_object.call_count, 2)

    def test_list_uploaded_parts_paginates_without_completing(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.list_parts.side_effect = [
            {"Parts": [{"PartNumber": 1, "ETag": '"etag-1"', "Size": 8}],
             "IsTruncated": True, "NextPartNumberMarker": 1},
            {"Parts": [{"PartNumber": 2, "ETag": '"etag-2"', "Size": 3}],
             "IsTruncated": False},
        ]
        result = self.build_adapter(client).list_uploaded_parts(
            "staging/" + "a" * 32, "multipart-id"
        )
        self.assertEqual([(p.part_number, p.etag, p.size_bytes) for p in result], [
            (1, '"etag-1"', 8), (2, '"etag-2"', 3),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(client.list_parts.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(client.list_parts.call_args.kwargs["PartNumberMarker"], 1)
        client.complete_multipart_upload.assert_not_called()

    def test_list_parts_rejects_nonadvancing_page_marker(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.list_parts.return_value = {
            "Parts": [{"PartNumber": 1, "ETag": '"etag-1"', "Size": 8}],
            "IsTruncated": True,
            "NextPartNumberMarker": 0,
        }
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).list_uploaded_parts(
                "staging/" + "a" * 32, "multipart-id"
            )
        self.assertEqual(client.list_parts.call_count, 1)

    def test_complete_uses_provider_manifest_and_rejects_mismatch(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.list_parts.return_value = {
            "Parts": [{"PartNumber": 1, "ETag": '"provider-etag"', "Size": 10}],
            "IsTruncated": False,
        }
        adapter = self.build_adapter(client)
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            adapter.complete_multipart(
                "quarantine/" + "b" * 32,
                "upload-id",
                [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag='"client-etag"')],
                expected_size=10,
            )
        client.complete_multipart_upload.assert_not_called()

    def test_completed_object_validates_secure_drive_session_id_not_s3_upload_id(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.list_parts.return_value = {
            "Parts": [{"PartNumber": 1, "ETag": '"provider-etag"', "Size": 10}],
            "IsTruncated": False,
        }
        client.head_object.return_value = {
            "ContentLength": 10,
            "Metadata": {"securedrive-upload-id": "secure-drive-session-uuid"},
        }
        adapter = self.build_adapter(client)
        stat = adapter.complete_multipart(
            "quarantine/" + "b" * 32,
            "s3-provider-multipart-id",
            [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag='"provider-etag"')],
            expected_size=10,
            expected_upload_session_id="secure-drive-session-uuid",
        )
        self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, 10)
        client.complete_multipart_upload.assert_called_once()

    def test_completed_object_rejects_mismatched_secure_drive_session_id(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.list_parts.return_value = {
            "Parts": [{"PartNumber": 1, "ETag": '"provider-etag"', "Size": 10}],
            "IsTruncated": False,
        }
        client.head_object.return_value = {
            "ContentLength": 10,
            "Metadata": {"securedrive-upload-id": "different-session"},
        }
        adapter = self.build_adapter(client)

            adapter.complete_multipart(
                "quarantine/" + "b" * 32,
                "s3-provider-multipart-id",
                [MultipartPart(part_number=1, etag='"provider-etag"')],
                expected_size=10,
                expected_upload_session_id="secure-drive-session-uuid",
            )

    def test_presigned_url_lifetime_is_capped(self):
        adapter = self.build_adapter(Mock(), max_presigned_url_seconds=60)
        with self.assertRaises(StorageNonRetryableError):
            adapter.create_part_upload_url(
                "quarantine/" + "b" * 32, "upload-id", 1, expires_in=61
            )

    def test_put_object_passes_checksum_to_storage_and_verifies_head(self):
        payload = b"ciphertext bytes"
        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        client = Mock()
        client.put_object.return_value = {}
        client.head_object.return_value = {
            "ContentLength": len(payload),
            "ChecksumSHA256": base64.b64encode(bytes.fromhex(digest)).decode(),
            "ChecksumType": "FULL_OBJECT",
        }
        stat = self.build_adapter(client).put_object(
            "final/" + "a" * 32,
            BytesIO(payload),
            size_bytes=len(payload),
            sha256_hex=digest,
        )
        self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, len(payload))
        self.assertEqual(
            client.put_object.call_args.kwargs["ChecksumSHA256"],
            base64.b64encode(bytes.fromhex(digest)).decode(),
        )

    def test_download_size_limit_rejects_provider_declared_oversize(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.get_object.return_value = {
            "Body": BytesIO(b"large"), "ContentLength": 50,
        }
        destination = BytesIO()
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).download_to(
                "staging/" + "a" * 32, destination, max_bytes=10
            )
        self.assertEqual(destination.getvalue(), b"")

    def test_download_size_limit_rejects_stream_longer_than_declared(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.get_object.return_value = {
            "Body": BytesIO(b"longer than metadata"), "ContentLength": 5,
        }
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).download_to(

            )

    def test_publish_verified_object_uses_conditional_server_side_copy(self):
        content = b"verified multipart bytes"
        digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        session_id = "session-uuid"
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.side_effect = [
            {
                "ContentLength": len(content), "ETag": '"source-etag-2"',
                "Metadata": {"securedrive-upload-id": session_id},
            },
            {
                "ContentLength": len(content), "ETag": '"destination-etag"',
                "Metadata": {
                    "securedrive-sha256": digest,
                    "securedrive-upload-id": session_id,
                },
            },
        ]
        storage = self.build_adapter(client)
        stat = storage.publish_verified_object(
            "staging/" + "a" * 32, "primary/" + "b" * 32,
            expected_size=len(content), expected_sha256=digest,
            upload_session_id=session_id, content_type="text/plain",
            expected_source_etag="source-etag-2",
        )
        self.assertEqual(stat.size_bytes, len(content))
        self.assertEqual(client.copy_object.call_count, 1)
        params = client.copy_object.call_args.kwargs
        self.assertEqual(params["CopySourceIfMatch"], '"source-etag-2"')
        self.assertEqual(params["MetadataDirective"], "REPLACE")
        self.assertEqual(params["Metadata"]["securedrive-sha256"], digest)
        self.assertEqual(params["ContentType"], "text/plain")
        client.put_object.assert_not_called()
        client.get_object.assert_not_called()
        client.delete_object.assert_not_called()

    def test_publish_rejects_source_changed_since_full_sha256(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.head_object.return_value = {
            "ContentLength": 3, "ETag": '"new-etag"',

        }

                upload_session_id="session-uuid", expected_source_etag="old-etag",
            )
        client.copy_object.assert_not_called()

    def test_publish_rejects_destination_without_verified_metadata(self):
        client = Mock()

        ]
        with self.assertRaises(StorageIntegrityError):
            self.build_adapter(client).publish_verified_object(
                "staging/" + "a" * 32, "primary/" + "b" * 32,
                expected_size=3, expected_sha256="a" * 64,
                upload_session_id="session-uuid",
            )

    def test_publish_recovers_lost_copy_response_by_head(self):
        client = Mock()
        client.copy_object.side_effect = ReadTimeoutError(
            endpoint_url="http://storage", error="response lost"
        )
        client.head_object.side_effect = [
            {"ContentLength": 3, "ETag": '"etag"',
             "Metadata": {"securedrive-upload-id": "session-uuid"}},
            {"ContentLength": 3,
             "Metadata": {
                 "securedrive-sha256": "a" * 64,
                 "securedrive-upload-id": "session-uuid",
             }},
        ]
        result = self.build_adapter(client).publish_verified_object(
            "staging/" + "a" * 32, "primary/" + "b" * 32,
            expected_size=3, expected_sha256="a" * 64,
            upload_session_id="session-uuid",

        self.assertEqual(result.size_bytes, 3)

from unittest import skipUnless

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import IntegrityError, connection, transaction
from django.test import TestCase

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount, Tenant
from files.models import File, FileVersion, UploadSession
from files.serializers import (
    FileMetadataSerializer,
    FileVersionMetadataSerializer,
    QuotaUsageSerializer,
    UploadSessionStatusSerializer,
)
from folders.models import Folder
from folders.serializers import FolderMetadataSerializer


User = get_user_model()


class TenantModelTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(username="tenant-user")
        self.tenant = self.user.personal_tenant
        self.other_user = User.objects.create_user(username="other-tenant-user")
        self.other_tenant = self.other_user.personal_tenant

    def test_folder_live_names_are_case_insensitive_and_trash_can_reuse_name(self):
        live = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            folder_name="Projects",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                Folder.objects.create(
                    tenant=self.tenant,
                    owner=self.user,
                    folder_name="projects",
                )

        trashed = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            folder_name="projects",
            deleted_at="2030-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                Folder.objects.filter(pk=trashed.pk).update(deleted_at=None)
        self.assertIsNone(Folder.objects.get(pk=live.pk).deleted_at)
        self.assertIsNotNone(Folder.objects.get(pk=trashed.pk).deleted_at)

    def test_file_live_names_are_unique_per_tenant_and_folder(self):
        File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            file_name="report.pdf",
            file_path="uploads/report.enc",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                File.objects.create(
                    tenant=self.tenant,
                    owner=self.user,
                    file_name="REPORT.PDF",
                    file_path="uploads/report-2.enc",
                )

    def test_serializers_expose_metadata_only_and_are_read_only(self):
        folder = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            folder_name="Documents",
        )
        drive_file = File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            folder=folder,
            file_name="encrypted.bin",
            file_path="uploads/secret-key.enc",
            wrapped_dek=b"not-for-api",
            encryption_nonce=b"nonce",
            dek_nonce=b"dek-nonce",
        )
        version = FileVersion.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            file=drive_file,
            version_number=1,
            state=FileVersion.State.PENDING,
            size_bytes=drive_file.file_size,
            wrapped_dek=b"not-for-api",
        )
        upload = UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            initiated_by=self.user,
            client_name="queued.bin",
            expected_size_bytes=10,
            expires_at="2030-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        )

        file_data = FileMetadataSerializer(drive_file).data
        folder_data = FolderMetadataSerializer(folder).data
        version_data = FileVersionMetadataSerializer(version).data
        upload_data = UploadSessionStatusSerializer(upload).data

        self.assertNotIn("file_path", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("tenant", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("owner", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("wrapped_dek", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("encryption_nonce", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("dek_nonce", file_data)
        self.assertNotIn("tenant", folder_data)
        self.assertNotIn("owner", folder_data)
        self.assertEqual(set(file_data.keys()), set(FileMetadataSerializer.Meta.fields))
        self.assertTrue(all(FileMetadataSerializer().fields[name].read_only for name in FileMetadataSerializer.Meta.fields))
        self.assertTrue(all(FolderMetadataSerializer().fields[name].read_only for name in FolderMetadataSerializer.Meta.fields))
        self.assertIn("used_bytes", QuotaUsageSerializer.Meta.fields)
        self.assertNotIn("user", QuotaUsageSerializer.Meta.fields)
        self.assertNotIn("tenant", QuotaUsageSerializer.Meta.fields)
        self.assertNotIn("wrapped_dek", version_data)
        self.assertNotIn("sha256", FileVersionMetadataSerializer.Meta.fields)
        self.assertNotIn("tenant", upload_data)
        self.assertNotIn("initiated_by", upload_data)
        self.assertNotIn("target_folder", upload_data)
        self.assertNotIn("expected_sha256", upload_data)

    @skipUnless(connection.vendor == "postgresql", "Composite foreign keys are PostgreSQL-only.")
    def test_postgres_rejects_cross_tenant_parent_and_file_folder(self):
        parent = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            owner=self.user,
            folder_name="Parent",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                Folder.objects.create(
                    tenant=self.other_tenant,
                    owner=self.other_user,
                    folder_name="Wrong parent",
                    parent=parent,
                )
                with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                    cursor.execute("SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE")

        other_folder = Folder.objects.create(
            tenant=self.other_tenant,
            owner=self.other_user,
            folder_name="Other folder",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                File.objects.create(
                    tenant=self.tenant,
                    owner=self.user,
                    folder=other_folder,
                    file_name="cross-tenant.txt",
                    file_path="uploads/cross.enc",
                )
                with connection.cursor() as cursor:
                    cursor.execute("SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE")

from unittest.mock import patch

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from accounts.models import QuotaAccount
from files.models import QuotaReservation, UploadSession


class UploadApiTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = get_user_model().objects.create_user(username="multipart-user", password="test-pass")
        self.tenant = self.user.personal_tenant
        self.account = QuotaAccount.objects.get(tenant=self.tenant, scope=QuotaAccount.Scope.TENANT)
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.user)

    @patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter")
    @patch("files.upload_api.reserve_upload_quota")
    def test_create_reserves_server_owned_session_and_starts_multipart(self, reserve, adapter_factory):
        adapter = adapter_factory.return_value
        adapter.create_object_key.return_value = "quarantine/" + "a" * 32
        adapter.initiate_multipart.return_value.upload_id = "provider-upload-id"
        response = self.client.post("/files/api/uploads/", {
            "name": "document.txt", "size_bytes": 9, "sha256": "a" * 64,
        }, format="json", HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY="req-1")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        upload = UploadSession.objects.get(pk=response.data["upload_id"])
        self.assertEqual(upload.tenant_id, self.tenant.pk)
        self.assertEqual(upload.initiated_by_id, self.user.pk)
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.UPLOADING)
        self.assertEqual(upload.object_key, "quarantine/" + "a" * 32)
        reserve.assert_called_once_with(upload.pk, self.user)

    def test_malicious_extension_is_rejected_before_session_creation(self):
        response = self.client.post("/files/api/uploads/", {
            "name": "payload.exe", "size_bytes": 12,
        }, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertFalse(UploadSession.objects.exists())

    def test_anonymous_cannot_create_upload(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=None)
        response = self.client.post("/files/api/uploads/", {
            "name": "document.txt", "size_bytes": 1,
        }, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

    def test_quota_exhaustion_rejects_session_without_finalizing_missing_reservation(self):
        self.account.limit_bytes = 0
        self.account.save(update_fields=["limit_bytes", "updated_at"])
        with (
            patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter") as adapter_factory,
            patch("files.upload_api.finalize_upload_quota") as finalize_quota,
        ):
            adapter_factory.return_value.create_object_key.return_value = "quarantine/" + "b" * 32
            response = self.client.post("/files/api/uploads/", {
                "name": "document.txt", "size_bytes": 9, "sha256": "a" * 64,
            }, format="json")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 413)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["failure_code"], "quota_exceeded")
        adapter_factory.return_value.initiate_multipart.assert_not_called()
        finalize_quota.assert_not_called()
        upload = UploadSession.objects.get()
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.FAILED)
        self.assertEqual(upload.failure_code, "quota_exceeded")
        self.assertFalse(QuotaReservation.objects.filter(upload_session=upload).exists())

    def test_setup_failure_before_reservation_does_not_finalize_missing_reservation(self):
        with (
            patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter") as adapter_factory,
            patch(
                "files.upload_api.reserve_upload_quota",
                side_effect=RuntimeError("Quota service unavailable"),
            ),
            patch("files.upload_api.finalize_upload_quota") as finalize_quota,
        ):
            adapter_factory.return_value.create_object_key.return_value = "quarantine/" + "e" * 32
            with self.assertLogs("files.upload_api", level="ERROR") as log_output:
                response = self.client.post("/files/api/uploads/", {
                    "name": "document.txt", "size_bytes": 9, "sha256": "a" * 64,
                }, format="json")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 503)
        self.assertTrue(any("Upload initialization failed" in line for line in log_output.output))
        self.assertFalse(any("Unable to release quota after setup failure" in line for line in log_output.output))
        finalize_quota.assert_not_called()
        upload = UploadSession.objects.get()
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.FAILED)
        self.assertEqual(upload.failure_code, "storage_setup_failed")
        self.assertFalse(QuotaReservation.objects.filter(upload_session=upload).exists())

    @patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter")
    def test_batch_authorization_returns_one_url_for_each_part(self, adapter_factory):
        adapter = adapter_factory.return_value
        adapter.create_part_upload_url.side_effect = lambda key, provider_id, number, *, expires_in: type(
            "Signed", (), {

                "required_headers": {},

        )()

        authorized = self.client.post(f"/files/api/uploads/{upload_id}/parts/1/authorization/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(authorized.status_code, 200)
        adapter.create_part_upload_url.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(adapter.create_part_upload_url.call_args.kwargs["expires_in"], 180)

"""Regression tests for workspace-scoped Drive access and mutations."""
import json
from unittest.mock import patch

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model

class WorkspaceDriveAccessTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client = Client()
        self.owner = User.objects.create_user(
            username="workspace-owner",
            email="workspace-owner@example.test",
            password="test-password",
        )
        self.tenant = Tenant.objects.create(
            kind=Tenant.Kind.BUSINESS,
            name="Workspace Access Corporation",
        )
        self.owner_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            user=self.owner,
            role=Membership.Role.OWNER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.member = User.objects.create_user(
            username="workspace-member",
            email="workspace-member@example.test",
            password="test-password",
        )
        self.member_membership = Membership.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            user=self.member,
            role=Membership.Role.MEMBER,
            status=Membership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )

        self.default_workspace = Workspace.objects.get(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            is_default=True,
        )
        self.viewer_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            name="Read Only",
            slug="read-only",
        )
        self.private_workspace = Workspace.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            name="Restricted",
            slug="restricted",
        )
        WorkspaceMembership.objects.create(
            workspace=self.viewer_workspace,
            membership=self.member_membership,
            role=WorkspaceMembership.Role.VIEWER,
            status=WorkspaceMembership.Status.ACTIVE,
        )

        self.default_file = self._create_file(
            self.default_workspace,
            "general.txt",
        )
        self.viewer_file = self._create_file(
            self.viewer_workspace,
            "read-only.txt",
        )
        self.private_file = self._create_file(
            self.private_workspace,
            "restricted.txt",
        )
        self.client.force_login(self.member)

    def _create_file(self, workspace, name):
        return File.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=workspace,
            owner=self.member,
            file_name=name,
            file_path=f"uploads/{workspace.slug}-{name}.enc",
            file_size=12,
            mime_type="text/plain",
        )

    def test_workspace_viewer_can_read_owned_file_but_cannot_edit(self):
        self.assertTrue(can_access_workspace(self.member, self.viewer_workspace))
        self.assertTrue(can_view_file(self.viewer_file, self.member))
        self.assertFalse(can_edit_workspace_content(self.member, self.viewer_workspace))
        self.assertFalse(can_edit_file(self.viewer_file, self.member))

    def test_drive_list_returns_only_items_from_selected_workspace(self):

            reverse("drive_items_api"),
            {"workspace_id": str(self.viewer_workspace.pk)},
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        names = {item["name"] for item in response.json()["items"]}
        self.assertEqual(names, {"read-only.txt"})

    def test_default_context_returns_only_personal_my_drive(self):
        """No workspace selector must never fall back to a business tenant."""
        personal_tenant = get_personal_tenant(self.member)
        personal_workspace = get_default_workspace(personal_tenant)
        File.objects.create(
            tenant=personal_tenant,
            workspace=personal_workspace,
            owner=self.member,
            file_name="my-drive.txt",
            file_path="uploads/my-drive.txt",
            file_size=12,
            mime_type="text/plain",
        )

        response = self.client.get(reverse("drive_items_api"))

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        names = {item["name"] for item in response.json()["items"]}
        self.assertEqual(names, {"my-drive.txt"})

    def test_explicit_workspace_without_membership_is_not_fallback_to_default(self):
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("drive_items_api"),
            {"workspace_id": str(self.private_workspace.pk)},
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)

    def test_viewer_cannot_create_root_folder_in_read_only_workspace(self):
        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("folder_create_api"),
            data=json.dumps({
                "name": "Not Allowed",

            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=self.viewer_workspace,

        ).exists())

    def test_viewer_cannot_start_upload_in_read_only_workspace(self):
        before = UploadSession.objects.count()
        with patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter") as storage_adapter:
            response = self.client.post(
                reverse("api-upload-create"),
                data=json.dumps({
                    "name": "not-allowed.txt",
                    "size_bytes": 1,
                    "sha256": "0" * 64,
                    "workspace_id": str(self.viewer_workspace.pk),
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
            )
            storage_adapter.assert_not_called()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(UploadSession.objects.count(), before)


    def test_downgraded_editor_cannot_authorize_parts_or_complete_upload(self):
        """A previously writable session must not survive role revocation."""
        membership = WorkspaceMembership.objects.get(
            workspace=self.viewer_workspace,
            membership=self.member_membership,
        )
        membership.role = WorkspaceMembership.Role.EDITOR
        membership.save(update_fields=["role"])
        upload = UploadSession.objects.create(
            tenant=self.tenant,
            workspace=self.viewer_workspace,
            initiated_by=self.member,
            client_name="report.txt",
            expected_size_bytes=9 * 1024 * 1024,
            expected_sha256="a" * 64,
            object_key="staging/" + "a" * 32,
            provider_upload_id="s3-upload-id",
            expires_at="2035-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            state=UploadSession.State.UPLOADING,
        )
        membership.role = WorkspaceMembership.Role.VIEWER
        membership.save(update_fields=["role"])

        with patch("files.upload_api.get_storage_adapter") as storage_adapter:
            responses = [
                self.client.get(reverse("api-upload-parts-list", args=[upload.pk])),
                self.client.post(reverse("api-upload-part-authorization", args=[upload.pk, 1])),
                self.client.post(
                    reverse("api-upload-parts-authorization-batch", args=[upload.pk]),
                    data=json.dumps({"part_numbers": [1]}),
                    content_type="application/json",
                ),
                self.client.post(
                    reverse("api-upload-complete", args=[upload.pk]),
                    data=json.dumps({"parts": [{"part_number": 1, "etag": '"part-etag"'}]}),
                    content_type="application/json",
                ),
            ]
            storage_adapter.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual([response.status_code for response in responses], [404, 404, 404, 404])
        upload.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(upload.state, UploadSession.State.UPLOADING)

    def test_move_api_cannot_select_an_item_from_another_workspace(self):
        response = self.client.post(
            reverse("drive_items_move_api"),
            data=json.dumps({
                "workspace_id": str(self.default_workspace.pk),
                "file_ids": [self.private_file.pk],
                "folder_ids": [],
                "destination_folder_id": None,
            }),
            content_type="application/json",
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
        self.private_file.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(self.private_file.folder_id)

    def test_archived_workspace_denies_owner_access(self):
        self.viewer_workspace.status = Workspace.Status.ARCHIVED
        self.viewer_workspace.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])

        self.assertFalse(can_access_workspace(self.member, self.viewer_workspace))
        self.assertFalse(can_view_file(self.viewer_file, self.member))
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("drive_items_api"),
            {"workspace_id": str(self.viewer_workspace.pk)},
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
