"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, History, Search, Trash2, HardDrive, Languages, Plug, Palette } from "lucide-react";
import DashboardShell from "@/components/layout/DashboardShell";
import CustomScrollArea from "@/components/ui/CustomScrollArea";
import { readThemePreference, setThemePreference, type ThemePreference } from "@/lib/theme";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import {
  clearMySearchHistory,
  deleteMyDriveData,
  getMyActivity,
  getMySearchHistory,
  type SearchHistoryItem,
  type UserActivityEvent,
} from "@/lib/user-settings-service";
import { requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";

type SettingsTab = "general" | "privacy" | "connections";
type QuotaSummary = { configured: boolean; limitBytes: number | null; usedBytes: number | null; percentUsed: number | null; message?: string };
function formatBytes(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value == null) return "—";
  if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let amount = value / 1024;
  let index = 0;
  while (amount >= 1024 && index < units.length - 1) { amount /= 1024; index++; }
  return `${amount.toFixed(amount >= 10 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[index]}`;
}
function formatDate(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }).format(date);
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<SettingsTab>("general");
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemePreference>("system");
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState("");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setTheme(readThemePreference()), 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  function changeTheme(next: ThemePreference) {
    setTheme(next);
    setThemePreference(next);
  }
  function inDateRange(value: string): boolean {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return false;
    const day = `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    // A single selected date filters that day; two dates filter the inclusive range.
    if (dateFrom && dateTo) return day >= dateFrom && day <= dateTo;
    if (dateFrom) return day === dateFrom;
    if (dateTo) return day === dateTo;
    return true;
  }

  const [quota, setQuota] = useState<QuotaSummary | null>(null);
  const [quotaError, setQuotaError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState<UserActivityEvent[]>([]);
  const [activityHasMore, setActivityHasMore] = useState(false);
  const [searchHasMore, setSearchHasMore] = useState(false);
  const [activityError, setActivityError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activityLoadingMore, setActivityLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [searchLoadingMore, setSearchLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [selectedActivity, setSelectedActivity] = useState<UserActivityEvent | null>(null);
  const [searchHistory, setSearchHistory] = useState<SearchHistoryItem[]>([]);
  const [privacyLoading, setPrivacyLoading] = useState(false);
  const [privacyError, setPrivacyError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [historyBusy, setHistoryBusy] = useState(false);
  const [deletePassword, setDeletePassword] = useState("");
  const [deleteConfirmation, setDeleteConfirmation] = useState("");
  const [deleteBusy, setDeleteBusy] = useState(false);
  const [deleteFeedback, setDeleteFeedback] = useState<{ kind: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);


  const loadPrivacyData = useCallback(async () => {
    setPrivacyLoading(true);
    setPrivacyError(null);
    setActivityError(null);
    setSearchError(null);
    // Separate failures: an unavailable Activity endpoint must never hide Search History.
    const [activityResult, searchResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
      getMyActivity(50),
      getMySearchHistory(50),
    ]);
    if (activityResult.status === "fulfilled") {
      setActivity(activityResult.value.events);
      setActivityHasMore(activityResult.value.hasMore);
    } else {
      setActivityError(activityResult.reason instanceof Error ? activityResult.reason.message : "Could not load activity history.");
    }
    if (searchResult.status === "fulfilled") {
      setSearchHistory(searchResult.value.items);
      setSearchHasMore(searchResult.value.hasMore);
    } else {
      setSearchError(searchResult.reason instanceof Error ? searchResult.reason.message : "Could not load search history.");
    }
    setPrivacyLoading(false);
  }, []);

  async function loadOlderActivity() {
    if (activityLoadingMore || !activityHasMore) return;
    setActivityLoadingMore(true);
    setActivityError(null);
    try {
      const next = await getMyActivity(50, activity.length);
      setActivity((previous) => [...previous, ...next.events.filter((event) => !previous.some((existing) => existing.id === event.id))]);
      setActivityHasMore(next.hasMore);
    } catch (error) {
      setActivityError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load older activity.");
    } finally {
      setActivityLoadingMore(false);
    }
  }

  async function loadOlderSearches() {
    if (searchLoadingMore || !searchHasMore) return;
    setSearchLoadingMore(true);
    setSearchError(null);
    try {
      const next = await getMySearchHistory(50, searchHistory.length);
      setSearchHistory((previous) => [...previous, ...next.items.filter((item) => !previous.some((existing) => existing.id === item.id))]);
      setSearchHasMore(next.hasMore);
    } catch (error) {
      setSearchError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load older searches.");
    } finally {
      setSearchLoadingMore(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== "privacy") return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { void loadPrivacyData(); }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [activeTab, loadPrivacyData]);


  async function handleClearHistory() {
    if (!window.confirm("Clear your search history? This cannot be undone.")) return;
    setHistoryBusy(true);
    setPrivacyError(null);
    try {
      await clearMySearchHistory();
      setSearchHistory([]);
      setSearchHasMore(false);
      setSearchError(null);
    } catch (error) {
      setPrivacyError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not clear search history.");
    } finally {
      setHistoryBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleDeleteMyDrive(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setDeleteFeedback(null);
    if (deleteConfirmation !== "DELETE MY DRIVE") {
      setDeleteFeedback({ kind: "error", text: 'Enter "DELETE MY DRIVE" exactly to confirm.' });
      return;
    }
    if (!deletePassword) {
      setDeleteFeedback({ kind: "error", text: "Enter your current password." });
      return;
    }
    const confirmed = window.confirm("This permanently deletes your personal My Drive files and folders, not shared workspace data. Continue?");
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeleteBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await deleteMyDriveData({ password: deletePassword, confirmation: "DELETE MY DRIVE" });
      setDeletePassword("");
      setDeleteConfirmation("");
      setDeleteFeedback({ kind: "success", text: `Deleted ${result.filesDeleted} files and ${result.foldersDeleted} folders from My Drive. Security logs were retained.` });
      await loadPrivacyData();
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("securedrive:folder-tree-refresh"));
    } catch (error) {
      setDeleteFeedback({ kind: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not delete My Drive data." });
    } finally {
      setDeleteBusy(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    requestAccountApi<QuotaSummary>("/accounts/api/me/quota/")
      .then((value) => { if (!cancelled) setQuota(value); })
      .catch((error: unknown) => { if (!cancelled) setQuotaError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Storage information is unavailable."); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);
  return (
    <DashboardShell settingsNavigation={{ active: activeTab, onChange: (section) => setActiveTab(section as SettingsTab) }}>
      <section className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl p-5 sm:p-8">
        <h1 className="mb-6 text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground">{
          activeTab === "general" ? "General Settings" : activeTab === "privacy" ? "Privacy" : "Connected Apps"
        }</h1>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          {activeTab === "general" ? (
            <div className="divide-y divide-border rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface px-5 sm:px-7">
              <section className="py-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><HardDrive size={19} className="text-brand-contrast" /><h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Storage</h3></div>
                {quota?.configured ? (
                  <div className="mt-4 max-w-lg space-y-2">
                    <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-background" role="progressbar" aria-label="Storage used" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={Math.max(0, Math.min(100, quota.percentUsed ?? 0))}>
                      <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-contrast" style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, quota.percentUsed ?? 0))}%` }} />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">{formatBytes(quota.usedBytes)} used{quota.limitBytes == null ? " · No limit" : ` of ${formatBytes(quota.limitBytes)}`}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-muted">{quotaError ?? quota?.message ?? "Loading storage information…"}</p>}
              </section>
              <section className="py-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Palette size={19} className="text-brand-contrast" /><h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Theme</h3></div>
                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {(["system", "light", "dark"] as const).map((option) => (
                    <button key={option} type="button" onClick={() => changeTheme(option)}
                      aria-pressed={theme === option}
                      className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium ${theme === option ? "border-brand bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast" : "border-border bg-background text-foreground"}`}>
                      {option === "system" ? "System" : option === "light" ? "Light" : "Dark"}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>
              <section className="py-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Languages size={19} className="text-brand-contrast" /><h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Language</h3></div>
                <label className="mt-4 block max-w-xs"><span className="mb-1.5 block text-xs text-muted">Display language</span>
                  <select value="en" disabled className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[13px] text-foreground"><option value="en">English</option></select>
                </label>
              </section>
            </div>
          ) : activeTab === "privacy" ? (
            <div className="space-y-5">

          {privacyError && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-surface p-3 text-sm text-danger">{privacyError}</p>}

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-5 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-background text-muted"><History size={19} /></span>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Activity History</h2>
                  
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => void loadPrivacyData()} disabled={privacyLoading}>Refresh</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background/50 px-3 py-3">
                <label className="text-xs text-muted">From
                  <input type="date" value={dateFrom} onChange={(event) => { const value = event.target.value; setDateFrom(value); if (dateTo && value > dateTo) setDateTo(""); }}
                    className="mt-1 block h-9 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-2 text-foreground" />
                </label>
                <label className="text-xs text-muted">To
                  <input type="date" value={dateTo} onChange={(event) => { const value = event.target.value; setDateTo(value); if (dateFrom && value < dateFrom) setDateFrom(""); }}
                    className="mt-1 block h-9 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-2 text-foreground" />
                </label>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDateFrom(""); setDateTo(""); }} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 text-xs text-foreground">Clear filter</button>
              </div>
            {activityError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-danger">{activityError}</p>}
            <CustomScrollArea className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border" contentClassName="divide-y divide-border">
              {privacyLoading ? <p className="p-4 text-sm text-muted">Loading activity…</p> : activity.filter((event) => inDateRange(event.createdAt)).length === 0 ? <p className="p-4 text-sm text-muted">{dateFrom || dateTo ? "No activity in the selected date range. Clear the date filter or load older activity." : "No activity recorded yet."}</p> : activity.filter((event) => inDateRange(event.createdAt)).map((event) => (
                <div
                  role="button"
                  key={event.id}
                  tabIndex={0}
                  aria-haspopup="dialog"
                  aria-label={`${event.actionLabel || event.action}, ${formatDate(event.createdAt)}. Double-click for details; press Enter to open.`}
                  title="Double-click to view activity details"
                  onDoubleClick={() => setSelectedActivity(event)}
                  onKeyDown={(keyboardEvent) => {
                    if (keyboardEvent.key === "Enter" || keyboardEvent.key === " ") {
                      keyboardEvent.preventDefault();
                      setSelectedActivity(event);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col gap-1 p-3 transition-colors hover:bg-background/60 focus-visible:bg-brand-soft focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-[-2px] focus-visible:outline-brand sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-4"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{event.actionLabel || event.action}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 wrap-break-word text-xs leading-5 text-muted">{event.description || event.actionLabel}{event.workspaceName ? ` · ${event.workspaceName}` : event.tenantName ? ` · ${event.tenantName}` : ""}
                      {(event.action === "SHARE" || event.action === "REVOKE_SHARE") && <span className="block">
                        Recipient: {(typeof event.metadata.recipient_email === "string" && event.metadata.recipient_email) || "Not recorded (legacy event)"}
                        {typeof event.metadata.permission === "string" ? ` · ${event.metadata.permission}` : ""}
                      </span>}</p>

                  </div>
                  <time className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-muted">{formatDate(event.createdAt)}</time>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CustomScrollArea>
            {activityHasMore && <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={activityLoadingMore} disabled={activityLoadingMore || privacyLoading} onClick={() => void loadOlderActivity()}>Load older activity</Button>
            </div>}

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-background text-muted"><Search size={19} /></span>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Search History</h2>
                  
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={historyBusy} disabled={historyBusy || searchHistory.length === 0} onClick={() => void handleClearHistory()}>Clear history</Button>
            </div>
            {searchError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-danger">{searchError}</p>}
            <CustomScrollArea className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border" contentClassName="divide-y divide-border">
              {privacyLoading ? <p className="p-4 text-sm text-muted">Loading search history…</p> : searchHistory.length === 0 ? <p className="p-4 text-sm text-muted">No search history yet.</p> : searchHistory.map((item) => (
                <article key={item.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1 p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between sm:gap-4">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="wrap-break-word text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{item.query}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted">{item.resultCount} results{item.workspaceName ? ` · ${item.workspaceName}` : " · My Drive"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <time className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-muted">{formatDate(item.createdAt)}</time>
                </article>
              ))}
            </CustomScrollArea>
            {searchHasMore && <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={searchLoadingMore} disabled={searchLoadingMore || privacyLoading} onClick={() => void loadOlderSearches()}>Load older searches</Button>
            </div>}
          </section>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-danger/30 bg-surface p-5 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-danger/10 text-danger"><AlertTriangle size={19} /></span>
              <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Delete My Data</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-danger/20 bg-danger/5 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-muted">
              Enter your current password and type <strong className="text-foreground">DELETE MY DRIVE</strong> to confirm. This permanently deletes personal My Drive files and folders, not shared workspace data.
            </div>
            <form className="mt-5 max-w-md space-y-4" onSubmit={(event) => { void handleDeleteMyDrive(event); }}>
              <label className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Current password</span>
                <input type="password" autoComplete="current-password" value={deletePassword} onChange={(event) => setDeletePassword(event.currentTarget.value)} className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-brand" />
              </label>
              <label className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Type DELETE MY DRIVE to confirm</span>
                <input value={deleteConfirmation} onChange={(event) => setDeleteConfirmation(event.currentTarget.value)} autoCapitalize="characters" className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-brand" />
              </label>
              {deleteFeedback && <p role="status" className={`text-sm ${deleteFeedback.kind === "success" ? "text-success" : "text-danger"}`}>{deleteFeedback.text}</p>}
              <Button type="submit" variant="destructive" loading={deleteBusy} disabled={deleteBusy || !deletePassword || deleteConfirmation !== "DELETE MY DRIVE"}><Trash2 size={15} /> Delete My Data</Button>
            </form>
          </section>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Plug size={19} className="text-brand-contrast" /><h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Connected Apps</h3></div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-muted">No connected apps.</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">Third-party app connections will be available in a future update.</p>
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <Dialog
        open={selectedActivity !== null}
        title="Activity details"
        description={selectedActivity ? `${selectedActivity.actionLabel || selectedActivity.action} · ${formatDate(selectedActivity.createdAt)}` : undefined}
        onClose={() => setSelectedActivity(null)}
      >
        {selectedActivity && (
          <dl className="grid gap-x-4 gap-y-3 text-[13px] sm:grid-cols-[145px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
            {([
              ["Event ID", String(selectedActivity.id)],
              ["Time", formatDate(selectedActivity.createdAt)],
              ["Action", selectedActivity.actionLabel || selectedActivity.action],
              ["Description", selectedActivity.description || "Not recorded"],
              ["Storage", selectedActivity.workspaceName || selectedActivity.tenantName || "Not recorded"],
              ...((selectedActivity.action === "UPLOAD" || selectedActivity.action === "DOWNLOAD") ? [
                ["File", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.resource_name === "string" ? selectedActivity.metadata.resource_name : "Not recorded"],
                ["File size", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.size_bytes === "number" ? formatBytes(selectedActivity.metadata.size_bytes) : "Not recorded"],
              ] : []),
              ...((selectedActivity.action === "SHARE" || selectedActivity.action === "REVOKE_SHARE") ? [
                ["Change", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.operation === "string" ? selectedActivity.metadata.operation.replaceAll("_", " ") : "Not recorded (legacy event)"],
                ["Recipient", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.recipient_email === "string" ? selectedActivity.metadata.recipient_email : "Not recorded (legacy event)"],
                ["Permission", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.permission === "string" ? selectedActivity.metadata.permission : "Not recorded"],
                ["Previous permission", typeof selectedActivity.metadata.previous_permission === "string" ? selectedActivity.metadata.previous_permission : "Not recorded"],
                ["Resources", Array.isArray(selectedActivity.metadata.resource_names) ? selectedActivity.metadata.resource_names.filter((name): name is string => typeof name === "string").join(", ") || "Not recorded" : "Not recorded"],
              ] : []),
            ] as Array<[string, string]>).map(([label, value]) => (
              <div className="contents" key={label}>
                <dt className="font-medium text-muted">{label}</dt>
                <dd className="min-w-0 break-words text-foreground">{value}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </DashboardShell>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\app\account\upgrade\page.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import AccountPageLayout from "@/components/account/AccountPageLayout";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";

export default function UpgradePage() {
  const { state, refresh, requestUpgrade, actionError, clearActionError } = useAccount();
  const [requestState, setRequestState] = useState<"idle" | "saving">("idle");

  async function submitUpgradeRequest() {
    setRequestState("saving");
    try {
      await requestUpgrade();
    } catch {
      // The provider exposes an explicit error and does not report success.
    } finally {
      setRequestState("idle");
    }
  }

  return (
    <AccountPageLayout title="Upgrade plan" description="Plan eligibility is determined by the backend account and tenant records.">
      {state.status === "loading" && (
        <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-5 text-sm text-muted">Checking account eligibility…</p>
      )}
      {state.status === "error" && (
        <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{state.error}</p>
          <Button className="mt-4" variant="secondary" onClick={() => void refresh()}>Retry</Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {state.status === "loaded" && state.account.account.type === "business" && (
        <div role="status" className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 text-sm text-muted">
          Personal plan upgrades are not available for business members. Contact your Tenant Admin about account access and quota allocation.
        </div>
      )}
      {state.status === "loaded" && state.account.account.type === "unclassified" && (
        <div role="status" className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 p-6 text-sm text-warning">
          Upgrade eligibility cannot be verified because the backend has not classified this account. No upgrade action is available.
        </div>
      )}
      {state.status === "loaded" && state.account.account.type === "individual" && state.account.account.upgradeEligible !== true && (
        <div role="status" className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 text-sm text-muted">
          The backend has not marked this individual account as eligible for an upgrade.
        </div>
      )}
      {state.status === "loaded" && state.account.account.type === "individual" && state.account.account.upgradeEligible === true && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-foreground">Upgrade is available for this individual account</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">The backend must re-check account eligibility and authorize any plan change.</p>
          {actionError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-danger">{actionError}</p>}
          <Button className="mt-5" disabled={requestState === "saving"} onClick={() => void submitUpgradeRequest()}>
            {requestState === "saving" ? "Submitting…" : "Continue to upgrade"}
          </Button>
          {actionError && <button type="button" onClick={clearActionError} className="ml-3 text-sm text-muted underline">Dismiss</button>}
        </section>
      )}
    </AccountPageLayout>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\app\drive\folders\[folderId]\page.tsx

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import DashboardShell from "@/components/layout/DashboardShell";
import DriveFileBrowser from "@/components/drive/DriveFileBrowser";

type DriveFolderPageProps = {
    params: Promise<{
        folderId: string;
    }>;
};

export default async function DriveFolderPage({
    params,
}: DriveFolderPageProps) {
    const { folderId } = await params;

    // Accept only positive, safe integer IDs.
    if (!/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(folderId)) {
        notFound();
    }

    const parsedFolderId = Number(folderId);

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsedFolderId)) {
        notFound();
    }

    return (
        <DashboardShell>
            <DriveFileBrowser
                key={parsedFolderId}
                title="My Drive"
                items={[]}
            />
        </DashboardShell>
    );
}

FILE: frontend\components\account\AccountProvider.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AccountServiceError, djangoAccountService, type AccountService, type AccountSnapshot, type ProfileUpdate } from "@/lib/account-service";
import { syncWorkspaceIdentity } from "@/lib/workspace-context";

type AccountLoadState =
  | { status: "loading"; account: null; error: null }
  | { status: "loaded"; account: AccountSnapshot; error: null }
  | { status: "error"; account: null; error: string };

type AccountContextValue = {
  state: AccountLoadState;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  acceptAuthenticatedAccount: (account: AccountSnapshot) => void;
  updateProfile: (input: ProfileUpdate) => Promise<AccountSnapshot>;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
  requestUpgrade: () => Promise<void>;
  actionError: string | null;
  clearActionError: () => void;
};

const AccountContext = createContext<AccountContextValue | null>(null);

export function useAccount(): AccountContextValue {
  const context = useContext(AccountContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useAccount must be used inside AccountProvider.");
  return context;
}

export default function AccountProvider({
  children,
  service = djangoAccountService,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  service?: AccountService;
}) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AccountLoadState>({ status: "loading", account: null, error: null });
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const requestSequence = useRef(0);

  const loadAccount = useCallback(async () => {
    const sequence = ++requestSequence.current;
    try {
      const account = await service.getCurrentAccount();
      if (sequence === requestSequence.current) {
        syncWorkspaceIdentity(account);
        setState({ status: "loaded", account, error: null });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (sequence !== requestSequence.current) return;
      const message = error instanceof AccountServiceError && (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)
        ? "Your session has expired or could not be verified. Please sign in again."
        : error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Account information could not be loaded.";
      setState({
        status: "error",
        account: null,
        error: message,
      });
    }
  }, [service]);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setState({ status: "loading", account: null, error: null });
    await loadAccount();
  }, [loadAccount]);

  const acceptAuthenticatedAccount = useCallback((account: AccountSnapshot) => {
    requestSequence.current += 1;
    syncWorkspaceIdentity(account);
    setState({ status: "loaded", account, error: null });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void Promise.resolve().then(loadAccount);
  }, [loadAccount]);

  const updateProfile = useCallback(async (input: ProfileUpdate) => {
    const sequence = ++requestSequence.current;
    try {
      const account = await service.updateProfile(input);
      if (sequence === requestSequence.current) {
        syncWorkspaceIdentity(account);
        setState({ status: "loaded", account, error: null });
      }
      return account;
    } catch (error) {
      if (sequence === requestSequence.current && error instanceof AccountServiceError && (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)) {
        setState({ status: "error", account: null, error: "Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again." });
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }, [service]);

  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    setActionError(null);
    try {
      await service.signOut();
      window.location.replace("/login?loggedOut=1");
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Sign out failed. Your session may still be active.";
      setActionError(message);
      throw error;
    }
  }, [service]);

  const requestUpgrade = useCallback(async () => {
    setActionError(null);
    try {
      await service.requestUpgrade();
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Upgrade is not connected.";
      setActionError(message);
      throw error;
    }
  }, [service]);

  const value = useMemo<AccountContextValue>(() => ({
    state,
    refresh,
    acceptAuthenticatedAccount,
    updateProfile,
    signOut,
    requestUpgrade,
    actionError,
    clearActionError: () => setActionError(null),
  }), [acceptAuthenticatedAccount, actionError, refresh, requestUpgrade, signOut, state, updateProfile]);

  return <AccountContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AccountContext.Provider>;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import {
  Archive, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, File as FileIcon, FileImage, FileMusic,
  FileText, FileVideo, FolderOpen, HardDrive, LockKeyhole,
  RefreshCw, Search, X,
} from "lucide-react";
import AdminPageHeader from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import AdminSegmentTabs from "@/components/admin/AdminSegmentTabs";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import styles from "./AdminFileDirectory.module.css";

const apiBase = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000").replace(/\/+$/, "");

type Scope = "all" | "my_drive" | "workspace" | "organization";
type Lifecycle = "active" | "trash" | "all";
type FileType = "all" | "document" | "image" | "video" | "audio" | "archive" | "other";
type Sort = "newest" | "updated" | "name" | "largest" | "oldest";
type FileRow = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  mime_type: string;
  owner: { id: number; username: string };
  scope: "my_drive" | "workspace" | "organization";
  organization: { id: string; name: string } | null;
  workspace: { id: string; name: string };
  folder: { id: number; name: string } | null;
  lifecycle: "active" | "trash";
  version_state: string | null;
  current_version: number | null;
  version_count: number | null;
  is_encrypted: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  deleted_at: string | null;
};
type FileVersion = {
  id: string;
  number: number;
  state: string;
  is_current: boolean;
  size_bytes: number;
  mime_type: string;
  created_at: string;
  verified_at: string | null;
  storage: { provider: string; state: string; verified_at: string | null }[];
};
type FileDetail = FileRow & {
  last_accessed_at: string | null;
  purge_after: string | null;
  versions: FileVersion[];
  versions_limit: number;
};
type Directory = {
  count: number;
  page: number;
  page_size: number;
  summary: { active: number; trash: number; active_metadata_bytes: number };
  results: FileRow[];
};

function formatBytes(value: number) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return "—";
  if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB"];
  let size = value / 1024;
  let unit = 0;
  while (size >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) { size /= 1024; unit++; }
  return `${size.toFixed(size >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${units[unit]}`;
}
function formatDate(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "—" : date.toLocaleString(undefined, { year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}
function formatState(value: string | null) {
  return value ? value.replaceAll("_", " ") : "No version metadata";
}
function iconForFile(file: FileRow) {
  const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
  if (file.mime_type.startsWith("image/") || /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg)$/.test(name)) return FileImage;
  if (file.mime_type.startsWith("video/") || /\.(mp4|mov|webm|avi)$/.test(name)) return FileVideo;
  if (file.mime_type.startsWith("audio/") || /\.(mp3|wav|ogg|flac)$/.test(name)) return FileMusic;
  if (/\.(zip|7z|rar|tar|gz)$/.test(name)) return Archive;
  if (/\.(pdf|txt|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|odt|ods)$/.test(name) || file.mime_type.startsWith("text/")) return FileText;
  return FileIcon;
}
function DataField({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-border/60 py-3 last:border-0 sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:justify-between sm:gap-4">
    <dt className="text-xs text-muted">{label}</dt><dd className="wrap-break-word text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground sm:max-w-[65%] sm:text-right">{value}</dd>
  </div>;
}

export default function AdminFileDirectory() {
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<Scope>("all");
  const [lifecycle, setLifecycle] = useState<Lifecycle>("active");
  const [fileType, setFileType] = useState<FileType>("all");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<Sort>("newest");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Directory | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<FileDetail | null>(null);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [detailError, setDetailError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ q: query, scope, status: lifecycle, type: fileType, sort, page: String(page) });
    fetch(`${apiBase}/accounts/api/admin/files/?${params}`, { credentials: "include", cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(response.status === 403
          ? "Access denied. Sign in with a Platform Admin account."
          : `Unable to load file inventory (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
        return response.json() as Promise<Directory>;
      })
      .then((result) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setData(result); setError(""); setLoading(false); } })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setData(null); setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "File request failed."); setLoading(false); } });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [query, scope, lifecycle, fileType, sort, page, revision]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedId === null) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    fetch(`${apiBase}/accounts/api/admin/files/${selectedId}/`, { credentials: "include", cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to load file details (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
        return response.json() as Promise<FileDetail>;
      })
      .then((result) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setDetail(result); setDetailLoading(false); setDetailError(""); } })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setDetail(null); setDetailLoading(false); setDetailError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Could not load details."); } });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [selectedId]);

  function openFile(id: number) {
    setSelectedId(id);
    setDetail(null);
    setDetailError("");
    setDetailLoading(true);
  }
  function closeFile() { setSelectedId(null); setDetail(null); setDetailError(""); }
  function search(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault(); setQuery(input.trim()); setPage(1); setLoading(true);
    setRevision((r) => r + 1);
  }
  function changeScope(value: Scope) { setScope(value); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }
  function changeStatus(value: Lifecycle) { setLifecycle(value); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }
  function changeType(value: FileType) { setFileType(value); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }
  function changeSort(value: Sort) { setSort(value); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((data?.count ?? 0) / (data?.page_size || 20)));
  const formatCount = (value: number | undefined) => value === undefined ? "—" : value.toLocaleString("en-US");

  return <div className="space-y-5">
    <AdminPageHeader title="File Management" actions={
      <button type="button" disabled={loading} onClick={() => { setLoading(true); setRevision((r) => r + 1); }} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-brand-soft disabled:opacity-50"><RefreshCw size={15} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />Refresh</button>
    } />

    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
      {[
        { label: "Active files", value: formatCount(data?.summary.active), description: "Current inventory" },
        { label: "Files in trash", value: formatCount(data?.summary.trash), description: "Soft-deleted metadata" },
        { label: "Active file sizes", value: data ? formatBytes(data.summary.active_metadata_bytes) : "—", description: "Logical size, not disk usage" },
      ].map((item) => <section key={item.label} className="rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface px-5 py-4"><p className="text-[12px] text-muted">{item.label}</p><p className="mt-2 text-[25px] font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight">{item.value}</p><p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted">{item.description}</p></section>)}
    </div>

    <section className={`${styles.filterContainer} overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface`}>
      <div className="space-y-4 border-b border-border p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <AdminSegmentTabs<Scope> value={scope} label="File ownership scope" onChange={changeScope} tabs={[
            { value: "all", label: "All files" },
            { value: "my_drive", label: "Personal Files" },
            { value: "workspace", label: "Workspaces" },
            { value: "organization", label: "Organizations" },
          ]} />
          <span className="text-xs text-muted">{loading ? "Loading…" : `${formatCount(data?.count)} matching files`}</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filterGrid}>
          <div className={styles.searchField}>
            <label htmlFor="admin-file-search" className="mb-1.5 block text-[12px] text-muted">Search files</label>
            <form data-admin-search-shell role="search" onSubmit={search} className="flex h-11 min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3">
              <Search size={16} className="shrink-0 text-muted" />
              <input
                id="admin-file-search"
                aria-label="Search files, owners, organizations or workspaces"
                placeholder="File, owner, workspace…"
                value={input}
                onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                className="min-w-0 w-full flex-1 bg-transparent text-[13px] text-foreground outline-none"
              />
              {input && <button type="button" title="Clear search" aria-label="Clear search" onClick={() => { setInput(""); setQuery(""); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }} className="shrink-0 text-muted hover:text-foreground"><X size={14} /></button>}
              <button type="submit" className="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-contrast">Search</button>
            </form>
          </div>
          <label className="min-w-0 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span className="mb-1.5 block">Status</span>
            <select aria-label="File status" value={lifecycle} onChange={(e) => changeStatus(e.target.value as Lifecycle)} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[13px] text-foreground">
              <option value="active">Active</option><option value="trash">In trash</option><option value="all">All statuses</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="min-w-0 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span className="mb-1.5 block">File type</span>
            <select aria-label="File type" value={fileType} onChange={(e) => changeType(e.target.value as FileType)} className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[13px] text-foreground">
              <option value="all">All types</option><option value="document">Documents</option><option value="image">Images</option><option value="video">Video</option><option value="audio">Audio</option><option value="archive">Archives</option><option value="other">Other</option>

          <tbody>{data?.results.map((file) => {

            return <tr key={file.id} className="border-t border-border/70 transition-colors hover:bg-background/70">

              <td className="px-4 py-3"><p className="font-medium">{file.owner.username}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted">ID {file.owner.id}</p></td>

"Personal Files" : "Independent Workspace")}>{file.organization?.name || (file.scope === "my_drive" ? "Personal Files" : "Independent Workspace")}</p></td>

"bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast" : "bg-background text-muted"}`}>{file.lifecycle === "active" ? "Active" : "In trash"}</span><p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] capitalize text-muted">{formatState(file.version_state)}</p></td>
              <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-[12px] text-muted">{formatDate(file.updated_at)}</td>
              <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right"><button type="button" onClick={() => openFile(file.id)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast" aria-label={`View metadata for ${file.name}`}>View</button></td>
            </tr>;
          })}</tbody>
        </table>
        {data?.results.length === 0 && <div className="flex min-h-44 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 p-7 text-center"><FolderOpen size={23} className="text-muted" /><p className="text-sm font-medium">No matching files</p><p className="text-xs text-muted">Try a different search, scope or filter.</p></div>}

"Active" : "In trash"}/><DataField label="Current version" value={detail.current_version ? `v${detail.current_version} · ${formatState(detail.version_state)}` : "Not recorded"}/><DataField label="Version history" value={`${detail.version_count} recorded`}/><DataField label="Encrypted" value={detail.is_encrypted ? "Yes" : "No"}/><DataField label="Created" value={formatDate(detail.created_at)}/><DataField label="Modified" value={formatDate(detail.updated_at)}/><DataField label="Last accessed" value={formatDate(detail.last_accessed_at)}/>{detail.deleted_at && <DataField label="Moved to trash" value={formatDate(detail.deleted_at)}/>}</dl></section>
        <section><h3 className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold"><HardDrive size={16} className="text-brand-contrast"/>Recorded versions & storage</h3><p className="mb-3 text-[11px] text-muted">Latest {detail.versions_limit} versions maximum. Storage entries show logical state only, not physical disk availability.</p>
          {detail.versions.length === 0 ? <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 text-[12px] text-muted">No file version records are available.</div> : <div className="space-y-2.5">{detail.versions.map((version) => <article key={version.id} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3.5"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><div><p className="text-[12px] font-semibold">Version {version.number}{version.is_current && <span className="ml-2 rounded-md bg-brand-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-brand-contrast">Current</span>}</p><p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted">{formatDate(version.created_at)} · {formatBytes(version.size_bytes)}</p></div><span className="rounded-lg border border-border px-2 py-1 text-[11px] capitalize">{formatState(version.state)}</span></div><div className="mt-2.5 space-y-1 border-t border-border pt-2.5">{version.storage.length > 0 ? version.storage.map((location, index) => <div key={`${version.id}-${index}`} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]"><span className="font-medium uppercase text-foreground">{location.provider}</span><span className="capitalize text-muted">{formatState(location.state)}</span></div>) : <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">No storage location recorded for this version.</p>}</div></article>)}</div>}
        </section>
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3 text-[11px] leading-5 text-muted"><LockKeyhole size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"/>This console intentionally does not expose file content, encryption keys, storage object identifiers or download links.</div>
      </div>}
    </Dialog>
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { RefreshCw, Search, ScrollText } from "lucide-react";
import AdminPageHeader from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import styles from "./AdminLogDirectory.module.css";

type Mode = "activity" | "audit";
type Filters = { q: string; action: string; scope: string; from: string; to: string };
type LogRow = {
  id: string;
  created_at: string;
  action: string;
  action_label: string;
  user?: string;
  scope?: "personal" | "organization" | "unassigned";
  tenant?: string | null;
  workspace?: string | null;
  personal_drive?: boolean;
  resource_type?: string | null;
  resource_name?: string;
  resource_id?: number | null;
  share?: {
    operation: "created" | "permission_changed" | "mixed" | "revoked" | "unknown";
    recipient: string;
    recipient_username: string;
    permission: string;
    previous_permission: string;
    resources: string[];
    resource_kinds: string[];
    count: number | null;
    created_count: number | null;
    updated_count: number | null;
    changes: { name: string; kind: string; operation: string; permission: string; previous_permission: string }[];
  } | null;
  actor?: string;
  target?: string;
  reason?: string;
};
type LogDirectory = {
  count: number;
  page: number;
  page_size: number;
  actions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  results: LogRow[];
};

const apiBase = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const emptyFilters: Filters = { q: "", action: "all", scope: "all", from: "", to: "" };

function localTime(value: string) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "—" : date.toLocaleString();
}

function scopeLabel(row: LogRow) {
  if (row.scope === "organization") return row.tenant || "Organization";
  if (row.scope === "personal") return row.personal_drive ? "Personal Files" : row.workspace ? "Personal workspace" : "Personal storage";
  return "Context not recorded";
}

function shareOperationLabel(row: LogRow) {
  if (row.action === "REVOKE_SHARE") return "Access revoked";
  switch (row.share?.operation) {
    case "created": return "Access granted";
    case "permission_changed": return "Permission changed";
    case "mixed": return "Grants updated";
    default: return "Share (legacy / unspecified)";
  }
}

function ActivityDetailsContent({ row }: { row: LogRow }) {
  const location = scopeLabel(row);
  const share = row.share;
  const detailRows: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ["Event ID", row.id],
    ["Time", localTime(row.created_at)],
    ["Actor", row.user || "Not recorded"],
    ["Action", share ? shareOperationLabel(row) : row.action_label || row.action],
    ["Storage scope", location],
    ["Workspace", row.workspace || "Not recorded"],
  ];
  if (share) {
    detailRows.push(
      ["Recipient", share.recipient || "Not recorded (legacy event)"],
      ["Recipient account", share.recipient_username || "Not recorded"],
      ["Permission", share.permission || "Not recorded"],
      ["Previous permission", share.previous_permission || "Not recorded"],
      ["Resource names", share.resources.length ? share.resources.join(", ") : "Not recorded (legacy event)"],
      ["Resource kinds", share.resource_kinds.length ? share.resource_kinds.join(", ") : "Not recorded"],
      ["Changed items", share.count === null ? "Not recorded" : String(share.count)],
    );
    if (share.created_count !== null) detailRows.push(["New grants", String(share.created_count)]);
    if (share.updated_count !== null) detailRows.push(["Permissions updated", String(share.updated_count)]);
    if (share.changes?.length) {
      detailRows.push(["Per-resource changes", share.changes.map((change) =>
        `${change.kind || "item"}: ${change.name || "Unknown"} · ${change.operation.replaceAll("_", " ")} · ${change.previous_permission ? `${change.previous_permission} → ` : ""}${change.permission}`
      ).join(" | ")]);
    }
  } else {
    detailRows.push(["Resource type", row.resource_type || "Not recorded"]);
    detailRows.push(["Resource name", row.resource_name || "Not recorded (legacy event)"]);
  }
  if (row.resource_id != null) detailRows.push(["Resource ID", String(row.resource_id)]);
  return <EventDetailList rows={detailRows} />;
}

function EventDetailList({ rows }: { rows: Array<[string, string]> }) {
  return (
    <dl className="grid gap-x-4 gap-y-3 text-[13px] sm:grid-cols-[150px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      {rows.map(([label, value]) => (
        <div key={label} className="contents">
          <dt className="font-medium text-muted">{label}</dt>
          <dd className="min-w-0 wrap-break-word text-foreground">{value}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

function AuditDetailsContent({ row }: { row: LogRow }) {
  return <EventDetailList rows={[
    ["Event ID", row.id],
    ["Time", localTime(row.created_at)],
    ["Administrator", row.actor || "Not recorded"],
    ["Action", row.action_label || row.action],
    ["Target account", row.target || "Not recorded"],
    ["Reason", row.reason || "Not recorded"],
  ]} />;
}

export default function AdminLogDirectory({ mode }: { mode: Mode }) {
  const activity = mode === "activity";
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Filters>({ ...emptyFilters });
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<Filters>({ ...emptyFilters });
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const [data, setData] = useState<LogDirectory | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [selectedRow, setSelectedRow] = useState<LogRow | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const endpoint = activity ? "activity" : "audit";
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), action: applied.action });
    if (applied.q) params.set("q", applied.q);
    if (activity && applied.scope !== "all") params.set("scope", applied.scope);
    if (applied.from) params.set("from", applied.from);
    if (applied.to) params.set("to", applied.to);

    fetch(`${apiBase}/accounts/api/admin/${endpoint}/?${params}`, {
      credentials: "include",
      cache: "no-store",
      signal: controller.signal,
    })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) {
          const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };
          throw new Error(body.detail || `Unable to load logs (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
        }
        return response.json() as Promise<LogDirectory>;
      })
      .then((result) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setData(result);
        setError("");
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Unable to load logs.");
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [activity, applied, page, revision]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((data?.count ?? 0) / (data?.page_size || 20)));
  const title = activity ? "User Activity" : "Admin Audit Logs";

  function applyFilters(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSelectedRow(null);
    setApplied({ ...draft, q: draft.q.trim().slice(0, 100) });
    setPage(1);
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    setRevision((current) => current + 1);
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    setSelectedRow(null);
    setDraft({ ...emptyFilters });
    setApplied({ ...emptyFilters });
    setPage(1);
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setRevision((current) => current + 1);
  }

  function refresh() {
    setLoading(true);
    setRevision((current) => current + 1);
  }

  function goToPage(next: number) {
    setSelectedRow(null);
    setPage(next);
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <AdminPageHeader
        title={title}
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={loading} onClick={refresh}>
            <RefreshCw size={15} /> Refresh
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <section className={`${styles.filterContainer} overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface`}>
        <form onSubmit={applyFilters} className={`${styles.filterForm} ${activity ? styles.activity : styles.audit} border-b border-border p-4 lg:p-5`}>
          <label className={`${styles.searchField} flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted`}>
            Search {activity ? "user or workspace" : "administrator or target"}
            <span data-admin-search-shell className="flex h-10 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3">
              <Search size={15} />
              <input
                type="search"
                value={draft.q}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, q: event.target.value }))}
                placeholder={activity ? "Username, email, organization…" : "Administrator or account…"}
                className="min-w-0 w-full bg-transparent text-[13px] text-foreground outline-none"
                maxLength={100}
              />
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
            Action
            <select
              value={draft.action}
              onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, action: event.target.value }))}
              className="h-10 min-w-0 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-2.5 text-[12px] text-foreground"
            >
              <option value="all">All actions</option>
              {data?.actions.map(({ value, label }) => <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          {activity && (
            <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
              Storage scope
              <select
                value={draft.scope}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, scope: event.target.value }))}
                className="h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-2.5 text-[12px] text-foreground"
              >
                <option value="all">All scopes</option>
                <option value="personal">Personal / independent</option>
                <option value="organization">Organizations</option>
                <option value="unassigned">No workspace context</option>
              </select>
            </label>
          )}
          <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
            From
            <input type="date" value={draft.from} max={draft.to || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, from: event.target.value }))}
              className="h-10 min-w-0 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-2.5 text-[12px] text-foreground" />
          </label>
          <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
            To
            <input type="date" value={draft.to} min={draft.from || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, to: event.target.value }))}
              className="h-10 min-w-0 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-2.5 text-[12px] text-foreground" />
          </label>
          <div className={`${styles.filterActions} flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2`}>
            <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={loading}>Apply filters</Button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground" onClick={resetFilters}>Clear</button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {error && <div role="alert" className="p-6 text-[13px] text-danger">{error}</div>}
        {loading && <div role="status" className="p-10 text-center text-[13px] text-muted">Loading {activity ? "user activity" : "audit events"}…</div>}
        {!loading && !error && (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-212.5 text-left text-[13px]">
              <thead className="bg-background text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">
                {activity ? (
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Time</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">User</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Action</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Location</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Resource / Recipient</th>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Time</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Administrator</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Action</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Target account</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Reason</th>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {data?.results.map((row) => (
                  <tr
                    key={row.id}
                    tabIndex={0}
                    aria-haspopup="dialog"
                    aria-label={`Event ${row.action_label || row.action}, ${localTime(row.created_at)}. Double-click for details; press Enter to open.`}
                    title="Double-click to view event details"
                    onDoubleClick={() => setSelectedRow(row)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        setSelectedRow(row);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="cursor-pointer border-t border-border/70 align-top transition-colors hover:bg-background/60 focus-visible:bg-brand-soft focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand"
                  >
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 text-[12px] text-muted">{localTime(row.created_at)}</td>
                    <td className="px-5 py-3 font-medium">{activity ? (row.user || "—") : (row.actor || "—")}</td>
                    <td className="px-5 py-3"><span className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-brand-soft px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-medium text-brand-contrast">{activity && row.share ? shareOperationLabel(row) : row.action_label || row.action}</span></td>
                    {activity ? (
                      <>
                        <td className="px-5 py-3"><p>{scopeLabel(row)}</p>{row.workspace && <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-muted">{row.workspace}</p>}</td>
                        <td className="min-w-75 max-w-120 px-5 py-3 text-muted">
                          {row.share ? (
                            <>
                              <p className="wrap-break-word text-foreground">{row.share.resources.length ? row.share.resources.join(", ") : "Resource not recorded"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[12px]">Recipient: {row.share.recipient || "Not recorded (legacy event)"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px]">{row.share.previous_permission ? `${row.share.previous_permission} → ` : ""}{row.share.permission || "Permission not recorded"}{row.share.count !== null ? ` · ${row.share.count} changed` : ""}</p>
                            </>
                          ) : <p>{row.resource_name || (row.resource_type ? `${row.resource_type}${row.resource_id != null ? ` #${row.resource_id}` : ""}` : "Resource not recorded")}</p>}
                        </td>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <td className="px-5 py-3">{row.target || "—"}</td>
                        <td className="max-w-80 wrap-break-word px-5 py-3 text-muted">{row.reason || "—"}</td>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {data?.results.length === 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center p-10 text-center text-muted">
                <ScrollText size={26} />
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">No matching events</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Try another action, date range or search term.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {!loading && !error && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border px-5 py-4 text-[12px]">
            <span className="text-muted">{(data?.count || 0).toLocaleString()} recorded events · Page {page} of {totalPages}</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button type="button" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => goToPage(page - 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-40">Previous</button>
              <button type="button" disabled={page >= totalPages} onClick={() => goToPage(page + 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
      <Dialog
        open={selectedRow !== null}
        title={activity ? "Activity details" : "Audit event details"}
        description={selectedRow ? `${selectedRow.action_label || selectedRow.action} · ${localTime(selectedRow.created_at)}` : undefined}
        onClose={() => setSelectedRow(null)}
      >
        {selectedRow && (activity
          ? <ActivityDetailsContent row={selectedRow} />
          : <AuditDetailsContent row={selectedRow} />)}
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import AdminPageHeader from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";

const apiBase = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000").replace(/\/+$/, "");

type Org = { id: string; name: string; status: string; workspaces: number; created_at: string };
type Workspace = { id: string; name: string; status: string; scope: "organization" | "personal"; organization: string | null; created_at: string };
type ResourceSort = "newest" | "oldest" | "name_asc" | "name_desc";
type Directory<T> = { count: number; page: number; page_size: number; sort?: ResourceSort; results: T[] };

const SORT_OPTIONS: Array<{ value: ResourceSort; label: string }> = [
  { value: "newest", label: "Newest first" },
  { value: "oldest", label: "Oldest first" },
  { value: "name_asc", label: "Name A–Z" },
  { value: "name_desc", label: "Name Z–A" },
];

function dateLabel(iso: string) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

export default function AdminResourceDirectory({ kind }: { kind: "organizations" | "workspaces" }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<ResourceSort>("newest");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Directory<Org | Workspace> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const isOrganizations = kind === "organizations";

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), q: search, sort });
    fetch(`${apiBase}/accounts/api/admin/${kind}/?${params}`, {
      credentials: "include", cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal,
    }).then(async (response) => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to load ${kind} (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
      return response.json() as Promise<Directory<Org | Workspace>>;
    }).then((result) => {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setData(result); setError(""); setLoading(false); }
    }).catch((reason: unknown) => {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setData(null); setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Request failed."); setLoading(false); }
    });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [kind, page, search, sort, refreshKey]);

  function submitSearch(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPage(1); setSearch(query.trim()); setRefreshKey((n) => n + 1); setLoading(true);
  }
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((data?.count ?? 0) / (data?.page_size || 20)));

  return <div className="space-y-5">
    <AdminPageHeader
      title={isOrganizations ? "Organization Management" : "Workspace Management"}
      actions={
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={loading} onClick={() => { setLoading(true); setRefreshKey((n) => n + 1); }}>
          <RefreshCw size={15} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />Refresh
        </Button>
      }
    />
    <section className="rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface px-5 py-4"><p className="text-[12px] text-muted">{isOrganizations ? "Matching organizations" : "Matching workspaces"}</p><p className="mt-1 text-[26px] font-semibold">{loading ? "—" : (data?.count ?? "—")}</p></section>
    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface">
      <div className="border-b border-border p-4">
        <div className="grid items-end gap-3 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(260px,1.8fr)_220px]">
          <form data-admin-search-shell role="search" onSubmit={submitSearch} className="flex h-11 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3">
            <Search size={15} className="text-muted" />
            <input value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} aria-label={`Search ${kind}`} placeholder={isOrganizations ? "Search organization name" : "Search workspace or owner organization"} className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-[13px] outline-none" />
            <button type="submit" className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-contrast">Search</button>
          </form>
          <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted">
            <span>Sort by</span>
            <select aria-label={`Sort ${kind}`} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[12px] text-foreground" value={sort} onChange={(event) => { setSort(event.target.value as ResourceSort); setPage(1); setLoading(true); }}>
              {SORT_OPTIONS.map((option) => <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="p-5 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
      {loading && <p className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted" role="status">Loading {kind}…</p>}
      {!loading && !error && <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full min-w-150 text-left text-[13px]"><thead className="bg-background text-[12px] text-muted"><tr><th className="px-5 py-3">Name</th><th className="px-5 py-3">{isOrganizations ? "Workspaces" : "Ownership"}</th><th className="px-5 py-3">Status</th><th className="px-5 py-3">Created</th></tr></thead><tbody>{data?.results.map((item) => <tr key={item.id} className="border-t border-border/70"><td className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">{item.name}</td><td className="px-5 py-3 text-muted">{"workspaces" in item ? item.workspaces : item.scope === "organization" ? (item.organization || "Organization") : "Personal workspace"}</td><td className="px-5 py-3 capitalize">{item.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}</td><td className="px-5 py-3 text-muted">{dateLabel(item.created_at)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>{data?.results.length === 0 && <p className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted">No matching {kind}.</p>}</div>}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border p-4 text-xs"><span className="text-muted">Page {page} of {totalPages}</span><div className="flex gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={page <= 1 || loading} onClick={() => { setPage((p) => p - 1); setLoading(true); }} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-40">Previous</button><button type="button" disabled={page >= totalPages || loading} onClick={() => { setPage((p) => p + 1); setLoading(true); }} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-40">Next</button></div></div>
    </section>
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Tab<T extends string> = { value: T; label: string; href?: string; icon?: ReactNode };

export default function AdminSegmentTabs<T extends string>({
  value, tabs, onChange, label,
}: {
  value: T;
  tabs: readonly Tab<T>[];
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
  label: string;
}) {
  const common = "inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand-contrast";
  return (
    <div className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto pb-1">
      <div aria-label={label} role={onChange ? "tablist" : "group"} className="inline-flex w-max items-center gap-1 rounded-xl bg-background p-1">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const active = value === tab.value;
          const classes = `${common} ${active ? "bg-surface text-brand-contrast shadow-sm" : "text-muted hover:bg-surface/70 hover:text-foreground"}`;
          const content = <>{tab.icon}{tab.label}</>;
          return tab.href
            ? <Link key={tab.value} href={tab.href} aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined} className={classes}>{content}</Link>
            : <button key={tab.value} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={active} onClick={() => onChange?.(tab.value)} className={classes}>{content}</button>;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type Overview = {
  users: { total: number; active: number; inactive: number; platform_admins: number; recently_seen: number };
  organizations: { total: number; active: number };
  workspaces: { total: number; active: number; organization: number; personal: number };
  files: { total: number; metadata_bytes: number; in_trash: number };

const formatNumber = (n: number | undefined) => n === undefined ? "—" : new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(n);
function formatBytes(n: number | undefined) {
  if (n === undefined) return "—";
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB"];
  let amount = n / 1024;
  let i = 0;
  while (amount >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { amount /= 1024; i++; }
  return `${amount.toFixed(amount >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${units[i]}`;
}

function MetricCard({ label, value, details, href, icon: Icon }: {
  label: string; value: string; details: string; href: string; icon: typeof Users;
}) {
  return <Link href={href} className="group flex min-h-39 flex-col justify-between rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface p-5 transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) hover:bg-brand-soft/30 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand">
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3"><span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-muted">{label}</span><span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast"><Icon size={19} /></span></div>
    <div><p className="mt-3 text-[28px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{value}</p><div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><p className="text-xs text-muted">{details}</p><ArrowRight size={15} className="shrink-0 text-muted transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" /></div></div>
  </Link>;
}

function Section({ title, description, children, href, label }: {
  title: string; description?: string; children: ReactNode; href?: string; label?: string;
}) {
  return <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border px-5 py-4"><div><h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold">{title}</h3>{description && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted">{description}</p>}</div>{href && <Link href={href} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-contrast hover:underline">{label || "View details"}<ArrowRight size={14} /></Link>}</div>
    {children}
  </section>;
}

function DataRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border/60 px-5 py-3.5 text-[13px] last:border-0"><span className="text-muted">{label}</span><span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{value}</span></div>;
