export default function PlatformDashboard() {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Overview | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const refresh = useCallback(() => { setRevision((v) => v + 1); setLoading(true); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    fetch(`${apiBase}/accounts/api/admin/overview/`, { credentials: "include", cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(response.status === 403
          ? "Administrator access was denied. Please sign in again."
          : `Could not load platform overview (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
        return response.json() as Promise<Overview>;
      })
      .then((data) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setOverview(data); setError(""); setLoading(false); } })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setOverview(null); setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Failed to load overview."); setLoading(false); } });

"animate-spin" : ""} />Refresh</button>} />

    <div role={loading ? "status" : undefined} aria-label={loading ? "Loading platform overview" : undefined} className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-4">
      <MetricCard label="User accounts" value={formatNumber(overview?.users.total)} details="Regular users" href="/admin/users" icon={Users} />
      <MetricCard label="Organizations" value={formatNumber(overview?.organizations.total)} details="Registered organizations" href="/admin/organizations" icon={Building2} />
      <MetricCard label="Workspaces" value={formatNumber(overview?.workspaces.total)} details="Active collaboration spaces" href="/admin/workspaces" icon={Workflow} />
      <MetricCard label="Stored files" value={formatNumber(overview?.files.total)} details="Available files" href="/admin/files" icon={FileText} />
    </div>
    <div className="grid gap-5 xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Section title="Accounts" href="/admin/users" label="Open users">
        <DataRow label="Enabled users" value={formatNumber(overview?.users.active)} />
        <DataRow label="Disabled users" value={formatNumber(overview?.users.inactive)} />

        <DataRow label="Platform admin accounts" value={formatNumber(overview?.users.platform_admins)} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="Workspaces" href="/admin/workspaces" label="Open workspaces">
        <DataRow label="Active workspaces" value={formatNumber(overview?.workspaces.active)} />
        <DataRow label="Organization workspaces" value={formatNumber(overview?.workspaces.organization)} />
        <DataRow label="Personal-tenant workspaces" value={formatNumber(overview?.workspaces.personal)} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="Files" href="/admin/infrastructure/quotas" label="Storage & quotas">
        <DataRow label="Active file metadata" value={formatBytes(overview?.files.metadata_bytes)} />

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { HardDrive, RefreshCw, Search, Settings2, X } from "lucide-react";
import AdminPageHeader from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import AdminSegmentTabs from "@/components/admin/AdminSegmentTabs";
import QuotaPlanPolicies from "@/components/admin/QuotaPlanPolicies";
import styles from "./QuotaManagement.module.css";
import { accountCsrfHeaders, requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";

type Quota = {
  id: string; limit_bytes: number | null; used_bytes: number; reserved_bytes: number;
  remaining_bytes: number | null; percentage: number | null; plan_code: string | null;
  status: "normal" | "warning" | "critical" | "full" | "over_quota";
};
type DirectoryRow = {
  scope: "personal" | "workspace"; id: string; name: string; detail: string;
  tenant_status: string; tenant_kind?: "personal" | "business";
  editable: boolean; quota: Quota | null;
};
type Directory = { count: number; page: number; page_size: number; results: DirectoryRow[] };
type Plan = { code: string; name: string; scope: "personal" | "workspace"; limit_bytes: number; is_active: boolean };
type Change = { selected: DirectoryRow; plan_code: string; custom_mib: string; reason: string };
type ConfigEvent = { id: string; created_at: string; actor: string; target?: string; action?: string; reason: string };
type ConfigAudit = { plan_change_count: number; policy_change_count: number; plan_changes: ConfigEvent[]; policy_changes: ConfigEvent[] };
type Audit = { id: string; actor: string; created_at: string; quota_account_id: string; old_limit_bytes: number | null; new_limit_bytes: number | null; old_plan_code: string; new_plan_code: string; reason: string };

const SIZE = 1024 * 1024;
const BASE = "/admin/infrastructure/quotas";
const fmt = (n: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(n);
function readable(n: number | null): string {
  if (n === null) return "Unlimited";
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  const unit = ["B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB"];
  let value = n; let index = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && index < unit.length - 1) { value /= 1024; index++; }
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${unit[index]}`;
}
function errorMessage(e: unknown) { return e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Request failed."; }
const sections = [
  { key: "users", text: "Personal" },
  { key: "teams", text: "Workspaces" },
  { key: "policies", text: "Plans & Policies" },
  { key: "capacity", text: "Audit" },
] as const;
const sortOptions = [
  { value: "name_asc", label: "Name A–Z" },
  { value: "name_desc", label: "Name Z–A" },
  { value: "newest", label: "Newest first" },
  { value: "oldest", label: "Oldest first" },
];

export default function QuotaManagement({ section = "overview" }: { section?: string }) {
  const active = section === "overview" ? "users" : section;
  const scope = active === "teams" ? "workspace" : "personal";
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("name_asc");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const [directory, setDirectory] = useState<Directory | null>(null);
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<Plan[]>([]);
  const [audit, setAudit] = useState<{ count: number; results: Audit[] } | null>(null);
  const [configAudit, setConfigAudit] = useState<ConfigAudit | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [change, setChange] = useState<Change | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [canEdit, setCanEdit] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const run = async () => {
      setLoading(true); setError("");
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ scope, q: search, sort, page: String(page) });
        const endpoint = active === "policies" ? "/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/" :
          active === "capacity" ? `/accounts/api/admin/quotas/history/?page=${page}` :
            `/accounts/api/admin/quotas/?${params}`;
        const result = await requestAccountApi<Directory | { plans: Plan[] } | { count: number; results: Audit[] }>(endpoint, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (active === "policies") setPlans((result as { plans: Plan[] }).plans);
        else if (active === "capacity") {
          setAudit(result as { count: number; results: Audit[] });
          const config = await requestAccountApi<ConfigAudit>(`/accounts/api/admin/quotas/configuration-history/?page=${page}`, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" });
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setConfigAudit(config);
        }
        else setDirectory(result as Directory);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(errorMessage(e));
      } finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false); }
    };
    void run();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [scope, search, sort, page, revision, active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    requestAccountApi<{ can_manage_admins: boolean }>("/accounts/api/admin/access/", { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((access) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setCanEdit(access.can_manage_admins); })
      .catch(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setCanEdit(false); });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    requestAccountApi<{ plans: Plan[] }>("/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/", { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((r) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setPlans(r.plans); })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  function refresh() { setRevision((r) => r + 1); }
  function searchSubmit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) { e.preventDefault(); setPage(1); setSearch(query.trim()); refresh(); }
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((directory?.count ?? 0) / (directory?.page_size || 20)));

  async function applyChange(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!change?.selected.quota || saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(""); setNotice("");
    const custom = Number(change.custom_mib);
    if (!change.plan_code && (!Number.isSafeInteger(custom) || custom < 0 || custom > 1000000000)) {
      setError("Custom quota must be an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,000 MiB."); setSaving(false); return;
    }
    try {
      const headers = await accountCsrfHeaders();
      await requestAccountApi(`/accounts/api/admin/quotas/${change.selected.quota.id}/`, {
        method: "PATCH", headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          plan_code: change.plan_code || null,
          limit_bytes: change.plan_code ? null : custom * SIZE,
          reason: change.reason.trim(),
        }),
      });
      setNotice(`Quota updated for ${change.selected.name}.`);
      setChange(null); refresh();
    } catch (e) { setError(errorMessage(e)); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  const title = "Quota Management";
  return <div className="space-y-5">
    <AdminPageHeader title={title} actions={<button type="button" onClick={refresh} disabled={loading} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-4 text-[13px] disabled:opacity-40"><RefreshCw size={15} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />Refresh</button>} />
    <AdminSegmentTabs value={active} label="Quota management sections" tabs={sections.map(({ key, text }) => ({ value: key, label: text, href: `${BASE}/${key}` }))} />
    {notice && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-[13px] text-foreground">{notice}</p>}
    {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-[13px] text-danger">{error}</p>}
    {(active === "users" || active === "teams") && <>
      <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">{active === "users" ? "Personal Drive accounts" : "Active collaboration workspaces"}: <strong className="ml-1 tabular-nums text-foreground">{loading ? "—" : fmt(directory?.count || 0)}</strong></p>
      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface">
        <div className={`${styles.filterGrid} border-b border-border p-4`}>
          <form role="search" onSubmit={searchSubmit} className="flex h-11 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-brand-contrast/30"><Search size={16} className="shrink-0 text-muted"/><input aria-label="Search quotas" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search account, workspace or organization" className="w-full min-w-0 bg-transparent text-[13px] outline-none focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-0"/><button type="submit" className="shrink-0 text-[12px] font-semibold text-brand-contrast">Search</button></form>
          <select aria-label="Sort quotas" value={sort} onChange={(e) => { setSort(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} className="h-11 min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[13px] text-foreground">{sortOptions.map((option) => <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</option>)}</select>
        </div>
        {loading ? <p role="status" className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted">Loading quota records…</p> : <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-212.5 text-left text-[13px]"><thead className="bg-background text-xs text-muted"><tr><th className="px-5 py-4">{active === "users" ? "Account" : "Workspace"}</th><th className="px-4 py-4">Plan</th><th className="px-4 py-4">Used / Reserved</th><th className="px-4 py-4">Limit</th><th className="px-4 py-4">Usage</th><th className="px-4 py-4">Status</th><th className="px-5 py-4 text-right">Actions</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{directory?.results.map((row) => {
              const q = row.quota; const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(q?.percentage ?? 0, 100));
              return <tr key={row.id} className="border-t border-border/70"><td className="px-5 py-4"><p className="font-semibold">{row.name}</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted">{row.detail}</p></td><td className="px-4 py-4 text-muted">{plans.find((p) => p.code === q?.plan_code)?.name ?? (q ? "Custom" : "Unconfigured")}</td><td className="px-4 py-4"><p>{q ? readable(q.used_bytes) : "—"}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted">Reserved: {q ? readable(q.reserved_bytes) : "—"}</p></td><td className="px-4 py-4">{q ? readable(q.limit_bytes) : "—"}</td><td className="px-4 py-4"><div className="h-2 w-28 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-background"><div className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-contrast" style={{ width: `${width}%` }} /></div><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">{q?.percentage === null || !q ? "—" : `${q.percentage}%`}</p></td><td className="px-4 py-4 capitalize">{q?.status.replaceAll("_", " ") ?? "Unconfigured"}</td><td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{row.editable && q && canEdit ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { setError(""); setChange({ selected: row, plan_code: q.plan_code || "", custom_mib: String(Math.round((q.limit_bytes || 0) / SIZE)), reason: "" }); }} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-contrast">Manage</button> : <span className="text-xs text-muted">{!row.editable ? "Organization managed" : !q ? "Requires reconciliation" : "View only"}</span>}</td></tr>;
            })}</tbody></table>{!directory?.results.length && <p className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted">No matching storage accounts.</p>}
          </div>}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border p-4 text-xs text-muted"><span>Page {page} of {totalPages}</span><div className="flex gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={page <= 1 || loading} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-30">Previous</button><button type="button" disabled={page >= totalPages || loading} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-30">Next</button></div></div>
      </section>
    </>}
    {active === "policies" && <QuotaPlanPolicies canEdit={canEdit} />}
    {active === "capacity" && <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface"><div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-border px-5 py-4 text-[14px] font-semibold"><HardDrive size={17}/>Quota changes</div>{loading ? <p className="p-8 text-sm text-muted">Loading audit history…</p> : <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full min-w-162.5 text-left text-[13px]"><thead className="bg-background text-xs text-muted"><tr><th className="px-5 py-3">Changed</th><th className="px-5 py-3">Administrator</th><th className="px-5 py-3">Old limit</th><th className="px-5 py-3">New limit</th><th className="px-5 py-3">Reason</th></tr></thead><tbody>{audit?.results.map((item) => <tr className="border-t border-border" key={item.id}><td className="px-5 py-4">{new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleString()}</td><td className="px-5 py-4">{item.actor}</td><td className="px-5 py-4">{readable(item.old_limit_bytes)}</td><td className="px-5 py-4">{readable(item.new_limit_bytes)}</td><td className="px-5 py-4">{item.reason}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>{!audit?.results.length && <p className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-muted">No quota changes recorded.</p>}</div>}<div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border p-4 text-xs"><span>{audit?.count ?? 0} events · Page {page}</span><div className="flex gap-2"><button disabled={page === 1} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-30">Previous</button><button disabled={!audit || page * 20 >= audit.count} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 disabled:opacity-30">Next</button></div></div></section>}
    {active === "capacity" && !loading && configAudit && <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface">
      <h2 className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold">Plan & policy changes</h2>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full min-w-160 text-left text-[12px]"><thead className="bg-background text-muted"><tr><th className="px-4 py-3">Changed</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Type</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Administrator</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Reason</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        {[...configAudit.plan_changes.map((e) => ({ ...e, type: `Plan ${e.target || ""} · ${e.action || "updated"}` })), ...configAudit.policy_changes.map((e) => ({ ...e, type: "Storage policy" }))].sort((a, b) => b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at)).map((event) => <tr key={event.id} className="border-t border-border/70"><td className="px-4 py-3">{new Date(event.created_at).toLocaleString()}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{event.type}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{event.actor}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{event.reason}</td></tr>)}
      </tbody></table></div>
      <p className="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 text-[11px] text-muted">{configAudit.plan_change_count} plan changes · {configAudit.policy_change_count} policy changes. Page {page} for each change type.</p>
    </section>}
    {change && <div role="presentation" className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/55 p-4" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) setChange(null); }}><section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Manage storage quota" className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-xl"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[17px] font-semibold"><Settings2 size={18}/>Manage quota</div><button type="button" disabled={saving} aria-label="Close" onClick={() => setChange(null)}><X size={20}/></button></div><p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">{change.selected.name}</p><form onSubmit={(e) => void applyChange(e)} className="mt-5 space-y-4"><label className="block text-[12px] font-medium">Storage plan<select className="mt-2 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3" value={change.plan_code} onChange={(e) => setChange({ ...change, plan_code: e.target.value })}><option value="">Custom quota</option>{plans.filter((p) => p.is_active && p.scope === change.selected.scope).map((p) => <option key={p.code} value={p.code}>{p.name} — {readable(p.limit_bytes)}</option>)}</select></label>{!change.plan_code && <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium">Limit (MiB)<input type="number" min={0} max={1000000000} step={1} required value={change.custom_mib} onChange={(e) => setChange({ ...change, custom_mib: e.target.value })} className="mt-2 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3" /></label>}<label className="block text-[12px] font-medium">Reason (8–500 characters)<textarea minLength={8} maxLength={500} required value={change.reason} onChange={(e) => setChange({ ...change, reason: e.target.value })} className="mt-2 min-h-24 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3" /></label><p className="text-xs text-muted">Lowering quota never deletes files. It prevents new uploads when capacity is insufficient.</p><div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => setChange(null)} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm">Cancel</button><button type="submit" disabled={saving || change.reason.trim().length < 8} className="rounded-xl bg-brand-soft px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-contrast disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save quota"}</button></div></form></section></div>}
  </div>;
}

FILE: frontend\components\admin\QuotaPlanPolicies.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Pencil, Plus, ShieldCheck, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { requestAccountApi, accountCsrfHeaders } from "@/lib/account-service";

type Plan = { code: string; name: string; scope: "personal" | "workspace"; limit_bytes: number; is_active: boolean; assignments: number };
type Policy = { warning_percent: number; critical_percent: number };
type FormPlan = { code: string; name: string; scope: "personal" | "workspace"; limit_mib: string; is_active: boolean; reason: string };
const MIB = 1024 ** 2;
const initial = (): FormPlan => ({ code: "", name: "", scope: "personal", limit_mib: "100", is_active: true, reason: "" });
const errorMessage = (e: unknown) => e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Request failed.";
const readable = (bytes: number | null) => bytes === null ? "Unlimited" : `${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(bytes / MIB)} MiB`;
const toBytes = (mib: string) => {
  const n = Number(mib);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 1000000000 ? n * MIB : null;
};

export default function QuotaPlanPolicies({ canEdit }: { canEdit: boolean }) {
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<Plan[]>([]);
  const [policy, setPolicy] = useState<Policy | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | "new" | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormPlan>(initial);
  const [policyReason, setPolicyReason] = useState("");
  const [warning, setWarning] = useState("80");
  const [critical, setCritical] = useState("95");
  const [showInactive, setShowInactive] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<Plan | null>(null);
  const [deleteReason, setDeleteReason] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    Promise.all([
      requestAccountApi<{ plans: Plan[] }>(`/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/${showInactive ? "?include_inactive=1" : ""}`, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" }),
      requestAccountApi<Policy>("/accounts/api/admin/quota-policy/", { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" }),
    ]).then(([planResult, policyResult]) => {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setPlans(planResult.plans);
      setPolicy(policyResult);
      setWarning(String(policyResult.warning_percent)); setCritical(String(policyResult.critical_percent));
      setError("");
    }).catch((err: unknown) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(errorMessage(err)); })
      .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false); });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [revision, showInactive]);

  function openPlan(plan?: Plan) {
    setNotice(""); setError("");
    setEditing(plan ? plan.code : "new");
    setForm(plan ? {
      code: plan.code, name: plan.name, scope: plan.scope,
      limit_mib: String(plan.limit_bytes / MIB), is_active: plan.is_active, reason: "",
    } : initial());
  }

  async function savePlan(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!editing || saving) return;
    const size = toBytes(form.limit_mib);
    if (size === null || form.reason.trim().length < 8 || form.reason.trim().length > 500) {
      setError("Use a whole MiB value and a reason of 8–500 characters."); return;
    }
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    const creating = editing === "new";
    try {
      const headers = await accountCsrfHeaders();
      const endpoint = creating ? "/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/create/" : `/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/${encodeURIComponent(editing)}/`;
      await requestAccountApi(endpoint, {
        method: creating ? "POST" : "PATCH", headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...(creating ? { code: form.code.trim(), scope: form.scope } : { is_active: form.is_active }),
          name: form.name.trim(), limit_bytes: size, reason: form.reason.trim() }),
      });
      setEditing(null); setNotice(creating ? "Plan created." : "Plan updated. Existing allocations are unchanged.");
      setRevision((r) => r + 1);
    } catch (e) { setError(errorMessage(e)); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  async function savePolicy(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    const warn = Number(warning); const crit = Number(critical);
    if (!Number.isInteger(warn) || !Number.isInteger(crit) || !(1 <= warn && warn < crit && crit <= 100) || policyReason.trim().length < 8 || policyReason.trim().length > 500) {
      setError("Provide valid warning/critical percentages and a reason of 8–500 characters."); return;
    }
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    try {
      await requestAccountApi("/accounts/api/admin/quota-policy/update/", {
        method: "PATCH", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ warning_percent: warn, critical_percent: crit, reason: policyReason.trim() }),
      });
      setNotice("Quota warning thresholds updated."); setPolicyReason(""); setRevision((r) => r + 1);
    } catch (e) { setError(errorMessage(e)); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  async function deletePlan(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!deleting || saving || deleteReason.trim().length < 8 || deleteReason.trim().length > 500) return;
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    try {
      await requestAccountApi(`/accounts/api/admin/quota-plans/${encodeURIComponent(deleting.code)}/delete/`, {
        method: "DELETE", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: deleteReason.trim() }),
      });
      setNotice(`Plan ${deleting.name} deleted. Existing quota limits are unchanged.`);
      setDeleting(null); setDeleteReason(""); setRevision((r) => r + 1);
    } catch (e) { setError(errorMessage(e)); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  return <div className="space-y-4">
    {notice && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3 text-sm text-foreground">{notice}</p>}
    {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-danger/50 p-3 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] border border-border bg-surface">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-[14px] font-semibold">Storage plans</h2>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-muted"><input type="checkbox" checked={showInactive} onChange={(e) => setShowInactive(e.target.checked)} />Show inactive</label>
          {canEdit && <button type="button" onClick={() => openPlan()} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-[12px] font-medium"><Plus size={14} />Add plan</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
      {loading ? <p className="p-5 text-sm text-muted">Loading plans…</p> : <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full min-w-150 text-left text-[13px]"><thead className="bg-background text-xs text-muted"><tr><th className="px-4 py-3">Plan</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Scope</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Limit</th><th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th><th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        {plans.map((plan) => <tr key={plan.code} className="border-t border-border/70"><td className="px-4 py-3"><strong>{plan.name}</strong><p className="text-[11px] text-muted">{plan.code}</p></td><td className="px-4 py-3 capitalize">{plan.scope}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{readable(plan.limit_bytes)}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{plan.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}</td><td className="px-4 py-3 text-right"><div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">{canEdit ? <>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => openPlan(plan)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs"><Pencil size={13} />Edit</button>
          {!(["free", "workspace-starter"].includes(plan.code)) && <button type="button" title={plan.assignments ? "Assigned plan: disable it first to hide without changing quotas" : "Delete unused plan"} disabled={plan.assignments > 0} onClick={() => { setDeleting(plan); setDeleteReason(""); setError(""); }} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs text-danger disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"><Trash2 size={13} />Delete</button>}
        </> : "View only"}</div></td></tr>)}
      </tbody></table>{!plans.length && <p className="p-5 text-sm text-muted">No storage plans.</p>}</div>}
    </section>
    <section className="rounded-[18px] border border-border bg-surface p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><ShieldCheck size={17} className="text-brand-contrast"/><h2 className="text-[14px] font-semibold">Quota warning thresholds</h2></div>
      <form onSubmit={(e) => void savePolicy(e)} className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
        <label className="w-32 text-[12px] text-muted">Warning (%)<input type="number" aria-label="Warning threshold" min={1} max={99} step={1} value={warning} onChange={(e) => setWarning(e.target.value)} disabled={!canEdit || saving} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-foreground" /></label>
        <label className="w-32 text-[12px] text-muted">Critical (%)<input type="number" aria-label="Critical threshold" min={2} max={100} step={1} value={critical} onChange={(e) => setCritical(e.target.value)} disabled={!canEdit || saving} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-foreground" /></label>
        {canEdit && <label className="min-w-50 flex-1 text-[12px] text-muted">Reason
          <input minLength={8} maxLength={500} value={policyReason} onChange={(e) => setPolicyReason(e.target.value)} required className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-foreground" placeholder="Explain the quota threshold change" />
        </label>}
        {canEdit && <button type="submit" disabled={saving || !policy || policyReason.trim().length < 8} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-soft px-4 text-[12px] font-semibold text-brand-contrast disabled:opacity-50">Save thresholds</button>}
      </form>
    </section>
    {deleting && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget && !saving) setDeleting(null); }}>
      <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Delete storage plan" className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex justify-between"><h3 className="font-semibold">Delete {deleting.name}?</h3><button type="button" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => setDeleting(null)} disabled={saving}><X size={18}/></button></div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] text-muted">Only unassigned plans can be permanently deleted. Assigned plans must be disabled instead; existing quota allocations remain unchanged.</p>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-[12px] text-danger">{error}</p>}
        <form className="mt-4 space-y-3" onSubmit={(event) => void deletePlan(event)}>
          <label className="block text-[12px]">Reason (8–500 characters)<textarea required minLength={8} maxLength={500} value={deleteReason} onChange={(e) => setDeleteReason(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 min-h-20 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3" /></label>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => setDeleting(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-2">Cancel</button><button type="submit" disabled={saving || deleteReason.trim().length < 8} className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 px-4 py-2 text-danger">{saving ? "Deleting…" : "Delete plan"}</button></div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>}
    {editing && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget && !saving) setEditing(null); }}>
      <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={editing === "new" ? "Create plan" : "Edit plan"} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex justify-between"><h3 className="font-semibold">{editing === "new" ? "Create plan" : "Edit plan"}</h3><button type="button" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} disabled={saving}><X size={18}/></button></div>
        <form onSubmit={(e) => void savePlan(e)} className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-[12px]">
          <label className="block">Code<input required disabled={editing !== "new"} pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*" maxLength={48} value={form.code} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, code: e.target.value })} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3"/></label>
          <label className="block">Name<input required minLength={2} maxLength={80} value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3"/></label>
          <label className="block">Scope<select disabled={editing !== "new"} value={form.scope} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, scope: e.target.value as FormPlan["scope"] })} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3"><option value="personal">Personal</option><option value="workspace">Workspace</option></select></label>
          <label className="block">Limit (MiB)<input type="number" min={0} step={1} required value={form.limit_mib} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, limit_mib: e.target.value })} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3" /></label>
          {editing !== "new" && <label className="flex items-center gap-2"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.is_active} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, is_active: e.target.checked })}/>Active</label>}
          <label className="block">Reason (8–500 characters)<textarea required minLength={8} maxLength={500} value={form.reason} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, reason: e.target.value })} className="mt-1 min-h-20 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3"/></label>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">Editing a preset does not automatically change existing quota assignments.</p>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => setEditing(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-2">Cancel</button><button type="submit" disabled={saving || form.reason.trim().length < 8} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-soft px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-brand-contrast">{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save"}</button></div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>}

FILE: frontend\components\admin\RoleAssignments.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeftRight, ArrowRightLeft, ShieldCheck, X } from "lucide-react";

type Role = "Administrator" | "Infrastructure Manager" | "Team Leader" | "Member" | "Auditor";
type Assignment = { id: string; name: string; role: Role };

const initialAssignments: Assignment[] = [
  { id: "BD-10021", name: "Olivia Martin", role: "Administrator" },
  { id: "BD-10022", name: "Ethan Wilson", role: "Team Leader" },
  { id: "BD-10023", name: "Ava Thompson", role: "Member" },
  { id: "BD-10027", name: "Taylor Kim", role: "Infrastructure Manager" },
  { id: "BD-10025", name: "Mia Chen", role: "Auditor" },
];

export default function RoleAssignments() {
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState(initialAssignments);
  const [firstId, setFirstId] = useState(initialAssignments[0].id);
  const [secondId, setSecondId] = useState(initialAssignments[1].id);
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<"transfer" | "swap" | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const first = assignments.find((user) => user.id === firstId);
  const second = assignments.find((user) => user.id === secondId);
  const canApply = first && second && first.id !== second.id;

  function confirmOperation() {
    if (!operation || !first || !second) return;
    if (operation === "swap") {
      setAssignments((current) => current.map((user) => (
        user.id === first.id ? { ...user, role: second.role }
          : user.id === second.id ? { ...user, role: first.role }
            : user
      )));
      setNotice("Role swap complete");
    } else {
      setAssignments((current) => current.map((user) => (
        user.id === first.id ? { ...user, role: "Member" }
          : user.id === second.id ? { ...user, role: first.role }
            : user
      )));
      setNotice("Role transfer complete");
    }
    setOperation(null);
  }

  return (
    <section className="mt-5 rounded-[22px] border border-border bg-surface p-5 sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <span className="rounded-xl bg-brand-soft p-2.5 text-brand"><ShieldCheck size={18} /></span>
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-semibold">Role transfer & swap</h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      {notice && <div role="status" className="mt-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-brand-soft p-3 text-xs text-brand-hover"><span>{notice}</span><button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" onClick={() => setNotice("")}><X size={15} /></button></div>}

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] md:items-end">
        <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted">From
          <select value={firstId} onChange={(event) => setFirstId(event.target.value)} className="mt-1.5 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-foreground">
            {assignments.map((user) => <option key={user.id} value={user.id}>{user.name} · {user.role}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button type="button" disabled={!canApply} onClick={() => setOperation("transfer")} className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 text-xs font-medium disabled:opacity-40"><ArrowRightLeft size={15} /> Transfer</button>
          <button type="button" disabled={!canApply} onClick={() => setOperation("swap")} className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 text-xs font-medium disabled:opacity-40"><ArrowLeftRight size={15} /> Swap</button>
        </div>
        <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted">To
          <select value={secondId} onChange={(event) => setSecondId(event.target.value)} className="mt-1.5 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-foreground">
            {assignments.map((user) => <option key={user.id} value={user.id}>{user.name} · {user.role}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      {operation && first && second && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-foreground/35 p-4">
          <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="role-preview-title" className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[22px] border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div><h3 id="role-preview-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">Review role change</h3></div>
              <button type="button" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={() => setOperation(null)} className="rounded-lg p-2 text-muted hover:bg-background"><X size={17} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-5 space-y-3 rounded-xl bg-background p-4 text-sm">
              <p>{first.name}: <strong>{first.role}</strong> {operation === "transfer" ? "→ Member" : `→ ${second.role}`}</p>
              <p>{second.name}: <strong>{second.role}</strong> → <strong>{first.role}</strong></p>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setOperation(null)} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium">Cancel</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={confirmOperation} className="rounded-xl bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-hover">Confirm</button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

"A new setup link will be emailed. All previously issued links will stop working." : intent?.kind === "suspend" ? "The user will be suspended, and database sessions revoked. Files and Workspaces are preserved." : "The user will be able to sign in again."}</p><label className="block text-[12px] font-semibold">Reason (8–500 characters)<textarea value={reason} maxLength={500} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} className="mt-2 min-h-20 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3 text-[13px] font-normal"/></label>{actionError && <p role="alert" className="text-[12px] text-danger">{actionError}</p>}<div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={closeModal}>Cancel</Button><Button variant={intent?.kind === "reactivate" ? }

type ViewMode = "list" | "grid";
type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc";
type SortKey = "name" | "modified" | "size" | "type";
type DriveItemType = "folder" | "document" | "image";
type PendingDestructiveAction = {
  action: "trash" | "delete";
  count: number;
  targets: DriveItem[];
};

type SelectionBox = {
  left: number;
  top: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
};

  scrollTop: number;
  clientHeight: number;
  scrollHeight: number;
  /** Content-space offset for the first row/card, excluding the table/group heading. */
  trackTop: number;

  pointerId: number;

const ITEM_DRAG_TYPE = "application/x-securedrive-item";

export type DriveItem = {
  id: number;
  folderId?: number;
  name: string;
  owner: string;
  ownerInitials: string;
  modified: string;
  size: string;
  type: DriveItemType;
  starred?: boolean;
  canManage?: boolean;
};

type DriveFileBrowserProps = {
  title: string;
  items: DriveItem[];
};

const MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_PER_BATCH = 500;
const MAX_UPLOAD_FILE_SIZE = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_UPLOAD_PATH_LENGTH = 1024;
const MAX_FILE_NAME_LENGTH = 255;

function listViewForTitle(title: string): DriveListView | null {
  if (title === "My Drive") return "drive";
  if (title === "Recent") return "recent";
  if (title === "Trash") return "trash";
  if (title === "Shared with me") return "shared";
  if (title === "Starred") return "starred";
  return null;
}

function renderItemIcon(type: DriveItemType, size: number): ReactNode {
  if (type === "folder") return <Folder size={size} />;
  if (type === "image") return <ImageIcon size={size} />;
  return <FileText size={size} />;
}

type DroppedEntry = {
  name: string;
  fullPath: string;
  isFile: boolean;
  isDirectory: boolean;
  file?: (success: (file: File) => void, failure: (error: DOMException) => void) => void;
  createReader?: () => {
    readEntries: (
      success: (entries: DroppedEntry[]) => void,
      failure: (error: DOMException) => void,
    ) => void;
  };
};

function getDroppedEntry(item: DataTransferItem): DroppedEntry | null {
  const itemWithEntry = item as DataTransferItem & {
    webkitGetAsEntry?: () => DroppedEntry | null;
  };
  return itemWithEntry.webkitGetAsEntry?.() ?? null;
}

async function readDroppedEntry(entry: DroppedEntry): Promise<{ file: File; relativePath: string }[]> {
  if (entry.isFile && entry.file) {
    const file = await new Promise<File>((resolve, reject) => {
      entry.file?.(resolve, reject);
    });
    return [{ file, relativePath: entry.fullPath.replace(/^\/+/, "") || file.name }];
  }

  if (entry.isDirectory && entry.createReader) {
    const reader = entry.createReader();
    const children: DroppedEntry[] = [];
    while (true) {
      const batch = await new Promise<DroppedEntry[]>((resolve, reject) => {
        reader.readEntries(resolve, reject);
      });
      if (batch.length === 0) break;
      children.push(...batch);
    }
    const nested = await Promise.all(children.map(readDroppedEntry));
    return nested.flat();
  }

  throw new Error(`The browser couldn't read "${entry.name}". Check folder access or choose files instead.`);
}

function validateUploadPath(path: string, file: File): string | null {
  const segments = path.split(/[\\/]/);
  if (!path.trim() || path.length > MAX_UPLOAD_PATH_LENGTH) return "File path is empty or exceeds 1,024 characters.";
  if (segments.some((segment) => !segment || segment === "." || segment === "..")) return "File path contains an invalid path segment.";
  if (file.name.length > MAX_FILE_NAME_LENGTH) return "File name exceeds 255 characters.";
  if (/[<>:"|?*\u0000-\u001f]/.test(file.name)) return "File name contains characters that are not allowed.";
  if (file.size > MAX_UPLOAD_FILE_SIZE) return "File exceeds the current 100 MB upload limit.";
  return null;
}

function parseSize(value: string) {
  const match = value.match(/^([\d.]+)\s*(B|KB|MB|GB|TB)$/i);
  if (!match) return 0;
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const unitIndex = units.indexOf(match[2].toUpperCase());
  return Number(match[1]) * 1024 ** unitIndex;
}

export default function DriveFileBrowser({ title, items }: DriveFileBrowserProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  // Remount on route/folder changes instead of synchronously resetting state in an effect.
  return <DriveFileBrowserContent key={`${title}:${pathname}`} title={title} items={items} />;
}

function DriveFileBrowserContent({ title, items }: DriveFileBrowserProps) {
  const listView = listViewForTitle(title);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const currentFolderId = useMemo(() => {
    if (title !== "My Drive") return null;
    const match = pathname.match(/^\/drive\/folders\/([1-9]\d*)\/?$/);
    if (!match) return null;
    const parsed = Number(match[1]);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
  }, [pathname, title]);
  const [driveItems, setDriveItems] = useState(items);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const searchQueryRef = useRef("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(listView !== null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [folderDetails, setFolderDetails] = useState<DriveFolderDetails | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>("list");
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey>("name");
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState<SortDirection>("asc");
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<number>>(() => new Set());
  const [isCreateFolderOpen, setIsCreateFolderOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newFolderName, setNewFolderName] = useState("Untitled folder");
  const [isCreatingFolder, setIsCreatingFolder] = useState(false);
  const [folderNameError, setFolderNameError] = useState("");
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [downloadStatus, setDownloadStatus] = useState<{
    text: string;
    progress: DownloadProgress | null;
  } | null>(null);
  const [pendingDestructive, setPendingDestructive] = useState<PendingDestructiveAction | null>(null);
  const [shareDialogOpen, setShareDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [shareTargets, setShareTargets] = useState<DriveItem[]>([]);
  const [shareEmail, setShareEmail] = useState("");
  const [sharePermission, setSharePermission] = useState<"viewer" | "editor">("viewer");
  const [sharing, setSharing] = useState(false);
  // Only OS/browser file drags activate the upload overlay. Internal Drive drags
  // must never wash out the whole interface.
  const [fileDropActive, setFileDropActive] = useState(false);
  const [dragMessage, setDragMessage] = useState("Drop files to upload");
  const [marqueeActive, setMarqueeActive] = useState(false);
  const [selectionBox, setSelectionBox] = useState<SelectionBox | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const folderInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const driveListRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollbarTrackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollbarDragRef = useRef<ScrollbarDrag>(null);
  const [scrollMetrics, setScrollMetrics] = useState<ScrollMetrics>({
    scrollTop: 0,
    clientHeight: 0,
    scrollHeight: 0,
    trackTop: 0,
  });
  const [selectionAnchorId, setSelectionAnchorId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const selectionStartRef = useRef<{
    x: number;
    y: number;
    pointerId: number;
    additive: boolean;
    baseIds: Set<number>;
    dragged: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const marqueeSelectedIdsRef = useRef<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const loadRequestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const moveDestinationRequestIdRef = useRef(0);
  const pasteHandlerRef = useRef<(files: readonly { file: File; relativePath: string }[]) => void>(() => {});
  const [isMoveDialogOpen, setIsMoveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [moveTargets, setMoveTargets] = useState<DriveItem[]>([]);
  const [moveDestinationId, setMoveDestinationId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [moveDestinationItems, setMoveDestinationItems] = useState<DriveItem[]>([]);
  const [moveDestinationDetails, setMoveDestinationDetails] = useState<DriveFolderDetails | null>(null);
  const [moveDestinationLoading, setMoveDestinationLoading] = useState(false);
  const [moveDestinationError, setMoveDestinationError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isMovingItems, setIsMovingItems] = useState(false);
  const [isDuplicatingItems, setIsDuplicatingItems] = useState(false);
  const [dropTargetFolderId, setDropTargetFolderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [breadcrumbDropTargetIndex, setBreadcrumbDropTargetIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const { enqueue, openManager } = useUploadManager();

  const loadItems = useCallback(async (
    folderId: number | null,
    view: DriveListView,
    queryOverride?: string,
  ) => {
    const requestId = ++loadRequestIdRef.current;
    const query = view === "drive"
      ? (queryOverride ?? searchQueryRef.current).trim().slice(0, 255)
      : "";
    const effectiveFolderId = query ? null : folderId;
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(null);
    try {
      if (view === "drive" && effectiveFolderId !== null) {
        setFolderDetails(null);
        const [details, nextItems] = await Promise.all([
          getDriveFolderDetails(effectiveFolderId),
          getDriveItems(effectiveFolderId, view, query),
        ]);
        if (requestId !== loadRequestIdRef.current) return;
        setFolderDetails(details);
        setDriveItems(nextItems);
      } else {
        const nextItems = await getDriveItems(effectiveFolderId, view, query);
        if (requestId !== loadRequestIdRef.current) return;
        setFolderDetails(null);
        setDriveItems(nextItems);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (requestId !== loadRequestIdRef.current) return;
      setFolderDetails(null);
      setLoadError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load Drive items.");
    } finally {
      if (requestId === loadRequestIdRef.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const updateScrollMetrics = useCallback(() => {
    const container = driveListRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tableHeader = container.querySelector("thead");
    const firstDriveItem = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-drive-item-id]");
    // In list view, start the custom scrollbar below the sticky column headings.
    // In grid view, align it with the first folder/file card rather than the section title.
    const trackTop = tableHeader instanceof HTMLElement
      ? tableHeader.getBoundingClientRect().height
      : firstDriveItem
        ? Math.max(0, firstDriveItem.getBoundingClientRect().top - containerRect.top + container.scrollTop)
        : 0;
    const next: ScrollMetrics = {
      scrollTop: container.scrollTop,
      clientHeight: container.clientHeight,
      scrollHeight: container.scrollHeight,
      trackTop: Math.round(trackTop),
    };
    setScrollMetrics((current) => (
      current.scrollTop === next.scrollTop
      && current.clientHeight === next.clientHeight
      && current.scrollHeight === next.scrollHeight
      && current.trackTop === next.trackTop
        ? current
        : next
    ));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = driveListRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const initialMeasureFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollMetrics);
    container.addEventListener("scroll", updateScrollMetrics, { passive: true });
    const observer = typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined"
      ? new ResizeObserver(updateScrollMetrics)
      : null;
    observer?.observe(container);
    if (container.firstElementChild instanceof HTMLElement) {
      observer?.observe(container.firstElementChild);
    }
    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(initialMeasureFrame);
      container.removeEventListener("scroll", updateScrollMetrics);
      observer?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [updateScrollMetrics, loading, view, driveItems.length, sortKey, sortDirection]);

  // The custom scrollbar occupies only the file/folder rows, not the column heading
  // or the Folders/Files group label. Keep the same 8px inset at the bottom.
  const scrollbarTrackHeight = Math.max(0, scrollMetrics.clientHeight - scrollMetrics.trackTop - 8);
  const scrollbarThumbHeight = useMemo(() => {
    if (scrollMetrics.clientHeight <= 0 || scrollbarTrackHeight <= 0) return 0;
    const visibleItemsHeight = Math.max(0, scrollMetrics.clientHeight - scrollMetrics.trackTop);
    if (scrollMetrics.scrollHeight <= scrollMetrics.clientHeight + 1) return scrollbarTrackHeight;
    const naturalHeight = scrollbarTrackHeight * visibleItemsHeight / scrollMetrics.scrollHeight;
    // A deliberately shorter thumb improves visual balance; dragging still maps to the full scroll range.
    return Math.min(scrollbarTrackHeight, Math.max(28, Math.round(naturalHeight * 0.66)));
  }, [scrollMetrics.clientHeight, scrollMetrics.scrollHeight, scrollMetrics.trackTop, scrollbarTrackHeight]);
  const maxScrollTop = Math.max(0, scrollMetrics.scrollHeight - scrollMetrics.clientHeight);
  const maxThumbTop = Math.max(0, scrollbarTrackHeight - scrollbarThumbHeight);
  const scrollbarThumbTop = maxScrollTop > 0
    ? (scrollMetrics.scrollTop / maxScrollTop) * maxThumbTop
    : 0;

  function handleScrollbarPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    const container = driveListRef.current;
    if (!container || maxScrollTop <= 0 || scrollbarThumbHeight <= 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();

    const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const travel = Math.max(0, event.currentTarget.clientHeight - scrollbarThumbHeight);
    const clickedThumb = event.target instanceof Element
      && Boolean(event.target.closest("[data-drive-scroll-thumb]"));
    let startThumbTop = scrollbarThumbTop;
    if (!clickedThumb && travel > 0) {
      startThumbTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(
        travel,
        event.clientY - rect.top - scrollbarThumbHeight / 2,
      ));
      container.scrollTop = (startThumbTop / travel) * maxScrollTop;
    }

    scrollbarDragRef.current = {
      pointerId: event.pointerId,
      startY: event.clientY,
      startThumbTop,
    };
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  }

  function handleScrollbarPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const drag = scrollbarDragRef.current;
    const container = driveListRef.current;
    if (!drag || !container || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const travel = Math.max(0, event.currentTarget.clientHeight - scrollbarThumbHeight);
    const nextThumbTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(
      travel,
      drag.startThumbTop + event.clientY - drag.startY,
    ));
    if (travel > 0 && maxScrollTop > 0) {
      container.scrollTop = (nextThumbTop / travel) * maxScrollTop;
    }
  }

  function finishScrollbarPointer(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const drag = scrollbarDragRef.current;
    if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
    scrollbarDragRef.current = null;
    if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
      event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    }
  }

  function handleScrollbarKeyDown(event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const container = driveListRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const pageStep = Math.max(40, Math.round(container.clientHeight * 0.85));
    let nextTop: number | null = null;
    if (event.key === "ArrowUp") nextTop = container.scrollTop - 40;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowDown") nextTop = container.scrollTop + 40;
    else if (event.key === "PageUp") nextTop = container.scrollTop - pageStep;
    else if (event.key === "PageDown" || event.key === " ") nextTop = container.scrollTop + pageStep;
    else if (event.key === "Home") nextTop = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") nextTop = container.scrollHeight;
    if (nextTop === null) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    container.scrollTop = nextTop;
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!listView) return;
    const initialQuery = listView === "drive"
      ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("q")?.trim().slice(0, 255) ?? ""
      : "";
    searchQueryRef.current = initialQuery;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setSearchQuery(initialQuery);
      void loadItems(listView === "drive" && !initialQuery ? currentFolderId : null, listView, initialQuery);
    }, 0);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [listView, currentFolderId, loadItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSearchChanged = (event: Event) => {
      const customEvent = event as CustomEvent<{ query?: string }>;
      const query = (customEvent.detail?.query ?? "").trim().slice(0, 255);
      searchQueryRef.current = query;
      setSearchQuery(query);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      setSelectionAnchorId(null);
      setFolderDetails(null);
      if (query) {
        void loadItems(null, "drive", query);
      } else if (listView === "drive") {
        void loadItems(currentFolderId, "drive", "");
      }
    };
    const handleHistoryNavigation = () => {
      const query = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("q") ?? "").trim().slice(0, 255);
      if (query === searchQueryRef.current) return;
      searchQueryRef.current = query;
      setSearchQuery(query);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      setSelectionAnchorId(null);
      if (listView === "drive") void loadItems(query ? null : currentFolderId, "drive", query);
    };
    window.addEventListener(DRIVE_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, handleSearchChanged);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", handleHistoryNavigation);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, handleSearchChanged);
      window.removeEventListener("popstate", handleHistoryNavigation);
    };
  }, [currentFolderId, listView, loadItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleWorkspaceChanged() {
      searchQueryRef.current = "";
      setSearchQuery("");
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      setSelectionAnchorId(null);
      setFolderDetails(null);
      if (currentFolderId !== null) {
        // A folder ID is not portable between workspaces. Return to the selected
        // workspace root rather than leaving a stale folder route on screen.
        router.replace("/drive");
        return;
      }
      if (listView) void loadItems(null, listView, "");
    }

    window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, handleWorkspaceChanged);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, handleWorkspaceChanged);
  }, [currentFolderId, listView, loadItems, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleUploadCompleted(event: Event) {
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent<{ destinationId: string | null }>).detail;
      if (!detail || !listView) return;

      // Quota and the sidebar folder tree are cached summaries. Invalidate them
      // after every completed upload, even when the upload target is elsewhere.
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT));
      if (listView === "drive") {
        const currentDestinationId = currentFolderId === null ? null : String(currentFolderId);
        if (detail.destinationId !== currentDestinationId) return;
        void loadItems(currentFolderId, "drive");
        return;
      }

      // Newly uploaded files can appear immediately in Recent as well.
      if (listView === "recent") {
        void loadItems(null, "recent");
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, handleUploadCompleted);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, handleUploadCompleted);
  }, [currentFolderId, listView, loadItems]);

  const selectedItems = useMemo(
    () => driveItems.filter((item) => selectedIds.has(item.id)),
    [driveItems, selectedIds],
  );
  const selectedCanManage = selectedItems.length > 0 && selectedItems.every((item) => item.canManage !== false);
  const sortedItems = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...driveItems].sort((first, second) => {
        // Keep folders grouped before files, regardless of sort column/direction.
        const firstIsFolder = first.type === "folder";
        const secondIsFolder = second.type === "folder";
        if (firstIsFolder !== secondIsFolder) return firstIsFolder ? -1 : 1;

        let comparison: number;
        if (sortKey === "modified") {
          comparison = first.modified.localeCompare(second.modified, undefined, { numeric: true });
        } else if (sortKey === "size") {
          comparison = parseSize(first.size) - parseSize(second.size);
        } else if (sortKey === "type") {
          comparison = first.type.localeCompare(second.type);
        } else {
          comparison = first.name.localeCompare(second.name, undefined, { numeric: true });
        }
        return sortDirection === "asc" ? comparison : -comparison;
      }),
    [driveItems, sortDirection, sortKey],
  );
  const folderItems = useMemo(
    () => sortedItems.filter((item) => item.type === "folder"),
    [sortedItems],
  );
  const fileItems = useMemo(
    () => sortedItems.filter((item) => item.type !== "folder"),
    [sortedItems],
  );

  const addUploadFiles = useCallback(async (files: readonly { file: File; relativePath: string }[]) => {
    if (files.length === 0) {
      setToast("No files were provided by the browser. Folder access may have been denied.");
      return;
    }
    if (files.length > MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_PER_BATCH) {
      setToast(`A batch can contain at most ${MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_PER_BATCH} files. None of this selection was added.`);
      return;
    }

    const baseDestinationId = currentFolderId !== null ? String(currentFolderId) : null;
    const normalizedFiles = files.map(({ file, relativePath }) => {
      const normalizedPath = relativePath.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\/+/, "");
      return {
        file,
        relativePath: normalizedPath,
        validationError: validateUploadPath(normalizedPath, file),
      };
    });

    // Folder paths shown in the queue must correspond to real Folder rows. Resolve each
    // parent path first, then attach that folder's ID to the individual upload task.
    const folderIdsByPath = new Map<string, string>();
    const createdOrReusedFolderIds = new Set<string>();
    const ensureFolder = async (name: string, parentId: string | null): Promise<string> => {
      const cacheKey = `${parentId ?? "root"}::${name.toLocaleLowerCase()}`;
      const cached = folderIdsByPath.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;

      // Reuse a same-named folder if it already exists under this parent.
      const siblings = await getDriveItems(parentId === null ? null : Number(parentId), "drive");
      const existing = siblings.find((item) =>
        item.type === "folder" && item.name.localeCompare(name, undefined, { sensitivity: "accent" }) === 0,
      );
      if (existing) {
        const id = String(existing.folderId ?? existing.id);
        folderIdsByPath.set(cacheKey, id);
        return id;
      }

      const created = await requestAccountApi<{
        id: number;
        name: string;
        parent_id: number | null;
        type: "folder";
      }>("/drive/api/folders/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, parent_id: parentId === null ? null : Number(parentId) }),
      });
      const id = String(created.id);
      folderIdsByPath.set(cacheKey, id);
      createdOrReusedFolderIds.add(id);
      return id;
    };

    try {
      const queuedFiles: Array<typeof normalizedFiles[number] & { destinationId: string | null }> = [];
      // Resolve paths sequentially so two files sharing a new parent folder cannot race
      // and create duplicate folder rows before the in-memory cache is populated.
      for (const entry of normalizedFiles) {
        // Invalid entries remain visible as failed/invalid queue items but must not cause
        // folder creation with unsafe path segments.
        if (entry.validationError) {
          queuedFiles.push({ ...entry, destinationId: baseDestinationId });
          continue;
        }

        const segments = entry.relativePath.split("/");
        let destinationId = baseDestinationId;
        const directorySegments = segments.slice(0, -1);
        for (const segment of directorySegments) {
          if (!segment || segment === "." || segment === "..") {
            throw new Error(`Invalid folder path in "${entry.relativePath}". No upload tasks were added.`);
          }
          destinationId = await ensureFolder(segment, destinationId);
        }
        queuedFiles.push({ ...entry, destinationId });
      }

      enqueue(queuedFiles.map(({ file, relativePath, validationError, destinationId }) => ({
        file,
        relativePath,
        validationError,
        destinationId,
      })), baseDestinationId);
      if (createdOrReusedFolderIds.size > 0) {
        notifyFolderTreeChanged();
        if (listView === "drive") await loadItems(currentFolderId, "drive");
      }
      openManager();
    } catch (error) {
      setToast(error instanceof Error
        ? `Could not prepare the folder structure. No files were queued. ${error.message}`
        : "Could not prepare the folder structure. No files were queued.");
    }
  }, [currentFolderId, enqueue, listView, loadItems, openManager]);

  function handleSelectedFiles(fileList: FileList | null) {
    if (!fileList) return;
    const selected = Array.from(fileList).map((file) => ({
      file,
      relativePath: file.webkitRelativePath || file.name,
    }));
    void addUploadFiles(selected);
  }

  function openFolderPicker() {
    const input = folderInputRef.current;
    if (!input) return;
    if (!("webkitdirectory" in input)) {
      setToast("Folder selection isn't supported by this browser. Use Upload files and select files individually.");
      return;
    }
    input.click();
  }

  async function handleCreateFolder() {
    const trimmedName = newFolderName.trim();

    if (!trimmedName) {
      setFolderNameError("Folder name cannot be empty.");
      return;
    }

    if (trimmedName.length > 255) {
      setFolderNameError("Folder name cannot exceed 255 characters.");
      return;
    }

    setIsCreatingFolder(true);
    setFolderNameError("");
    setToast("Creating folder...");

    try {
      await requestAccountApi<{
        id: number;
        name: string;
        parent_id: number | null;
        type: "folder";
      }>("/drive/api/folders/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: trimmedName,
          parent_id: currentFolderId,
        }),
      });

      setIsCreateFolderOpen(false);
      setNewFolderName("Untitled folder");
      notifyFolderTreeChanged();

      // Refresh the list first; hide the progress toast after the folder is shown.
      await loadItems(
        currentFolderId,
        listView ?? "drive",
      );
      setToast(null);
    } catch (error) {
      setToast(null);
      setFolderNameError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not create the folder.",
      );
    } finally {
      setIsCreatingFolder(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    function onUploadFiles() {
      fileInputRef.current?.click();
    }
    function onUploadFolder() {
      openFolderPicker();
    }
    function onCreateFolder() {
      if (title !== "My Drive") {
        setToast("Creating folders is only available in My Drive.");
        return;
      }

      setNewFolderName("Untitled folder");
      setFolderNameError("");
      setIsCreateFolderOpen(true);
    }
    function onFilePickerCancel() {
      setToast("File selection canceled. Nothing was added to the queue.");
    }

    window.addEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_FILES_EVENT, onUploadFiles);
    window.addEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_FOLDER_EVENT, onUploadFolder);
    window.addEventListener(DRIVE_CREATE_FOLDER_EVENT, onCreateFolder);
    const fileInput = fileInputRef.current;
    const folderInput = folderInputRef.current;
    fileInput?.addEventListener("cancel", onFilePickerCancel);
    folderInput?.addEventListener("cancel", onFilePickerCancel);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_FILES_EVENT, onUploadFiles);
      window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_FOLDER_EVENT, onUploadFolder);
      window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_CREATE_FOLDER_EVENT, onCreateFolder);
      fileInput?.removeEventListener("cancel", onFilePickerCancel);
      folderInput?.removeEventListener("cancel", onFilePickerCancel);
    };
  }, [title]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      if (
        event.target instanceof Element
        && event.target.closest('[role="menu"], dialog[open]')
      ) return;
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      setSelectionAnchorId(null);
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  function handleItemClick(event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>, id: number) {
    // Suppress the synthetic click after a marquee gesture using the clicked item DOM node.
    // This keeps render-time callback analysis free of ref reads.
    const clickedNode = event.currentTarget;
    if (clickedNode.dataset.suppressSelectionClick === "true") {
      delete clickedNode.dataset.suppressSelectionClick;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    // Windows Explorer-style selection:
    // click = single select, Ctrl/Cmd+click = toggle one item, Shift+click = range.
    if (event.shiftKey) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const anchorId = selectionAnchorId ?? id;
      if (selectionAnchorId === null) setSelectionAnchorId(anchorId);
      let anchorIndex = sortedItems.findIndex((item) => item.id === anchorId);
      const targetIndex = sortedItems.findIndex((item) => item.id === id);
      if (anchorIndex < 0) anchorIndex = targetIndex;
      if (targetIndex < 0) return;

      const start = Math.min(anchorIndex, targetIndex);
      const end = Math.max(anchorIndex, targetIndex);
      const rangeIds = sortedItems.slice(start, end + 1).map((item) => item.id);
      setSelectedIds((current) => {
        const next = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? new Set(current) : new Set<number>();
        rangeIds.forEach((rangeId) => next.add(rangeId));
        return next;
      });
      return;
    }

    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      setSelectedIds((current) => {
        const next = new Set(current);
        if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
        else next.add(id);
        return next;
      });
      setSelectionAnchorId(id);
      return;
    }

    setSelectedIds(new Set([id]));
    setSelectionAnchorId(id);
  }

  function toggleItem(id: number) {
    setSelectedIds((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
    setSelectionAnchorId(id);
  }

  function handleMarqueePointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.shiftKey) return;
    const target = event.target;
    if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;
    // Starting on a row/card body is allowed: a simple click still selects that item,
    // while moving beyond the drag threshold turns the gesture into a marquee.
    // Keep menus, action buttons, sort controls, and explicit drag handles independent.
    if (target.closest(
      'thead, button, a, input, select, textarea, [role="menu"], [role="toolbar"], dialog[open], [contenteditable="true"], [data-no-marquee-selection="true"]',
    )) return;

    const additive = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    const baseIds = new Set(selectedIds);
    selectionStartRef.current = {
      x: event.clientX,
      y: event.clientY,
      pointerId: event.pointerId,
      additive,
      baseIds,
      dragged: false,
    };
    marqueeSelectedIdsRef.current = new Set(additive ? baseIds : []);
    setSelectionBox(null);
    setMarqueeActive(true);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    function handlePointerMove(event: PointerEvent) {
      const start = selectionStartRef.current;
      const container = driveListRef.current;
      if (!start || !container || event.pointerId !== start.pointerId) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - start.x;
      const dy = event.clientY - start.y;
      if (!start.dragged && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 4) return;
      start.dragged = true;

      const left = Math.min(start.x, event.clientX);
      const top = Math.min(start.y, event.clientY);
      const right = Math.max(start.x, event.clientX);
      const bottom = Math.max(start.y, event.clientY);
      setSelectionBox({ left, top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top });

      const next = new Set(start.additive ? start.baseIds : []);
      const itemNodes = container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-drive-item-id]");
      itemNodes.forEach((node) => {
        const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
        const intersects = rect.left <= right
          && rect.right >= left
          && rect.top <= bottom
          && rect.bottom >= top;
        if (intersects) {
          const id = Number(node.dataset.driveItemId);
          if (Number.isSafeInteger(id)) next.add(id);
        }
      });
      marqueeSelectedIdsRef.current = next;
      setSelectedIds(next);
    }

    function finishPointer(event: PointerEvent) {
      const start = selectionStartRef.current;
      if (!start || (event.pointerId !== undefined && event.pointerId !== start.pointerId)) return;
      if (start.dragged) {
        // Mark the item under the pointer so its synthetic post-drag click is ignored.
        // The marker is stored on the DOM item rather than a ref read by the render callback.
        const pointerTarget = event.target instanceof Element
          ? event.target.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-drive-item-id]")
          : null;
        if (pointerTarget) {
          pointerTarget.dataset.suppressSelectionClick = "true";
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (pointerTarget.dataset.suppressSelectionClick === "true") {
              delete pointerTarget.dataset.suppressSelectionClick;
            }
          }, 0);
        }
        const container = driveListRef.current;
        const selectedInListOrder = container
          ? Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-drive-item-id]"))
            .map((node) => Number(node.dataset.driveItemId))
            .filter((id) => Number.isSafeInteger(id) && marqueeSelectedIdsRef.current.has(id))
          : [];
        if (selectedInListOrder.length) {
          setSelectionAnchorId(selectedInListOrder[selectedInListOrder.length - 1]);
        }
      } else if (!start.additive) {
        // Clicking blank space clears selection; a row/card click handler will then
        // select the clicked item if the pointer was released on one.
        const target = event.target;
        const clickedItem = target instanceof Element && target.closest('[data-drive-item-id]');
        if (!clickedItem) {
          setSelectedIds(new Set());
          setSelectionAnchorId(null);
        }
      }
      selectionStartRef.current = null;
      setSelectionBox(null);
      setMarqueeActive(false);
    }

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", finishPointer);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", finishPointer);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", finishPointer);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", finishPointer);
    };
  }, []);

  // Keep the latest queue handler available to the global paste listener without
  // reinstalling the listener on every render.
  useEffect(() => {
    pasteHandlerRef.current = addUploadFiles;
  }, [addUploadFiles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function onPaste(event: ClipboardEvent) {
      const target = event.target;
      if (target instanceof Element && target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"], [role="textbox"]')) {
        return;
      }
      const transfer = event.clipboardData;
      if (!transfer) return;
      const fromFiles = Array.from(transfer.files ?? []);
      const fromItems = Array.from(transfer.items ?? [])
        .filter((item) => item.kind === "file")
        .map((item) => item.getAsFile())
        .filter((file): file is File => file !== null);
      // The FileList is the canonical collection. Some browsers expose the same
