"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CircleAlert, LoaderCircle, Pause, Play, RotateCcw, Upload, X } from "lucide-react";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import Toast from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import {
  createUploadTask,
  confirmTaskCompleted,
  markDuplicateTasks,
  retryTask,
  transitionTask,
  type UploadStatus,
  type UploadTask,
} from "./upload-manager-model";
import {
  djangoMultipartUploadService,
  UploadServiceUnavailableError,
  UploadPausedError,
  type UploadFailure,
  type UploadProgressReport,
  type UploadService,
} from "./upload-service";

import { DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT } from "@/lib/workspace-context";
export { DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT };

export type UploadFileInput = {
  file: File;
  relativePath: string;
  /** Optional per-file destination used when uploading a directory tree. */
  destinationId?: string | null;
  validationError?: string | null;
};

type UploadConflictResolution = NonNullable<UploadTask["conflictResolution"]>;

type UploadManagerValue = {
  tasks: UploadTask[];
  serviceConnected: boolean;
  supportsPauseResume: boolean;
  enqueue: (files: readonly UploadFileInput[], destinationId: string | null) => void;
  openManager: () => void;
};

const UploadManagerContext = createContext<UploadManagerValue | null>(null);

const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
const MAX_CONCURRENT_UPLOADS = 3;
const ACTIVE_STATUSES: UploadStatus[] = [
  "queued", "preparing", "uploading", "paused", "verifying", "scanning",
];

function isActive(task: UploadTask): boolean {
  return ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(task.status);
}

function statusLabel(status: UploadStatus): string {
  return {
    queued: "Queued",
    preparing: "Preparing",
    uploading: "Uploading",
    paused: "Paused",
    verifying: "Verifying",
    scanning: "Scanning",
    completed: "Completed",
    failed: "Failed",
    canceled: "Canceled",
  }[status];
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let value = bytes / 1024;
  let unit = units[0];
  for (let index = 1; value >= 1024 && index < units.length; index += 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    unit = units[index];
  }
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 0 : 1)} ${unit}`;
}

function formatDuration(seconds: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "";
  const rounded = Math.ceil(seconds);
  if (rounded < 60) return `${rounded}s`;
  if (rounded < 3600) return `${Math.ceil(rounded / 60)}m`;
  return `${Math.floor(rounded / 3600)}h ${Math.ceil((rounded % 3600) / 60)}m`;
}

export function useUploadManager(): UploadManagerValue {
  const context = useContext(UploadManagerContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useUploadManager must be used inside UploadManager.");
  return context;
}

export default function UploadManager({
  children,
  service = djangoMultipartUploadService,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  service?: UploadService;
}) {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<UploadTask[]>([]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dismissedTaskIds, setDismissedTaskIds] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set<string>());
  const tasksRef = useRef(tasks);
  const filesRef = useRef(new Map<string, File>());
  const controllersRef = useRef(new Map<string, AbortController>());
  const cancelingRef = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const nextId = useRef(0);

  const commit = useCallback((update: (current: UploadTask[]) => UploadTask[]) => {
    const next = markDuplicateTasks(update(tasksRef.current));
    tasksRef.current = next;
    setTasks(next);
  }, []);

  const updateTask = useCallback((id: string, update: (task: UploadTask) => UploadTask) => {
    commit((current) => current.map((task) => task.id === id ? update(task) : task));
  }, [commit]);

  const enqueue = useCallback((inputs: readonly UploadFileInput[], destinationId: string | null) => {
    const incoming = inputs.map(({ file, relativePath, destinationId: fileDestinationId, validationError }) => {
      const id = `upload-${Date.now()}-${++nextId.current}`;
      if (!validationError) filesRef.current.set(id, file);
      return createUploadTask({
        id,
        fileName: file.name,
        relativePath,
        mimeType: file.type || "Unknown file type",
        size: file.size,
        destinationId: fileDestinationId !== undefined ? fileDestinationId : destinationId,
        validationError,
      });
    });
    setDismissedTaskIds((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      incoming.forEach((task) => next.delete(task.id));
      return next;
    });
    commit((current) => markDuplicateTasks([...current, ...incoming]));
    setVisible(true);
    setOpen(true);
  }, [commit]);

  const applyFailure = useCallback((id: string, failure: UploadFailure) => {
    const current = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
    if (!current || !isActive(current)) return;
    const retryable = failure.retryable && current.retryPolicy.retries < MAX_RETRIES;
    if (!retryable) filesRef.current.delete(id);
    updateTask(id, (task) => transitionTask(task, "failed", {
      error: [failure.message, failure.action].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
      retryPolicy: {
        ...task.retryPolicy,
        maxRetries: MAX_RETRIES,
        retryable,
      },
    }));
  }, [updateTask]);

  const run = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const current = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
    const file = filesRef.current.get(id);
    if (!current || current.status !== "queued" || controllersRef.current.has(id) || !service.connected) return;
    if (current.duplicate && !current.conflictResolution) return;
    if (!file) {
      applyFailure(id, {
        message: "The in-memory file is no longer available.",
        retryable: false,
        action: "Select the file again.",
      });
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    controllersRef.current.set(id, controller);
    let backendConfirmedComplete = false;
    try {
      await service.upload(
        tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id)!,
        file,
        {
          onStatus: (status, uploadSessionId) => {
            const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
            if (!latest || !isActive(latest)) return;
            if (latest.status === status) {
              if (uploadSessionId && uploadSessionId !== latest.uploadSessionId) {
                updateTask(id, (task) => ({ ...task, uploadSessionId }));
              }
              return;
            }
            try {
              updateTask(id, (task) => transitionTask(task, status, {
                uploadSessionId: uploadSessionId ?? task.uploadSessionId,
              }));
            } catch {
              applyFailure(id, {
                message: `Upload service reported an unexpected state (${status}).`,
                retryable: false,
                action: "Contact support before retrying.",
              });
            }
          },
          onProgress: (progress: UploadProgressReport) => {
            const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
            if (!latest || latest.status !== "uploading") return;
            const totalBytes = Number.isFinite(progress.totalBytes) && progress.totalBytes >= 0
              ? progress.totalBytes
              : latest.size;
            const uploadedBytes = Number.isFinite(progress.uploadedBytes)
              ? Math.max(0, Math.min(progress.uploadedBytes, totalBytes))
              : 0;
            updateTask(id, (task) => ({
              ...task,
              progress: {
                uploadedBytes,
                totalBytes,
                ...(Number.isFinite(progress.bytesPerSecond) && (progress.bytesPerSecond ?? 0) > 0
                  ? { bytesPerSecond: progress.bytesPerSecond }
                  : {}),
                ...(Number.isFinite(progress.etaSeconds) && (progress.etaSeconds ?? -1) >= 0
                  ? { etaSeconds: progress.etaSeconds }
                  : {}),
              },
            }));
          },
          onCompleted: () => {
            const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
            if (!latest || !isActive(latest) || latest.status === "queued" || latest.status === "preparing") return;
            updateTask(id, (task) => confirmTaskCompleted(task, true));
            backendConfirmedComplete = true;
            filesRef.current.delete(id);
            if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, {
                detail: { destinationId: latest.destinationId },
              }));
            }
          },
        },
        controller.signal,
      );
      const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
      if (latest?.status === "canceled") return;
      if (!backendConfirmedComplete) {
        applyFailure(id, {
          message: "Upload service ended without confirming object completion and required checks.",
          retryable: false,
          action: "Do not treat this file as available. Check service logs or contact support.",
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (error instanceof UploadPausedError) {
        const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
        if (latest?.status === "uploading") {
          updateTask(id, (task) => transitionTask(task, "paused"));
        }
        return;
      }
      if (error instanceof UploadServiceUnavailableError) {
        applyFailure(id, { message: error.message, retryable: false, action: error.action });
      } else {
        const reported = error as Partial<UploadFailure>;
        applyFailure(id, {
          message: typeof reported.message === "string" ? reported.message : "Upload failed unexpectedly.",
          retryable: reported.retryable === true,
          action: typeof reported.action === "string" ? reported.action : "Review the error before retrying.",
        });
      }
    } finally {
      controllersRef.current.delete(id);
    }
  }, [applyFailure, service, updateTask]);

  const start = useCallback((id: string) => {
    void run(id);
  }, [run]);

  const retry = useCallback((id: string) => {
    try {
      updateTask(id, (task) => retryTask(task, MAX_RETRIES));
      start(id);
    } catch (error) {
      setNotification(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "This upload cannot be retried.");
    }
  }, [start, updateTask]);

  const cancel = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const current = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
    // Once Complete has been submitted, a cancel click cannot reliably
    // undo storage completion or DB publication. Do not claim it was canceled.
    if (!current || !["queued", "preparing", "uploading", "paused"].includes(current.status)) return;
    if (cancelingRef.current.has(id)) return;
    if ((current.status === "paused" || current.status === "queued") &&
        current.uploadSessionId && !controllersRef.current.has(id)) {
      const file = filesRef.current.get(id);
      if (!file || !service.cancelPaused) {
        setNotification("Cannot cancel the paused upload safely without its file and server abort support.");
        return;
      }
      cancelingRef.current.add(id);
      try {
        await service.cancelPaused(current, file);
      } catch (error) {
        setNotification(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not abort the server upload session.");
        return;
      } finally {
        cancelingRef.current.delete(id);
      }
    }
    const latest = tasksRef.current.find((task) => task.id === id);
    if (!latest || !["queued", "preparing", "uploading", "paused"].includes(latest.status)) return;
    controllersRef.current.get(id)?.abort();
    updateTask(id, (task) => transitionTask(task, "canceled"));
    filesRef.current.delete(id);
    controllersRef.current.delete(id);
  }, [service, updateTask]);

  const closeManager = useCallback(() => {
    setDismissedTaskIds(new Set(tasksRef.current.map((task) => task.id)));
    setVisible(false);
  }, []);

  const setConflictResolution = useCallback((id: string, value: UploadConflictResolution) => {
    updateTask(id, (task) => ({ ...task, conflictResolution: value }));
  }, [updateTask]);

  const pause = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const task = tasksRef.current.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!task || !service.supportsPauseResume || !service.pause || task.status !== "uploading" || !task.uploadSessionId) return;
    try {
      await service.pause(task);
      const latest = tasksRef.current.find((item) => item.id === id);
      if (latest?.status === "uploading") updateTask(id, (item) => transitionTask(item, "paused"));
    } catch (error) {
      setNotification(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The upload could not be paused.");
    }
  }, [service, updateTask]);

  const resume = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const task = tasksRef.current.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!task || cancelingRef.current.has(id) || !service.supportsPauseResume || !service.resume || task.status !== "paused" || !task.uploadSessionId) return;
    try {
      await service.resume(task);
      const latest = tasksRef.current.find((item) => item.id === id);
      if (latest?.status === "paused") {
        // A resumed run must rehash/verify its file and reconcile remote parts.
        // It is a new transport invocation using the same server UploadSession.
        updateTask(id, (item) => transitionTask(item, "queued"));
        // Normal scheduler enforces MAX_CONCURRENT_UPLOADS before restart.
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setNotification(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The upload could not be resumed.");
    }
  }, [service, updateTask]);

  // Start selected files automatically, but bound concurrent files to avoid
  // launching hundreds of transfers when a folder contains many files.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!service.connected) return;

    const activeIds = new Set(
      tasks
        .filter((task) => ["preparing", "uploading", "verifying", "scanning"].includes(task.status))
        .map((task) => task.id),
    );
    for (const id of controllersRef.current.keys()) activeIds.add(id);

    const freeSlots = MAX_CONCURRENT_UPLOADS - activeIds.size;
    if (freeSlots <= 0) return;

    const startable = tasks.filter((task) =>
      task.status === "queued"
      && (!task.duplicate || Boolean(task.conflictResolution))
      && !controllersRef.current.has(task.id),
    );
    for (const task of startable.slice(0, freeSlots)) {
      start(task.id);
    }
  }, [service.connected, start, tasks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function warnBeforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent) {
      if (!tasksRef.current.some(isActive)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.returnValue = "";
    }
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warnBeforeUnload);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warnBeforeUnload);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    controllersRef.current.forEach((controller) => controller.abort());
    controllersRef.current.clear();
    filesRef.current.clear();
  }, []);

  const contextValue = useMemo<UploadManagerValue>(() => ({
    tasks,
    serviceConnected: service.connected,
    supportsPauseResume: service.supportsPauseResume,
    enqueue,
    openManager: () => {
      setVisible(true);
      setOpen(true);
    },
  }), [enqueue, service.connected, service.supportsPauseResume, tasks]);


  const visibleTasks = tasks.filter((task) => !dismissedTaskIds.has(task.id));
  const queuedCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "queued").length;
  const activeCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) =>
    ["preparing", "uploading", "paused", "verifying", "scanning"].includes(task.status),
  ).length;
  const completedCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "completed").length;
  const failedCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "failed").length;

  const visibleCount = queuedCount + activeCount;
  const cancellableCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) =>
    ["queued", "preparing", "uploading", "paused"].includes(task.status),
  ).length;
  const etaSeconds = visibleTasks
    .filter((task) => task.status === "uploading" && Number.isFinite(task.progress?.etaSeconds))
    .map((task) => task.progress?.etaSeconds ?? 0)
    .filter((seconds) => seconds > 0);
  const etaLabel = etaSeconds.length
    ? `About ${formatDuration(Math.max(...etaSeconds))} remaining…`
    : activeCount > 0
      ? (visibleTasks.some((task) => task.status === "verifying" || task.status === "scanning")
        ? "Verifying upload…"
        : visibleTasks.some((task) => task.status === "preparing")
          ? "Starting upload…"
          : "Uploading…")
      : failedCount > 0
        ? `${failedCount} failed`
        : `${completedCount} completed`;
  const trayTitle = visibleCount > 0
    ? `Uploading ${visibleCount} item${visibleCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
    : completedCount > 0
      ? `Uploaded ${completedCount} item${completedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      : "Uploads";

  return (
    <UploadManagerContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
      {visibleTasks.length > 0 && (
        visible ? (
          <section
            aria-label="Upload status"
            className="fixed bottom-0 right-0 z-80 flex max-h-[min(65vh,30rem)] w-[min(25rem,calc(100vw-1.5rem))] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background font-sans shadow-(--shadow-popover)"
          >
            <div className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-2 border-b border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground">{trayTitle}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
                aria-label={open ? "Collapse upload status" : "Expand upload status"}
                title={open ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-background"
              >
                {open ? <ChevronDown size={22} /> : <ChevronUp size={22} />}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeManager}
                aria-label="Close and clear upload status"
                title="Hide"
                className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-background"
              >
                <X size={21} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {open && (
              <>
            {activeCount > 0 && (
              <div className="flex min-h-8 items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5">
                <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[12px] text-muted" role="status">
                  {visibleTasks.some((task) => task.status === "verifying" || task.status === "scanning")
                    ? "Processing upload…"
                    : etaLabel}
                </p>
                {cancellableCount > 0 && (
                  <span
                    className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted"
                    role="status"
                    aria-label="Upload in progress"
                    title="Upload in progress"
                  >
                    <LoaderCircle size={19} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            {notification && (
              <div className="px-3 pt-3">
                <Toast title="Upload notice" variant="warning" onDismiss={() => setNotification(null)}>
                  {notification}
                </Toast>
              </div>
            )}

            {!service.connected && (
              <p className="border-b border-border px-4 py-2 text-xs text-warning" role="status">
                Upload service is not connected.
              </p>
            )}

            <ul aria-label="Upload items" className="min-h-0 space-y-0 overflow-y-auto">
              {visibleTasks.map((task) => (
                <UploadTaskRow
                  key={task.id}
                  task={task}
                  connected={service.connected}
                  canPause={service.supportsPauseResume && Boolean(task.uploadSessionId)}
                  onCancel={() => { void cancel(task.id); }}
                  onRetry={() => retry(task.id)}
                  onPause={() => { void pause(task.id); }}
                  onResume={() => { void resume(task.id); }}
                  onConflictResolution={(value) => setConflictResolution(task.id, value)}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>

              </>
            )}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setVisible(true); setOpen(true); }}
            aria-label={`Show upload status: ${queuedCount} queued, ${activeCount} in progress, ${completedCount} completed, ${failedCount} failed`}
            className="fixed bottom-0 right-0 z-80 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground shadow-(--shadow-popover) transition-colors hover:bg-surface"
          >
            {visibleCount > 0 ? <Upload size={17} aria-hidden="true" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={17} className="text-success" aria-hidden="true" />}
            {visibleCount > 0
              ? `Uploading ${visibleCount}`
              : completedCount > 0
                ? `Uploaded ${completedCount}`
                : `Uploads (${tasks.length})`}
            {activeCount > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-brand-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-brand-contrast">{activeCount}</span>}
          </button>
        )
      )}
    </UploadManagerContext.Provider>
  );
}

function UploadTaskRow({
  task,
  connected,
  canPause,
  onCancel,
  onRetry,
  onPause,
  onResume,
  onConflictResolution,
}: {
  task: UploadTask;
  connected: boolean;
  canPause: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onPause: () => void;
  onResume: () => void;
  onConflictResolution: (value: UploadConflictResolution) => void;
}) {
  const terminal = task.status === "completed" || task.status === "failed" || task.status === "canceled";
  const canCancel = ["queued", "preparing", "uploading", "paused"].includes(task.status);
  const showProgress = Boolean(task.progress)
    && ["uploading", "verifying", "scanning"].includes(task.status);
  const transferred = task.progress?.uploadedBytes ?? 0;
  const total = task.progress?.totalBytes ?? task.size;
  const progressPercent = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((transferred / total) * 100)) : 0;

  return (
    <li className="border-b border-border px-3 py-2 last:border-b-0">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
        <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-surface text-muted">
          <Upload size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground" title={task.fileName}>{task.fileName}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted" title={task.relativePath}>
            {task.relativePath === task.fileName ? formatBytes(task.size) : `${task.relativePath} · ${formatBytes(task.size)}`}
          </p>
        </div>

        {task.status === "completed" ? (
          <CheckCircle2 size={21} aria-label="Upload completed" className="shrink-0 text-success" />
        ) : task.status === "failed" ? (
          <CircleAlert size={21} aria-label="Upload failed" className="shrink-0 text-danger" />
        ) : task.status === "canceled" ? (
          <X size={19} aria-label="Upload canceled" className="shrink-0 text-muted" />
        ) : canCancel ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCancel}
            aria-label={`Stop upload of ${task.fileName}`}
            title="Stop upload"
            className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        ) : !terminal ? (
          <LoaderCircle
            size={22}
            aria-label={`Upload ${statusLabel(task.status).toLowerCase()}`}
            className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-muted"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {!terminal && task.status !== "verifying" && task.status !== "scanning" && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted">
          {task.status === "uploading" && task.progress
            ? `${progressPercent}% uploaded${task.progress.bytesPerSecond
              ? ` · ${formatBytes(task.progress.bytesPerSecond)}/s${task.progress.etaSeconds !== undefined
                ? ` · ${formatDuration(task.progress.etaSeconds)} remaining` : ""}`
              : ""}`
            : statusLabel(task.status)}
        </p>
      )}

      {showProgress && task.status === "uploading" && (
        <div className="mt-2">
          <progress
            aria-label={`Upload progress for ${task.fileName}`}
            max={Math.max(total, 1)}
            value={Math.min(transferred, total)}
            className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full accent-success"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {task.status === "failed" && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <p role="alert" className="min-w-0 text-xs text-danger">
            {task.error}
            {task.retryPolicy.retryable && <span> Retry {task.retryPolicy.retries}/{task.retryPolicy.maxRetries}.</span>}
          </p>
          {task.retryPolicy.retryable && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={onRetry}
              disabled={!connected || task.retryPolicy.retries >= task.retryPolicy.maxRetries}
              aria-label={`Retry ${task.fileName}`}
            >
              <RotateCcw size={13} /> Retry
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {task.duplicate && !terminal && (
        <fieldset className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 p-2 text-xs text-warning">
          <legend className="px-1 font-medium">Duplicate path</legend>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
            {([
              ["skip", "Skip"],
              ["keep-both", "Keep both"],
              ["replace", "Replace"],
            ] as const).map(([value, label]) => (
              <label key={value} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name={`conflict-${task.id}`}
                  checked={task.conflictResolution === value}
                  onChange={() => onConflictResolution(value)}
                />
                {label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {canPause && task.status === "uploading" && (
        <button type="button" onClick={onPause} className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted underline" aria-label={`Pause ${task.fileName}`}>
          <Pause size={12} className="mr-1 inline" />Pause
        </button>
      )}
      {canPause && task.status === "paused" && (
        <button type="button" onClick={onResume} className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted underline" aria-label={`Resume ${task.fileName}`}>
          <Play size={12} className="mr-1 inline" />Resume
        </button>
      )}
      {task.status === "queued" && !task.duplicate && !connected && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-warning">Upload service is not connected.</p>
      )}
      {task.status === "queued" && task.duplicate && !task.conflictResolution && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-warning">Choose how to handle this duplicate to continue.</p>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export type UploadStatus =
  | "queued"
  | "preparing"
  | "uploading"
  | "paused"
  | "verifying"
  | "scanning"
  | "completed"
  | "failed"
  | "canceled";

export type RetryPolicy = {
  retries: number;
  maxRetries: number;
  retryable: boolean;
};

export type UploadProgress = {
  uploadedBytes: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  bytesPerSecond?: number;
  etaSeconds?: number;
};

export type UploadTask = {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  relativePath: string;
  mimeType: string;
  size: number;
  destinationId: string | null;
  status: UploadStatus;
  retryPolicy: RetryPolicy;
  error: string | null;
  progress: UploadProgress | null;
  uploadSessionId: string | null;
  duplicate: boolean;
  conflictResolution: "reject" | "skip" | "keep-both" | "replace" | null;
};

const transitions: Record<UploadStatus, readonly UploadStatus[]> = {
  queued: ["preparing", "canceled", "failed"],
  preparing: ["uploading", "failed", "canceled"],
  uploading: ["paused", "verifying", "scanning", "completed", "failed", "canceled"],
  paused: ["queued", "uploading", "failed", "canceled"],
  verifying: ["scanning", "completed", "failed", "canceled"],
  scanning: ["completed", "failed", "canceled"],
  completed: [],
  failed: ["queued", "canceled"],
  canceled: [],
};

export function canTransition(from: UploadStatus, to: UploadStatus): boolean {
  return transitions[from].includes(to);
}

export function transitionTask(
  task: UploadTask,
  nextStatus: UploadStatus,
  patch: Partial<Pick<UploadTask, "error" | "progress" | "uploadSessionId" | "retryPolicy">> = {},
): UploadTask {
  if (nextStatus === "completed") {
    throw new Error("Use confirmTaskCompleted only after the upload service confirms completion and required checks.");
  }
  return applyTransition(task, nextStatus, patch);
}

function applyTransition(
  task: UploadTask,
  nextStatus: UploadStatus,
  patch: Partial<Pick<UploadTask, "error" | "progress" | "uploadSessionId" | "retryPolicy">>,
): UploadTask {
  if (!canTransition(task.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid upload transition: ${task.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }
  return {
    ...task,
    ...patch,
    status: nextStatus,
    error: nextStatus === "failed" ? (patch.error ?? task.error) : null,
  };
}

export function confirmTaskCompleted(task: UploadTask, backendConfirmed: boolean): UploadTask {
  if (!backendConfirmed) {
    throw new Error("Upload completion requires backend confirmation and all required checks.");
  }
  return applyTransition(task, "completed", {});
}

export function retryTask(task: UploadTask, maxRetries = task.retryPolicy.maxRetries): UploadTask {
  if (task.status !== "failed") {
    throw new Error(`Only failed uploads can be retried (current status: ${task.status}).`);
  }
  if (!task.retryPolicy.retryable) {
    throw new Error(task.error ?? "This upload cannot be retried. Check the error guidance.");
  }
  if (task.retryPolicy.retries >= maxRetries) {
    throw new Error(`Retry limit reached (${maxRetries}). Choose a corrective action before trying again.`);
  }
  return transitionTask(task, "queued", {
    error: null,
    progress: null,
    retryPolicy: { ...task.retryPolicy, retries: task.retryPolicy.retries + 1 },
  });
}

export function createUploadTask(input: {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  relativePath: string;
  mimeType: string;
  size: number;
  destinationId: string | null;
  validationError?: string | null;
}): UploadTask {
  const { validationError, ...taskInput } = input;
  const task: UploadTask = {
    ...taskInput,
    status: "queued",
    retryPolicy: { retries: 0, maxRetries: 3, retryable: true },
    error: null,
    progress: null,
    uploadSessionId: null,
    duplicate: false,
    conflictResolution: null,
  };
  return validationError
    ? transitionTask(task, "failed", {
        error: validationError,
        retryPolicy: { retries: 0, maxRetries: 3, retryable: false },
      })
    : task;
}

export function markDuplicateTasks(tasks: UploadTask[]): UploadTask[] {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (task.status === "canceled" || (task.status === "failed" && !task.retryPolicy.retryable)) continue;
    const key = `${task.destinationId ?? "root"}:${task.relativePath.toLocaleLowerCase()}`;
    counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return tasks.map((task) => ({
    ...task,
    duplicate: task.status !== "canceled"
      && !(task.status === "failed" && !task.retryPolicy.retryable)
      && (counts.get(`${task.destinationId ?? "root"}:${task.relativePath.toLocaleLowerCase()}`) ?? 0) > 1,
    conflictResolution: task.status !== "canceled"
      && !(task.status === "failed" && !task.retryPolicy.retryable)
      && (counts.get(`${task.destinationId ?? "root"}:${task.relativePath.toLocaleLowerCase()}`) ?? 0) > 1
      ? task.conflictResolution
      : null,
  }));
}

/**
 * Request expiring S3 multipart presigned URLs only when a transfer reaches a
 * bounded group of parts. A shared in-flight promise prevents several file
 * workers from issuing duplicate authorization requests for the same group.
 * URLs must never be persisted in localStorage or logging/diagnostics.
 */
export class OnDemandPartAuthorizer<T extends { part_number: number }> {
  private readonly indices = new Map<number, number>();
  private readonly batches = new Map<number, Promise<ReadonlyMap<number, T>>>();
  private readonly overrides = new Map<number, T>();
  private readonly pending: readonly number[];
  private readonly batchSize: number;
  private readonly authorizeBatch: (partNumbers: number[]) => Promise<readonly T[]>;

  constructor(
    pending: readonly number[],
    batchSize: number,
    authorizeBatch: (partNumbers: number[]) => Promise<readonly T[]>,
  ) {
    this.pending = pending;
    this.batchSize = batchSize;
    this.authorizeBatch = authorizeBatch;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(batchSize) || batchSize < 1 || batchSize > 1000) {
      throw new RangeError("Invalid multipart authorization batch size.");
    }
    pending.forEach((part, index) => {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(part) || part < 1 || this.indices.has(part)) {
        throw new RangeError("Multipart part numbers must be unique positive integers.");
      }
      this.indices.set(part, index);
    });
  }

  async get(partNumber: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
    if (signal?.aborted) throw new DOMException("Upload interrupted.", "AbortError");
    const replacement = this.overrides.get(partNumber);
    if (replacement) return replacement;
    const index = this.indices.get(partNumber);
    if (index === undefined) throw new RangeError("Part is not pending in this upload.");
    const group = Math.floor(index / this.batchSize);
    let batch = this.batches.get(group);
    if (!batch) {
      const numbers = this.pending.slice(group * this.batchSize, (group + 1) * this.batchSize);
      batch = this.authorizeBatch([...numbers]).then((authorized) => {
        const result = new Map<number, T>();
        const expected = new Set(numbers);
        for (const part of authorized) {
          if (!expected.has(part.part_number) || result.has(part.part_number)) {
            throw new Error("Storage returned an unexpected or duplicated part authorization.");
          }
          result.set(part.part_number, part);
        }
        if (result.size !== numbers.length) throw new Error("Storage did not authorize all requested parts.");
        return result;
      }).catch((error: unknown) => {
        // A network failure should not permanently poison the group cache.
        this.batches.delete(group);
        throw error;
      });
      this.batches.set(group, batch);
    }
    const permission = (await batch).get(partNumber);
    if (signal?.aborted) throw new DOMException("Upload interrupted.", "AbortError");
    if (!permission) throw new Error("Part authorization is missing.");
    return this.overrides.get(partNumber) ?? permission;
  }

  /** A storage 403 may indicate an expired URL; refresh only that part. */
  replace(permission: T): void {
    if (!this.indices.has(permission.part_number)) throw new RangeError("Cannot replace a part outside this upload.");
    this.overrides.set(permission.part_number, permission);
  }
}

/** Constant-time accounting of transport bytes for concurrent multipart PUTs. */
export class UploadPartProgress {
  private readonly loaded = new Map<number, number>();
  private transferred = 0;
  private readonly fileSize: number;
  private readonly partSize: number;

  constructor(fileSize: number, partSize: number) {
    this.fileSize = fileSize;
    this.partSize = partSize;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(fileSize) || fileSize < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(partSize) || partSize <= 0) {
      throw new RangeError("Invalid multipart file or part size.");
    }
  }

  get uploadedBytes(): number { return this.transferred; }

  update(partNumber: number, loaded: number): number {
    const start = (partNumber - 1) * this.partSize;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(partNumber) || partNumber < 1 || start >= this.fileSize) {
      throw new RangeError("Invalid part number for this file.");
    }
    const max = Math.min(this.partSize, this.fileSize - start);
    const safe = Number.isFinite(loaded) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(loaded, max)) : 0;
    const previous = this.loaded.get(partNumber) ?? 0;
    this.transferred += safe - previous;
    this.loaded.set(partNumber, safe);
    return this.transferred;
  }
}

/**
 * Sample high-frequency XHR progress at a bounded cadence instead of causing
 * one React state update per transport event. Throughput uses NET progress,
 * not the already-received parts restored during Resume.
 */
export type UploadTelemetrySnapshot = {
  uploadedBytes: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  bytesPerSecond?: number;
  etaSeconds?: number;
};

type Sample = { at: number; bytes: number };

export class UploadProgressTelemetry {
  private readonly samples: Sample[];
  private lastSeenBytes: number;
  private lastEmittedAt = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  private lastAt: number;
  private readonly totalBytes: number;
  private readonly clock: () => number;
  private readonly minUpdateMs: number;
  private readonly windowMs: number;

  constructor(
    totalBytes: number,
    initialBytes = 0,
    clock: () => number = () => performance.now(),
    minUpdateMs = 150,
    windowMs = 5000,
  ) {
    this.totalBytes = totalBytes;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.minUpdateMs = minUpdateMs;
    this.windowMs = windowMs;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(totalBytes) || totalBytes < 0 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(initialBytes) || initialBytes < 0 || initialBytes > totalBytes ||
        !Number.isFinite(minUpdateMs) || minUpdateMs < 0 ||
        !Number.isFinite(windowMs) || windowMs <= minUpdateMs) {
      throw new RangeError("Invalid upload telemetry configuration.");
    }
    this.lastSeenBytes = initialBytes;
    this.lastAt = this.clock();
    this.samples = [{ at: this.lastAt, bytes: initialBytes }];
  }

  report(bytes: number, force = false): UploadTelemetrySnapshot | null {
    const now = Math.max(this.lastAt, this.clock());
    this.lastAt = now;
    const safe = Number.isFinite(bytes) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(bytes, this.totalBytes)) : this.lastSeenBytes;
    const rolledBack = safe < this.lastSeenBytes;
    this.lastSeenBytes = safe;
    if (rolledBack) {
      // A retry can reset one part's progress to zero. Old samples would
      // otherwise produce negative speeds or misleading ETAs.
      this.samples.length = 0;
      this.samples.push({ at: now, bytes: safe });
    }
    if (!force && !rolledBack && now - this.lastEmittedAt < this.minUpdateMs) return null;
    this.lastEmittedAt = now;
    if (!rolledBack) this.samples.push({ at: now, bytes: safe });
    while (this.samples.length > 1 && this.samples[1].at <= now - this.windowMs) this.samples.shift();

    const first = this.samples[0];
    const elapsed = (now - first.at) / 1000;
    const delta = safe - first.bytes;
    const snapshot: UploadTelemetrySnapshot = { uploadedBytes: safe, totalBytes: this.totalBytes };
    if (elapsed >= 0.25 && delta > 0) {
      const speed = delta / elapsed;
      if (Number.isFinite(speed) && speed > 0) {
        snapshot.bytesPerSecond = speed;
        snapshot.etaSeconds = Math.max(0, (this.totalBytes - safe) / speed);
      }
    }
    return snapshot;
  }
}

/**
 * A part receipt contains only a server-returned ETag, never a presigned URL.
 * Persisting receipts allows a browser retry to keep already uploaded parts.
 * The backend rechecks the complete manifest against MinIO before publishing.
 */
export function restorePartReceipts(
  serialized: string | null,
  sessionId: string,
  partCount: number,
): Map<number, string> {
  const result = new Map<number, string>();
  if (!serialized || !Number.isSafeInteger(partCount) || partCount < 0) return result;
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(serialized);
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return result;
    const record = value as { sessionId?: unknown; parts?: unknown };
    if (record.sessionId !== sessionId || !Array.isArray(record.parts) || record.parts.length > partCount) return result;
    for (const part of record.parts) {
      if (!Array.isArray(part) || part.length !== 2) return new Map();
      const [number, etag] = part;
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number) || number < 1 || number > partCount ||
          typeof etag !== "string" || !etag || etag.length > 256 || /[\r\n]/.test(etag) || result.has(number)) {
        return new Map();
      }
      result.set(number, etag);
    }
  } catch {
    return new Map();
  }
  return result;
}

export function serializePartReceipts(sessionId: string, completed: ReadonlyMap<number, string>): string {
  return JSON.stringify({ sessionId, parts: [...completed].sort(([a], [b]) => a - b) });
}

export type ProviderPart = { part_number: number; etag: string; size_bytes: number };

/** Keep only client-uploaded receipts that still match the provider. */
export function reconcilePartReceipts(
  receipts: ReadonlyMap<number, string>,
  providerParts: readonly ProviderPart[],
  fileSize: number,
  partSize: number,
): Map<number, string> {
  const provider = new Map(providerParts.map((part) => [part.part_number, part]));
  return new Map([...receipts].filter(([number, etag]) => {
    const part = provider.get(number);
    const expectedSize = Math.min(partSize, fileSize - (number - 1) * partSize);
    return part?.etag === etag && part.size_bytes === expectedSize && expectedSize > 0;
  }));
}

type UploadSessionResponse = { upload_id: string; state: string; part_size: number };
type PartAuthorization = { url: string; method: "PUT"; headers: Record<string, string>; expires_in: number };
type AuthorizedPart = PartAuthorization & { part_number: number };

function uploadPart(url: string, headers: Record<string, string>, blob: Blob, signal: AbortSignal,
  report: (loaded: number) => void): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      reject(new DOMException("Upload canceled", "AbortError"));
      return;
    }
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("PUT", url);
    xhr.timeout = 120_000;
    Object.entries(headers).forEach(([name, value]) => xhr.setRequestHeader(name, value));
    xhr.upload.onprogress = (event) => { if (event.lengthComputable) report(event.loaded); };
    xhr.onload = () => {
      const etag = xhr.getResponseHeader("ETag");
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300 && etag) resolve(etag);
      else reject(Object.assign(new Error(`Storage part upload failed (${xhr.status}).`), {
        status: xhr.status,
        retryable: [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(xhr.status) || xhr.status === 403,
      }));
    };
    xhr.onerror = () => reject(Object.assign(new Error("Network interrupted during part upload."), { retryable: true }));
    xhr.ontimeout = () => reject(Object.assign(new Error("Upload part timed out."), { retryable: true }));
    xhr.onabort = () => reject(new DOMException("Upload canceled", "AbortError"));
    const onAbort = () => xhr.abort();
    signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    xhr.onloadend = () => signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
    if (signal.aborted) {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      reject(new DOMException("Upload canceled", "AbortError"));
      return;
    }
    xhr.send(blob);
  });
}

async function authorize(uploadId: string, part: number): Promise<PartAuthorization> {
  // Single-part fallback is used only when a previously issued batch URL expires.
  return requestUploadApi<PartAuthorization>(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/parts/${part}/authorization/`, {
    method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
  });
}

async function authorizeBatch(uploadId: string, partNumbers: number[]): Promise<AuthorizedPart[]> {
  if (partNumbers.length === 0) return [];
  const response = await requestUploadApi<{ parts: AuthorizedPart[] }>(
    `/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/parts/authorizations/`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { ...(await accountCsrfHeaders()), "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ part_numbers: partNumbers }),
    },
  );
  const authorized = new Map(response.parts.map((part) => [part.part_number, part]));
  if (partNumbers.some((partNumber) => !authorized.has(partNumber))) {
    throw new Error("Storage authorization did not include every requested upload part.");
  }
  return partNumbers.map((partNumber) => authorized.get(partNumber)!);
}

async function fetchReconciledPartReceipts(
  uploadId: string,
  fileSize: number,
  receipts: ReadonlyMap<number, string>,
): Promise<Map<number, string>> {
  if (!receipts.size) return new Map();
  const response = await requestUploadApi<{ parts: ProviderPart[] }>(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/parts/`);
  return reconcilePartReceipts(receipts, response.parts, fileSize, PART_SIZE);
}

async function requestUploadApi<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await requestAccountApi<T>(path, init);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AccountServiceError && [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(error.status ?? 0)) {
      throw Object.assign(error, { retryable: true, action: "Retry this upload; completed parts can be sent again safely." });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

export const djangoMultipartUploadService: UploadService = {
  connected: true,
  supportsPauseResume: true,
  async upload(task, file, observer, signal) {
    if (activeTransfers.has(task.id)) throw new Error("Upload task already has an active transfer.");
    const control = new UploadTransferControl(signal);
    activeTransfers.set(task.id, control);
    try {
    observer.onStatus("preparing", task.uploadSessionId ?? undefined);
    // A file with the same name/size can be uploaded to different folders.
    const resumeKey = resumeStorageKey(task, file);
    // Abort during hashing must not allocate a new UploadSession. If this is a
    // resumed task, release its existing reservation on *cancel* (not pause).
    const cancelBeforeUpload = async () => {
      const existingSession = task.uploadSessionId ?? readSessionValue(resumeKey);
      if (existingSession) {
        try {
          await requestUploadApi(`/files/api/uploads/${existingSession}/abort/`, {
            method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
          });
        } catch { /* Expiry/reconciliation will clean up on network failure. */ }
      }
      forgetResumeState(resumeKey);
    };
    let fileSha256: string;
    try {
      fileSha256 = await sha256File(file, { signal: control.signal });
    } catch (error) {
      control.throwIfPaused();
      if (signal.aborted) {
        await cancelBeforeUpload();
        return;
      }
      throw error;
    }
    control.throwIfPaused();
    if (signal.aborted) {
      await cancelBeforeUpload();
      return;
    }
    let uploadId = task.uploadSessionId ?? readSessionValue(resumeKey);
    let alreadyCompleting = false;
    if (uploadId) {
      try {
        const state = await requestUploadApi<{ state: string; expected_sha256: string }>(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/`);
        if (state.expected_sha256 !== fileSha256) {
          try { await requestUploadApi(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/abort/`, { method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders() }); } catch { /* Expiry cleanup remains available. */ }
          uploadId = null;
        }
        if (!uploadId) throw new AccountServiceError("Stored upload session belongs to a different file.", 404);
        if (state.state === "available" || state.state === "completed") {
          observer.onStatus("uploading", uploadId);
          observer.onStatus("verifying", uploadId);
          observer.onCompleted();
          removeSessionValue(resumeKey);
          removeSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`);
          removeSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:parts`);
          return;
        }
        alreadyCompleting = state.state === "verifying" || state.state === "scanning";
        if (state.state !== "uploading" && !alreadyCompleting) uploadId = null;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof AccountServiceError && error.status === 404) uploadId = null;
        else throw error;
      }
      if (!uploadId) {
        removeSessionValue(resumeKey);
        removeSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`);
      }
    }
    if (!uploadId) {
      let idempotency = readSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`);
      if (!idempotency) {
        idempotency = crypto.randomUUID();
        saveSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`, idempotency);
      }
      const created = await requestUploadApi<UploadSessionResponse>("/files/api/uploads/", {
        method: "POST", headers: { ...(await accountCsrfHeaders()), "Idempotency-Key": idempotency },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: file.name, size_bytes: file.size, sha256: fileSha256, folder_id: task.destinationId }),
      });
      uploadId = created.upload_id;
    }
    saveSessionValue(resumeKey, uploadId);
    const count = Math.ceil(file.size / PART_SIZE);
    const receiptsKey = `${resumeKey}:parts`;
    // Receipts originate from successful XHR responses. Never store presigned URLs.
    // The server independently validates the manifest against MinIO ListParts.
    const savedReceipts = alreadyCompleting ? new Map<number, string>()
      : restorePartReceipts(readSessionValue(receiptsKey), uploadId, count);
    // A previously uploaded part can disappear or be overwritten by another tab.
    // Reuse only receipts still confirmed by the storage provider.
    const completed = alreadyCompleting ? savedReceipts
      : await fetchReconciledPartReceipts(uploadId, file.size, savedReceipts);
    if (savedReceipts.size > 0) {
      saveSessionValue(receiptsKey, serializePartReceipts(uploadId, completed));
    }
    const progress = new UploadPartProgress(file.size, PART_SIZE);
    completed.forEach((_etag, number) => progress.update(number, PART_SIZE));
    const telemetry = new UploadProgressTelemetry(file.size, progress.uploadedBytes);
    const updatePartProgress = (number: number, loaded: number, force = false) => {
      const uploadedBytes = progress.update(number, loaded);
      const report = telemetry.report(uploadedBytes, force);
      if (report) observer.onProgress(report);
    };
    observer.onStatus("uploading", uploadId);
    if (alreadyCompleting) observer.onStatus("verifying", uploadId);
    else if (completed.size > 0) {
      const report = telemetry.report(progress.uploadedBytes, true);
      if (report) observer.onProgress(report);
    }
    const pending = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index + 1)
      .filter((number) => !completed.has(number));
    // Workers request each small batch just before use rather than minting all
    // short-lived URLs at once (especially useful on slow or paused uploads).
    const partAuthorizations = new OnDemandPartAuthorizer<AuthorizedPart>(
      pending, AUTHORIZATION_BATCH_SIZE,
      (numbers) => authorizeBatch(uploadId!, numbers),
    );
    let next = 0;
    let fatal: unknown;
    const worker = async () => {
      while (!control.signal.aborted && !fatal) {
        const partNumber = pending[next++];
        if (partNumber === undefined) return;
        const start = (partNumber - 1) * PART_SIZE;
        const part = file.slice(start, Math.min(file.size, start + PART_SIZE));
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= PART_RETRIES; attempt++) {
          try {
            const permission = await partAuthorizations.get(partNumber, control.signal);
            const etag = await uploadPart(permission.url, permission.headers, part, control.signal, (loaded) => {
              updatePartProgress(partNumber, loaded);
            });
            completed.set(partNumber, etag);
            saveSessionValue(receiptsKey, serializePartReceipts(uploadId!, completed));
            updatePartProgress(partNumber, part.size, true);
            break;
          } catch (error) {
            if (control.signal.aborted) throw error;
            if (attempt === PART_RETRIES || (error as { retryable?: boolean }).retryable !== true) { fatal = error; return; }
            updatePartProgress(partNumber, 0, true);
            if ((error as { status?: number }).status === 403) {
              const refreshed = await authorize(uploadId!, partNumber);
              partAuthorizations.replace({ part_number: partNumber, ...refreshed });
            }
            await sleep(Math.min(2000, 200 * (2 ** attempt) + Math.random() * 150));
          }
        }
      }
    };
    if (!alreadyCompleting) {
      // Wait for every interrupted PUT to settle before exposing Resume.
      const outcomes = await Promise.allSettled(
        Array.from({ length: Math.min(PART_CONCURRENCY, pending.length) }, worker),
      );
      control.throwIfPaused();
      if (!signal.aborted) {
        const rejected = outcomes.find((outcome) => outcome.status === "rejected");
        if (rejected?.status === "rejected") throw rejected.reason;
      }
    }
    // Pause preserves the server-side UploadSession and its uploaded parts.
    // Do not call the Django abort endpoint or discard the saved receipts.
    control.throwIfPaused();
    if (signal.aborted) {
      try {
        await requestUploadApi(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/abort/`, {
          method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        });
      } catch {
        // Session expiry cleanup is the recovery path if the network is already gone.
      }
      removeSessionValue(resumeKey);
      removeSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`);
      removeSessionValue(receiptsKey);
      return;
    }
    if (fatal) throw fatal;
    if (!alreadyCompleting) {
      control.throwIfPaused();
      observer.onStatus("verifying", uploadId);
      await requestUploadApi<{ state: string; file_id?: number }>(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/complete/`, {
        method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ parts: [...completed].sort(([a], [b]) => a - b).map(([part_number, etag]) => ({ part_number, etag })) }),
      });
    }
    let result: { state: string; file_id?: number; failure_code?: string | null } = { state: "verifying" };
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 120; attempt += 1) {
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      result = await requestUploadApi<{ state: string; file_id?: number; failure_code?: string | null }>(`/files/api/uploads/${uploadId}/`);
      if (result.state === "scanning") observer.onStatus("scanning", uploadId);
      else if (result.state === "verifying") observer.onStatus("verifying", uploadId);
      if (result.state === "available" || result.state === "completed" || result.state === "failed") break;
      await sleep(5000);
    }
    if (result.state === "failed") throw Object.assign(new Error("The server rejected this upload during verification or security checks."), { retryable: false, action: "Review the file and select it again after correcting the issue." });
    if (result.state !== "available" && result.state !== "completed") throw Object.assign(new Error("Finalization is still running; retry to resume status polling."), { retryable: true, action: "The server retains this upload session; retry to check its status." });
    removeSessionValue(resumeKey);
    removeSessionValue(`${resumeKey}:idempotency`);
    removeSessionValue(receiptsKey);
    observer.onCompleted();
    } finally {
      activeTransfers.delete(task.id);
      control.finish();
    }
  },
  async pause(task) {
    const transfer = activeTransfers.get(task.id);
    if (!transfer) throw new Error("There is no active upload to pause.");
    transfer.pause();
    await transfer.finished;
  },
  async resume(task) {
    if (activeTransfers.has(task.id)) throw new Error("The previous upload has not stopped yet.");
    // UploadManager schedules upload() again. That method verifies the saved
    // UploadSession/receipt manifest against the provider before sending parts.
  },
  async cancelPaused(task, file) {
    if (!task.uploadSessionId) throw new Error("Paused upload has no server session to cancel.");
    if (activeTransfers.has(task.id)) throw new Error("Cannot cancel while an upload is still stopping.");
    await requestUploadApi(`/files/api/uploads/${task.uploadSessionId}/abort/`, {
      method: "POST", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
    });
    forgetResumeState(resumeStorageKey(task, file));
  },
};

/**
 * A pause interrupts browser PUT requests but keeps the provider's multipart
 * upload session alive. Cancellation is a separate signal from UploadManager.
 */
export class UploadPausedError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super("Upload paused; completed parts remain available for resume.");
    this.name = "UploadPausedError";
  }
}

export class UploadTransferControl {
  private readonly controller = new AbortController();
  private readonly externalSignal: AbortSignal;
  private pauseRequested = false;
  private finishWaiting!: () => void;
  private disposed = false;
  readonly finished: Promise<void>;

  private readonly onCancel = () => this.controller.abort();

  constructor(cancelSignal: AbortSignal) {
    this.externalSignal = cancelSignal;
    this.finished = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { this.finishWaiting = resolve; });
    if (cancelSignal.aborted) this.onCancel();
    else cancelSignal.addEventListener("abort", this.onCancel, { once: true });
  }

  get signal(): AbortSignal { return this.controller.signal; }
  get paused(): boolean { return this.pauseRequested && !this.externalSignal.aborted; }

  pause(): void {
    if (this.disposed || this.externalSignal.aborted) throw new Error("Upload is no longer pausable.");
    this.pauseRequested = true;
    this.controller.abort();
  }

  throwIfPaused(): void {
    if (this.paused) throw new UploadPausedError();
  }

  finish(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.externalSignal.removeEventListener("abort", this.onCancel);
    this.finishWaiting();
  }
}

/** Choose the most specific match so System Health is not active on Storage Topology. */
function navItemActive(href: string, pathname: string) {
  if (pathname === href) return true;
  if (!pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`)) return false;
  return !groups.some(({ items }) => items.some(({ href: moreSpecific }) =>
    moreSpecific !== href && moreSpecific.startsWith(`${href}/`) &&
    (pathname === moreSpecific || pathname.startsWith(`${moreSpecific}/`)),
  ));
}

    </div>
  </div>;
}

"use client";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Cloud, Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import Input from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { AccountServiceError } from "@/lib/account-service";
import { djangoAuthService } from "@/lib/auth-service";
import { safeInternalRedirect } from "@/lib/auth-redirect";

export default function AuthForm({ mode }: { mode: "login" | "register" }) {
  const isRegister = mode === "register";
  const passwordFieldName = isRegister ? "password1" : "password";
  const router = useRouter();
  const { acceptAuthenticatedAccount } = useAccount();
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [registrationAccepted, setRegistrationAccepted] = useState(false);

  function fieldError(name: string) {
    return fieldErrors[name]?.join(" ") ?? "";
  }

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage("");
    setFieldErrors({});
    setRegistrationAccepted(false);
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    try {
      if (isRegister) {
        await djangoAuthService.register({
            username: String(formData.get("username") ?? "").trim(),
            email: String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim(),
            password1: String(formData.get("password1") ?? ""),
            password2: String(formData.get("password2") ?? ""),
          });
        setRegistrationAccepted(true);
        setMessage(
          "If registration can be completed, you can sign in to continue. If you cannot sign in, check your details or contact support.",
        );
        return;
      }
      const account = await djangoAuthService.signIn({
        email: String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim(),
        password: String(formData.get(passwordFieldName) ?? ""),
      });
      acceptAuthenticatedAccount(account);
      const next = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("next");
      router.replace(account.is_platform_admin ? "/admin" : (safeInternalRedirect(next).startsWith("/admin") ? "/drive" : safeInternalRedirect(next)));
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof AccountServiceError) {
        setFieldErrors(error.fieldErrors);
        setMessage(
          error.status === 401
            ? "Invalid email or password."
            : error.status === 403
              ? "Your session could not be confirmed. Refresh and try again."
              : error.message,
        );
      } else {
        setMessage("Authentication failed. Please try again.");
      }
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background px-5 py-12 sm:px-8">
      <section className="w-full max-w-[500px] rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface p-7 shadow-[var(--shadow-popover)] sm:p-10" aria-labelledby="auth-title">
        <Link href="/login" className="mb-8 flex w-fit items-center gap-3 rounded-md">
          <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-[var(--radius-control)] bg-brand text-white"><Cloud size={20} /></span>
          <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">BlueDrive</span>
        </Link>

        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-brand-contrast">{isRegister ? "Create account" : "Welcome back"}</p>
        <h1 id="auth-title" className="mt-3 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            {isRegister ? "Start your secure workspace" : "Sign in to BlueDrive"}
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">
          {isRegister ? "Create an account to store and manage your files securely." : "Enter your email and password to access your files."}
        </p>

        <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted" aria-hidden="true">
          <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
          <span>Continue with email</span>
          <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
        </div>

        <form className="mt-6 space-y-4" onSubmit={submit}>
            {isRegister && (
              <label className="block">
                <span className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Username</span>
                <Input
                  required
                  disabled={pending}
                  name="username"
                  autoComplete="username"
                  placeholder="Choose a username"
                  invalid={Boolean(fieldError("username"))}
                  aria-describedby={fieldError("username") ? "username-error" : undefined}
                  className="h-12 px-4"
                />
                {fieldError("username") && <span id="username-error" className="mt-1 block text-xs text-danger">{fieldError("username")}</span>}
              </label>
            )}

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Email address</span>
              <Input
                required
                disabled={pending}
                name="email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                invalid={Boolean(fieldError("email"))}
                aria-describedby={fieldError("email") ? "email-error" : undefined}
                className="h-12 px-4"
              />
              {fieldError("email") && <span id="email-error" className="mt-1 block text-xs text-danger">{fieldError("email")}</span>}
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Password</span>
              <span className="relative block">
                <Input
                  required
                  disabled={pending}
                  name={passwordFieldName}
                  minLength={8}
                  type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                  autoComplete={isRegister ? "new-password" : "current-password"}
                  placeholder={isRegister ? "At least 8 characters" : "Enter your password"}
                  invalid={Boolean(fieldError(passwordFieldName))}
                  aria-describedby={fieldError(passwordFieldName) ? `${passwordFieldName}-error` : undefined}
                  className="h-12 px-4 pr-12"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-background"
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={17} /> : <Eye size={17} />}
                </button>
              </span>
              {fieldError(passwordFieldName) && <span id={`${passwordFieldName}-error`} className="mt-1 block text-xs text-danger">{fieldError(passwordFieldName)}</span>}
            </label>

            {isRegister && (
              <label className="block">
                <span className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Confirm password</span>
                <Input
                  required
                  disabled={pending}
                  name="password2"
                  minLength={8}

                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  placeholder="Enter your password again"
                  invalid={Boolean(fieldError("password2"))}
                  aria-describedby={fieldError("password2") ? "password2-error" : undefined}
                  className="h-12 px-4"
                />
                {fieldError("password2") && <span id="password2-error" className="mt-1 block text-xs text-danger">{fieldError("password2")}</span>}
              </label>
            )}

            {!isRegister && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-muted">Password recovery is not available yet.</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {message && <p role={registrationAccepted ? "status" : "alert"} className={`rounded-[var(--radius-control)] border p-3 text-sm leading-5 ${registrationAccepted ? "border-success/20 bg-success/10 text-success" : "border-danger/20 bg-danger/10 text-danger"}`}>{message}</p>}

            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" loading={pending} className="w-full">

"use client";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";

import Sidebar from "./Sidebar";
import SettingsSidebar from "./SettingsSidebar";
import Header from "./Header";

export default function DashboardShell({
  children,
  settingsNavigation,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  settingsNavigation?: { active: string; onChange: (section: string) => void };
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state } = useAccount();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.status === "loaded" && state.account?.is_platform_admin) router.replace("/admin");
  }, [state, router]);
  const [mobileNavigationOpen, setMobileNavigationOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigationRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const menuButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const wasNavigationOpen = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mobileNavigationOpen) {
      navigationRef.current?.querySelector("a")?.focus();
    } else if (wasNavigationOpen.current) {
      menuButtonRef.current?.focus();
    }
    wasNavigationOpen.current = mobileNavigationOpen;
  }, [mobileNavigationOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileNavigationOpen) return;

    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setMobileNavigationOpen(false);
        return;
      }
      if (event.key !== "Tab") return;

      const focusable = navigationRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
        'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
      );
      if (!focusable?.length) return;

      const first = focusable[0];
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [mobileNavigationOpen]);

  if (state.status === "loaded" && state.account?.is_platform_admin) return null;

  return (
    <main className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background">
      {mobileNavigationOpen && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close navigation"
          onClick={() => setMobileNavigationOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-foreground/35 lg:hidden"
        />
      )}
      {settingsNavigation ? (
        <SettingsSidebar navigationRef={navigationRef} mobileOpen={mobileNavigationOpen}
          active={settingsNavigation.active} onChange={settingsNavigation.onChange}
          onNavigate={() => setMobileNavigationOpen(false)} />
      ) : (
        <Sidebar navigationRef={navigationRef} mobileOpen={mobileNavigationOpen}
          onNavigate={() => setMobileNavigationOpen(false)} />
      )}

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        <Header
          menuButtonRef={menuButtonRef}
          mobileOpen={mobileNavigationOpen}
          onMenuClick={() => setMobileNavigationOpen(true)}
        />

        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import type { Ref } from "react";
import {
    Bell,
    Menu,
    Search,
    Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { DRIVE_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT } from "@/lib/workspace-context";
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import ContextMenu, { type ContextMenuAction } from "@/components/ui/ContextMenu";
import Toast from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";

export default function Header({
    mobileOpen,
    onMenuClick,
    menuButtonRef,
}: {
    mobileOpen: boolean;
    onMenuClick: () => void;
    menuButtonRef: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>;
}) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        const syncSearchFromUrl = () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            setSearchText(params.get("q") ?? "");
        };
        syncSearchFromUrl();
        const clearSearchOnWorkspaceSwitch = () => setSearchText("");
        window.addEventListener("popstate", syncSearchFromUrl);
        window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, clearSearchOnWorkspaceSwitch);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("popstate", syncSearchFromUrl);
            window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, clearSearchOnWorkspaceSwitch);
        };
    }, [pathname]);

    function submitSearch(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const query = searchText.trim().slice(0, 255);
        setSearchText(query);
        router.push(query ? `/drive?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : "/drive");
        // If we are already on Drive, keep the mounted file browser in sync.
        // Other routes remount Drive and read the submitted query from the URL.
        if (pathname === "/drive") {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(DRIVE_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT, { detail: { query } }));
        }
    }
    const {
        state: accountState,
        signOut,
        actionError,
        clearActionError,
    } = useAccount();
    const account = accountState.status === "loaded" ? accountState.account : null;
    const profileLabel = account?.profile.username || account?.profile.email || "Account";
    const initials = profileLabel.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();
    const accountActions: ContextMenuAction[] = [
        {
            label: "Profile",
            onSelect: () => router.push("/account/profile"),
        },
        {
            label: "Settings",
            onSelect: () => router.push("/account/settings"),
        },
    ];
    accountActions.push({
        label: "Sign out",
        onSelect: () => {
            void signOut().catch(() => undefined);
        },
    });

    return (
        <header className="flex h-18 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b border-border bg-surface/90 px-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:gap-3 sm:px-6">
            <button
                ref={menuButtonRef}
                type="button"
                aria-label="Open navigation"
                aria-controls="drive-navigation"
                aria-expanded={mobileOpen}
                onClick={onMenuClick}
                className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-muted transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast lg:hidden"
            >
                <Menu size={20} />
            </button>

            <form onSubmit={submitSearch} role="search" className="relative min-w-0 w-full max-w-105 flex-1">
                <Search
                    size={16}
                    strokeWidth={1.8}
                    className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted"
                />
                <input
                    type="search"
                    value={searchText}
                    maxLength={255}
                    onChange={(event) => setSearchText(event.currentTarget.value)}
                    aria-label="Search files and folders"
                    placeholder="Search files and folders"
                    title="Search in the current Drive or workspace"
                    className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background pl-10 pr-3 text-[13px] text-foreground outline-none transition placeholder:text-muted focus:border-brand focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/10"
                />
            </form>

            <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3">
                {account?.account.type === "individual" && account.account.upgradeEligible === true && (
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => router.push("/account/upgrade")}
                        className="hidden h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-contrast px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-hover sm:flex"
                    >
                        <Sparkles size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
                        Upgrade plan
                    </button>
                )}

                <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled
                    aria-label="Notifications — not connected yet"
                    title="Notifications are not connected yet"
                    className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-muted opacity-60"
                >
                    <Bell size={17} strokeWidth={1.8} />
                </button>

                <ContextMenu
                    label={accountState.status === "loading" ? "Account actions" : accountState.status === "error" ? "Account actions · account data unavailable" : `Account actions for ${profileLabel}`}
                    trigger={<><div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-soft text-xs font-semibold text-brand">{initials}</div><span className="hidden max-w-32 truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground xl:block">{profileLabel}</span></>}
                    actions={accountActions}
                    triggerClassName="flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg p-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-background"
                />
            </div>
            {actionError && (
                <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-80 w-[min(24rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]">
                    <Toast title="Account action failed" variant="error" onDismiss={clearActionError}>
                        {actionError}
                    </Toast>
                </div>
            )}
        </header>
    );
}

FILE: frontend\components\layout\Sidebar.tsx
