"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type Ref } from "react";
import {
    ChevronDown,
    ChevronRight,
    Clock3,
    Building2,
    Folder,
    HardDrive,
    Share2,
    Star,
    Trash2,
    X,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { BrandLogo } from "@/components/ui/BrandLogo";
import DriveNewMenu from "@/components/drive/DriveNewMenu";
import WorkspaceSwitcher from "@/components/workspaces/WorkspaceSwitcher";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";
import { DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT, WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT } from "@/lib/workspace-context";
import { requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";
import { clearActiveWorkspaceSelection, getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest } from "@/lib/workspace-context";

type FolderTreeNode = {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    parent_id: number | null;
    children: FolderTreeNode[];
};

type SidebarProps = {
    mobileOpen: boolean;
    onNavigate: () => void;
    navigationRef: Ref<HTMLElement>;
};

type QuotaSummary = {
    configured: boolean;
    workspaceName?: string;
    limitBytes: number | null;
    usedBytes: number | null;
    reservedBytes: number | null;
    remainingBytes: number | null;
    percentUsed: number | null;
    message?: string;
    organizationCap?: {
        limitBytes: number | null;
        usedBytes: number;
        reservedBytes: number;
        remainingBytes: number | null;
        percentUsed: number | null;
    };
};

function formatStorageBytes(value: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (value == null) return "—";
    if (value < 1024) return `${value} B`;
    const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB", "PB"];
    let amount = value / 1024;
    let index = 0;
    while (amount >= 1024 && index < units.length - 1) {
        amount /= 1024;
        index += 1;
    }
    return `${amount.toFixed(amount >= 10 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[index]}`;
}

const navigationItems = [
    { label: "My Drive", href: "/drive", icon: HardDrive },
    { label: "Shared with me", href: "/drive/shared", icon: Share2 },
    { label: "Recent", href: "/drive/recent", icon: Clock3 },
    { label: "Starred", href: "/drive/starred", icon: Star },
    { label: "Trash", href: "/drive/trash", icon: Trash2 },
];

function collectAncestorIds(nodes: FolderTreeNode[], targetId: number, path: number[] = []): number[] | null {
    for (const node of nodes) {
        const nextPath = [...path, node.id];
        if (node.id === targetId) return nextPath;
        const nested = collectAncestorIds(node.children, targetId, nextPath);
        if (nested) return nested;
    }
    return null;
}

export default function Sidebar({ mobileOpen, onNavigate, navigationRef }: SidebarProps) {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const { state: accountState } = useAccount();
    const account = accountState.status === "loaded" ? accountState.account : null;
    const tenant = account?.account.tenant ?? null;
    const canManageOrganization = Boolean(
        account?.account.type === "business" && tenant && ["owner", "admin"].includes(tenant.role),
    );
    const [folderTree, setFolderTree] = useState<FolderTreeNode[]>([]);
    const [expandedFolders, setExpandedFolders] = useState<Set<number>>(() => new Set());
    const [myDriveExpanded, setMyDriveExpanded] = useState(false);
    const [quota, setQuota] = useState<QuotaSummary | null>(null);
    const [quotaLoading, setQuotaLoading] = useState(true);
    const [quotaError, setQuotaError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const refreshQuota = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!account?.profile.username) {
            setQuota(null);
            setQuotaLoading(false);
            return;
        }
        setQuotaLoading(true);
        setQuotaError(null);
        try {
            const headers = new Headers();
            const workspaceId = getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest();
            if (workspaceId) headers.set("X-Workspace-ID", workspaceId);
            const result = await requestAccountApi<QuotaSummary>("/accounts/api/me/quota/", { headers });
            setQuota(result);
        } catch (error) {
            setQuota(null);
            setQuotaError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load storage usage.");
        } finally {
            setQuotaLoading(false);
        }
    }, [account?.profile.username]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { void refreshQuota(); }, 0);
        const onQuotaInvalidated = () => { void refreshQuota(); };
        window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
        window.addEventListener(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
        window.addEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
        return () => {
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
            window.removeEventListener(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
            window.removeEventListener(DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT, onQuotaInvalidated);
        };
    }, [refreshQuota]);

    const refreshFolderTree = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            const result = await requestAccountApi<{ items: FolderTreeNode[] }>("/drive/api/folder-tree/");
            setFolderTree(result.items ?? []);
        } catch {
            // Keep navigation usable while storage/API services are unavailable.
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const onFolderTreeRefresh = () => { void refreshFolderTree(); };
        // Defer the initial request so the effect itself does not synchronously
        // trigger state updates; the API response updates state asynchronously.
        const initialRefresh = window.setTimeout(() => {
            void refreshFolderTree();
        }, 0);
        window.addEventListener(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT, onFolderTreeRefresh);
        window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onFolderTreeRefresh);
        return () => {
            window.clearTimeout(initialRefresh);
            window.removeEventListener(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT, onFolderTreeRefresh);
            window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onFolderTreeRefresh);
        };
    }, [refreshFolderTree]);

    const toggleFolder = useCallback((folderId: number) => {
        setExpandedFolders((current) => {
            const next = new Set(current);
            if (next.has(folderId)) next.delete(folderId);
            else next.add(folderId);
            return next;
        });
    }, []);

    const renderFolderNode = (node: FolderTreeNode, depth = 0) => {
        const href = `/drive/folders/${node.id}`;
        const active = pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
        const expanded = expandedFolders.has(node.id);
        return (
            <div key={node.id}>
                <div className={`group flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg pr-1 transition-colors ${active ? "bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast" : "text-muted hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground"}`} style={{ paddingLeft: `${8 + depth * 12}px` }}>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={expanded ? `Collapse ${node.name}` : `Expand ${node.name}`}
                        aria-expanded={expanded}
                        onClick={() => toggleFolder(node.id)}
                        className="flex h-7 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md hover:bg-surface"
                    >
                        {node.children.length > 0
                            ? expanded ? <ChevronDown size={14} /> : <ChevronRight size={14} />
                            : <span className="w-3" />}
                    </button>
                    <Link
                        href={href}
                        onClick={() => {
                            const path = collectAncestorIds(folderTree, node.id);
                            if (path) {
                                setExpandedFolders((current) => new Set([...current, ...path]));
                            }
                            onNavigate();
                        }}
                        aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                        title={node.name}
                        className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-medium"
                    >
                        <Folder size={14} className="shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">{node.name}</span>
                    </Link>
                </div>
                {expanded && node.children.length > 0 && (
                    <div>{node.children.map((child) => renderFolderNode(child, depth + 1))}</div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    };

    return (
        <aside ref={navigationRef} id="drive-navigation" className={`fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex h-screen w-57.5 shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-border bg-surface transition-transform duration-(--motion-normal) lg:static lg:z-auto lg:translate-x-0 ${
            mobileOpen ? "visible translate-x-0" : "invisible -translate-x-full lg:visible"
        }`}>
            <div className="flex h-18 shrink-0 items-center justify-between px-4">
                <Link href="/drive" onClick={() => { clearActiveWorkspaceSelection(); onNavigate(); }} className="flex min-w-0 items-center">
                    <BrandLogo />
                </Link>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label="Close navigation"
                    onClick={onNavigate}
                    className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast lg:hidden"
                >
                    <X size={18} />
                </button>
            </div>

            <WorkspaceSwitcher />

            <div className="px-3 pb-4"><DriveNewMenu /></div>

            <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                    {navigationItems.map((item) => {
                        const Icon = item.icon;
                        const active = item.href === "/drive"
                            ? pathname === "/drive" || pathname.startsWith("/drive/folders/")
                            : pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);

                        if (item.href === "/drive") {
                            return (
                                <div key={item.href}>
                                    <div className={`flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl text-[14px] transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) ${active ? "bg-brand-soft font-semibold text-brand-contrast shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_var(--brand-primary-contrast)]" : "font-medium text-muted hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground"}`}>
                                        <Link href={item.href} onClick={() => { if (item.href === "/drive") clearActiveWorkspaceSelection(); onNavigate(); }} aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 px-3">
                                            <Icon size={17} strokeWidth={active ? 2 : 1.8} />
                                            <span>{item.label}</span>
                                        </Link>
                                        <button type="button" aria-label={myDriveExpanded ? "Collapse My Drive folders" : "Expand My Drive folders"} aria-expanded={myDriveExpanded} onClick={() => setMyDriveExpanded((current) => !current)} className="mr-1 flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-surface">
                                            {myDriveExpanded ? <ChevronDown size={15} /> : <ChevronRight size={15} />}
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                    {myDriveExpanded && folderTree.length > 0 && (
                                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-0.5">{folderTree.map((node) => renderFolderNode(node))}</div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            );
                        }

                        return (
                            <Link key={item.href} href={item.href} onClick={onNavigate} aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined} className={[
                                "flex h-10 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 text-[14px] transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast)",
                                active ? "bg-brand-soft font-semibold text-brand-contrast shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_var(--brand-primary-contrast)]" : "font-medium text-muted hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground",
                            ].join(" ")}>
                                <Icon size={17} strokeWidth={active ? 2 : 1.8} />
                                <span>{item.label}</span>
                            </Link>
                        );
                    })}
                    {canManageOrganization && (
                        <Link
                            href="/organization/admin"
                            onClick={onNavigate}
                            aria-current={pathname === "/organization/admin" || pathname.startsWith("/organization/admin/") ? "page" : undefined}
                            className={[
                                "mt-2 flex h-10 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 text-[14px] transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast)",
                                pathname === "/organization/admin" || pathname.startsWith("/organization/admin/")
                                    ? "bg-brand-soft font-semibold text-brand-contrast shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_var(--brand-primary-contrast)]"
                                    : "font-medium text-muted hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground",
                            ].join(" ")}
                        >
                            <Building2 size={17} />
                            <span>Organization admin</span>
                        </Link>
                    )}
                </div>
            </nav>

            <div className="m-4 rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-surface px-4 py-4">
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[12px] font-medium text-muted">Storage</span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-foreground">
                        {quotaLoading ? "Loading…" : quota?.configured ? (quota.limitBytes == null ? "No limit" : `${quota.percentUsed ?? 0}%`) : "Quota"}
                    </span>
                </div>
                {quotaLoading ? (
                    <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-background"><div className="h-full w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-brand" /></div>
                ) : quota?.configured ? (
                    <>
                        <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-background" role="progressbar" aria-label="Storage quota used" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={quota.percentUsed ?? 0}>
                            <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${(quota.percentUsed ?? 0) >= 95 ? "bg-danger" : "bg-brand-contrast"}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, quota.percentUsed ?? 0))}%` }} />
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted">
                            {formatStorageBytes(quota.usedBytes)} used{quota.limitBytes == null ? "" : ` of ${formatStorageBytes(quota.limitBytes)}`}
                        </p>
                        {quota.reservedBytes ? <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-muted">{formatStorageBytes(quota.reservedBytes)} reserved for uploads</p> : null}
                        {quota.organizationCap ? (
                            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] leading-4 text-muted">
                                Organization cap: {formatStorageBytes(quota.organizationCap.usedBytes)} used
                                {quota.organizationCap.limitBytes == null ? " · no limit" : ` of ${formatStorageBytes(quota.organizationCap.limitBytes)}`}
                                {quota.organizationCap.reservedBytes ? ` · ${formatStorageBytes(quota.organizationCap.reservedBytes)} reserved` : ""}
                            </p>
                        ) : null}
                    </>
                ) : (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-4 text-muted">{quota?.message ?? quotaError ?? "Storage quota is not configured."}</p>
                )}
            </div>
        </aside>
    );
}


================================================================================
FILE: frontend\components\organization\OrganizationAdminPage.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Building2, FolderKanban, Plus, RefreshCw, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import ConfirmDialog from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import DataTable from "@/components/ui/DataTable";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import { AccountServiceError } from "@/lib/account-service";
import {
  addWorkspaceMember,
  createWorkspace,
  getOrganizationAdminData,
  getWorkspaceMembers,
  removeWorkspaceMember,
  updateWorkspace,
  type OrganizationMember,
  type WorkspaceMemberAssignment,
} from "@/lib/organization-admin-service";
import type { OrganizationWorkspace } from "@/lib/workspace-service";
import { WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT } from "@/lib/workspace-context";

type AdminTab = "workspaces" | "members";
type WorkspaceRole = WorkspaceMemberAssignment["workspaceRole"];
const roles: WorkspaceRole[] = ["viewer", "editor", "admin"];
const inputClass = "min-h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground";
const tableCellClass = "border-t border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm";

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof AccountServiceError) return error.message;
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The request could not be completed.";
}

function formatRole(value: string): string {
  return value.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + value.slice(1);
}

/** Organization members and workspaces have direct, per-user permissions only. */
export default function OrganizationAdminPage() {
  const { state } = useAccount();
  const snapshot = state.status === "loaded" ? state.account : null;
  const tenant = snapshot?.account.tenant ?? null;
  const tenantId = tenant?.id ?? null;
  const isBusiness = snapshot?.account.type === "business";
  const canManage = Boolean(tenant && isBusiness && ["owner", "admin"].includes(tenant.role));

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<AdminTab>("workspaces");
  const [workspaces, setWorkspaces] = useState<OrganizationWorkspace[]>([]);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<OrganizationMember[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<OrganizationWorkspace | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [archiveTarget, setArchiveTarget] = useState<OrganizationWorkspace | null>(null);

  const [selectedWorkspace, setSelectedWorkspace] = useState<OrganizationWorkspace | null>(null);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<WorkspaceMemberAssignment[]>([]);
  const [accessLoading, setAccessLoading] = useState(false);
  const [accessError, setAccessError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedMemberId, setSelectedMemberId] = useState("");
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState<WorkspaceRole>("viewer");

  const activeMembers = useMemo(() => members.filter((member) => member.status === "active"), [members]);
  const assignedIds = new Set(assignments.filter((item) => item.status === "active").map((item) => item.membershipId));
  const availableMembers = activeMembers.filter((member) => !assignedIds.has(member.membershipId));

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!tenantId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getOrganizationAdminData(tenantId);
      setWorkspaces(data.workspaces);
      setMembers(data.members);
      setError(null);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(errorMessage(cause));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [tenantId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canManage || !tenantId) return;

    // Ignore responses from an organization that is no longer selected.
    let active = true;
    void getOrganizationAdminData(tenantId)
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setWorkspaces(data.workspaces);
        setMembers(data.members);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch((cause: unknown) => {
        if (active) setError(errorMessage(cause));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [canManage, tenantId]);

  const refreshAccess = useCallback(async (workspace: OrganizationWorkspace) => {
    if (!tenantId) return;
    setAccessLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await getWorkspaceMembers(tenantId, workspace.id);
      setAssignments(result.members);
      setAccessError(null);
    } catch (cause) {
      setAccessError(errorMessage(cause));
      throw cause;
    } finally {
      setAccessLoading(false);
    }
  }, [tenantId]);

  async function perform(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string, refreshWorkspace?: OrganizationWorkspace) {
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      await action();
      if (refreshWorkspace) {
        await refreshAccess(refreshWorkspace);
      } else {
        await load();
      }
      setNotice(success);
      return true;
    } catch (cause) {
      if (refreshWorkspace) setAccessError(errorMessage(cause));
      else setError(errorMessage(cause));
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function openForm(workspace?: OrganizationWorkspace) {
    setEditing(workspace ?? null);
    setName(workspace?.name ?? "");
    setDescription(workspace?.description ?? "");
    setFormOpen(true);
  }

  async function saveWorkspace() {
    if (!tenantId || !name.trim()) return;
    const success = await perform(
      () => editing
        ? updateWorkspace(tenantId, editing.id, { name: name.trim(), description: description.trim() })
        : createWorkspace(tenantId, { name: name.trim(), description: description.trim() }),
      editing ? "Workspace updated." : "Workspace created.",
    );
    if (success) {
      setFormOpen(false);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
    }
  }

  async function toggleArchive() {
    if (!tenantId || !archiveTarget) return;
    const nextStatus = archiveTarget.status === "active" ? "archived" : "active";
    const success = await perform(
      () => updateWorkspace(tenantId, archiveTarget.id, { status: nextStatus }),
      `Workspace ${nextStatus === "archived" ? "archived" : "restored"}.`,
    );
    if (success) {
      setArchiveTarget(null);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
    }
  }

  function openAccess(workspace: OrganizationWorkspace) {
    setSelectedWorkspace(workspace);
    setAssignments([]);
    setAccessError(null);
    setSelectedMemberId("");
    void refreshAccess(workspace).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  async function grantMember(membershipId: string, role: WorkspaceRole) {
    if (!tenantId || !selectedWorkspace) return;
    const success = await perform(
      () => addWorkspaceMember(tenantId, selectedWorkspace.id, { membership_id: membershipId, role }),
      "Workspace access updated.", selectedWorkspace,
    );
    if (success) setSelectedMemberId("");
  }

  async function revokeMember(membershipId: string) {
    if (!tenantId || !selectedWorkspace) return;
    await perform(
      () => removeWorkspaceMember(tenantId, selectedWorkspace.id, membershipId),
      "Workspace access removed.", selectedWorkspace,
    );
  }

  if (state.status === "loading") return <div className="p-8 text-muted">Loading account…</div>;
  if (!isBusiness || !tenant) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-muted">Select a business organization to manage workspaces.</div>;
  }
  if (!canManage) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-danger">Organization administrator access is required.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1600px] space-y-5 p-4 sm:p-6 xl:p-8">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted"><Building2 size={15} /> Organization</p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">{tenant.name}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">Manage workspaces and grant access to individual members.</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="secondary" loading={loading} onClick={() => void load()}><RefreshCw size={16} /> Refresh</Button>
      </header>

      {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 p-3 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
      {notice && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-border p-3 text-sm">{notice}</p>}

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4"><p className="text-sm text-muted">Active workspaces</p><p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">{workspaces.filter((item) => item.status === "active").length}</p></div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4"><p className="text-sm text-muted">Active members</p><p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">{activeMembers.length}</p></div>
      </div>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-border p-3">
          <Button variant={tab === "workspaces" ? "primary" : "ghost"} size="sm" onClick={() => setTab("workspaces")}><FolderKanban size={15} /> Workspaces</Button>
          <Button variant={tab === "members" ? "primary" : "ghost"} size="sm" onClick={() => setTab("members")}><Users size={15} /> Members</Button>
          <div className="flex-1" />
          {tab === "workspaces" && <Button size="sm" onClick={() => openForm()}><Plus size={15} /> New workspace</Button>}
        </div>

        {loading ? <p className="p-6 text-sm text-muted">Loading organization data…</p> : tab === "workspaces" ? (
          <DataTable>
            <thead><tr className="text-xs text-muted"><th className="p-3">Workspace</th><th className="p-3">Members</th><th className="p-3">Status</th><th className="p-3">Actions</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{workspaces.map((workspace) => (
              <tr key={workspace.id}>
                <td className={tableCellClass}><strong>{workspace.name}</strong>{workspace.isDefault && <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted">Default</span>}<p className="text-xs text-muted">{workspace.description}</p></td>
                <td className={tableCellClass}>{workspace.memberCount}</td>
                <td className={tableCellClass}>{formatRole(workspace.status)}</td>
                <td className={tableCellClass}><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => openAccess(workspace)}>Access</Button>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => openForm(workspace)}>Edit</Button>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={workspace.isDefault && workspace.status === "active"} onClick={() => setArchiveTarget(workspace)}>{workspace.status === "active" ? "Archive" : "Restore"}</Button>
                </div></td>
              </tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </DataTable>
        ) : (
          <DataTable>
            <thead><tr className="text-xs text-muted"><th className="p-3">Member</th><th className="p-3">Organization role</th><th className="p-3">Status</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{members.map((member) => (
              <tr key={member.membershipId}><td className={tableCellClass}>{member.username}<p className="text-xs text-muted">{member.email}</p></td><td className={tableCellClass}>{formatRole(member.role)}</td><td className={tableCellClass}>{formatRole(member.status)}</td></tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </section>

      <Dialog open={formOpen} title={editing ? "Edit workspace" : "Create workspace"} onClose={() => setFormOpen(false)}>
        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); void saveWorkspace(); }}>
          <label className="block text-sm">Name<input className={`${inputClass} mt-1`} value={name} maxLength={255} required onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block text-sm">Description<textarea className={`${inputClass} mt-1`} value={description} maxLength={4000} rows={3} onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setFormOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button><Button type="submit" loading={saving} disabled={!name.trim()}>Save</Button></div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog open={Boolean(selectedWorkspace)} title={selectedWorkspace ? `${selectedWorkspace.name} members` : "Workspace access"} description="Assign access directly to organization members." onClose={() => setSelectedWorkspace(null)} className="w-[min(100%-2rem,50rem)]">
        {selectedWorkspace && <div className="space-y-4">
          {accessError && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-danger">{accessError}</p>}
          <form className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_8rem_auto]" onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (selectedMemberId) void grantMember(selectedMemberId, selectedRole); }}>
            <select aria-label="Organization member" className={`${inputClass} flex-1`} value={selectedMemberId} onChange={(event) => setSelectedMemberId(event.target.value)} disabled={saving || selectedWorkspace.status !== "active"}>
              <option value="">Select a member…</option>
              {availableMembers.map((member) => <option key={member.membershipId} value={member.membershipId}>{member.username} ({member.email})</option>)}
            </select>
            <select aria-label="Workspace role" className={inputClass} value={selectedRole} onChange={(event) => setSelectedRole(event.target.value as WorkspaceRole)} disabled={saving || selectedWorkspace.status !== "active"}>
              {roles.map((role) => <option key={role} value={role}>{formatRole(role)}</option>)}
            </select>
            <Button type="submit" loading={saving} disabled={!selectedMemberId || selectedWorkspace.status !== "active"}>Add member</Button>
          </form>
          {accessLoading ? <p className="text-sm text-muted">Loading members…</p> : (
            <DataTable>
              <thead><tr className="text-xs text-muted"><th className="p-3">Member</th><th className="p-3">Role</th><th className="p-3">Action</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{assignments.filter((item) => item.status === "active").map((member) => (
                <tr key={member.assignmentId}>
                  <td className={tableCellClass}>{member.username}<p className="text-xs text-muted">{member.email}</p></td>
                  <td className={tableCellClass}>
                    <select aria-label={`Role for ${member.username}`} className={inputClass} value={member.workspaceRole} disabled={saving || selectedWorkspace.status !== "active"} onChange={(event) => void grantMember(member.membershipId, event.target.value as WorkspaceRole)}>
                      {roles.map((role) => <option key={role} value={role}>{formatRole(role)}</option>)}
                    </select>
                  </td>
                  <td className={tableCellClass}><Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={saving || selectedWorkspace.status !== "active"} onClick={() => void revokeMember(member.membershipId)}>Remove</Button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}</tbody>
            </DataTable>
          )}
        </div>}
      </Dialog>

      <ConfirmDialog open={Boolean(archiveTarget)} title={archiveTarget?.status === "active" ? "Archive workspace" : "Restore workspace"} description={`Change status of “${archiveTarget?.name ?? ""}”?`} destructive={archiveTarget?.status === "active"} pending={saving} onClose={() => setArchiveTarget(null)} onConfirm={() => void toggleArchive()} />
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type EmptyStateProps = {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: ReactNode;
};

export default function EmptyState({
  title = "Nothing here yet",
  description = "Items you add will appear here.",
  action,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  return (
    <section className="flex min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-10 text-center" aria-label={title}>
      <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h2>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted">{description}</p>
      {action && <div className="mt-5">{action}</div>}
    </section>
  );
}

import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";

type ErrorStateProps = {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  onRetry?: () => void;
};

export default function ErrorState({
  title = "Something went wrong",
  description = "Please try again.",
  onRetry,
}: ErrorStateProps) {
  return (
    <section role="alert" className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-10 text-center">
      <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h2>
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted">{description}</p>
      {onRetry && <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={onRetry} className="mt-5">Try again</Button>}
    </section>
  );
}

  label?: string;
  className?: string;
};

export default function LoadingState({
  label = "Loading",
  className = "",
}: LoadingStateProps) {
  return (
    <div role="status" aria-label={label} className={`flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted ${className}`}>
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-brand-contrast border-r-transparent" />
      <span>{label}...</span>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\components\theme\ThemeProvider.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { readThemePreference, resolveTheme, THEME_CHANGED_EVENT } from "@/lib/theme";

export default function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const apply = () => {
      const resolved = resolveTheme(readThemePreference());
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = resolved;
      document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
    };

    apply();
    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    window.addEventListener(THEME_CHANGED_EVENT, apply);
    window.addEventListener("storage", apply);
    media.addEventListener("change", apply);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(THEME_CHANGED_EVENT, apply);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", apply);
      media.removeEventListener("change", apply);
    };
  }, []);

  return children;
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type BadgeProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: "neutral" | "brand" | "success" | "warning" | "danger";
  className?: string;
};

const variants = {
  neutral: "bg-background text-foreground",
  brand: "bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast",
  success: "bg-green-50 text-success",
  warning: "bg-amber-50 text-warning",
  danger: "bg-rose-50 text-danger",
};

export default function Badge({
  children,
  variant = "neutral",
  className = "",
}: BadgeProps) {
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\components\ui\Breadcrumb.tsx

import Link from "next/link";

export type BreadcrumbItem = {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  onSelect?: () => void;
};

type BreadcrumbProps = {
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
  className?: string;
  dropTargetIndex?: number | null;
  onItemDragOver?: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>, index: number) => void;
  onItemDragLeave?: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>, index: number) => void;
  onItemDrop?: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>, index: number) => void;
};

export default function Breadcrumb({
  items,
  className = "",
  dropTargetIndex = null,
  onItemDragOver,
  onItemDragLeave,
  onItemDrop,
}: BreadcrumbProps) {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className={className}>
      <ol className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        {items.map((item, index) => {
          const current = index === items.length - 1;
          return (
            <li
              key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
              onDragOver={onItemDragOver ? (event) => onItemDragOver(event, index) : undefined}
              onDragLeave={onItemDragLeave ? (event) => onItemDragLeave(event, index) : undefined}
              onDrop={onItemDrop ? (event) => onItemDrop(event, index) : undefined}
              data-breadcrumb-drop-target={dropTargetIndex === index ? "true" : undefined}
              className={`flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-md transition-colors duration-150 ${dropTargetIndex === index ? "bg-brand-soft ring-2 ring-brand-contrast/50" : ""}`}
            >
              {index > 0 && <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-muted">/</span>}
              {current ? (
                <span
                  aria-current={current ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={`truncate ${current ? "font-medium text-foreground" : "text-muted"}`}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </span>
              ) : item.onSelect ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={item.onSelect}
                  className="truncate text-muted transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) hover:text-brand-contrast"
                >
                  {item.label}
                </button>
              ) : !item.href ? (
                <span className="truncate text-muted">{item.label}</span>
              ) : (
                <Link
                  href={item.href}
                  className="truncate text-muted transition-colors duration-(--motion-fast) hover:text-brand-contrast"
                >
                  {item.label}
                </Link>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react";

type ButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "destructive";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  loading?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
};

const variants = {
  primary: "bg-brand-contrast text-white hover:bg-brand-dark",
  secondary: "border border-border-strong bg-surface text-foreground hover:bg-background",
  ghost: "text-muted hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast",
  destructive: "bg-danger text-white hover:bg-rose-800",
};

const sizes = {
  sm: "min-h-9 px-3 text-xs",
  md: "min-h-10 px-4 text-sm",
  lg: "min-h-12 px-5 text-sm",
};

export default function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  disabled,
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  children,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      {...props}
      type={type}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[var(--radius-control)] font-semibold transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 ${variants[variant]} ${sizes[size]} ${className}`}
    >
      {loading && <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-current border-r-transparent" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";

type ConfirmDialogProps = {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
  pending?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export default function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel = "Confirm",
  destructive = false,
  pending = false,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}: ConfirmDialogProps) {
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      title={title}
      description={description}
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant={destructive ? "destructive" : "primary"}
          loading={pending}
          onClick={onConfirm}
        >
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\components\ui\ContextMenu.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";

export type ContextMenuAction = {
  label: string;
  onSelect: () => void;
  destructive?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

type ContextMenuProps = {
  label: string;
  trigger: ReactNode;
  actions: ContextMenuAction[];
  triggerClassName?: string;
  /** Optional account identity block above menu actions. */
  header?: ReactNode;
};

type MenuPosition = {
  top: number;
  left: number;
};

export default function ContextMenu({
  label,
  trigger,
  actions,
  triggerClassName,
  header,
}: ContextMenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<MenuPosition>({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const menuId = useId();

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !triggerRef.current || !menuRef.current) return;
    const triggerRect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const menuRect = menuRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const margin = 8;
    const left = Math.max(
      margin,
      Math.min(triggerRect.right - menuRect.width, window.innerWidth - menuRect.width - margin),
    );
    const top = Math.max(
      margin,
      Math.min(triggerRect.bottom + 4, window.innerHeight - menuRect.height - margin),
    );
    setPosition({ top, left });
    menuRef.current.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="menuitem"]:not(:disabled)')?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (
        !menuRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)
        && !triggerRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
  }, [open]);

  function close(restoreFocus = true) {
    setOpen(false);
    if (restoreFocus) requestAnimationFrame(() => triggerRef.current?.focus());
  }

  function handleKeyDown(event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLUListElement>) {
    const menuItems = Array.from(
      event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="menuitem"]:not(:disabled)'),
    );
    const currentIndex = menuItems.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
    if (!menuItems.length) return;

    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      close();
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      menuItems[(currentIndex + 1) % menuItems.length].focus();
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      menuItems[(currentIndex - 1 + menuItems.length) % menuItems.length].focus();
    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
      event.preventDefault();
      menuItems[0].focus();
    } else if (event.key === "End") {
      event.preventDefault();
      menuItems[menuItems.length - 1].focus();
    } else if (event.key === "Tab") {
      close(false);
      triggerRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        aria-label={label}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={menuId}
        onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
            event.preventDefault();
            setOpen(true);
          }
        }}
        className={triggerClassName ?? "inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-[var(--radius-control)] text-muted transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground"}
      >
        {trigger}
      </button>
      {open && typeof document !== "undefined" && createPortal(
        <ul
          ref={menuRef}
          id={menuId}
          role="menu"
          aria-label={label}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          style={{ top: position.top, left: position.left }}
          className="fixed z-[70] max-h-[min(70vh,24rem)] min-w-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-1 shadow-[var(--shadow-popover)]"
        >
          {header && <li role="none" className="border-b border-border p-2.5">{header}</li>}
          {actions.map((action) => (
            <li key={action.label} role="none">
              <button
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                disabled={action.disabled}
                onClick={() => {
                  action.onSelect();
                  close();
                }}
                className={`w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${
                  action.destructive
                    ? "text-danger hover:bg-rose-50"
                    : "text-foreground hover:bg-background"
                }`}
              >
                {action.label}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\components\ui\CustomScrollArea.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type PointerEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";

type Metrics = { visible: boolean; height: number; top: number };

export default function CustomScrollArea({ children, className = "", contentClassName = "" }: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  contentClassName?: string;
}) {
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dragRef = useRef<{ pointerY: number; scrollTop: number } | null>(null);
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<Metrics>({ visible: false, height: 0, top: 0 });

  const measure = useCallback(() => {
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    if (!viewport) return;
    const visibleHeight = viewport.clientHeight;
    const contentHeight = viewport.scrollHeight;
    const available = Math.max(0, visibleHeight - 8);
    if (contentHeight <= visibleHeight + 1 || !available) {
      setMetrics({ visible: false, height: 0, top: 0 });
      return;
    }
    const height = Math.max(28, available * visibleHeight / contentHeight);
    const travel = Math.max(0, available - height);
    const top = travel * viewport.scrollTop / Math.max(1, contentHeight - visibleHeight);
    setMetrics({ visible: true, height, top });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    if (!viewport) return;
    const resize = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    resize.observe(viewport);
    if (viewport.firstElementChild) resize.observe(viewport.firstElementChild);
    const mutation = new MutationObserver(measure);
    mutation.observe(viewport, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(measure);
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); resize.disconnect(); mutation.disconnect(); };
  }, [measure]);

  function handlePointerDown(event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!viewport || !track || !metrics.visible) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const thumb = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest('[data-scroll-thumb]');
    if (!thumb) {
      const bounds = track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const trackHeight = Math.max(1, bounds.height - 8);
      const travel = Math.max(1, trackHeight - metrics.height);
      const desired = Math.max(0, Math.min(travel, event.clientY - bounds.top - 4 - metrics.height / 2));
      viewport.scrollTop = desired / travel * (viewport.scrollHeight - viewport.clientHeight);
      measure();
    }
    dragRef.current = { pointerY: event.clientY, scrollTop: viewport.scrollTop };
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  }

  function handlePointerMove(event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const drag = dragRef.current;
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!drag || !viewport || !track) return;
    const travel = Math.max(1, track.clientHeight - 8 - metrics.height);
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, viewport.scrollHeight - viewport.clientHeight);
    viewport.scrollTop = drag.scrollTop + (event.clientY - drag.pointerY) * maxScroll / travel;
  }

  function handlePointerEnd() { dragRef.current = null; }

  return (
    <div className={`relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      <div ref={viewportRef} tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="Scrollable history"
        onScroll={measure} className="custom-scroll-viewport max-h-76 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
        <div className={contentClassName}>{children}</div>
      </div>
      {metrics.visible && (
        <div ref={trackRef} aria-hidden="true" onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove} onPointerUp={handlePointerEnd}
          onPointerCancel={handlePointerEnd} onLostPointerCapture={handlePointerEnd}
          className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-3 touch-none select-none">
          <div data-scroll-thumb="true" className="absolute right-0 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-border-strong hover:bg-brand"
            style={{ height: `${metrics.height}px`, top: `${metrics.top + 4}px` }} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\components\ui\Dialog.tsx

"use client";

import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";

type DialogProps = {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
};

export default function Dialog({
  open,
  title,
  description,
  onClose,
  children,
  className = "",
}: DialogProps) {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  const descriptionId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;

    if (open && !dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
    if (!open && dialog.open) dialog.close();
  }, [open]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={dialogRef}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      aria-describedby={description ? descriptionId : undefined}
      onCancel={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
      className={`m-auto max-h-[min(90vh,48rem)] w-[min(100%-2rem,32rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-0 text-foreground shadow-[var(--shadow-popover)] backdrop:bg-foreground/35 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
        <div>
          <h2 id={titleId} className="text-base font-semibold">{title}</h2>
          {description && <p id={descriptionId} className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">{description}</p>}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="rounded-lg p-2 text-muted transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="p-5">{children}</div>
    </dialog>
  );
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react";

type IconButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  label: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: "default" | "destructive";
};

export default function IconButton({
  label,
  children,
  variant = "default",
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  ...props
}: IconButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      {...props}
      type={type}
      aria-label={label}
      className={`inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-[var(--radius-control)] transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 ${
        variant === "destructive"
          ? "text-danger hover:bg-rose-50"
          : "text-muted hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast"
      } ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

import type { InputHTMLAttributes } from "react";

type InputProps = InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
  invalid?: boolean;
};

export default function Input({
  invalid,
  "aria-invalid": ariaInvalid,
  className = "",
  ...props
}: InputProps) {
  const isInvalid = invalid || ariaInvalid === true || ariaInvalid === "true";

  return (
    <input
      {...props}
      aria-invalid={isInvalid || undefined}
      className={`min-h-10 w-full rounded-[var(--radius-control)] border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-foreground transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-fast)] placeholder:text-muted disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-background disabled:opacity-60 ${
        isInvalid
          ? "border-danger focus-visible:outline-danger"
          : "border-border-strong hover:border-muted focus-visible:border-brand-contrast"
      } ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

type ProgressProps = {
  value?: number;
  max?: number;
  label: string;
  className?: string;
};

export default function Progress({
  value,
  max = 100,
  label,
  className = "",
}: ProgressProps) {
  const safeMax = Number.isFinite(max) && max > 0 ? max : 100;
  const safeValue = value === undefined
    ? undefined
    : Math.min(safeMax, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0));
  const percentage = safeValue === undefined ? undefined : (safeValue / safeMax) * 100;

  return (
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={safeMax}
      aria-valuenow={safeValue}
      className={`h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-border ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        className={`h-full rounded-full bg-brand-contrast transition-[width] duration-[var(--motion-normal)] ${
          percentage === undefined ? "w-1/3 animate-pulse" : ""
        }`}
        style={percentage === undefined ? undefined : { width: `${percentage}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { X } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import IconButton from "@/components/ui/IconButton";

type ToastProps = {
  title: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
  variant?: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info";
  onDismiss?: () => void;
};

const variants = {
  success: "border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-success",
  warning: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-warning",
  error: "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-danger",
  info: "border-brand/20 bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast",
};

export default function Toast({
  title,
  children,
  variant = "info",
  onDismiss,
}: ToastProps) {
  return (
    <div
      role={variant === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}
      aria-live={variant === "error" ? "assertive" : "polite"}
      className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-sm ${variants[variant]}`}
    >
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{title}</p>
        {children && <div className="mt-1 text-sm">{children}</div>}
      </div>
      {onDismiss && (
        <IconButton label="Dismiss notification" onClick={onDismiss}>
          <X size={17} />
        </IconButton>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { cloneElement, isValidElement, useId, type ReactElement } from "react";

type TooltipProps = {
  content: string;
  children: ReactElement<{ "aria-describedby"?: string }>;
};

export default function Tooltip({ content, children }: TooltipProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const describedBy = [children.props["aria-describedby"], id]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
  const trigger = isValidElement(children)
    ? cloneElement(children, { "aria-describedby": describedBy })
    : children;

  return (
    <span className="group/tooltip relative inline-flex">
      {trigger}
      <span
        id={id}
        role="tooltip"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full left-1/2 z-40 mb-2 w-max max-w-56 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-lg bg-brand-dark px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white opacity-0 shadow-sm transition-opacity duration-[var(--motion-fast)] group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 group-focus-within/tooltip:opacity-100"
      >
        {content}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft, Clock3, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { getWorkspaceActivity, type WorkspaceActivityEvent } from "@/lib/workspace-service";

function formatDate(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
  }).format(date);
}

export default function WorkspaceActivityPage({ workspaceId }: { workspaceId: string }) {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<WorkspaceActivityEvent[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [refreshCount, setRefreshCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const startTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
      }
    }, 0);
    void getWorkspaceActivity(workspaceId)
      .then((rows) => { if (!cancelled) setEvents(rows); })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "The workspace timeline could not be loaded.");
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; window.clearTimeout(startTimer); };
  }, [workspaceId, refreshCount]);

  return (
    <section className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <Link href="/drive" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-muted hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Drive
      </Link>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted"><Clock3 size={16} /> Workspace activity</div>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">Timeline</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted">Review file and membership events in this workspace. Access is limited to workspace managers.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setRefreshCount((value) => value + 1)} disabled={loading} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground hover:bg-background disabled:opacity-50">
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} /> Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted">Loading workspace activity…</div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="p-6">
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm font-semibold text-danger">Timeline could not be loaded</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">{error}</p>
          </div>
        ) : events.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-10 text-center">
            <Clock3 size={24} className="mx-auto text-muted" />
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">No activity yet</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">Workspace events will appear here as people work with files and members.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ol className="divide-y divide-border">
            {events.map((event) => (
              <li key={event.id} className="grid gap-2 px-4 py-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_12rem] sm:items-start sm:px-5">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="inline-flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-soft text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-contrast">{event.username.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{event.username}</span>
                    <span className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted">{event.actionLabel || event.action}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-2 break-words text-sm leading-6 text-foreground">{event.description || event.actionLabel || event.action}</p>
                </div>
                <time className="text-xs text-muted sm:text-right">{formatDate(event.createdAt)}</time>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CheckCircle2, LoaderCircle, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { setActiveWorkspaceSelection, WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT } from "@/lib/workspace-context";
import { acceptWorkspaceInvite, previewWorkspaceInvite } from "@/lib/workspace-service";

type InvitePreview = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof previewWorkspaceInvite>>;

export default function WorkspaceInviteAcceptance({ token }: { token: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state: accountState } = useAccount();
  const account = accountState.status === "loaded" ? accountState.account : null;
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<InvitePreview | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [joining, setJoining] = useState(false);
  const [joined, setJoined] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!token) return;
    void previewWorkspaceInvite(token)
      .then((result) => { if (!cancelled) setPreview(result); })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "The invitation could not be verified.");
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [token]);

  async function handleJoin() {
    setJoining(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await acceptWorkspaceInvite(token);
      if (account) {
        setActiveWorkspaceSelection({
          tenantId: result.workspace.tenantId,
          workspaceId: result.workspace.id,
          username: account.profile.username,
        });
      }
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
      setJoined(true);
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Could not join the workspace.");
    } finally {
      setJoining(false);
    }
  }

  const displayLoading = Boolean(token) && loading;
  const displayError = !token
    ? "This invitation link is missing its token."
    : error;

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background px-4 py-10">
      <section className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-[var(--shadow-popover)] sm:p-8">
        <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast"><Users size={22} /></div>
        {displayLoading ? (
          <div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted"><LoaderCircle size={16} className="animate-spin" /> Checking invitation…</div>
        ) : joined ? (
          <>
            <CheckCircle2 size={24} className="mt-5 text-success" />
            <h1 className="mt-3 text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">You joined {preview?.workspaceName ?? "the workspace"}</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">The workspace is now available in your sidebar.</p>
            <Button className="mt-6 w-full" onClick={() => router.push("/drive")}>Open Drive</Button>
          </>
        ) : displayError ? (
          <>
            <h1 className="mt-5 text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">Invitation unavailable</h1>
            <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-danger">{displayError}</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">Sign in with the invited email address, then reopen this link. Invitations expire after seven days.</p>
            <Link href={`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/workspace-invite?token=${token}`)}`} className="mt-5 inline-flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-brand-contrast px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-dark">Sign in</Link>
          </>
        ) : preview ? (
          <>
            <h1 className="mt-5 text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">Join {preview.workspaceName}</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">{preview.workspaceDescription || "You have been invited to collaborate in this workspace."}</p>
            <dl className="mt-5 space-y-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 text-sm">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-muted">Invited by</dt><dd className="font-medium text-foreground">{preview.invitedBy}</dd></div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-muted">Invitation sent to</dt><dd className="break-all text-right font-medium text-foreground">{preview.invitedEmail}</dd></div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-muted">Access role</dt><dd className="font-medium capitalize text-foreground">{preview.role}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            {account ? (
              <Button className="mt-6 w-full" loading={joining} onClick={() => { void handleJoin(); }}>Accept invitation</Button>
            ) : (
              <Link href={`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/workspace-invite?token=${token}`)}`} className="mt-6 inline-flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-brand-contrast px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-dark">Sign in to accept</Link>
            )}
          </>
        ) : null}
        {error && preview && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
        <Link href="/drive" className="mt-6 inline-flex text-xs font-medium text-muted hover:text-foreground">Return to Drive</Link>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
