FILE: frontend\components\workspaces\WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx
================================================================================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  Clock3,
  Copy,
  Layers,
  Link2,
  LoaderCircle,
  LogIn,
  Plus,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useAccount } from "@/components/account/AccountProvider";
import Dialog from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
import {
  clearActiveWorkspaceSelection,
  getSavedWorkspaceSelection,
  setActiveWorkspaceSelection,
  FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT,
  WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT,
  WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT,
} from "@/lib/workspace-context";
import {
  acceptWorkspaceInvite,
  createMyWorkspace,
  createWorkspaceInvite,
  getMyWorkspaces,
  type InviteRole,
  type OrganizationWorkspace,
} from "@/lib/workspace-service";

type DialogMode = "create" | "invite" | "join" | null;

function initials(value: string): string {
  const words = value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return words.slice(0, 2).map((word) => word[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "").join("") || "U";
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The request could not be completed.";
}

function tokenFromInput(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return "";
  try {
    const url = new URL(trimmed, window.location.origin);
    return url.searchParams.get("token") ?? trimmed;
  } catch {
    return trimmed;
  }
}

export default function WorkspaceSwitcher() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state: accountState } = useAccount();
  const account = accountState.status === "loaded" ? accountState.account : null;
  const username = account?.profile.username ?? "";
  const ownInitials = initials(username || account?.profile.email || "User");

  const [workspaces, setWorkspaces] = useState<OrganizationWorkspace[]>([]);
  const [selectedWorkspaceId, setSelectedWorkspaceId] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [dialogMode, setDialogMode] = useState<DialogMode>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [createName, setCreateName] = useState("");
  const [createDescription, setCreateDescription] = useState("");
  const [defaultMemberRole, setDefaultMemberRole] = useState<InviteRole>("viewer");
  const [inviteWorkspaceId, setInviteWorkspaceId] = useState("");
  const [inviteEmail, setInviteEmail] = useState("");
  const [inviteRole, setInviteRole] = useState<InviteRole>("viewer");
  const [inviteUrl, setInviteUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedInvite, setCopiedInvite] = useState(false);
  const [joinInput, setJoinInput] = useState("");

  const manageableWorkspaces = useMemo(
    () => workspaces.filter((workspace) => workspace.canManage),
    [workspaces],
  );

  const reloadWorkspaces = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!username) return [] as OrganizationWorkspace[];
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(null);
    try {
      const result = await getMyWorkspaces();
      setWorkspaces(result.filter((workspace) => workspace.status === "active"));
      const saved = getSavedWorkspaceSelection();
      const savedAvailable = Boolean(
        saved && saved.username === username && result.some(
          (workspace) => workspace.id === saved.workspaceId && workspace.tenantId === saved.tenantId && workspace.status === "active",
        ),
      );
      if (savedAvailable && saved) {
        setSelectedWorkspaceId(saved.workspaceId);
        setActiveWorkspaceSelection(saved);
      } else {
        if (saved?.username === username) clearActiveWorkspaceSelection();
        setSelectedWorkspaceId("");
      }
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      setLoadError(errorMessage(error));
      setWorkspaces([]);
      return [] as OrganizationWorkspace[];
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [username]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { void reloadWorkspaces(); }, 0);
    const onUpdated = () => { void reloadWorkspaces(); };
    const onWorkspaceChanged = () => {
      const saved = getSavedWorkspaceSelection();
      setSelectedWorkspaceId(saved?.username === username ? saved.workspaceId : "");
    };
    window.addEventListener(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT, onUpdated);
    window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onWorkspaceChanged);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT, onUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT, onWorkspaceChanged);
    };
  }, [reloadWorkspaces, username]);


  const effectiveInviteWorkspaceId = manageableWorkspaces.some(
    (workspace) => workspace.id === inviteWorkspaceId,
  ) ? inviteWorkspaceId : (manageableWorkspaces[0]?.id ?? "");

  function openDialog(mode: Exclude<DialogMode, null>) {
    setFormError(null);
    setInviteUrl(null);
    setCopiedInvite(false);
    if (mode === "invite") {
      setInviteEmail("");
      const selected = manageableWorkspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === inviteWorkspaceId)
        ?? manageableWorkspaces[0];
      if (selected) {
        setInviteWorkspaceId(selected.id);
        setInviteRole(selected.defaultMemberRole);
      }
    }
    if (mode === "join") setJoinInput("");
    setDialogMode(mode);
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    if (submitting) return;
    setDialogMode(null);
    setFormError(null);
    setInviteUrl(null);
  }

  function activateWorkspace(workspace: OrganizationWorkspace, notify = true) {
    if (!username) return;
    setSelectedWorkspaceId(workspace.id);
    setActiveWorkspaceSelection({
      tenantId: workspace.tenantId,
      workspaceId: workspace.id,
      username,
    }, { notify });
  }

  function selectWorkspace(workspace: OrganizationWorkspace) {
    activateWorkspace(workspace);
    router.push("/drive");
  }

  async function handleCreate(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      const workspace = await createMyWorkspace({
        name: createName.trim(),
        description: createDescription.trim(),
        default_member_role: defaultMemberRole,
      });
      await reloadWorkspaces();
      setSelectedWorkspaceId(workspace.id);
      setActiveWorkspaceSelection({ tenantId: workspace.tenantId, workspaceId: workspace.id, username });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
      setCreateName("");
      setCreateDescription("");
      setDialogMode(null);
      router.push("/drive");
    } catch (error) {
      setFormError(errorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleInvite(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFormError(null);
    setInviteUrl(null);
    try {
      const result = await createWorkspaceInvite(effectiveInviteWorkspaceId, {
        email: inviteEmail.trim(),
        role: inviteRole,
      });
      const url = new URL("/workspace-invite", window.location.origin);
      url.searchParams.set("token", result.inviteToken);
      setInviteUrl(url.toString());
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
    } catch (error) {
      setFormError(errorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleJoin(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      const token = tokenFromInput(joinInput);
      if (!token) throw new Error("Paste a workspace invitation link or token.");
      const result = await acceptWorkspaceInvite(token);
      await reloadWorkspaces();
      setSelectedWorkspaceId(result.workspace.id);
      setActiveWorkspaceSelection({
        tenantId: result.workspace.tenantId,
        workspaceId: result.workspace.id,
        username,
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT));
      setJoinInput("");
      setDialogMode(null);
      router.push("/drive");
    } catch (error) {
      setFormError(errorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function copyInvite() {
    if (!inviteUrl) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(inviteUrl);
      setCopiedInvite(true);
    } catch {
      setFormError("Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the invitation link below.");
    }
  }

  if (accountState.status !== "loaded") return null;

  return (
    <section className="mx-3 mb-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-3" aria-label="Workspaces">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
        aria-expanded={expanded}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-1 py-1 text-left"
      >
        <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-soft text-brand-contrast">
          <Layers size={15} />
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground">Workspaces</span>
        </span>
        {loading ? <LoaderCircle size={14} className="animate-spin text-muted" /> : expanded ? <ChevronDown size={15} className="text-muted" /> : <ChevronDown size={15} className="-rotate-90 text-muted" />}
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => openDialog("create")} className="flex h-[30px] items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast">
              <Plus size={12} /> Create
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => openDialog("join")} className="flex h-[30px] items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground hover:bg-brand-soft hover:text-brand-contrast">
              <LogIn size={12} /> Join
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-2 max-h-52 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-0.5">
            {workspaces.length === 0 && !loading && !loadError && (
              <p className="px-1 py-2 text-[11px] leading-4 text-muted">No workspaces yet...</p>
            )}
            {workspaces.map((workspace) => {
              const active = selectedWorkspaceId === workspace.id;
              const avatar = workspace.isOwnedByMe ? ownInitials : workspace.createdByInitials || initials(workspace.createdByUsername);
              return (
                <div key={workspace.id} className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl pr-1 transition-colors ${active ? "bg-brand-soft" : "hover:bg-surface"}`}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => selectWorkspace(workspace)}
                    aria-pressed={active}
                    title={`${workspace.name} · created by ${workspace.createdByUsername}`}
                    className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-1.5 py-2 text-left"
                  >
                    <span className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${workspace.isOwnedByMe ? "bg-brand-contrast text-white" : "border border-border bg-surface text-foreground"}`}>
                      {avatar}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className={`block truncate text-xs font-semibold ${active ? "text-brand-contrast" : "text-foreground"}`}>{workspace.name}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-muted">{workspace.isOwnedByMe ? "Created by you" : `By ${workspace.createdByUsername}`} · {workspace.currentUserRole ?? "Member"}</span>
                    </span>
                    {active && <Check size={13} className="shrink-0 text-brand-contrast" />}
                  </button>
                  {workspace.canManage && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        // A silent context switch avoids the Drive browser's
                        // folder-reset navigation racing the timeline route.
                        activateWorkspace(workspace, false);
                        window.dispatchEvent(new Event(FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT));
                        router.push(`/drive/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspace.id)}/activity`);
                      }}
                      aria-label={`Open ${workspace.name} timeline`}
                      title="Workspace timeline"
                      className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted hover:bg-surface hover:text-brand-contrast"
                    >
                      <Clock3 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          {loadError && <p role="status" className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-4 text-danger">{loadError}</p>}
        </>
      )}

      <Dialog
        open={dialogMode === "create"}
        title="Create a workspace"
        description="Create a shared area for files and collaboration. My Drive remains separate."
        onClose={closeDialog}
      >
        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleCreate}>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Workspace name <span className="text-danger">*</span></span>
            <input autoFocus required maxLength={255} value={createName} onChange={(event) => setCreateName(event.currentTarget.value)} placeholder="e.g. Product launch" className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand" />
          </label>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Description <span className="font-normal text-muted">(optional)</span></span>
            <textarea rows={3} maxLength={4000} value={createDescription} onChange={(event) => setCreateDescription(event.currentTarget.value)} placeholder="What will this workspace be used for?" className="w-full resize-y rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand" />
          </label>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Default role for invited members</span>
            <select value={defaultMemberRole} onChange={(event) => setDefaultMemberRole(event.currentTarget.value as InviteRole)} className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand">
              <option value="viewer">Viewer — can view and download</option>
              <option value="editor">Editor — can add and manage files</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-muted">
            <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">Access policy</p>
            Only people with an invitation link can join. Links expire after 7 days and are tied to the invited email address.
          </div>
          {formError && <p role="alert" className="text-xs leading-5 text-danger">{formError}</p>}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={closeDialog} disabled={submitting}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button type="submit" loading={submitting} disabled={!createName.trim()}>Create workspace</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog
        open={dialogMode === "invite"}
        title={inviteUrl ? "Invitation link created" : "Invite a member"}
        description={inviteUrl ? "Copy the link and send it to the invited person." : "Invitations are tied to the recipient's account email and expire in 7 days."}
        onClose={closeDialog}
      >
        {inviteUrl ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3">
              <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Invitation link</p>
              <input readOnly value={inviteUrl} onFocus={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()} className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-2 text-xs text-foreground outline-none" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted">The link grants the role selected for this invitation. The recipient must sign in with {inviteEmail || "the invited email address"}.</p>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => { setDialogMode(null); setInviteUrl(null); setInviteEmail(""); }}>Done</Button>
              <Button onClick={() => { void copyInvite(); }}><Copy size={14} /> {copiedInvite ? "Copied" : "Copy link"}</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleInvite}>
            {manageableWorkspaces.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted">You do not manage any workspace yet. Create one or ask a workspace admin to invite members.</p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <label className="block space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Workspace</span>
                  <select required value={effectiveInviteWorkspaceId} onChange={(event) => {
                    const nextId = event.currentTarget.value;
                    setInviteWorkspaceId(nextId);
                    const nextWorkspace = manageableWorkspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === nextId);
                    if (nextWorkspace) setInviteRole(nextWorkspace.defaultMemberRole);
                  }} className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand">
                    {manageableWorkspaces.map((workspace) => <option key={workspace.id} value={workspace.id}>{workspace.name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label className="block space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Email address</span>
                  <input autoFocus required type="email" maxLength={254} value={inviteEmail} onChange={(event) => setInviteEmail(event.currentTarget.value)} placeholder="colleague@example.com" className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand" />
                </label>
                <label className="block space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Permission</span>
                  <select value={inviteRole} onChange={(event) => setInviteRole(event.currentTarget.value as InviteRole)} className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand">
                    <option value="viewer">Viewer — can view and download</option>
                    <option value="editor">Editor — can add and manage files</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
              </>
            )}
            {formError && <p role="alert" className="text-xs leading-5 text-danger">{formError}</p>}
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={closeDialog} disabled={submitting}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button type="submit" loading={submitting} disabled={manageableWorkspaces.length === 0 || !inviteEmail.trim() || !effectiveInviteWorkspaceId}><Link2 size={14} /> Create invitation</Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog
        open={dialogMode === "join"}
        title="Join a workspace"
        description="Paste an invitation link or token sent to your account email."
        onClose={closeDialog}
      >
        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleJoin}>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Invitation link or token</span>
            <textarea required rows={3} value={joinInput} onChange={(event) => setJoinInput(event.currentTarget.value)} placeholder="https://your-domain/workspace-invite?token=…" className="w-full resize-y rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand" />
          </label>
          {formError && <p role="alert" className="text-xs leading-5 text-danger">{formError}</p>}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={closeDialog} disabled={submitting}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button type="submit" loading={submitting} disabled={!joinInput.trim()}><LogIn size={14} /> Join workspace</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>
    </section>
  );
}

import { getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest } from "@/lib/workspace-context";

export type AccountType = "individual" | "business" | "unclassified";

export type AccountSnapshot = {
  is_platform_admin?: boolean;
  profile: {
    username: string;
    email: string;
  };
  account: {
    type: AccountType;
    tenant: { id: string; name: string; role: string } | null;
    upgradeEligible: boolean | null;
  };
  memberships: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    type: "personal" | "business";
    role: string;
  }>;
};

export type ProfileUpdate = Pick<AccountSnapshot["profile"], "email">;

export interface AccountService {
  getCurrentAccount(): Promise<AccountSnapshot>;
  updateProfile(input: ProfileUpdate): Promise<AccountSnapshot>;
  signOut(): Promise<void>;
  requestUpgrade(): Promise<void>;
}

export class AccountServiceError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    readonly status: number | null = null,
    readonly fieldErrors: Record<string, string[]> = {},
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AccountServiceError";
  }
}

function apiBase(): string {
  const base = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL?.trim();
  if (!base) {
    throw new AccountServiceError(
      "Account service is not connected. Configure NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to use backend account features.",
    );
  }
  return base.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

export async function requestAccountApi<T>(
  path: string,
  init: RequestInit = {},
): Promise<T> {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    const headers = new Headers(init.headers);
    if (!headers.has("Accept")) headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
    if (init.body && !headers.has("Content-Type")) {
      headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
    }

    const requestPath = path.split("?", 1)[0] ?? path;
    const isWorkspaceScopedRequest = /^\/(drive|files|folders|sharing)\//.test(requestPath);
    if (isWorkspaceScopedRequest) {
      // The server remains the authorization boundary; this header only selects
      // the active workspace context for the existing Drive APIs.
      headers.delete("X-Workspace-ID");
      const workspaceId = getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest();
      if (workspaceId) headers.set("X-Workspace-ID", workspaceId);
    }

    response = await fetch(`${apiBase()}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      credentials: "include",
      headers,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AccountServiceError) throw error;
    throw new AccountServiceError("Could not reach the account service. Check your connection and retry.");
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    let detail: {
      detail?: string;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, Array<string | { message?: string }>>;
      error?: {
        message?: string;
        field_errors?: Record<string, string[]>;
      };
    } = {};
    try {
      detail = await response.json();
    } catch {
      // Keep an explicit HTTP status when the response has no JSON body.
    }
    const rawFieldErrors = detail.fieldErrors ?? detail.error?.field_errors ?? {};
    const fieldErrors = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(rawFieldErrors).map(([field, errors]) => [
        field,
        errors.map((error) =>
          typeof error === "string" ? error : error.message ?? "Invalid value.",
        ),
      ]),
    );
    throw new AccountServiceError(
      detail.detail ?? detail.error?.message ?? `Account request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`,
      response.status,
      fieldErrors,
    );
  }

  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export async function accountCsrfHeaders(): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ csrfToken: string }>("/accounts/api/csrf/");
  return { "X-CSRFToken": result.csrfToken };
}

export const djangoAccountService: AccountService = {
  getCurrentAccount() {
    return requestAccountApi<AccountSnapshot>("/accounts/api/me/");
  },
  async updateProfile(input) {
    return requestAccountApi<AccountSnapshot>("/accounts/api/me/", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(input),
    });
  },
  async signOut() {
    await requestAccountApi<void>("/accounts/api/logout/", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
    });
  },
  async requestUpgrade() {
    throw new AccountServiceError(
      "Personal plan upgrades are not connected. No plan change was made.",
    );
  },
};

export function getConfiguredSupportUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_URL?.trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw);
    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const FALLBACK_PATH = "/drive";

export function safeInternalRedirect(
  candidate: string | null | undefined,
  fallback = FALLBACK_PATH,
): string {
  if (
    !candidate ||
    !candidate.startsWith("/") ||
    candidate.startsWith("//") ||
    candidate.includes("\\") ||
    /%(?:2f|5c)/i.test(candidate) ||
    /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(candidate)
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  try {
    const destination = new URL(candidate, "https://securedrive.invalid");
    if (destination.origin !== "https://securedrive.invalid") return fallback;
    if (destination.pathname === "/login" || destination.pathname === "/register") {
      return fallback;
    }
    return `${destination.pathname}${destination.search}${destination.hash}`;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

FILE: frontend\lib\drive-service.ts

import { requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";
import { getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest } from "@/lib/workspace-context";

export type DownloadProgress = { loaded: number; total: number | null };

function driveApiBase(): string {
  const base = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL?.trim();
  if (!base) throw new Error("Drive service is not connected. Configure NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.");
  return base.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

function filenameFromDisposition(value: string | null, fallback: string): string {
  const utf8 = value?.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i)?.[1];
  const quoted = value?.match(/filename="((?:\\.|[^"])*)"/i)?.[1];
  let name = fallback;
  try {
    if (utf8) name = decodeURIComponent(utf8);
    else if (quoted) name = quoted.replace(/\\([\\"])/g, "$1");
  } catch {
    name = fallback;
  }
  return name.replace(/[\\/\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, "_").slice(0, 255) || "download";
}

export function downloadDriveFile(
  fileId: number,
  fallbackName: string,
  onProgress: (progress: DownloadProgress) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("GET", `${driveApiBase()}/drive/files/${fileId}/download/`);
    xhr.withCredentials = true;
    xhr.responseType = "blob";
    xhr.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/octet-stream, application/json");
    const workspaceId = getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest();
    if (workspaceId) xhr.setRequestHeader("X-Workspace-ID", workspaceId);
    xhr.onprogress = (event) => onProgress({
      loaded: event.loaded,
      total: event.lengthComputable && event.total > 0 ? event.total : null,
    });
    xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Network error while downloading. Retry the download."));
    xhr.onabort = () => reject(new Error("Download canceled."));
    xhr.onload = async () => {
      if (xhr.status < 200 || xhr.status >= 300) {
        let detail = `Download failed (HTTP ${xhr.status}).`;
        try {
          const body = JSON.parse(await (xhr.response as Blob).text()) as { detail?: string };
          if (body.detail) detail = body.detail;
        } catch {
          // Keep the status-only message for non-JSON responses.
        }
        reject(new Error(detail));
        return;
      }
      if (!xhr.getResponseHeader("Content-Type")?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/octet-stream")) {
        reject(new Error("The service returned an unexpected response. No file was saved."));
        return;
      }
      try {
        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(xhr.response as Blob);
        const anchor = document.createElement("a");
        anchor.href = objectUrl;
        anchor.download = filenameFromDisposition(
          xhr.getResponseHeader("Content-Disposition"),
          fallbackName,
        );
        anchor.rel = "noreferrer";
        document.body.appendChild(anchor);
        anchor.click();
        anchor.remove();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 60_000);
        resolve();
      } catch {
        reject(new Error("The file was received but the browser could not save it."));
      }
    };
    try {
      xhr.send();
    } catch {
      reject(new Error("Could not start the download. Retry."));
    }
  });
}

type DriveApiItem = {
  id: number;
  folderId?: number;
  name: string;
  owner: string;
  ownerInitials: string;
  modified: string;
  size: number | null;
  type: "folder" | "document" | "image";
  starred?: boolean;
  canManage?: boolean;
};

function formatBytes(bytes: number | null): string {
  if (bytes === null) return "—";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let value = bytes / 1024;
  let unit = units[0];
  for (let index = 1; value >= 1024 && index < units.length; index += 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    unit = units[index];
  }
  return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 0 : 1)} ${unit}`;
}

export type DriveItem = Omit<DriveApiItem, "size" | "modified"> & {
  size: string;
  modified: string;
};

export type DriveListView = "drive" | "recent" | "trash" | "shared" | "starred";

export type DriveFolderAncestor = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
};

export type DriveFolderDetails = {
  type: "folder";
  name: string;
  owner: string;
  created_at: string;
  modified_at: string;
  location: string;
  ancestors: DriveFolderAncestor[];
  folder_count: number;
  file_count: number;
  access: string;
  shared_by: string | null;
  last_action: string;
};

export async function getDriveItems(
  folderId: number | null,
  view: DriveListView = "drive",
  searchQuery = "",
): Promise<DriveItem[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ view });
  const query = searchQuery.trim().slice(0, 255);
  if (query && view === "drive") params.set("q", query);
  else if (folderId !== null) params.set("folder", String(folderId));
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ items: DriveApiItem[] }>(`/drive/api/items/?${params.toString()}`);
  return result.items.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    size: formatBytes(item.size),
    starred: Boolean(item.starred),
    modified: new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium" }).format(new Date(item.modified)),
  }));
}


export async function getDriveFolderDetails(
  folderId: number,
): Promise<DriveFolderDetails> {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(folderId) || folderId <= 0) {
    throw new Error("Invalid folder ID.");
  }

  return requestAccountApi<DriveFolderDetails>(
    `/drive/folder/${folderId}/details/`,
  );
}

import { accountCsrfHeaders, requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";
import type { OrganizationWorkspace, WorkspaceStatus } from "@/lib/workspace-service";

export type OrganizationMember = {
  membershipId: string;
  userId: number;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  role: "owner" | "admin" | "member" | string;
  status: "active" | "invited" | "suspended" | "revoked" | string;
};

export type WorkspaceMemberAssignment = {
  assignmentId: string;
  membershipId: string;
  userId: number;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  organizationRole: string;
  workspaceRole: "admin" | "editor" | "viewer";
  status: "active" | "revoked";
};

export type WorkspaceInput = {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status?: WorkspaceStatus;
};

function tenantPath(tenantId: string, resourcePath = ""): string {
  return `/accounts/api/tenants/${encodeURIComponent(tenantId)}/${resourcePath}`;
}

async function mutate<T>(path: string, method: "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE", body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  return requestAccountApi<T>(path, {
    method,
    headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
    ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
  });
}

/** Get only organization workspaces and members; access is assigned per user. */
export async function getOrganizationAdminData(tenantId: string): Promise<{
  workspaces: OrganizationWorkspace[];
  members: OrganizationMember[];
}> {
  const base = tenantPath(tenantId);
  const [workspaceResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
    requestAccountApi<{ workspaces: OrganizationWorkspace[] }>(`${base}workspaces/`),
    requestAccountApi<{ members: OrganizationMember[] }>(`${base}members/`),
  ]);
  return { workspaces: workspaceResult.workspaces, members: memberResult.members };
}

export function createWorkspace(tenantId: string, input: Pick<WorkspaceInput, "name" | "description">) {
  return mutate<{ workspace: OrganizationWorkspace }>(tenantPath(tenantId, "workspaces/"), "POST", input);
}

export function updateWorkspace(tenantId: string, workspaceId: string, input: Partial<WorkspaceInput>) {
  return mutate<{ workspace: OrganizationWorkspace }>(
    tenantPath(tenantId, `workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/`),
    "PATCH",
    input,
  );
}

export function getWorkspaceMembers(tenantId: string, workspaceId: string) {
  return requestAccountApi<{ members: WorkspaceMemberAssignment[] }>(
    tenantPath(tenantId, `workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/members/`),
  );
}

export function addWorkspaceMember(
  tenantId: string,
  workspaceId: string,
  input: { membership_id: string; role: WorkspaceMemberAssignment["workspaceRole"] },
) {
  return mutate<{ member: WorkspaceMemberAssignment }>(
    tenantPath(tenantId, `workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/members/`),
    "POST",
    input,
  );
}

export function removeWorkspaceMember(tenantId: string, workspaceId: string, membershipId: string) {
  return mutate<void>(
    tenantPath(tenantId, `workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(membershipId)}/`),
    "DELETE",
  );
}

export type ThemePreference = "system" | "light" | "dark";

export const THEME_CHANGED_EVENT = "securedrive:theme-changed";
const THEME_KEY = "securedrive:theme-preference:v1";

export function readThemePreference(): ThemePreference {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "system";
  try {
    const value = window.localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    return value === "light" || value === "dark" || value === "system" ? value : "system";
  } catch {
    return "system";
  }
}

export function setThemePreference(preference: ThemePreference): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, preference);
  } catch {
    // The current page still applies the preference even if browser storage is blocked.
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(THEME_CHANGED_EVENT));
}

export function resolveTheme(preference: ThemePreference): "light" | "dark" {
  if (preference === "light" || preference === "dark") return preference;
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
}

    usedBytes: number;
    reservedBytes: number;
    remainingBytes: number | null;
    percentUsed: number | null;
  };
  message?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
};

function workspaceHeaders(): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers();
  const workspaceId = getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest();
  if (workspaceId) headers.set("X-Workspace-ID", workspaceId);
  return headers;
}

export async function getMyQuota(): Promise<MyQuotaSummary> {
  return requestAccountApi<MyQuotaSummary>("/accounts/api/me/quota/", {
    headers: workspaceHeaders(),
  });
}

export type ActivityPage = { events: UserActivityEvent[]; hasMore: boolean };
export type SearchHistoryPage = { items: SearchHistoryItem[]; hasMore: boolean };

// Request pages directly from Django so older uploads/downloads are not hidden
// behind the former 100-event limit. The backend owns chronological ordering.
export async function getMyActivity(limit = 50, offset = 0): Promise<ActivityPage> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    limit: String(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, limit))),
    offset: String(Math.max(0, offset)),
  });
  return requestAccountApi<ActivityPage>(`/accounts/api/me/activity/?${params.toString()}`);
}

export async function getMySearchHistory(limit = 50, offset = 0): Promise<SearchHistoryPage> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    limit: String(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, limit))),
    offset: String(Math.max(0, offset)),
  });
  return requestAccountApi<SearchHistoryPage>(
    `/accounts/api/me/search-history/?${params.toString()}`,
  );
}

export async function clearMySearchHistory(): Promise<number> {
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ deletedCount: number }>(
    "/accounts/api/me/search-history/",
    { method: "DELETE", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders() },
  );
  return result.deletedCount;
}

export async function deleteMyDriveData(input: {
  password: string;
  confirmation: "DELETE MY DRIVE";
}): Promise<{ detail: string; filesDeleted: number; foldersDeleted: number; auditLogRetained: boolean }> {
  return requestAccountApi("/accounts/api/me/delete-data/", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
    body: JSON.stringify(input),
  });
}

FILE: frontend\lib\workspace-context.ts
================================================================================
import type { AccountSnapshot } from "@/lib/account-service";

export const WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT = "securedrive:workspace-changed";
export const WORKSPACES_UPDATED_EVENT = "securedrive:workspaces-updated";
export const FOLDER_TREE_REFRESH_EVENT = "securedrive:folder-tree-refresh";
export const DRIVE_SEARCH_CHANGED_EVENT = "securedrive:drive-search-changed";
export const DRIVE_UPLOAD_COMPLETED_EVENT = "securedrive:upload-completed";

const SELECTION_KEY = "securedrive:workspace-selection:v1";
const IDENTITY_KEY = "securedrive:workspace-identity:v1";

type WorkspaceSelection = {
  tenantId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  username: string;
};

type WorkspaceIdentity = {
  username: string;
};

let memorySelection: WorkspaceSelection | null = null;
let memorySelectionInitialized = false;
let memoryIdentity: WorkspaceIdentity | null = null;
let memoryIdentityInitialized = false;

function readJson<T>(key: string): T | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as T : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function safeDispatchWorkspaceChanged(): void {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACE_CHANGED_EVENT));
  }
}

export function getSavedWorkspaceSelection(): WorkspaceSelection | null {
  const selection = memorySelectionInitialized
    ? memorySelection
    : readJson<WorkspaceSelection>(SELECTION_KEY);
  if (
    !selection ||
    typeof selection.tenantId !== "string" ||
    typeof selection.workspaceId !== "string" ||
    typeof selection.username !== "string"
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return selection;
}

export function getActiveWorkspaceIdForRequest(): string | null {
  const selection = getSavedWorkspaceSelection();
  const identity = memoryIdentityInitialized
    ? memoryIdentity
    : readJson<WorkspaceIdentity>(IDENTITY_KEY);
  if (!selection || !identity || identity.username !== selection.username) {
    return null;
  }
  // Workspace membership may belong to another user's personal tenant. The
  // backend validates the selected workspace UUID on every request.
  return selection.workspaceId;
}

export function setActiveWorkspaceSelection(input: WorkspaceSelection, options: { notify?: boolean } = {}): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const current = getSavedWorkspaceSelection();
  if (
    current?.tenantId === input.tenantId &&
    current.workspaceId === input.workspaceId &&
    current.username === input.username
  ) {
    return;
  }
  memorySelection = input;
  memorySelectionInitialized = true;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(SELECTION_KEY, JSON.stringify(input));
  } catch {
    // The in-memory value still applies for this page when persistence is blocked.
  }
  if (options.notify !== false) safeDispatchWorkspaceChanged();
}

export function clearActiveWorkspaceSelection(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const existed = getSavedWorkspaceSelection() !== null;
  memorySelection = null;
  memorySelectionInitialized = true;
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(SELECTION_KEY);
  } catch {
    // The selection is optional when browser storage is unavailable.
  }
  if (existed) safeDispatchWorkspaceChanged();
}

/** Keep a saved workspace bound to the authenticated user and selected tenant. */
export function syncWorkspaceIdentity(account: AccountSnapshot): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

  const next: WorkspaceIdentity = {
    username: account.profile.username,
  };
  const previous = memoryIdentityInitialized
    ? memoryIdentity
    : readJson<WorkspaceIdentity>(IDENTITY_KEY);
  const changed = previous?.username !== next.username;

  memoryIdentity = next;
  memoryIdentityInitialized = true;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(IDENTITY_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  } catch {
    // Selection persistence is a convenience, not an access-control boundary.
  }

  if (!changed) return;

  memorySelection = null;
  memorySelectionInitialized = true;
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(SELECTION_KEY);
  } catch {
    // A stale selection will not be used unless its identity matches.
  }
  safeDispatchWorkspaceChanged();
}

import { accountCsrfHeaders, requestAccountApi } from "@/lib/account-service";

export type WorkspaceStatus = "active" | "archived";
export type WorkspaceRole = "viewer" | "editor" | "admin";
export type InviteRole = "viewer" | "editor";

export type OrganizationWorkspace = {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  tenantName: string;
  tenantKind: "personal" | "business";
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  description: string;
  status: WorkspaceStatus;
  isDefault: boolean;
  defaultMemberRole: InviteRole;
  currentUserRole: WorkspaceRole | null;
  canManage: boolean;
  createdByUserId: number | null;
  createdByUsername: string;
  createdByInitials: string;
  isOwnedByMe: boolean;
  memberCount: number;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};

export type CreateWorkspaceInput = {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  default_member_role: InviteRole;
};

export type WorkspaceInviteResult = {
  invitationId: string;
  email: string;
  role: InviteRole;
  workspaceId: string;
  workspaceName: string;
  inviteToken: string;
  expiresAt: string;
};

export type WorkspaceActivityEvent = {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  action: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  description: string;
  createdAt: string;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export async function getMyWorkspaces(): Promise<OrganizationWorkspace[]> {
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ workspaces: OrganizationWorkspace[] }>(
    "/accounts/api/workspaces/",
  );
  return result.workspaces;
}

export async function createMyWorkspace(input: CreateWorkspaceInput): Promise<OrganizationWorkspace> {
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ workspace: OrganizationWorkspace }>(
    "/accounts/api/workspaces/",
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(input),
    },
  );
  return result.workspace;
}

export async function updateWorkspace(
  workspaceId: string,
  input: Partial<Pick<OrganizationWorkspace, "name" | "description" | "status" | "defaultMemberRole">>,
): Promise<OrganizationWorkspace> {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (input.name !== undefined) body.name = input.name;
  if (input.description !== undefined) body.description = input.description;
  if (input.status !== undefined) body.status = input.status;
  if (input.defaultMemberRole !== undefined) body.default_member_role = input.defaultMemberRole;
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ workspace: OrganizationWorkspace }>(
    `/accounts/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/`,
    { method: "PATCH", headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify(body) },
  );
  return result.workspace;
}

export async function createWorkspaceInvite(
  workspaceId: string,
  input: { email: string; role: InviteRole },
): Promise<WorkspaceInviteResult> {
  return requestAccountApi<WorkspaceInviteResult>(
    `/accounts/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/invites/`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(input),
    },
  );
}

export async function previewWorkspaceInvite(token: string): Promise<{
  workspaceId: string;
  workspaceName: string;
  workspaceDescription: string;
  invitedEmail: string;
  role: InviteRole;
  invitedBy: string;
  expiresAt: string;
}> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ token });
  return requestAccountApi(`/accounts/api/workspace-invites/preview/?${params.toString()}`);
}

export async function acceptWorkspaceInvite(token: string): Promise<{
  joined: boolean;
  alreadyMember: boolean;
  workspace: OrganizationWorkspace;
}> {
  return requestAccountApi("/accounts/api/workspace-invites/accept/", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: await accountCsrfHeaders(),
    body: JSON.stringify({ token }),
  });
}

export async function getWorkspaceActivity(workspaceId: string): Promise<WorkspaceActivityEvent[]> {
  const result = await requestAccountApi<{ events: WorkspaceActivityEvent[] }>(
    `/accounts/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/activity/`,
  );
  return result.events;
}

# BlueDrive share-access test hotfix

## Why the original test failed
The `active_tenant_required` decorator returns 403 for authenticated staff accounts with no active tenant membership. That occurs before per-file access logic can produce 404. The original test expected 404 and 302 even though the request never reached the file view.

## Changes
- `backend/sharing/tests.py`: Update expectations to 403 for the staff-without-membership test, keeping mutation-safety assertions.
- Add a regression test for ACTIVE `PlatformAdminIdentity`: the platform-admin middleware must deny every Drive operation with 403.
- No changes to production code, permissions, database tables, quota or share logging.

## Apply
From SecureDrive project root (PowerShell):

```powershell
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\BlueDrive-Share-Access-Test-Hotfix.zip" -DestinationPath "." -Force
python .\backend\manage.py test sharing.tests.SharingAccessTests.test_platform_staff_does_not_bypass_file_permissions sharing.tests.SharingAccessTests.test_active_platform_admin_is_blocked_from_drive_endpoints -v 2
python .\backend\manage.py test sharing.tests -v 2
```

## Verification
Python AST syntax checked; Django integration tests must be run on the user's Windows environment.

# BlueDrive: quota plans and sharing-size removal

## Changes

- Quota Plans now have `Delete` actions (Super Admin only, reason 8-500 characters, audited).
- The `free` and `workspace-starter` plans cannot be deleted or disabled.
- Assigned plans cannot be deleted: quota allocations and plan references are preserved.
- Plan directory shows active plans by default; `Show inactive` reveals archived ones.
- Existing plan cleanup is an explicit management command, dry-run by default.
- Share-size policy controls and enforcement are removed for direct file and folder sharing.
- Warning/critical quota thresholds remain configurable at `/accounts/api/admin/quota-policy/`.
- The old `StoragePolicy.max_personal_file_bytes` column is **retained but ignored** for historical compatibility; it is no longer read by share endpoints or editable through the API. No migration needed.
- Plan audit history is preserved. New events record plan deletions and archival.

## Install (project root on Windows PowerShell)

Before applying: commit or back up code and PostgreSQL. Close Django, Next.js and workers.

    Expand-Archive -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\BlueDrive-Quota-Plan-Cleanup-Fix.zip" -DestinationPath "." -Force

Then validate:

    python .\backend\manage.py check
    python .\backend\manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
    python .\backend\manage.py test accounts.test_admin_plan_policy accounts.test_quota_management sharing.tests -v 2
    cd frontend
    npm run build

## Clean obsolete plan presets

The code patch itself does **not** change database plan rows.
Run the dry-run first from the project root:

    python .\backend\manage.py prune_storage_plans

After inspecting the output and backing up PostgreSQL, apply it as your Super Admin:

    python .\backend\manage.py prune_storage_plans --apply --actor YOUR_SUPERADMIN_USERNAME

Only `free` and `workspace-starter` will remain active. Other unassigned
presets are **deleted**, while assigned presets are disabled and hidden
from the active list. Assigned quota limits, references and files remain unchanged.
The command is repeatable. `Show inactive` can reveal assigned legacy presets.

## Limitations

- Integration tests and production Next.js build were not run in this container.
- The new API endpoints require the latest matching frontend and backend; restart both.
- This does not reassign old quotas to Free or Workspace Starter or change the default
  quota for newly created accounts/workspaces. Existing quotas remain as configured.
- Historical direct-sharing size settings stay in an unused DB column; no restriction is applied.

# BlueDrive Activity History & Search History patch

This patch addresses **visibility of existing history**; it does not recreate missing audit events.

## Scope

- Activity History: remove the action-type filter; server sorts newest first (`created_at DESC, pk DESC`). Keep double-click details modal.
- Fetch 50 records at a time and offer "Load older activity" and "Load older searches". Each list uses independent requests and error messages.
- Search History: display all stored search queries without applying the Activity date filter. Its records are in the `logs_searchhistory` database table, separate from ActivityLog.
- Django endpoints `/accounts/api/me/activity/` and `/accounts/api/me/search-history/` accept `offset` and return `hasMore`; old response keys (`events`, `items`) remain intact.
- Add a read-only diagnostics command with per-user counts. No data migration or destructive operation.

## Install (PowerShell from project root)

Back up/commit current source first. Stop Django and Next.js, then:

```powershell
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\BlueDrive-Activity-History-Recovery-Fix.zip" -DestinationPath . -Force
python .\backend\manage.py check
python .\backend\manage.py test accounts.test_activity_history_pagination dashboard.test_search_activity files.tests.test_activity_log_transfers files.tests.test_download_security accounts.test_self_service_api -v 2
cd frontend
npm run build
```

Restart Django and Next.js. At Settings > Privacy: reset Activity date filters if set, click Refresh, and use "Load older activity" or "Load older searches". Rows are sorted newest first.

## Diagnose absent events (read-only)

```powershell
python .\backend\manage.py inspect_activity_history --username YOUR_USERNAME
```

Interpretation:
- SearchHistory > 0: existing queries should display in Search History. If zero, verify that searching from Drive creates a row. Cleared/deleted history cannot be inferred from ActivityLog if earlier metadata stored only query length; restore from a PostgreSQL backup if required.
- UPLOAD > 0: recorded successful uploads should appear in Activity History as pages are loaded. A historical successful upload **from before event recording was introduced** does not automatically become an audit event.
- Upload sessions in VERIFYING/SCANNING: start/verify the separate worker `python .\backend\manage.py run_upload_finalizer` and check its output. A successful multipart upload produces its UPLOAD event only after AVAILABLE publication.
- DOWNLOAD > 0: existing successful download events should appear as pages are loaded. A blocked/failed download intentionally creates no successful DOWNLOAD event.

This patch does not alter upload/download event creation paths because the latest source already records successful multipart finalization and successful single-file downloads; the actual database counts and worker state must be checked first.

## Validation scope

Verified locally: Python syntax, TypeScript/TSX syntax parsing, ZIP integrity. Full Django integration tests and Next.js production build require installed project dependencies and access to your test database. No migrations are needed.
